# _Amanita phalloides_

[Audio 1](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Amanita_phalloides)[](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fayil:En-Amanita_phalloides.ogg "Play audio")Duration: 1 minute and 24 seconds.1:24[](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fayil:En-Amanita_phalloides.ogg)

sauyin sa

**_Amanita_ phalloides**_(/æməˈnaɪtə pawnˈlɔɪdiːz/ am-ə-NITE-ə pawn-LOYD-eez), wanda aka fi sani da **murfin mutuwa**, ƙwayoyin cuta ne masu guba da ƙwayoyin ƙwayoyin halitta, ɗaya daga cikin da yawa a cikin jinsin Amanita. Ya samo asali ne a Turai [[1]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Amanita\_phalloides#cite\_note-1) amma daga baya aka gabatar da shi zuwa wasu sassan duniya tun daga ƙarshen karni na ashirin, [[2]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Amanita\_phalloides#cite\_note-Litten75-2)[[3]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Amanita\_phalloides#cite\_note-MedJAus1993-3)[[4]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Amanita\_phalloides#cite\_note-Kurtziana1983-4)_ A. phalloides _ya samar da ectomycorrhizas tare da itatuwa daban-daban.[[5]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Amanita\_phalloides#cite\_note-5) A wasu lokuta, an gabatar da murfin mutuwa zuwa sabbin yankuna tare da noman nau'ikan itacen oak, chestnut, da Pine. Manyan jikin 'ya'yan itace suna bayyana a lokacin rani da kaka; ƙwanƙolin suna da launin kore tare da fararen stipe da gills. Launi na murfin yana da bambanci, gami da fararen siffofi, don haka ba abin dogaro ba ne._

Wadannan ƙwayoyin ƙwayoyin cuta suna kama da nau'ikan da za a iya cinyewa da yawa (musamman ƙwayoyin Kaisar da ƙwayoyin ciyawa) waɗanda mutane ke cinyewa, suna ƙara haɗarin guba ta haɗari. Amatoxins, nau'in guba da aka samu a cikin waɗannan ƙwayoyin, suna da tsayayya da zafi: suna tsayayya le canje-canje saboda zafi da sanyi, don haka tasirin su mai guba ba a rage su ta hanyar dafa ko daskarewa ba.

## Tarihin lissafi

[[gyara sashe](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Amanita_phalloides&veaction=edit&section=1 "Gyara sashe: Tarihin lissafi") | [gyara masomin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Amanita_phalloides&action=edit&section=1 "Edit section's source code: Tarihin lissafi")]

An sanya sunan murfin mutuwa a cikin [Latin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Harshen_Latin "Harshen Latin") kamar haka a cikin wasiku tsakanin likitan Ingila [Thomas Browne](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Thomas_Browne?action=edit&redlink=1 "Thomas Browne (babu wannan shafin)") da [Christopher Merrett](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Christopher_Merrett?action=edit&redlink=1 "Christopher Merrett (babu wannan shafin)") . Masanin tsire-tsire na Faransa [Sébastien Vaillant](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/S%C3%A9bastien_Vaillant?action=edit&redlink=1 "Sébastien Vaillant (babu wannan shafin)") ne [An bayyana shi](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Species_description?action=edit&redlink=1 "Species description (babu wannan shafin)") a cikin 1727, wanda ya ba da ɗan gajeren kalma mai suna "Fungus phalloides, annulatus, sordide virescens, et patulus" (shaped phallus, ring-stemmed, dirty green mushroom tare da babban 'spreading' cap.p).

title: Timbuktu
text:
# Timbuktu


**Timbuktu** birni ne, da ke a yankin Tombouctou, aƙasarn[Mali](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mali "Mali") yammacin Afirka. Jami'ar Sankore da sauran makarantun addinin musulunci ko madrasas suna cikin gari. Garin yana da mahimmanci ga tunani da kuma addini a ƙarni na goma sha’biyar 15 da goma sha’shidda 16. Yana da mahimmanci wajen yada [addinin Musulunci](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Musulunci "Musulunci") ta hanyar [Afirka](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Afirka "Afirka") a wancan lokacin. Akwai manyan [masallatai](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Masallaci "Masallaci") guda uku: Djingareyber, Sankore da Sidi Yahya.Tunatarwa ne game da zamanin zinar Timbuktu. Kullum ana gyara su, amma ana musu barazana saboda hamada tana yaduwa. [[1]](#cite_note-1)

Mutanen Songhay, Abzinawa, Fulani, da na Mandé sune ke zaune a Timbuktu. Shi yana kilomita goma sha’biyar 15 arewa daa [Kogin Neja](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Neja_(kogi) "Neja (kogi)") . Akwai hanya ta [hamadar Sahara](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sahara "Sahara") daga gabas zuwa yamma kuma ana amfani da wannan don kasuwanci . Akwai wani daga arewa zuwa kudu . Waɗannan hanyoyi biyu sun haɗu a Timbuktu. Yana da wani *entrepôt* ga dutse gishiri daga Taoudenni . Wannan yana nufin cewa an kawo gishirin nan kuma a sayar wa wasu mutane su kai shi wani wuri, amma ba a biyan haraji .

Wurin ya taimaka mutane daban-daban sun haɗu, don haka mutanen gida, [Abzinawa](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Abzinawa "Abzinawa") da [Larabawa suka](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Larabawa "Larabawa") haɗu anan. Tana da dogon tarihi na cakuɗa kasuwancin [Afirka](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Afirka "Afirka"), don haka ya zama sananne a [Turai](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Turai "Turai") saboda wannan dalili. Saboda haka, mutanen yamma suna yawan tunanin Timbuktu a matsayin na musamman. Tana da yanayin hamada mai zafi ( *BWh* a cikin ƙirar yanayin Koeppen ).

[Timbuktu ya ba Musulunci](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Musulunci "Musulunci") na duniya damar bincike da nazari. [[2]](#cite_note-2) An rubuta littattafai masu mahimmanci kuma an kwafa su a Timbuktu a cikin ƙarni na 14. Wannan ya sa garin ya zama cibiyar rubutu a [Afirka](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Afirka "Afirka").

# Amurka

*Wannan Muƙalar **guntuwa** ce: tana buƙatar a inganta ta, kuna iya [gyara ta](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Amurka&action=edit).*

Tarihin kafuwar United States of America 🇺🇸

🌍 Asalin farko (kafin Turawa)

Kafin zuwan Turawa, yankin Amurka ya kasance cike da ƙabilun asali (Native Americans) waɗanda suka zauna a wurin tsawon dubban shekaru suna nan.

Sun kasance da al’adu da tsarin rayuwa daban-daban.

🚢 Zuwa Turawa

A shekarar 1492, Christopher Columbus ya isa nahiyar Amurka (duk da bai isa yankin USA kai tsaye ba).

Daga baya Turawa daga ƙasashe kamar England, Spain da Faransa suka fara kafa mazauna a yankin.

🏘️ Mulkin mallaka (Colonies)

Zuwa ƙarni na 17, Ingila ta kafa ƙasashe 13 (Thirteen Colonies) a gabashin Amurka.

Waɗannan yankuna suna ƙarƙashin ikon sarautar Ingila.

⚔️ Yaƙin ‘Yancin Kai

A shekarun 1770s, rikici ya tashi tsakanin mazauna yankin da Ingila saboda haraji da rashin ‘yanci.

Wannan ya kai ga American Revolutionary War.

📜 Sanarwar ‘Yancin Kai

A ranar 4 ga Yuli, 1776, aka fitar da Declaration of Independence.

Jagorori kamar Thomas Jefferson sun rubuta takardar.

Wannan ya nuna cewa yankunan sun balle daga Ingila.

🏛️ Kafuwar ƙasa

Bayan nasara a yaƙi, an kafa sabuwar ƙasa mai suna United States of America.

A shekarar 1787, aka rubuta kundin tsarin mulki (Constitution).

A 1789, George Washington ya zama shugaban ƙasa na farko.

🌎 Faɗaɗa ƙasa

Daga baya Amurka ta faɗaɗa ta hanyar saye da yaƙe-yaƙe.

Ta zama ɗaya daga cikin manyan ƙasashe acikin duniya.

📌 Kammalawa

Kafuwar Amurka ta samo asali ne daga mulkin mallaka na Ingila, zuwa yaƙin neman ‘yanci, sannan ta zama ƙasa mai cikakken iko. Yanzu tana daga cikin ƙasashe mafi ƙarfi a duniya.

intanet ta haɗa duka duniya wuri ɗaya domin mutanen su tattauna, su nemi ilimi, su yi kasuwanci, su nishaɗantu ko su ajiye bayani.

Al'ummar wasu garuruwan arewacin Zamfara da ke Najeriya, na ci gaba kokawa akan katsewar Internet a wasu yankunansu tsawon wattani uku ba tare da sanar da su dalilan da ya sa hukumomi suka ɗauki matakin hakan ba. Al'ummar kananan hukumomin Kauran Namoda da Shinkafi da Zurmi da kuma Birnin Magaji, sun ce rashin intanet din ya jefa su cikin tsaka mai wuya. Mazauna wadannan yankuna sun ce rashin intanet din ya sanya ala tilas suna tsallakawa zuwa yankunan makwabtansu kafin su samu intanet don biyan bukatunsu. Kwamared Abdulrazak Bello Kaura, shi ne sakataren watsa labarai na kungiyar kula da ci gaban Kauran Namoda, ya shaida wa BBC cewa, da farko matsalar ta fara da rashin iya kiran waya sai mun je har Gusau, sannan zamu iya kiran waya. Ya ce,"To daga baya sai aka dawo ana iya kiran waya, daga nan kuma sai intanet y afara daukewa, ya zamana bama iya siyan data ballanata mu yi abu da ya shafi amfani da intanet da wayoyinmu na salula ko kuma kwamfuta. "Ba ma iya komai sai dai mu je shagunan da ke amfani da intanet wanda suke siya don yi sana'a wanda anan idan kaje kudin da zaka biya don tura wani sako ko amfani da intanet din ta sun a wani kankanin lokaci na da yawan gaske." In ji shi. Kwamared Abdulrazak Bello Kaura, ya ce "Wannan matsala ta rashin intanet din ta tilastawa matasa da dama barin gari domin su je ci gaba da harkokinsu na kasuwanci da suke amfani da intanet,"

‎Manhajar intanet biyar da gwamnatin Najeriya ta yi gargadi kan sauke su

‎21 Nuwamba 2022

‎Shawarwari bakwai kan yadda za ku yi amfani da wayarku

‎25 Fabrairu 2024

‎Ko ya kamata gwamnatocin Afirka su dakatar da TikTok?

‎4 Aprilu 2023

‎Ya ce," Matasa musamman mata da ke amfani da intanet wajen tallata wasu kaya da suke sayarwa, yanzu komai ya tsaya cak, kuma hakan ya kara haifar da matsin lamba da damuwa da talauci a tsakanin al'ummarmu."Dan wasan Barcelona, Lionel Messi, ya kafa sabon tarihi a fagen kwallon kafa inda ya zarta tsohon dan kwallon Brazil Pele, wanda ya zura kwallaye 75 a shekara daya. Kafin wannan lokaci, Pele ne na biyu a tarihin zura kwallaye masu yawa cikin shekara guda, inda yake bayan Gerd Muller, wanda ya ci kwallaye 85 a wasanni 60 lokacin da yake kulob din Bayern Munich da Jamus ta Yamma a shekarar 1972. Sai dai a yanzu Messi, dan shekaru 25, shi ne ke bin bayan Muller, bayan da ya zura kwallaye biyu a wasan da kulob din sa ya buga da Mallorca ranar Lahadi. Don haka yanzu ya zura kwallaye 76 a wasanni 59 da ya buga. Hakan dai ya sanya shi a hanyar lashe kyautar Ballon d'Or a karo na hudu a jere.

title: Buta
text:
# Buta

**Buta**, wani lokaci ana kiransa da **tea kettle** ko **teakettle**, wata na'ura ce da aka ƙera don tafasa ruwa, yawanci tana da _murfi_, _magudanar ruwa_, da _zare_. Akwai nau'ikan guda biyu: _stovetop buta_, wanda ke amfani da zafi daga [hob](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cooktop?action=edit&redlink=1 "Cooktop (babu wannan shafin)"), da _electric buta_, wanda wani [karamin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Small_appliance?action=edit&redlink=1 "Small appliance (babu wannan shafin)")[na'ura](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kitchen_appliance?action=edit&redlink=1 "Kitchen appliance (babu wannan shafin)") ce tare da [na'ura mai zafi](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Heating_element?action=edit&redlink=1 "Heating element (babu wannan shafin)") a ciki.

**Buta:** wani abu ne da ake amfani da shi wajen ɗaukar ruwa ko kuma wankan tsarki, ana kuma amfani da shi wajen wanke hannu da fuska.

## Etymology

[[gyara sashe](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Buta&veaction=edit&section=1 "Gyara sashe: Etymology") | [gyara masomin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Buta&action=edit&section=1 "Edit section's source code: Etymology")]

Kalmar _buta_ ta samo asali ne daga tsohuwar harshen Norse _ketill_, "[cauldron](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cauldron?action=edit&redlink=1 "Cauldron (babu wannan shafin)")". Rubutun Tsohon Ingilishi shine _cetel_ tare da farkon _che-_ [tʃ] kamar 'cherry', Middle English (da kuma yare) shine _chetel_, duk sun fito (tare da Jamusanci _Kessel_ "cauldron") daga Germanic _*katilaz_, wanda aka aro daga Latin _catillus_, ƙaramin nau'i na _catinus_ "tukunyar zurfi don hidima ko dafa abinci",[[1]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Buta#cite_note-1) wanda a cikin mahallin daban-daban ake fassara shi da "kwano", "tukunyar zurfi", ko "rariya".

## Stovetop butas

[[gyara sashe](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Buta&veaction=edit&section=2 "Gyara sashe: Stovetop butas") | [gyara masomin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Buta&action=edit&section=2 "Edit section's source code: Stovetop butas")]


A [stovetop](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Stovetop?action=edit&redlink=1 "Stovetop (babu wannan shafin)") buta on a [gas burner](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gas_burner?action=edit&redlink=1 "Gas burner (babu wannan shafin)"); this type, without a lid, is filled through the spout.

buta na zamani na stovetop wani tukunyar ƙarfe ce tare da ƙasa madaidaiciya da ake amfani da ita don dumama ruwa akan [stovetop ko hob](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Stovetop?action=edit&redlink=1 "Stovetop (babu wannan shafin)"). Yawanci suna da zare a saman, magudanar ruwa, da murfi. Wasu kuma suna da wani [kukin tururi](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Whistle?action=edit&redlink=1 "Whistle (babu wannan shafin)") wanda ke nuna lokacin da ruwan ya kai ga tafasa. Ana yin butas yawanci da [stainless steel](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Stainless_steel?action=edit&redlink=1 "Stainless steel (babu wannan shafin)") amma kuma ana iya yin su daga tagulla ko wasu ƙarfe.

## Electric butas

[[gyara sashe](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Buta&veaction=edit&section=3 "Gyara sashe: Electric butas") | [gyara masomin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Buta&action=edit&section=3 "Edit section's source code: Electric butas")]


An electric buta , with boiling water visible in its transparent water chamber

A kasashe da ke da wutar lantarki 200–240 V, ana amfani da butas na lantarki sosai don tafasa ruwa ba tare da bukatar murhu ba. Ana rufe na'urar dumama gaba ɗaya, tare da ƙimar ƙarfin wuta na 2–3 kW. Wannan yana nufin cewa ana ɗaukar wutar lantarki har zuwa 13 A, wanda yake da ƙima mai yawa daga cikin wutar da ake samu a yawancin gidaje: [babban fuse](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fuse_(electrical)?action=edit&redlink=1 "Fuse (electrical) (babu wannan shafin)") na yawancin gidaje yana tsakanin 20 da 100 amps. A kasashe da ke da wutar lantarki 120 V, ana ɗaukar sau biyu na wutar lantarki don samun ƙarfin wuta iri ɗaya.[[2]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Buta#cite_note-2)

[Fayil:Thermal Vision video of a butasof water being boiled.webm](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/Special:UploadWizard?uselang=ha&wpDestFile=Thermal_Vision_video_of_a_butasof_water_being_boiled.webm "Fayil:Thermal Vision video of a butasof water being boiled.webm")

Thermal Vision video of water being boiled in an electric buta

A cikin ƙira na zamani, da zarar ruwan ya kai ga tafasa, buta ɗin yana kashe kansa ta atomatik, yana hana ruwan tafasa har ya ƙare kuma ya lalata na'urar dumama.

### Bincike

[[gyara sashe](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Buta&veaction=edit&section=4 "Gyara sashe: Bincike") | [gyara masomin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Buta&action=edit&section=4 "Edit section's source code: Bincike")]

buta na lantarki suka zama wata matsayin sauƙi don butas na stovetop a ƙarshe na karshen shekara ta 19. A 1893, kamfanin Crompton da Co. a Birnin Birtaniya ya fara amfani da butas na lantarki a cikin [Samfuri:Trade literature](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Samfuri:Trade_literature?action=edit&redlink=1 "Samfuri:Trade literature (babu wannan shafin)") dinsa. Amma, butas na lantarki na farko sun gano sun fiye da shekara ne saboda na'urar daukar wuta ba zai iya kara da ruwa ba. A yanzu, an samu 'compartment' na kusa daga sama daga sakamako na ruwan da ake amfani dashi don daukar na'urar daukar wutan lantarki. Bayanin butas na lantarki na farko sun fi daga farko don daukar wutar lantarki na stovetop na lokacin. A 1902, 'Archer' butas na lantarki da aka rubuta da Premier Electric Heaters a Birmingham, Ingilishi, ya tattauna kama. Yana da na'urar daukar wuta mai zafi a sama na buta (ba a haifar da ruwan ba), kuma shine wani daga buta na farko da aka samu da na wutar zama mai amfani. A 1922, Leslie Large, wani injinia mai daɗin riko daga Bulpitt & Sons daga Birmingham, ya hana na'urar kwakwalwa mai da wayar da aka watsa da kuma na na'ura a ciki na tala. Na'urar zai iya daukar wutar kuma tana da matsala fiye da buta na stovetop na lokacin. A 1955, kamfanin Ingilishi mai tattalin arziki na [Russell Hobbs](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Russell_Hobbs?action=edit&redlink=1 "Russell Hobbs (babu wannan shafin)") ya raba matattar sai dai ya yi zama a wani jerin tattalin buta na stainless steel na farko na K1.[[3]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Buta#cite_note-3)

## Whistling butas

[[gyara sashe](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Buta&veaction=edit&section=5 "Gyara sashe: Whistling butas") | [gyara masomin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Buta&action=edit&section=5 "Edit section's source code: Whistling butas")]


A butas, with a detachable whistle over its spout


[Audio 1](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Buta)[](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fayil:Tea_kettle_whistle.ogg "Play audio")Duration: 41 seconds.0:41

Coming to a boil, boiling, and cooling
* * *

_Problems playing this file? See [media help](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Taimako:Media?action=edit&redlink=1 "Taimako:Media (babu wannan shafin)")._

Whistling butas shine wani tukunyar da aka kafa shi tare da wani gajeren da ya goge sautin [whistle](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Whistle?action=edit&redlink=1 "Whistle (babu wannan shafin)") lokacin da ruwan a cikin buta ya fara tafasa. Wannan aiki mai nuna goge shi ne ya kawo tsawo, kamar yadda a fashewa a fizikansa a matsayin [tone hole](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tone_hole?action=edit&redlink=1 "Tone hole (babu wannan shafin)").[[4]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Buta#cite_note-Henrywood2013-4)

Tun da haka, sabuwar fahimta da aka kasancewa an samu na jiran yadda wannan aiki ya faru a wani littafi mai suna _The Aeroacoustics of a Steam buta_, da aka rubuta ta da R. H. Henrywood, wanda yana makaranta a shekarar bakwai a farkon Ingilishi na Cambridge, da A. Agarwal, mai tsage hannu, a jaridar _[Physics of Fluids](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Physics\_of\_Fluids?action=edit&redlink=1 "Physics of Fluids (babu wannan shafin)")_ a shekara ta 2013.[[4]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Buta#cite_note-Henrywood2013-4)[[5]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Buta#cite_note-UoC-5)

Harry Bramson ne wanda ya bada buta na tea mai goge sautin.[[6]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Buta#cite_note-6)

## buta's na Tea mai atomatik

[[gyara sashe](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Buta&veaction=edit&section=6 "Gyara sashe: buta's na Tea mai atomatik") | [gyara masomin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Buta&action=edit&section=6 "Edit section's source code: buta's na Tea mai atomatik")]

butas na Tea mai atomatik sun kasance wani matsayin sauƙi don tattara inganta da shayin tea, an samu su da nau'in amfani don bada kayan abinci na tea daga baya. Bayan samun zama, butas na tea mai atomatik ya dauka ruwan har zuwa wurin har zuwa siffa don haɗa sahu gaba. Wannan shi ne saboda nau'in kayan abinci mai yawa na [tea](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tea?action=edit&redlink=1 "Tea (babu wannan shafin)") za'a buɗe a cikin saukin da take da inganci mai buƙatar karar kwabo da suke a sanyin matsala. [[7]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Buta#cite_note-7) A kowanne lokaci za su yi jin kamar jiran na biyu don yin farin ciki idan ya hau ƙarshen ruwan ya tashi, kuma yana da ingantaccen zama daga baya na ruwan bayan haɗin inganci.[[8]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Buta#cite_note-8)

# Wikipedia a harshen Hausa

_Wannan Muƙalar **guntuwa** ce: tana buƙatar a inganta ta, kuna iya [gyara ta](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Wikipedia\_a\_harshen\_Hausa&action=edit)._

title: Kakaki
text:
# Kakaki


 

**Kakaki** ƙaho ne na ƙarfe mai tsayin mita uku zuwa huɗu da ake amfani da shi wajen rera waƙar gargajiyar [Hausawa](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hausawa "Hausawa"). *Kakaki* shine sunan da ake amfani dashi a [Chadi](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cadi "Cadi"), [Burkina Faso](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Burkina_Faso "Burkina Faso"), [Ghana](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ghana "Ghana"), [Benin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Benin "Benin") [Niger](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nijar_(ƙasa) "Nijar (ƙasa)"), da [Najeriya](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Najeriya "Najeriya").[[1]](#cite_note-1)

An kuma san kayan aikin da *malakat* a [Habasha](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya "Itofiya"). [[2]](#cite_note-2) [*[ana buƙatar hujja](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Citation_needed "Wikipedia:Citation needed")*]

Wani tsohon kayan aiki, kakaki ya kasance babba a cikin a kan [Songhai](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mutanen_Songhai "Mutanen Songhai"). Sautinsa yana da alaƙa da sarauta kuma ana yinsa ne kawai a abubuwan da ake yi a fadar sarki ko sarki a cikin al'ummar Hausawa. [[3]](#cite_note-3)Ana amfani da shi azaman ɓangare na *sara*, sanarwa na mako-mako na iko da iko. Kakaki maza ne ke wasa dashi.

title: Islam
text:
# Musulunci

 Wata yarinya a Karanta Alqur'ani Mai girma



dakin Allah (S WA)


gurin ibadan musulmai

[[1]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Islam#cite_note-:0-1)**Addinin Musulunci** (Islama;[[2]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Islam#cite_note-2)[Larabci](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Larabci "Larabci"): ٱلْإِسْلَام‎, romanized:_al-Islām_, Turanci: Islam) Shi ne shaidawa babu abun bautawa da gaskiya sai [Allah](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Allah "Allah"), kuma [Annabi Muhammad](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Annabi_Muhammad "Annabi Muhammad") (S A W) bawan Allah ne kuma manzon Allah ne.[[3]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Islam#cite_note-3)[[4]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Islam#cite_note-4)[[5]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Islam#cite_note-5)[[6]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Islam#cite_note-6)[[7]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Islam#cite_note-7)[[8]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Islam#cite_note-:1-8)

Addinin yana da alaƙa da [Annabi Ibrahim](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Annabi_Ibrahim "Annabi Ibrahim") kuma ya ƙunshi hukunce-hukunce daga [Alqur'ani](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Alqur'ani_mai_girma "Alqur'ani mai girma") da kuma koyarwar Manzon tsira Annabi Muhammad (s a w) wanda shine ya zo da littafin sannan akwai aƙalla mabiya addinin [musulunci](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Musulunci) mutum biliyan ɗaya da ɗugo tara (1.9B). Addinin musulunci shine addini na biyu dangane da yawan mabiya bayan addinin [Kirista](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kirista "Kirista").[[9]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Islam#cite_note-www.pewresearch.org-2022-9)[[10]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Islam#cite_note-10)[[11]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Islam#cite_note-11)

[Annabi Muhammad](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Annabi_Muhammad "Annabi Muhammad") (S AW) tsira da amincin Allah su tabbata a gareshi,[[12]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Islam#cite_note-12) shine manzo wanda [Allah](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Allah "Allah") ya aiko shi zuwa ga mutane baki ɗaya kuma na ƙarshen/cikamakin annabawa a Duniya domin ya sake jaddada addinin Allah, a yi imani da Allah wanda ya halicci kowa da komai.

Addinin musulunci na da mabiya a duk faɗin ƙasashen Duniya kuma mafiya yawa su na zaune ne a yankin gabas ta tsakiya, da yankin Afirka ta arewa waɗanda mafi yawancinsu Larabawa ne masu bin addinin musulunci, sai dai akwai ɗinbin mabiya addinin musulunci a ko'ina a faɗin duniya.[[13]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Islam#cite_note-13) Ma'anar addinin Musulunci shine yarda da miƙa wuya da kaɗaita [Allah](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Allah "Allah") Maɗaukakin Sarki, wato shaidawa babu abin bautawa da gaskiya sai Allah kuma Annabi Muhammad (s.a.w) Manzon Allah ne.[[14]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Islam#cite_note-14)[[15]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Islam#cite_note-15)[[16]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Islam#cite_note-16)[[17]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Islam#cite_note-17)[[18]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Islam#cite_note-18)

Musulmai sun yi imani cewa addinin Musulunci shine cikakken addini kuma addini na gaskiya wanda aka turo [Annabawa da manzanni](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Annabi "Annabi") da yawa a baya, wanda suka haɗa da kakanmu [Annabi Adamu](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Adamu_a_Musulunci "Adamu a Musulunci"), Annabi Nuhu, [Annabi Ibrahim](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Annabi_Ibrahim "Annabi Ibrahim"), [Annabi Musa](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Annabi_Musa "Annabi Musa") da kuma [Annabi Isah](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Annabi_Isah "Annabi Isah").[[19]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Islam#cite_note-19)[[20]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Islam#cite_note-20)[[21]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Islam#cite_note-21)[[22]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Islam#cite_note-22)

Har wa yau, Musulmai sun yi imani cewa Alqur'ani maganar Allah ne, kuma saƙon Ubangiji ne na ƙarshe wanda babu tawaya a cikin shi. Tare da Alqur'ani, Musulmai sunyi imani da sauran littattafan da aka turo kamar [Attaura](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Attaura_a_Musulunci "Attaura a Musulunci"), Zabura da Injila. Kuma Annabi [Muhammad (SAW)](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Muhammad "Muhammad") shine cikamakin Annabawan Musulunci, kuma ta shine addinin Musulunci ya cika. Koyarwarsa da umurninsa ana ƙiran su da [Sunnah](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sunnah "Sunnah") wanda aka rubuta a littattafai da ake ƙira [Hadisi](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hadisi "Hadisi"), wanda ke koyar da tsarin mulki da rayuwa.

ANNABAWA

An yi imani da cewa Allah Ta’ala ne ya zaɓi [annabawa](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Annabawa "Annabawa") (Larabci: أنبياء, anbiyāʾ) domin su yi wa’azin saƙon Allah. Wasu daga cikin waɗannan annabawan kuma suna zuwa da sabon littafi, kuma ana kiran su “manzanni” (رسول, rasūl). Musulmai sun gaskata cewa annabawa mutane ne, ba alloli ba. An ce dukkan annabawan sun yi wa’azin saƙon Musulunci guda ɗaya – wato miƙa wuya ga nufin Allah – ga al’ummomi dabam-dabam a zamanin da suka gabata, kuma wannan shi ne dalilin da ake cewa ya haifar da kamanceceniya da yawa tsakanin addinai. [Alqur’ani](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Alqur'ani_mai_girma "Alqur'ani mai girma") ya ambaci sunayen mutane da yawa waɗanda ake ɗauka a matsayin annabawa a Musulunci, ciki har da Adamu, Nuhu, Ibrahim, Musa, Dawuda da Isa, alaihimus salam, da sauransu. Labaran da suka shafi annabawan da suka wuce abin da Alqur’ani ya ambata an tattara su kuma an yi nazari a kansu a cikin [Qisas al-Anbiya](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Qisas_al-Anbiya "en:Qisas al-Anbiya") (Labarun Annabawa).[[1]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Islam#cite_note-:0-1)[[23]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Islam#cite_note-23)

Musulmai sun yi imani cewa Allah Ya aiko Muhammadu (Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) a matsayin annabi na ƙarshe (“Hatimin Annabawa”) domin ya isar da cikakken saƙon Musulunci. A Musulunci, misalin rayuwar Muhammadu (S.A.W.) wanda ya zama abin koyi shi ake kira [sunnah](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sunnah "Sunnah") (a zahiri “hanyar da aka bi”). Ana ƙarfafa Musulmai su yi koyi da ɗabi’un Muhammadu (S.A.W.) a rayuwarsu ta yau da kullum, kuma ana ganin sunnah tana da muhimmanci wajen jagorantar fassarar Alqur’ani. Wannan misali an kiyaye shi a cikin hadisai da ake kira hadisi, waɗanda suka ƙunshi ruwayoyin maganganunsa, ayyukansa, da halayensa. Hadisi Qudsi wani nau’i ne na hadisi, wanda ake ɗauka a matsayin kalmomin Allah na zahiri da Muhammadu (S.A.W.) ya ruwaito, waɗanda ba sa cikin Alƙur’ani. Hadisi yana ƙunshe da abubuwa biyu: sarkar masu ruwaya, da ake kira sanad, da kuma ainihin lafazin, da ake kira matn. Akwai hanyoyi dabam-dabam na rarraba ingancin hadisai, inda ma’aunin da aka fi amfani da shi ya kasance: “sahihi” ko “ingantacce” (صحيح, ṣaḥīḥ); “hasan” ko “mai kyau” (حسن, ḥasan); ko “ɗa’if” ko “mai rauni” (ضعيف, ḍaʻīf), [[24]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Islam#cite_note-24)da sauransu. [Kutub al-Sittah](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kutub_al-Sittah "Kutub al-Sittah") tarin littattafai ne guda shida, waɗanda ake ɗauka a matsayin mafiya ingantattun ruwayoyi a Musuluncin Ahlus-Sunnah. Daga cikinsu akwai [Sahih al-Bukhari](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sahi_al-Bukhari "Sahi al-Bukhari"), wanda galibi Ahlus-Sunnah suke ɗaukarsa a matsayin ɗaya daga cikin mafiya ingantattun madogara bayan Alƙur’ani. Wani sanannen tushen hadisai kuma shi ne Littattafai Huɗu [(Al-Kutub al-Arba’ah](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Four_Books "en:The Four Books")), waɗanda ‘yan Shi’a suke ɗauka a matsayin mafiya ingantaccen tushen hadisi.[[8]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Islam#cite_note-:1-8)[[25]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Islam#cite_note-25)

title: Harshen Igbo
text:
# Harshen Igbo

The **modern Igbo alphabet** (Igbo: Mkpụrụ Edemede Igbo), otherwise known as the **Igbo alphabet** (_Mkpụrụ Edemede Igbo_[[1]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Harshen_Igbo#cite_note-1)), is the alphabet of the [Igbo language](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Harshen_Ibo "Harshen Ibo"), it is one of the three national [languages of Nigeria](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Harsunan_Najeriya "Harsunan Najeriya").[[2]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Harshen_Igbo#cite_note-2) The modern Igbo alphabet is made up of 36 letters,[[3]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Harshen_Igbo#cite_note-3) which includes only a 24-letter set of the ISO basic Latin alphabet minus Q and X, which are not part of Abidịị Igbo. C is not used other than in the digraph 'ch'. The alphabet uses the dot above on the letter Ṅ, and the dot below on Ị, Ọ and Ụ.

Akwai yarukan Igbo da yawa, wasu daga cikinsu ba su da fahimta. Hanyar rubuce-rubucen Igbo ta dogara ne akan yarukan Owerri da Umuahia na Igbo.

An gabatar da _Sabon Tsarin Orthography_ ga Igbo, kuma an yi amfani da shi, alal misali, a cikin 1998 Igbo English Dictionary by [Michael Echeruo](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Michael_Echeruo "Michael Echeruo"), amma ba a karɓa ba. A cikin wannan rubutun, [diaeresis](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/%CC%88?action=edit&redlink=1 "̈ (babu wannan shafin)") ya maye gurbin maɓallin da ke ƙasa (ï ö ü).

title: Asim Basu
text:
# Asim Basu

An haife shi a cikin shekarar 1935, ga Motilal Basu da Bijanbala Basu a ƙauyen Kakhada, Bhogarai, gundumar Balasore. Lokacin da Basu ya kasance a [Kolkata](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kolkata "Kolkata"), a lokacin karatunsa na kwaleji, ya sami damar yin aiki tare da ɗan wasan kwaikwayo Utpal Dutt a gidan wasan kwaikwayo na Minerva, Kolkata kuma basirarsa ta bunƙasa wajen yin wasan kwaikwayo, jagora da tsarawa a can. Ya dawo [Odisha](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Odisha "Odisha") kuma ya kafa kungiyar wasan kwaikwayo "Rupakar".[[3]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Asim_Basu#cite_note-TP-3)ta

## Sana'a

[[gyara sashe](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Asim_Basu&veaction=edit&section=2 "Gyara sashe: Sana'a") | [gyara masomin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Asim_Basu&action=edit&section=2 "Edit section's source code: Sana'a")]

Basu ya fara fitowa a wasa a matsayin darakta tare da Bijay Mishra na 'Duiti Surya Dagdha Phula Ku Nei'. Ya jagoranci wasanni kusan 200. Ya yi aiki a matsayin mai tsarawa na wasanni sama da 500 kuma shine darektan fasaha na fina-finan Odia da yawa. Ya kasance daraktan fasaha a fina-finai kamar Chha Mana Atha Guntha, Indradhanura Chhai da Shodh (Hindi). Ya kuma yi fitowa a cikin fina-finai da film na Tele da yawa kamar Chha Mana Atha Guntha, Jaga Balia da Dadagiri.

## Mutuwa

# Kairo


Kairo.


Kairo


Cairo by night

**Birnin Kairo**, da turanci _Cairo_, Larabci _Alqahira_. Birni ne dake a lardin Kairo, a ƙasar [Misra](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Misra "Misra"). Shi ne babban birnin ƙasar Misra kuma babban birnin lardin Kairo. Bisa ga ƙidayar jama'a a shekarar 2010, akwai jimilar mutane kimanin 20,439,541 (miliyan ashirin da dubu dari huɗu da talatin da tara da ɗari biyar da arba'in da ɗaya). An gina birnin Kairo a ƙarni na goma bayan haihuwar [Isa (AS)](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Annabi_Isa "Annabi Isa").

title: 1940 Wasan kwallon kafa na Mandatory Palestine da Lebanon
text:
# 1940 Wasan kwallon kafa na Mandatory Palestine da Lebanon

Wasan kwallon kafa na 1940 tsakanin kungiyoyin kasa na [Mandatory Palestine](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mandatory_Palestine?action=edit&redlink=1 "Mandatory Palestine (babu wannan shafin)") da Lebanon shine wasan farko na kasa da kasa na karshe, kuma na karshe kafin su zama tawagar kasar [Isra'ila](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Isra'ila "Isra'ila") bayan 1948. Wasan ya faru ne a ranar 27 ga Afrilu 1940 a Filin wasa na Maccabiah a [Tel Aviv](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tel_Abib "Tel Abib") . John Blackwell na Sojojin [Burtaniya](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Burtaniya "Burtaniya") ne ya tsara wasan, masu kallo tsakanin 6,000 da 10,000 ne suka kalli wasan kuma ya ƙare a cikin nasara 5-1 ga gida.

Falasdi u ta zira kwallaye a minti na biyu na wasan, ta ninka jagorancin su minti 10 bayan haka tare da kisa. Ƙarin kwallaye biyu daga cikin gida sun nuna rabi na farko ya ƙare 4-0. Da aka tilasta maye gurbin Palasdinu a rabin lokaci saboda rauni ya hana su kula da wasan kuma a minti na biyar na rabi na biyu, dan wasan Lebanon Camille Cordahi ya zira kwallaye don zama dan wasan Lebanon na farko. Werner Kaspi ya zira kwallaye na biyu na wasan a minti na 60, tare da wasan ya ƙare 5-1.

Wasannin da suka biyo baya na Lebanon duk sun kasance wasannin sada zumunci da [Siriya](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Syria_national_football_team?action=edit&redlink=1 "Syria national football team (babu wannan shafin)"), daya a 1942 da biyu a 1947. A shekara ta 1948 tawagar Mandatory Palestine ta zama tawagar Isra'ila, tare da kafa Jihar Isra'ila. Sun buga wasan su na gaba a wasan sada zumunci da [Cyprus](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cyprus_national_football_team?action=edit&redlink=1 "Cyprus national football team (babu wannan shafin)") a shekarar 1949. Daga cikin 'yan wasa 11 na Lebanon, shida sun ci gaba da buga akalla wasa daya na kasa da kasa. [Shalom Shalomzon](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shalom_Shalomzon?action=edit&redlink=1 "Shalom Shalomzon (babu wannan shafin)") shine kawai dan wasan Palasdinu da ya sake fitowa a duniya.

A cikin shekarun 1930, [Taya](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tyre,_Lebanon?action=edit&redlink=1 "Tyre, Lebanon (babu wannan shafin)")-linkid="95>Lebanon ta kasance wurin da ake zuwa na yau da kullun don yawon shakatawa na abokantaka ta kungiyoyin [kwallon kafa](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kungiyar_Kwallon_Kafa "Kungiyar Kwallon Kafa") a Mandatory Palestine . Kungiyoyi irin su [Tel Aviv](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tel_Aviv "Tel Aviv") F.C.">Maccabi Tel Aviv, Maccabi Petah Tikva, da Maccabi Haifa suna buga wa kungiyoyi daga [Beirut](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Beirut "Beirut"), Tyre, da Sidon wasa a kai a kai.[[1]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/1940_Wasan_kwallon_kafa_na_Mandatory_Palestine_da_Lebanon#cite_note-haaretz1-1) A ƙarshen 1939, shugaban Kungiyar Kwallon Kafa ta Lebanon (LFA) Jamil Sawaya ya ziyarci iyalinsa a [Urushalima](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jerusalem "Jerusalem") da [Jaffa](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jaffa "Jaffa").[[2]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/1940_Wasan_kwallon_kafa_na_Mandatory_Palestine_da_Lebanon#cite_note-IFA-2) Sawaya tana da dangantaka ta abokantaka tare da shugabannin kungiyoyin kwallon kafa na Palasdinawa da yawa, musamman tare da shugaban Ƙungiyar Kwallon Kafa ta Falasdinu (PFA). [[2]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/1940_Wasan_kwallon_kafa_na_Mandatory_Palestine_da_Lebanon#cite_note-IFA-2) A lokacin ziyarar da ya kai Urushalima, Sawaya ya sadu da shugaban PFA, kuma kimanin makonni uku kafin wasan, tawagar Yahudawa ta Palasdinawa ta gayyaci LFA don shiga wasan sada zumunci a Tel Aviv. Kungiyar Lebanon ta yarda da gayyatar, kuma an shirya wasan ne a ranar 27 ga Afrilu 1940.[[3]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/1940_Wasan_kwallon_kafa_na_Mandatory_Palestine_da_Lebanon#cite_note-filastin-3)

text:
# Abin da ya fi dacewa (album na Barbra Streisand)

What Matters Most shi ne kundi na talatin da uku na mawaƙa na Amurka Barbra Streisand wanda aka saki a ranar 23 ga watan Agusta, 2011, ta Columbia Records. An sadaukar da shi ga kalmomin abokanta na dogon lokaci Alan da Marilyn Bergman, Streisand kanta ce ta samar da kundin. Ba a saki mutane ba don inganta kundin; an fara shi a lamba 4 a kan Billboard 200 kuma ya sami kyakkyawan bita daga masu sukar kiɗa.

Bayan da ta rubuta waƙoƙin Bergman da yawa a lokacin aikinta, Streisand ta shirya What Matters Most a matsayin damar da za ta sami wasu lu'u-lu'u daga littafin waƙoƙinsu mai yawa. Deluxe edition ya haɗa da faifai na biyu wanda ke dauke da waƙoƙin Bergman da Streisand ya riga ya rubuta.

A Grammy Awards na 54 What Matters Most an zabi shi don Mafi Kyawun Al'adun gargajiya na gargajiya. A cikin makon farko kundin ya sayar da kwafin 68,000 a Amurka da kwafin 210,000 a cikin shekara guda. Kundin ya zama kundi na huɗu na studio don kada ya sami takardar shaidar daga RIAA Certification a Amurka.

[[gyara sashe](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Abin_da_ya_fi_dacewa_(album_na_Barbra_Streisand)&veaction=edit&section=1 "Gyara sashe: Abin da ke faruwa a Starbucks") | [gyara masomin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Abin_da_ya_fi_dacewa_(album_na_Barbra_Streisand)&action=edit&section=1 "Edit section's source code: Abin da ke faruwa a Starbucks")]

A cikin gabatar da kundin, an samar da aikin Streisand na Fabrairu a MusiCares Mutum na Shekara don kallo a kan Starbucks Digital Network tsakanin Agusta 23 da 30, 2011 .

# Ibn Battuta


## Tarihin Rayuwa

[[gyara sashe](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Ibn_Battuta&veaction=edit&section=1 "Gyara sashe: Tarihin Rayuwa") | [gyara masomin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Ibn_Battuta&action=edit&section=1 "Edit section's source code: Tarihin Rayuwa")]

**Abu Abdullahi Muhammad bn Battutah** ( [/ˌ ɪ b ən b æ t ˈ t uː t ɑː/](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Taimako:IPA/English?action=edit&redlink=1 "Taimako:IPA/English (babu wannan shafin)") an haifeshi,a ranar 24 ga watan Fabrairu shekarata 1304–zuwa1368/1369), [[lower-alpha 1]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ibn_Battuta#cite_note-2) wanda aka fi sani da **Ibn Battuta**, Balarabe ne mai binciken Berber kuma masani na asalin Maghrebi . [[6]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ibn_Battuta#cite_note-7) A cikin tsawon shekaru talatin, Ibn Battuta ya ziyarci yawancin [Arewacin Afirka](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Arewacin_Afirka "Arewacin Afirka"), [Gabas ta Tsakiya](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gabas_ta_Tsakiya "Gabas ta Tsakiya"), Asiya ta Tsakiya, Kudancin Asiya, Kudu maso Gabashin Asiya, Sin, da Iberian Peninsula.

Ibn Battuta yayi tafiya fiye da Wani Mai bincike acikin tarihin kafin zamani, totalling around 117,000 km (73,000 mi), surpassing [Zheng He](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Zheng_He "Zheng He") with about 50,000 km (31,000 mi) and [Marco Polo](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Marco_Polo "Marco Polo") with 24,000 km (15,000 mi).[[7]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ibn_Battuta#cite_note-8)[[8]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ibn_Battuta#cite_note-FOOTNOTEDunn200520-9)[[9]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ibn_Battuta#cite_note-10) There have been doubts over the historicity of some of Ibn Battuta's travels, particularly as they reach further East.

title: Hausa music
text:
# Waƙoƙin Hausa

Garaya abin kidan gargajiya a Arewacin Najeriya


Masu busa Kakaki a Arewacin Najeriya

[Hausawa](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hausawa "Hausawa") suna daya daga cikin manya-manyan kabilu a Kasar [Najeriya](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Najeriya "Najeriya"), [Nijar](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nijar_(%C6%99asa) "Nijar (ƙasa)"), [Ghana](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ghana "Ghana"), [Sudan](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sudan "Sudan"), [Kamaru](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kamaru "Kamaru") da kuma yawancin kasashen yamma da tsakiyar Afirka. Su kaden ya taka wani muhimmin bangare a cikin ci gaban Nijeriya music, bayar da tasu gudunmuwar da irin wannan abubuwa a matsayin Goje, a daya-stringed irin goge. **Akwai nau'ikan kiɗe-kiɗe iri biyu na kide-kide** na gargajiya na Hausa: kidan mutanen karkara da kidan kotun birni. Sun gabatar da tsarin al'adun gargajiya na Afirka wanda har yanzu ya shahara a yau.

Ana yin kidan bikin ( _rokon fada_ ) [[1]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hausa_music#cite_note-1) a matsayin alama ta matsayi, kuma gabadaya ana zakar mawaka don dalilai na siyasa sabanin na kida. Ana iya jin kidan bikin a _sararin_ mako-mako, sanarwa ce ta sarki wanda ake yi kowace yamma Alhamis.

Courtly yabo-mawaka [[2]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hausa_music#cite_note-2) kamar mashahuri Narambada, suna kishin singing cikin falalan wani majibinci, kamar wani sultan ko sarkin. Gõdiya songs suna tare da kettledrums da _kalangu_ magana ganguna, tare da kakaki, wani irin dogon kaho samu daga cewa amfani da Songhai da sojan doki.

Kidan gargajiya na karkara ya hada da salon da ke rakiyar rawar asauwara ta 'yan mata da kuma bòòríí ko addinin Bori duka sanannun wakokinsu. [[3]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hausa_music#cite_note-3) An kawo shi har zuwa arewa kamar Tripoli, Libya ta hanyar kasuwancin Saharar Sahara. Cultungiyar ibada ta bòòríí tana gunshe da kidan trance, wanda alamar calabash, lute ko fiddle ke bugawa. Yayin bukukuwan, mata da sauran kungiyoyin da ke gefe sun fada cikin nutsuwa kuma suna yin wasu halaye marasa kyau, kamar kwaikwayon alade ko halayyar jima'i. Wadannan mutane an ce mallakar su da hali, kowanne da irin nasa kudin (kírààrì). Akwai irin wadannan kungiyoyin asiri na ruki (abin da ake kira "gungiyoyin bautar gumaka") da aka samo a yankin Neja Delta.

Fitattun Mawakan Hausa sun hada [Muhamman Shata](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mahaman_Shata "Mahaman Shata"), wanda waka tare da drummers, [Dan Maraya](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dan_Maraya_Jos "Dan Maraya Jos"), wanda ke taka wata daya-stringed lute kira wani kuntikii, Audo Yaron Goje, wanda ke taka wa Goje, da kuma Ibrahim Na Habu, wanda ke taka a ƙananan irin goge kira wani kukkuma . [[4]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hausa_music#cite_note-4)

# Achike Udenwa

**Achike Udenwa** (an haife shi a cikin shekara ta 1948) shi ne [gwamnan](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gwamna "Gwamna")[jihar Imo](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Imo "Imo") a [Najeriya](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Najeriya "Najeriya"). Ya zama gwamna bayan ya ci zaɓe a cikin shekarar 1999.[[1]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Achike_Udenwa#cite_note-1) Udenwa ya sake lashe zaɓe a shekara ta 2003, kuma wa'adinsa ya ƙare a ranar 29 ga watan Mayun shekarar 2007.[[2]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Achike_Udenwa#cite_note-2)[Ɗan jam'iyyar PDP](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Peoples_Democratic_Party "Peoples Democratic Party") ne. Udenwa kuma sarkin [Igbo](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Inyamurai "Inyamurai") ne. Cif Ikedi Ohakim ne ya gaje shi a ranar 29 ga watan Mayun 2007.

A cikin watan Disambar 2008, Shugaba [Umaru Ƴar'adua](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Umaru_Musa_Yar'Adua "Umaru Musa Yar'Adua") ya naɗa shi [ministan kasuwanci da masana'antu](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Federal_Ministry_of_Commerce_(Nigeria) "Federal Ministry of Commerce (Nigeria)").[[3]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Achike_Udenwa#cite_note-3) Ya bar mulki a cikin watan Maris ɗin shekarar 2010 lokacin da muƙaddashin shugaban ƙasa [Goodluck Jonathan](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Goodluck_Jonathan "Goodluck Jonathan") ya rusa majalisar ministocinsa.[[4]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Achike_Udenwa#cite_note-4)

title: Adi Roche
text:
# Adi Roche

**Adi Marie Roche** (an haife ta a ranar 11 ga watan Yulin shekara ta 1955) 'yar gwagwarmayar Irish ce, mai ba da shawara kan makaman nukiliya, kuma mai fafutukar zaman lafiya, taimakon jin kai da ilimi. Ta kafa kuma ita ce Shugaba na Chernobyl Children's Project International . Ta mayar da hankali kan sauƙaƙe wahalar da yara suka fuskanta bayan Bala'in nukiliya na Chernobyl na 1986. Ta kasance dan takara da ya gaza a zaben shugaban kasa na Irish na shekara ta 1997.

## Rayuwa ta farko

[[gyara sashe](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Adi_Roche&veaction=edit&section=1 "Gyara sashe: Rayuwa ta farko") | [gyara masomin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Adi_Roche&action=edit&section=1 "Edit section's source code: Rayuwa ta farko")]

An haifi Adi Roche a Clonmel, County Tipperary a shekarar 1955. Bayan kammala makarantar sakandare, ta tafi aiki ga Aer Lingus . [[1]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Adi_Roche#cite_note-1) Ta bar a shekarar 1984 don yin aiki na cikakken lokaci a matsayin mai sa kai don Kamfen na Irish don Kashe Makaman Nukiliya . Ta kirkiro Shirin Ilimi na Zaman Lafiya kuma ta gabatar da shi a makarantu sama da hamsin a duk faɗin Ireland. A shekara ta 1990, ta zama mace ta farko ta Irish da aka zaba a cikin kwamitin daraktocin Ofishin Zaman Lafiya na Duniya a [Majalisar Dinkin Duniya](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Majalisar_%C6%8Ainkin_Duniya "Majalisar Ɗinkin Duniya") a [Geneva](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Geneva "Geneva").

## Chernobyl Children International

[[gyara sashe](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Adi_Roche&veaction=edit&section=2 "Gyara sashe: Chernobyl Children International") | [gyara masomin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Adi_Roche&action=edit&section=2 "Edit section's source code: Chernobyl Children International")]

A cikin 1991, Roche ya kafa Chernobyl Children International, don samar da taimako ga yara na [Belarus](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Belarus "Belarus"), Yammacin Rasha da [Ukraine](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ukraniya "Ukraniya") bayan bala'in nukiliya na Chernobyle na 1986. [[2]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Adi_Roche#cite_note-Clifford-2) Kungiyar tana aiki a fannonin ci gaban kasa da kasa da kuma taimakon likita da na jin kai. Yana aiki tare da yara da iyalai waɗanda ke ci gaba da shafar bala'in.

A karkashin jagorancin Roche, Chernobyl Children International (CCI) ya yi iƙirarin cewa ya isar da sama da Yuro miliyan 105 ga yankunan da bala'in nukiliyar Chernobyle ya fi shafa kuma ya yi iccirarin cewa ta ba da damar yara sama da 25,500 da bala'ar Chernobylla ta shafa su zo [Ireland](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ayilan_(%C6%99asa) "Ayilan (ƙasa)") don magani mai mahimmanci da warkewa.[[3]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Adi_Roche#cite_note-3)CCI ta fadada ikonta zuwa manufofi daban-daban na kiwon lafiya a Belarus, gami da gina gidaje masu zaman kansu masu zaman kansu ga yara masu nakasa, kafa asibitin jariri na farko na kasar, da kuma fara yarjejeniyar tallafi tsakanin Ireland da Belarus.

## Aiki tare da Majalisar Dinkin Duniya

[[gyara sashe](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Adi_Roche&veaction=edit&section=3 "Gyara sashe: Aiki tare da Majalisar Dinkin Duniya") | [gyara masomin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Adi_Roche&action=edit&section=3 "Edit section's source code: Aiki tare da Majalisar Dinkin Duniya")]

Roche ya kaddamar da nune-nunen bala'in Chernobyl don bikin cika shekaru 15 da hadarin nukiliya a hedkwatar Majalisar Dinkin Duniya a New York a shekara ta 2001. An nuna gadon Chernobyl ta hanyar hotunan dijital, hotuna da siffofi. Mai suna Black Wind, White Land, nune-nunen ya kasance na tsawon wata, taron al'adu wanda ke nuna ayyukan masu zane-zane waɗanda suka nuna wahalar da bala'in ya haifar. Majalisar Dinkin Duniya ta dauki shi a matsayin gagarumin nasara kuma ya fara gabatar da shi a Turai a Dublin a shekara ta 2002. [[4]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Adi_Roche#cite_note-4)

Ta ci gaba da aiki tare da Majalisar Dinkin Duniya don nuna sakamakon bala'in Chernobyl. A cikin shekaru goma da suka gabata ta ba da gudummawa ga taron da Majalisar Dinkin Duniya ke tallafawa da kuma tarurruka kan tasirin Chernobyl. Ta yi jawabi ga Jakadun Majalisar Dinkin Duniya, taron [UNESCO](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/UNESCO "UNESCO") kan Chernobyl, da kuma bikin zaman lafiya na Manchester. Roche ya ba da shawara da shawarwari ga Ofishin Binciken Bukatar Majalisar Dinkin Duniya kuma ya gabatar da shirye-shirye da yawa game da yadda za a iya taimakawa kungiyoyi masu zaman kansu a ƙoƙarin su na isar da taimakon jin kai ga yankunan da suka fi shafa a [Belarus](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Belarus "Belarus"), [Ukraine](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ukraniya "Ukraniya") da yammacin [Rasha](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rasha "Rasha").

A watan Yulin shekara ta 2003, ita ce babban mai magana a lokacin kaddamar da Cibiyar Bincike da Bayanai ta Duniya ta Chernobyl (ICRIN) a [Geneva](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Geneva "Geneva"), [Switzerland](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Switzerland "Switzerland"). ICRIN wani shiri ne na hadin gwiwa wanda Majalisar Dinkin Duniya da Swiss Agency for Development and Co-operation suka tallafawa. An nada Roche don wakiltar kungiyoyi masu zaman kansu a Kwamitin Gudanarwa na ICRIN.

Don yin bikin cika shekaru 18 da bala'in a watan Afrilu na shekara ta 2004, an gayyaci Roche ya yi magana a Babban Taron Majalisar Dinkin Duniya a hedkwatar su a New York da kuma nuna shirin da ya lashe kyautar Oscar Chernobyl Heart . A shekara ta 2004, Chernobyl Children International ta sami matsayin hukuma ta NGO daga Majalisar Dinkin Duniya.[[5]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Adi_Roche#cite_note-5) Har ila yau, UNDP ta gayyace ta don zama a kwamitin shirya su, kuma ta yi aiki a matsayin babban mai magana a taron Chernobyl na kasa da kasa wanda aka gudanar a [Minsk](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Miniska "Miniska") a watan Afrilu na shekara ta 2006 (don yin bikin cika shekaru 20 na bala'in Chernobyle).

A ranar 26 ga Afrilu 2016, ranar cika shekaru 30 da Bala'in Chernobyl, Roche ya yi jawabi mai mahimmanci ga Babban Taron Majalisar Dinkin Duniya a New York. A cikin wani yunkuri da ba a taɓa gani ba, tawagar Majalisar Dinkin Duniya ta Belarus ta ba ta lokacin magana a tattaunawar Babban Taron kan Chernobyl don nuna godiya ga rawar da Ireland da Chernobyle Children International suka taka wajen taimakawa wadanda bala'in Chernobylla ya shafa. Wannan shi ne karo na farko da aka ba da lambar yabo ga mutum na yau da kullun (wanda ba shi da difloma / wanda ba shi da siyasa) na yin magana a Babban Taron Majalisar Dinkin Duniya a lokacin da aka ba kasar.

## Daraja da kyaututtuka

[[gyara sashe](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Adi_Roche&veaction=edit&section=4 "Gyara sashe: Daraja da kyaututtuka") | [gyara masomin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Adi_Roche&action=edit&section=4 "Edit section's source code: Daraja da kyaututtuka")]

An ba Roche lambar yabo ta European Woman Laureate Award bayan fitowar fim din 'Black Wind, White Land' (1993) wanda ya nuna wahalar yara na Chernobyl. A cikin wannan shekarar ta sami taken Mutumin Jamhuriyar Shekara.

A shekara ta 1997, Roche ta sami lambar yabo ta zaman lafiya ta kasa da kasa ta Tipperary, [[6]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Adi_Roche#cite_note-TIPA-TPC01a-6) wanda aka bayyana a matsayin "kyakkyawan lambar yabo ta Ireland don aikin jin kai. "

A shekara ta 2001, Jami'ar Alberta, Kanada ta ba Roche digiri na girmamawa na likita.

A shekara ta 2007, Roche ya lashe lambar yabo ta Robert Burns Humanitarian Award .

A shekara ta 2010, Roche ta sami lambar yabo ta Duniya ta Lafiya ta Yara . Tun daga wannan lokacin, Chernobyl Children International ta ceci rayukan dubban yara da aka haifa tare da lahani na zuciya.

A shekara ta 2015, an ba Roche suna World of Children Alumni Award Honoree, saboda "matsananciyar tasirin da ta ci gaba da samu a rayuwar yaran yankin Chernobyl".

Har ila yau a cikin 2015, Roche ta lashe kyautar Princess Grace Humanitarian Award . [[7]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Adi_Roche#cite_note-wcahon-7)

A cikin 2020, an ba Roche kyautar Ahmadiyya Muslim Peace Prize "saboda kokarin da ta yi na ba da shawara game da kawar da makaman nukiliya da tallafawa wadanda bala'in Chernobyl ya shafa". An gabatar da kyautar ne kawai ga Roche a cikin 2024, saboda rikitarwa da suka taso daga annobar COVID-19 da mamayar Rasha a Ukraine. [[8]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Adi_Roche#cite_note-8)

**Kyaututtuka**:

*   Kyautar Shugaban kasa Tipperary Chamber of Commerce 2019
*   'Yanci na Birnin Cork 2016 [[9]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Adi_Roche#cite_note-9)
*   Kyautar Kyautar Rayuwa ta Ireland ta 2016 [[10]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Adi_Roche#cite_note-10)
*   Kyautar Kyautar Kyauta ta Sarauniya ta 2015
*   Top 20 na Mata Mafi Girma na Ireland na Duk Lokaci 2014
*   Babban mai magana a bikin tunawa da girgizar kasar Japan a Fukushima 2012
*   Kyautar David Chow Humanitarian ta 2008
*   Kyautar Robert Burns Humanitarian 2007
*   Dan takarar People's Alliance don yakin neman zaben shugaban kasa na Irish a shekarar 1997
*   Mutumin Turai na Shekara 1996
*   Kyautar Mata ta Turai ta 1996
*   Mutumin Irish na Shekara 1996
*   Matar Irish ta farko da aka zaba a cikin kwamitin daraktocin Ofishin Zaman Lafiya na Duniya a Geneva
*   Wanda aka nada a gwamnati a kwamitin Cibiyar Kare Radiological ta Ireland (RPII)

**Matsayi na girmamawa:**

*   Roche tana da digiri na girmamawa na Dokoki daga Jami'ar Alberta, Kanada .
*   A shekara ta 2002 an ba ta lambar yabo ta Doctorate of Laws tare da Ali Hewson ta Jami'ar Kasa ta Ireland, Galway .
*   A shekara ta 2016 an ba ta lambar yabo ta Doctorate of Letters tare da Ali Hewson ta Jami'ar Limerick . [[11]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Adi_Roche#cite_note-11)

## Siyasa

[[gyara sashe](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Adi_Roche&veaction=edit&section=5 "Gyara sashe: Siyasa") | [gyara masomin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Adi_Roche&action=edit&section=5 "Edit section's source code: Siyasa")]

Roche ya tsaya a ofishin Shugaban Ireland a matsayin dan takarar hadin gwiwa na Jam'iyyar Labour Party, Democratic Left da Green Party a Zaben shugaban kasa na 1997.

Roche ya zo na huɗu daga cikin 'yan takara biyar tare da kusan 7% na kuri'un.[[12]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Adi_Roche#cite_note-12)

title: Chinelo Okparanta
text:
# Chinelo Okparanta

**Chinelo Okparanta,** ( </img> (an haife ta a shekara ta 1981) marubuciyace yar Najeriya ce kuma [yar gajeriyar labari](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gajeren_labari "Gajeren labari") . [[1]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chinelo_Okparanta#cite_note-1) An haife ta a [Fatakwalt,](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Port_Harcourt "Port Harcourt")[Najeriya](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Najeriya "Najeriya"), inda ta tashi [[2]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chinelo_Okparanta#cite_note-iowa-2) har zuwa shekara 10, lokacin da ta yi hijira zuwa [Amurka](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tarayyar_Amurka "Tarayyar Amurka") tare da danginta. [[3]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chinelo_Okparanta#cite_note-3)

An haifi Chinelo Okparanta a Port Harcourt, [Najeriya](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Najeriya "Najeriya"), kuma tana da shekaru 10 ta yi hijira tare da danginta zuwa Amurka. Ta yi karatu a Jami'ar Jihar [Pennsylvania](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pennsylvania "Pennsylvania") ( Schreyer Honors College ), Jami'ar Rutgers da kuma [Iowa](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Iowa "Iowa") Workshop Marubuta . [[2]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chinelo_Okparanta#cite_note-iowa-2)

## Sana'a

[[gyara sashe](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Chinelo_Okparanta&veaction=edit&section=1 "Gyara sashe: Sana'a") | [gyara masomin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Chinelo_Okparanta&action=edit&section=1 "Edit section's source code: Sana'a")]

Okparanta ta wallafa gajerun labarai ne a cikin wallafe-wallafen ciki har da _Granta_, _The New Yorker_, _Tin House_, _The Kenyon Review_, _The Southern Review_, _TriQuarterly_, _Conjunctions_, _Subtropics_ da _The Coffin Factory_ . Rubuce-rubucenta sun bayyana a cikin _AGNI_, Labari na Kyautar Labari, da Jami'ar Iowa, Shirin Rubuce-rubuce na Duniya . Okparanta ta gudanar da zumunci ko ziyarar farfesa a Jami'ar Iowa, Jami'ar Colgate, Jami'ar Purdue, Kwalejin City na New York, da Jami'ar Columbia . Ta kasance abokiyar farfesace na Turanci da Rubutun Ƙirƙira (Fiction) a Jami'ar Bucknell, inda ta kasance C. Graydon & Mary E. Rogers Faculty Research Fellow da Margaret Hollinshead Ley Farfesa a cikin Waƙa & Rubutun Ƙirƙirar har zuwa shekarar 2021. A halin yanzu ita abokiyar farfesa ce ta Ingilishi da kuma Darakta na Shiri a Rubutun Ƙirƙira a Kwalejin Swarthmore .

Tarin ɗan gajeren labarin halinta na farko, _Farin ciki, Kamar Ruwa_ (Littattafan Grant da Houghton Miffin Harcourt ), an daɗe ana jera su don lambar yabo ta 2013 Frank O'Connor International Short Story Award, [[4]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chinelo_Okparanta#cite_note-4) ɗan wasan ƙarshe na 2014 New York Public Library Young Lions Fiction Award, ta kuma lashe lambar yabo ta shekarar 2014 Lambda Literary Award for Lesbian Fiction . An zabe ta a cikin Ƙungiyar Ƙwararru na shekarar 2014. Sauran girmamawa sun haɗa da lambar yabo ta shekarar 2013 Society of Midland Authors Award (na ƙarshe), da Kyautar Caine na shekarar 2013 a Rubutun Afirka (na ƙarshe), da ƙari.

Gajeren labarinta na "Adalci" an ne a haɗa 2014 cikin PEN/O. Henry Prize Labarun, a cikin gajerun labarai guda 20 na wannan shekara. [[5]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chinelo_Okparanta#cite_note-5)

_Farin ciki, Kamar Ruwa_ shine zaɓin Editoci don _Bitar Littafin New York Times_ akan Satumba 20, 2013. An kuma jera tari tari a matsayin ɗaya daga cikin Mafiya kyawun almara na Afirka _na The Guardian_ na shekarar 2013, kuma a cikin watan Disamba na shekarar 2014 an sanar da shi a matsayin ɗan wasan ƙarshe na lambar yabo ta Etisalat na kasar Najeriya. [[6]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chinelo_Okparanta#cite_note-6)


Chinelo Okparanta

Littafinta na farko,a _ƙarƙashin Bishiyoyin Udala_, an buga shine a cikin shekarar 2015. Mawallafin _[jaridar New York Times](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/New\_York\_Times "New York Times")_ ya kira Okparanta "marubuciya mai kyau kuma madaidaiciya", [[7]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chinelo_Okparanta#cite_note-7) da kuma _The Guardian_ (Birtaniya) ya kwatanta littafin a matsayin "labari mai ban sha'awa game da bayyanar wata budurwa 'yar luwadi da girma a Najeriya a lokacin [yakin basasar kasar Najeriya](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ya%C6%99in_basasar_Najeriya "Yaƙin basasar Najeriya") ... "a cikinsa". . . Okparanta da yaudara ya sasanta tsakanin labarin soyayya da labarin yaki.” [[8]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chinelo_Okparanta#cite_note-8)

_A ƙarƙashin Bishiyoyin Udala_ shine Zaɓin Editocin _Bita na Littafin New York Times_ da kuma wanda aka zaɓa don Kyautar _Binciken Kirkus_ na shekarar 2015 a cikin Fiction. Ɗaya daga cikin "Mafiya kyawun Littattafai na shekarar 2015" na NPR, shi ma ya sanya BuzzFeed, a _Jaridar Wall Street Journal_, _Miliyoyin_, _Bustle_, Sanin Shelf, da Mawallafin Abincin rana "Mafiya kyawun" [[9]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chinelo_Okparanta#cite_note-9) da "Mafi Tsammani" jerin, da sauransu. . An daɗe ana jera shina a cikin shekarar 2015 Center for Fiction First Novel Prize, wanda aka zaba kuma akaba lambar yabo tan shekarar 2016 NAACP Image Award for External Literary Work of Fiction, wanda aka zaba a shekarar 2016 Hurston-Wright Legacy Award a Fiction, dab dana karshe a shekarar 2016 Publishing Triangle Literary Awards ( Ferro-Grumley Award ), dan wasan kusa da na karshe na 2016 VCU Cabell First Novelist Award, da aka jera don 2016 Chautauqua Prize ,[_[ana buƙatar hujja](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Citation\_needed "Wikipedia:Citation needed")_] kuma sun sami nasarar lashe lambar yabo ta Lambda Literary 2016 a cikin Babban Labarin Almara na Madigo.

_A ƙarƙashin Bishiyoyin Udala_ kuma sun sami lambar yabo ne ta shekarar 2016 Jessie Redmon Fauset a cikin Fiction kuma ya kasance zaɓi a shekarar 2017 Amelia Bloomer Project na Ƙungiyar Laburare ta kasar Amurka . Hakanan an zaɓi shi don Kyautar Adabin Dublin ta Duniya ta shekarar 2017.

A cikin shekarar 2017 ne, Okparanta ta lashe lambar yabo ta Buga Triangle ta shekarar 2016 Betty Berzon Emerging Writer Award .

_Pulse Najeriya_ mai suna _Karkashin Bishiyoyin Udala_ daya daga cikin Manyan Littattafan Najeriya guda 10 na shekar 2015. _YNaija_ ta jera ta a matsayin daya daga cikin Littattafai Goma da suka fi shahara a shekarar 2015. [[10]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chinelo_Okparanta#cite_note-10)_Afridiaspora_ ya lissafa ta a matsayin ɗaya daga cikin mafi kyawun litattafan kasashen Afirka na shekarar 2015. [[11]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chinelo_Okparanta#cite_note-11)

A cikin watan Afrilu na shekarar 2017, _Granta_ ya zaɓi Okparanta don sau ɗaya a cikin shekaru goma Mafi kyawun jerin littafan kasar Amurkawa na matasa . [[12]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chinelo_Okparanta#cite_note-12)[[13]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chinelo_Okparanta#cite_note-13)

Mawallafinta na "Trump a cikin Classroom" an haɗa shi a cikin tarihi na shekarar 2019 _Sabbin 'ya'yan Afirka_, editan [Margaret Busby](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Margaret_Busby "Margaret Busby") .

Chinelo Okparanta ta samu karbuwa a matsayin zakara na masu rajin ra'ayin mazan jiya da marasa galihu a duk tsawon rayuwarta ta marubuciya, [Helon Habila](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Helon_Habila "Helon Habila").

Littattafan Okparanta guda uku, "Farin Ciki Kamar Ruwa," "Karƙashin Bishiyar Udala," da na baya-bayan nan, "Harry Sylvester Bird" sun ba da fifikon labarun al'ummar LGBTQ da mutane masu launi ta hanyar hangen nesa na cikin gida da hangen nesa na waje.

title: Albin Kurti
text:
# Albin Kurti

**Albin Kurti** (sq sq ['albin 'kuɾti]; an haife shi a ranar 24 ga watan Maris na shekara ta 1975) ɗan siyasan Kosovo ne kuma ɗan majalisa wanda ya kasance Firayim Minista na Kosovo tun daga shekara ta 2021, bayan ya rike mukamin daga Fabrairu zuwa Yuni 2020. Ya zama sananne a shekara ta 1997 a matsayin mataimakin shugaban ƙungiyar ɗaliban Jami'ar Pristina, kuma babban mai shirya zanga-zangar dalibai marasa tashin hankali na 1997 da 1998. Kurti ya yi aiki a ofishin Adem Demaçi lokacin da ya zama wakilin siyasa na Sojojin 'Yanci na Kosovo (KLA). sq Kurti ya kasance memba na Majalisar Jamhuriyar Kosovo tun daga shekara ta 2010 a majalisun dokoki uku a jere.

## Rayuwa da aiki

[[gyara sashe](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Albin_Kurti&veaction=edit&section=1 "Gyara sashe: Rayuwa da aiki") | [gyara masomin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Albin_Kurti&action=edit&section=1 "Edit section's source code: Rayuwa da aiki")]

### Rayuwa ta farko

[[gyara sashe](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Albin_Kurti&veaction=edit&section=2 "Gyara sashe: Rayuwa ta farko") | [gyara masomin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Albin_Kurti&action=edit&section=2 "Edit section's source code: Rayuwa ta farko")]

An haifi Albin Kurti a ranar 24 ga Maris 1975 a Pristina, Kosovo na SFR Yugoslavia . Mahaifin Kurti, Zaim Kurti ya fito ne daga dangin kabilanci-[Montenegro](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Socialist_Republic_of_Montenegro?action=edit&redlink=1 "Socialist Republic of Montenegro (babu wannan shafin)")" id="mwGw" rel="mw:WikiLink" title="Albanians in Montenegro">Albanian daga ƙauyen Sukobin a cikin Garin Ulcinj, Montenegro; injiniya, ya koma Pristina don neman aiki. Mahaifiyar Kurti, Arife Kurti malamar makarantar firamare ce mai ritaya, an haife ta kuma ta yi karatu a Pristina . Kurti kuma yana da 'yan'uwa biyu, Arianit da Taulant . Kurti ya kammala karatun firamare da na tsakiya a Pristina . Ya kammala karatu a jami'a a shekara ta 2003 a fannin Sadarwa da Injiniyan Kwamfuta a Kwalejin Injiniya a Jami'ar Pristina . [[1]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Albin_Kurti#cite_note-Biography-1)

### Yaƙin Kosovo

[[gyara sashe](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Albin_Kurti&veaction=edit&section=3 "Gyara sashe: Yaƙin Kosovo") | [gyara masomin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Albin_Kurti&action=edit&section=3 "Edit section's source code: Yaƙin Kosovo")]

Kurti ya fara zama sananne a watan Oktoba na shekara ta 1997, a matsayin daya daga cikin shugabannin zanga-zangar dalibai a Kosovo. Daliban Albania sun nuna rashin amincewa da mamaye harabar Jami'ar Pristina da 'yan sanda na Yugoslav suka yi. An fara aikin ne a shekarar 1991 kuma ya haifar da ma'aikatan ilimi na kabilanci da dalibai da ke amfani da wasu wurare don azuzuwan su saboda dokar Serbia ta hana su amfani da wuraren jami'a.[[2]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Albin_Kurti#cite_note-2) An murkushe zanga-zangar da karfi, amma dalibai da Kurti ba su dakatar da juriya ba kuma sun shirya wasu zanga-zambe a cikin watanni masu zuwa. A watan Yulin 1998, Kurti ya kasance mataimakin wakilin siyasa na UÇK, Adem Demaçi . Wadannan ayyukan sun sanya shi a matsayin manufa ga 'yan sanda na Yugoslav.[[1]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Albin_Kurti#cite_note-Biography-1)[[3]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Albin_Kurti#cite_note-3)

A watan Afrilu na shekara ta 1999, a lokacin Fashewar bam na NATO a Yugoslavia, sojojin Yugoslav sun kama Kurti kuma sun yi masa duka sosai.[[4]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Albin_Kurti#cite_note-albnet-4) An fara tura shi gidan yarin Dubrava, amma yayin da sojojin Serbia suka janye daga Kosovo, sai suka tura shi kurkuku a Požarevac a ranar 10 ga Yuni 1999.[[1]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Albin_Kurti#cite_note-Biography-1) Daga baya a wannan shekarar, an tuhume shi da "tsare da amincin yankin Yugoslavia da kuma yin makirci don yin aikin abokan gaba da ke da alaƙa da ta'addanci" kuma an yanke masa hukuncin shekaru 15 a kurkuku.[[5]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Albin_Kurti#cite_note-5)

TKurti was released in December 2001 by Yugoslavia's post-Milošević government after being pardoned by President Vojislav Koštunica[[6]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Albin_Kurti#cite_note-6) amid international pressure. Since his release, he worked outside party politics in Kosovo but was a severe critic of the United Nations Interim Administration Mission in Kosovo (UNMIK) and of corruption. He organised non-violent protests in support of the families of those whose relatives disappeared in the war, and in favour of Kosovo's [self-determination](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/%C6%98addamar_da_kai "Ƙaddamar da kai"). On 23 April 2003 Kurti graduated with a degree in Computer and Telecommunications Sciences from the University of Pristina. He was an activist for the Action for Kosovo Network (AKN), which was formed in 1997 as a movement focused on human rights and social justice, education, culture and art.[_[ana buƙatar hujja](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Citation\_needed "Wikipedia:Citation needed")_]


Albin Kurti a cikin zanga-zangar Vetëvendosje, 2013

### Tsohon al'amuran

[[gyara sashe](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Albin_Kurti&veaction=edit&section=4 "Gyara sashe: Tsohon al'amuran") | [gyara masomin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Albin_Kurti&action=edit&section=4 "Edit section's source code: Tsohon al'amuran")]

A ranar 12 ga watan Yunin shekara ta 2005 'yan gwagwarmayar AKN sun rubuta taken "Babu tattaunawa, Ƙaddamar da Kai" a bangon gine-ginen UNMIK. 'Yan sanda, tare da taimakon' yan sanda na Majalisar Dinkin Duniya, sun kama, sun daure, kuma sun yanke wa daruruwan masu fafutuka hukunci, gami da Kurti. Daga nan sai AKN ta canza sunanta zuwa Ƙungiyar Ƙaddamar da Kai (Vetëvendosje). Vetëvendosje ya bukaci a gudanar da raba gardama game da matsayin Kosovo, yana mai cewa "kawai tare da raba gardamar a matsayin amfani da haƙƙin kasa da kasa don tabbatar da kai, za mu iya fahimtar mafita ta dimokuradiyya ga Kosovo, maimakon tattaunawar da ke daidaita 'yanci".[[7]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Albin_Kurti#cite_note-7)

A watan Fabrairun 2007 Vetëvendosje ta shirya zanga-zangar adawa da Shirin Ahtisaari, wanda a cewar su ya raba Kosovo bisa kabilanci kuma bai bai baiwa mutanen Kosovo abin da suke ƙoƙarin yi ba. Wannan zanga-zangar ta zama tashin hankali kuma 'yan sanda na Majalisar Dinkin Duniya na Romania sun kashe masu zanga-zambe biyu ba tare da makamai ba kuma sun ji wa wasu 80 rauni da harsashin filastik da roba. An kama Kurti. An tsare shi har zuwa watan Yulin 2007 sannan aka tsare shi a gidan yari. [Amnesty International](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Amnesty_International "Amnesty International") ta soki laifuffukan da aka yi a cikin gurfanar da shi. Daga karshe an yanke masa hukuncin watanni tara. Kurti ya kasance mai ba da shawara game da "tsayayya mai ƙarfi ba tare da tashin hankali ba".[[8]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Albin_Kurti#cite_note-8)

Vetëvendosje ya shiga bangaren siyasa na Kosovo ta hanyar yin takara a zaben 2010 a karon farko. Albin Kurti ya kasance dan takarar Firayim Minista, kodayake Vetëvendosje kawai ya ci 12.69% kuma ya lashe kujeru 14 daga cikin 120 a majalisar, ya zama na uku na siyasa a kasar. Vetëvendosje ya soki Yarjejeniyar Brussels tsakanin Kosovo da Serbia. 'Yan majalisa na Vetëvendosje, ciki har da Kurti, 'yan sanda sun fitar da su daga majalisa saboda rushe zaman majalisa.[[9]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Albin_Kurti#cite_note-9)

Kurti ya sake tsayawa takarar Firayim Minista a zaben da ya biyo baya a shekarar 2014, amma Vetëvendosje ya sake zama na uku, kawai ya sami kujeru 16. Vetëvendosje da Kurti da kansu sun shiga cikin zanga-zangar a cikin majalisa wanda ya sami kulawa ta duniya ta hanyar kunna iskar hawaye a majalisa a lokuta da yawa.

A cikin Zaben 2017 Vetëvendosje ya ninka sau biyu a girmansa, ya zama babbar jam'iyyar siyasa a Kosovo kuma ya lashe kujeru 32 (mafi yawan a matsayin jam'iyya idan aka kwatanta da sauran jam'iyyun a wannan zaben); jam'iyyarsa ta dauki kuri'u 200.135 (27.49%). [[10]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Albin_Kurti#cite_note-10) Har yanzu babban Haɗin gwiwar PANA ne ya ci su wanda ya dauki 245,627 (33,74%). Albin Kurti ya zama dan siyasa mafi yawan kuri'u a Kosovo. A wannan lokacin, Kurti shine shugaban 'yan adawa kuma Vetëvendosje ya sami nasarar sanya matsin lamba a kan gwamnati tare da hadin gwiwar sauran jam'iyyar adawa, LDK. A ranar 3 ga watan Janairun 2018, an yanke wa Kurti hukuncin shekara 1 da watanni 6 a kurkuku a kan gwaji saboda rawar da ya taka wajen kashe iskar hawaye a shekarar 2015.[[11]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Albin_Kurti#cite_note-11)

Firayim Minista Ramush Haradinaj ya yi murabus a watan Yulin 2019, inda ya kai Kosovo zuwa zaben da wuri a watan Oktoba 2019. A cikin zaɓen da ya biyo baya, Vetëvendosje na Kurti ya lashe mafi yawan masu jefa kuri'a tare da 221,001 (26,27% ko kujeru 29) kuma ya kasance babban ƙarfin siyasa a Kosovo, tare da rabon Kurti na kuri'un da ya karu idan aka kwatanta da 2017. Ya zama Firayim Minista na Kosovo a farkon watan Fabrairun 2020.

Bayan girgizar kasa ta Albania ta 2019, Kurti ya ziyarci [Durrës](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Durr%C3%ABs "Durrës") don bincika lalacewar kuma ya jaddada muhimmancin hadin gwiwar hukumomi tsakanin Kosovo da Albania.

A ranar 18 ga watan Maris 2020, Kurti ya kori Ministan Cikin Gida Agim Veliu (LDK) saboda goyon bayansa na ayyana dokar ta baci don magance Cutar coronavirus, wanda zai ba da iko ga Kwamitin Tsaro na Kosovo wanda Hashim Thaçi (PDK) ke jagoranta. Jam'iyyar Democrat League of Kosovo, ƙaramin abokin tarayya na hadin gwiwa, ta gabatar da ƙudurin rashin amincewa don ramawa ga korar, kuma a ranar 25 ga Maris mambobi 82 na Majalisar Kosovo sun kada kuri'a don amincewa da ƙuduri, kuma majalisar Kurti ta zama gwamnati ta farko da aka jefa kuri'a daga mulki saboda rashin jituwa game da cutar coronavirus.

Ma'aikatar Kurti ta ci gaba a matsayin gwamnati mai kulawa, har zuwa 3 ga Yuni 2020, lokacin da aka zabi Avdullah Hoti a matsayin Firayim Minista na gaba.

A ranar 26 ga watan Janairun 2021, kwamitin korafin zaben Kosovo ya hana Kurti yin takara a Zaben majalisar dokoki na Kosovo na 2021, saboda an same shi da laifin aikata laifi kasa da shekaru uku kafin zaben. [[12]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Albin_Kurti#cite_note-12) Duk da wannan, jam'iyyar ta ci gaba da cin nasara da kashi 50.28% na kuri'un.

Jam'iyyar Kurti ta lashe kujeru da yawa bayan zaben 'yan majalisa na Fabrairu 2025, wanda ya haifar da rikice-rikicen siyasa a Majalisar. An sake gudanar da wani zabe a watan Disamba na shekara ta 2025, inda Vetëvendosje ya lashe wa'adi na uku ta hanyar lashe karin kujeru.[[13]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Albin_Kurti#cite_note-13)[[14]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Albin_Kurti#cite_note-14)[[15]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Albin_Kurti#cite_note-15)

Duk da cewa jam'iyyarsa ta lashe zaben majalisar dokoki na Disamba 2025 tare da kashi 51.10% na kuri'un, bai iya cimma yarjejeniyar siyasa tare da jam'iyyun adawa kan zaben sabon shugaban Kosovo ba. Saboda Majalisar Kosovo ta kasa zabar shugaban kasa a cikin iyakar kundin tsarin mulki, an rushe Majalisar, wanda ya haifar da kiran sabon zaben majalisar dokoki.[[16]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Albin_Kurti#cite_note-16)

## Firayim Minista

[[gyara sashe](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Albin_Kurti&veaction=edit&section=5 "Gyara sashe: Firayim Minista") | [gyara masomin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Albin_Kurti&action=edit&section=5 "Edit section's source code: Firayim Minista")]


Ma'aikatar Kurti ta farko


Ma'aikatar Kurti ta Biyu

A ranar 3 ga watan Fabrairun 2020, an zabi Albin Kurti a matsayin Firayim Minista na Kosovo tare da kuri'u 66 da aka amince da su da kuma 10 da suka guje wa, [[17]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Albin_Kurti#cite_note-17) 'yan majalisa 34 na adawa sun kaurace wa kuri'ar kuma sun bar ginin majalisar Kosovo.

Ɗaya daga cikin yanke shawara na farko da Kurti da majalisar ministocinsa suka yi shi ne soke karuwar albashi da gwamnatin Haradinaj ta baya ta baiwa ministoci kuma ta dawo da albashi zuwa adadin da suka gabata.[[18]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Albin_Kurti#cite_note-Bamine-18) A sakamakon haka, albashin Firayim Minista na kowane wata da aka saita a € 2,950 zai koma € 1,500 ga Kurti.

A matsayin wani ɓangare na tsarin manufofin gwamnatinsa, Kurti yana neman gabatar da lokacin watanni uku na aikin soja a Kosovo, yana kallon shi da muhimmanci ga tsaron kasar.

An zabi Kurti a matsayin Firayim Minista na Kosovo a karo na biyu a ranar 22 ga Maris 2021 tare da mambobi 67 na majalisar da suka kada kuri'a da kuma mambobi 30 da suka yi adawa.[[19]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Albin_Kurti#cite_note-19)

### Siyasa

[[gyara sashe](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Albin_Kurti&veaction=edit&section=6 "Gyara sashe: Siyasa") | [gyara masomin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Albin_Kurti&action=edit&section=6 "Edit section's source code: Siyasa")]

#### Tattalin Arziki

[[gyara sashe](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Albin_Kurti&veaction=edit&section=7 "Gyara sashe: Tattalin Arziki") | [gyara masomin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Albin_Kurti&action=edit&section=7 "Edit section's source code: Tattalin Arziki")]

Dangane da rahoton 2024 na Asusun Kuɗi na Duniya (IMF), tattalin arzikin Kosovo ya kasance "mai jurewa" a lokacin Kurti, yana yin rikodin ci gaban GDP na gaske na 3.3% a 2023 da kuma hasashen 3.8% a 2024. [[20]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Albin_Kurti#cite_note-IMF2024-20) Rahoton tattalin arziki na Ma'aikatar Harkokin Waje ta Switzerland ya lura cewa, kodayake ci gaban GDP ya ragu daga 4.3% a cikin 2022 galibi saboda rashin ƙarfi na fitarwa, karuwar saka hannun jari na jama'a da ci gaba da hauhawar kudaden da aka tura (14% na GDP) ya ba da "ƙarfin ƙarfi". Bayan ya kai 11.6% a 2022, hauhawar farashi ya kai 4.9% a 2023. Don rage tasirin tsada mai yawa, gwamnatin Kurti ta gabatar da kunshin tallafin kasafin kudi wanda ya kai kashi 4.3% na GDP, gami da tallafin makamashi da kula da farashi akan kayayyakin man fetur. Kudin shiga ya karu da kashi 9% zuwa Yuro biliyan 2.86 (29.6% na GDP), yayin da kudaden da aka kashe sun karu da kashi 40.8%. A sakamakon haka, Kosovo ta yi rikodin saurin karfafa kasafin kudi a cikin tattalin arzikin Turai masu tasowa, ta rage rashi zuwa 0.2% na GDP da bashin jama'a zuwa 17.5% na GDP, matakin mafi ƙasƙanci a Yammacin Balkans. A karkashin gwamnatin Kurti, fitar da sabis na ICT ya karu da kusan 36%, sabis na tafiye-tafiye ya karu da 17.7% kuma bangaren noma ya karu da 3.3% a 2023.

## Rayuwa ta mutum

[[gyara sashe](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Albin_Kurti&veaction=edit&section=8 "Gyara sashe: Rayuwa ta mutum") | [gyara masomin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Albin_Kurti&action=edit&section=8 "Edit section's source code: Rayuwa ta mutum")]

Kurti ta auri mai bincike na Norway Rita Augestad Knudsen kuma suna da 'yar tare. Yana magana da Albanian, Serbian da Ingilishi. Baya ga zama ɗan ƙasa na Kosovo, Kurti yana da ɗan ƙasar Albania kuma ya jefa kuri'a a zaɓen Albania.[[21]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Albin_Kurti#cite_note-21)
