title: AJ Odudu
text:
# AJ Odudu

" AJ " Odudu (an haife ta a ranar 12 ga Fabrairu 1988) ƴar wasan kwaikwayo ce na talabijin na Burtaniya. Tana gabatar da shirin gaskiya na ITV2 mai suna Big Brother (tun daga 2023) da Celebrity Big Brother (tun daga 2024) tare da Will Best, da kuma shirin da aka yi a baya mai suna Big Brother's Bit on the Side (2013). A shekarar 2021, ta gabatar da shirin gaskiya na Channel 4, wanda aka yi wa lakabi da Married at First Sight: Afters .

## Rayuwar farko da ilimi

[[gyara sashe](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=AJ_Odudu&veaction=edit&section=1 "Gyara sashe: Rayuwar farko da ilimi") | [gyara masomin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=AJ_Odudu&action=edit&section=1 "Edit section's source code: Rayuwar farko da ilimi")]

An haifi Onatejiro Odudu a ranar 12 ga Fabrairu, 1988 a Blackburn, Lancashire, Ingila. [[1]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/AJ_Odudu#cite_note-1) Mahaifiyarta, Florence, da mahaifinta, James, ' [yan Najeriya](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/%C6%8Aan_Nijeriya "Ɗan Nijeriya") ne kuma tana ɗaya daga cikin yara takwas (maza biyar da mata uku). Iyayenta sun yi auren da aka shirya musu, wanda mahaifiyarta ta yi ƙaura zuwa Burtaniya daga Najeriya a shekarun 1970. Mahaifinta yana aiki a matsayin madugun bas, mahaifiyarta kuma tana aiki a matsayin mai dinki, mai wanke-wanke, da kuma mai cin abincin dare a wata makaranta mai zaman kanta. [[2]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/AJ_Odudu#cite_note-2)

Odudu ya halarci Makarantar Sakandare ta St Bede's RC da Kwalejin St Mary's da ke Blackburn. [[3]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/AJ_Odudu#cite_note-TIL-3) A shekarar 2009 ta kammala karatun digiri a fannin Turanci da siyasa daga Jami'ar Keele . [[4]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/AJ_Odudu#cite_note-4)

## Sana'a

[[gyara sashe](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=AJ_Odudu&veaction=edit&section=2 "Gyara sashe: Sana'a") | [gyara masomin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=AJ_Odudu&action=edit&section=2 "Edit section's source code: Sana'a")]


 Odudu a watan Janairun 2015

Odudu ta fara aikinta a matsayin mai ba da rahoto ga BBC Blast da ke Radio Lancashire . Matsayinta na farko na gabatarwa ya fara ne a shekarar 2009 a cikin shirin BBC Two _The Almost Perfect Guide to Life_[[3]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/AJ_Odudu#cite_note-TIL-3) da kuma shirin _The 5:19 Show_, wani shiri na kan layi a gidan yanar gizon BBC, [[5]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/AJ_Odudu#cite_note-5) wanda a baya ya yi aiki a matsayin 'ɗan jarida mai ban sha'awa' na ƙarshen. A shekara ta 2010, ta kasance bako a shirin _100 Greatest Toys_, wani shiri na musamman da aka watsa a tashar 4. [[6]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/AJ_Odudu#cite_note-6) Ta fito a matsayinta a cikin _Comedy Lab_ a shekarar 2011 [[7]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/AJ_Odudu#cite_note-7) kuma ta gabatar da shirin Sky Arts na bikin Isle of Wight na 2012 tare. [[3]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/AJ_Odudu#cite_note-TIL-3)

A watan Yunin 2013, Odudu ya fara gabatar da _Big Brother's Bit on the Side_ tare da Rylan Clark da Emma Willis, sannan kuma _Celebrity Big Brother's Bit on the Psych_ daga watan Agustan 2013. An tabbatar da ficewarta daga shirin a watan Nuwamba na 2013, inda aka maye gurbinta da mai shiga gasar _Celebrity Big Brother 12_ kuma tsohuwar mai gabatar da shirin _Loose Women_, Carol McGiffin . A watan Agusta na 2013, Odudu ta ƙaddamar da shafinta na yanar gizo a gidan yanar gizon mujallar _Hello_ ta Burtaniya. [[8]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/AJ_Odudu#cite_note-8) Daga shekarar 2015 zuwa 2019, Odudu ta dauki nauyin shirin 4Music _mai suna Trending Live!_ , tare da Jimmy Hill da Vick Hope . [[9]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/AJ_Odudu#cite_note-9)

Tana gabatar da wasan tambayoyi na Facebook na kan layi "Confetti" a watan Maris da Afrilu 2019. [[10]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/AJ_Odudu#cite_note-10)

A watan Yulin 2021, ta lashe kashin farko na _Celebrity Karaoke Club_ a ITV2 . Haka kuma a cikin wannan watan, an tabbatar da Odudu a matsayin mai masaukin baki na wani sabon shiri na _The Big Breakfast_, wanda aka gabatar tare da Mo Gilligan da aka riga aka sanar, a Channel 4 a watan Satumba na 2021. [[11]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/AJ_Odudu#cite_note-11)

A watan Satumba na 2021, Odudu ya fara ɗaukar nauyin shirin gaskiya na Channel 4, wanda aka yi wa laƙabi da Married at First Sight: Afters (wanda daga baya aka sake masa suna Married at First Sight: Unveiled) [[12]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/AJ_Odudu#cite_note-12) . A shekara mai zuwa, ta karbi bakuncin shiri na biyu na gasar gaskiya shirin The Bridge: Race to a Fortune for Channel 4 da HBO Max. [[13]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/AJ_Odudu#cite_note-JNMBiography-13) . A shekara mai zuwa, ta karbi bakuncin shiri na biyu na gasar gaskiya shirin The Bridge: Race to a Fortune for Channel 4 da HBO Max. [[13]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/AJ_Odudu#cite_note-JNMBiography-13)

A watan Maris na 2022, ta haɗu da wani mai shirya _gasar The Great Comic Relief Prize_ tare da Vernon Kay .

Odudu ya gabatar da maki ga alkalan Burtaniya a Gasar Waƙoƙin Eurovision ta 2022. [[14]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/AJ_Odudu#cite_note-14)[[15]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/AJ_Odudu#cite_note-15) A watan Yunin 2022, ta kasance mai gabatar da shirin BBC na Platinum Jubilee Pageant . [[16]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/AJ_Odudu#cite_note-16) A ranar 10 ga Janairu 2023, an sanar da cewa Odudu zai jagoranci taron raba kyaututtuka da kuma raba kyaututtuka na kusa da na karshe na Gasar Waƙoƙin Eurovision ta 2023 wanda za a watsa kai tsaye a BBC Two.

A ƙarshen shekarar 2022 da 2023, Odudu ta faɗaɗa fayil ɗin ɗaukar nauyin karatunta ta hanyar amfani da wasu tsare-tsare na musamman da suka shafi gasa da kuma gaskiya. Ta jagoranci gasar gyaran gashi ta E4 The Big Blow Out (2022), ta gabatar da shirin gyaran gidaje mai suna The Big Interiors Battle (2023) a tashar Channel 4, sannan ta dauki nauyin shirin nishaɗi mai suna The Greatest Auction (2023) don wannan cibiyar sadarwa. [[17]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/AJ_Odudu#cite_note-17)

A watan Afrilun 2023, an sanar da cewa Odudu zai karbi bakuncin farfaɗo da _Big Brother_ a ITV, tare da Will Best . [[18]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/AJ_Odudu#cite_note-18)[[19]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/AJ_Odudu#cite_note-bigbrother-19) Odudu da Best sun kuma gabatar da wani sabon fim mai suna _Celebrity Big Brother_ tun lokacin da aka farfado da shi a shekarar 2024. [[20]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/AJ_Odudu#cite_note-20) . Sun ci gaba da jagorantar ƙungiyar ta hanyar maimaitawa a shekarar 2025, ciki har da jerin fina-finai na biyu na Celebrity Big Brother a watan Afrilun 2025 da kuma jerin fina-finai na uku a watan Satumban 2025 [[21]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/AJ_Odudu#cite_note-21) . A watan Maris na 2025, ta haɗu da shirya babban shirin talabijin kai tsaye na Comic Relief a BBC One tare da Vernon Kay da Paddy McGuinness [[22]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/AJ_Odudu#cite_note-22) . Daga baya a wannan shekarar, ta sake yin aiki tare da Kay don gabatar da shirin gasar zane-zane ta ITV M&S: Dress the Nation [[13]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/AJ_Odudu#cite_note-JNMBiography-13)

### _Strictly Come Dancing_

[[gyara sashe](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=AJ_Odudu&veaction=edit&section=3 "Gyara sashe: Strictly Come Dancing") | [gyara masomin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=AJ_Odudu&action=edit&section=3 "Edit section's source code: Strictly Come Dancing")]

Daga watan Satumba na 2021, ta kasance mai fafatawa a jerin shirye-shiryen _Strictly Come Dancing_ na 19, tare da haɗin gwiwa da ƙwararren ɗan rawa Kai Widdrington . [[23]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/AJ_Odudu#cite_note-23) Sun jagoranci teburin gasar a makon farko da maki 34, [[24]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/AJ_Odudu#cite_note-24) kuma a mako na 7, lokacin da suka ci 39 ga Charleston dinsu don " Kada Ku Zo Da Lulu ". [[25]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/AJ_Odudu#cite_note-25)[[26]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/AJ_Odudu#cite_note-26) Ma'auratan sun kuma jagoranci ƙungiyar a zagayen kusa da na ƙarshe, amma an tilasta musu janyewa daga gasar a ranar 17 ga Disamba, kwana ɗaya kafin wasan ƙarshe, bayan da Odudu ya "yaji" a idon sawun ta na dama. # Charlie Kirk



**Charles James Kirk** (Oktoba 14, 1993 - Satumba 10, 2025) ɗan gwagwarmayar siyasa ne na dama na Amurka, ɗan kasuwa, kuma ɗan jarida. Ya kafa kungiyar dalibai masu ra'ayin mazan jiya Turning Point USA (TPUSA) a shekarar 2012 kuma ya yi aiki a matsayin babban darakta har zuwa lokacin da aka kashe shi a shekarar 2025. Babban abokin [Donald Trump](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Donald_Trump "Donald Trump"), ya zama ɗaya daga cikin fitattun muryoyin ƙungiyar MAGA a cikin [Jam'iyyar Republican](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jam'iyyar_Republican_(Amurka) "Jam'iyyar Republican (Amurka)"), yana buga littattafai da yawa kuma yana karɓar bakuncin The Charlie Kirk Show .–

## Rayuwa ta farko

[[gyara sashe](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Charlie_Kirk&veaction=edit&section=1 "Gyara sashe: Rayuwa ta farko") | [gyara masomin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Charlie_Kirk&action=edit&section=1 "Edit section's source code: Rayuwa ta farko")]

An haifi Charles James Kirk a ranar 14 ga Oktoba, 1993, a yankin Chicago na Arlington Heights, Illinois, kuma ya girma a kusa da Prospect Heights. Mahaifinsa, Robert W. Kirk, masanin gine-gine ne wanda ke da hannu a gina Hasumiyar Trump . Mahaifiyarsa, Kathryn (née Smith), tsohuwar 'yar kasuwa ce a Chicago Mercantile Exchange wacce daga baya ta yi aiki a matsayin mai ba da shawara kan lafiyar kwakwalwa. [[1]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Charlie_Kirk#cite_note-keilman-1)[[2]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Charlie_Kirk#cite_note-Beaumont_2025-2)[[3]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Charlie_Kirk#cite_note-3)[[4]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Charlie_Kirk#cite_note-Independent9.14.25-4) Yana da ɗan'uwa ɗaya, ƙaramar 'yar'uwa, Mary, wacce ta ci gaba da zama mai kula da fasaha a Birnin Chicago.[[5]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Charlie_Kirk#cite_note-5)[[6]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Charlie_Kirk#cite_note-6)

A shekara ta 2010, a lokacin da yake ƙarami a Makarantar Sakandare ta Wheeling, Kirk ya ba da kansa don nasarar yakin neman zabe na Majalisar Dattijan Amurka na Republican Mark Kirk na Illinois (babu dangantaka). Har ila yau, a lokacin ƙaramin shekarunsa, ya fara sauraron The Rush Limbaugh Show, sanannen watsa shirye-shiryen rediyo mai ra'ayin mazan jiya. A cikin babban shekarunsa, ya fara kauracewa kukis a kantin sayar da abinci na makarantar don juyar da karuwar farashi. Ya kuma rubuta wata kasida ga Breitbart News yana zargin nuna bambanci a cikin litattafan makarantar sakandare; hakan ya haifar da bayyanarsa ta farko a kafofin watsa labarai a kan Fox Business yana da shekaru 17.

## Ƙungiyoyin

[[gyara sashe](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Charlie_Kirk&veaction=edit&section=2 "Gyara sashe: Ƙungiyoyin") | [gyara masomin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Charlie_Kirk&action=edit&section=2 "Edit section's source code: Ƙungiyoyin")]

### Canjin Ƙasar Amurka

[[gyara sashe](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Charlie_Kirk&veaction=edit&section=3 "Gyara sashe: Canjin Ƙasar Amurka") | [gyara masomin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Charlie_Kirk&action=edit&section=3 "Edit section's source code: Canjin Ƙasar Amurka")]


Kirk yana magana a taron Conservative Political Action Conference (CPAC) na 2013 a National Harbor, Maryland

A watan Mayu na shekara ta 2012, Kirk ya ba da jawabi a [Jami'ar Benedictine](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Benedictine_University?action=edit&redlink=1 "Benedictine University (babu wannan shafin)") ta "Ranar Gwamnatin Matasa", inda ya sadu da [Bill Montgomery](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bill_Montgomery_(mai_fafutuka) "Bill Montgomery (mai fafutuka)"), mai shekaru 72 da ya yi ritaya wanda a lokacin ya kasance dan takarar majalisa mai goyon bayan Tea Party.[[7]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Charlie_Kirk#cite_note-7) Montgomery daga baya ya ce masu magana a taron sun gaji da masu sauraro na 'yan daruruwan yara na makarantar sakandare, amma sun fara mai da hankali sosai lokacin da Kirk ya fara magana. Montgomery daga nan ya ƙarfafa Kirk ya bi gwagwarmayar siyasa na cikakken lokaci.[[8]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Charlie_Kirk#cite_note-8) Wata daya bayan sun hadu da farko, Montgomery da Kirk sun kafa Turning Point USA, suna so su fara wata kungiya da ke fafatawa da kungiyoyi masu sassaucin ra'ayi kamar [MoveOn.org](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/MoveOn.org?action=edit&redlink=1 "MoveOn.org (babu wannan shafin)").[[9]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Charlie_Kirk#cite_note-atlantic2-9) Kirk ya bayyana shi a matsayin ƙungiyar ɗalibai da ke ba da shawara ga kasuwanni kyauta da ƙayyadadden gwamnati. A taron Jamhuriyar Republican na 2012, Kirk ya sadu da Foster Friess, tsohon manajan saka hannun jari kuma sanannen mai ba da gudummawa na Jamhuriya, kuma ya shawo kansa ya ba da kuɗin kungiyar.

A cikin 2021, TPUSA ta ba da sanarwar cewa za ta ƙaddamar da makarantar kimiyya ta kan layi a matsayin madadin makarantu "da guba ga matasanmu da ra'ayoyin adawa da Amurka". Turning Point Academy an yi niyya ne don biyan iyalai da ke neman "Ilimi na farko na Amurka". Kamfanin ilimi na Arizona StrongMind da farko ya yi haɗin gwiwa tare da TPUSA tare da shirye-shiryen buɗe makarantar ta hanyar faduwar 2022 kuma ya tantance "da yiwuwar samar da sama da dala miliyan 40 a cikin kudaden shiga a cikakken ƙarfin (ɗalibai 10,000) ".[[10]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Charlie_Kirk#cite_note-Stanley-Becker_&_Reinhard_2022-10) Haɗin gwiwar ya ƙare bayan StrongMind ya sami martani daga ma'aikatansa, kuma babban dan kwangila Freedom Learning Group, wanda ya shirya abubuwan da ke cikin makarantar, shi ma ya fita.[[10]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Charlie_Kirk#cite_note-Stanley-Becker_&_Reinhard_2022-10) A cikin 2022, Turning Point ta yi haɗin gwiwa tare da Dream City Christian School, makarantar mai zaman kanta da ke da ɗakunan karatu a Glendale da Scottsdale, Arizona, kuma tana da alaƙa da Dream City Church. A cikin shekara ta 2022-2023, makarantar ta sami $ 900,000 a cikin kudaden takardar shaidar makaranta ta Arizona.[[11]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Charlie_Kirk#cite_note-host-11)

# Daular Mali

**Daular Mali** (Manding: *Mandé* [[1]](#cite_note-:4-1) ko Manden; [Larabci](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Larabci "Larabci"): مالي‎, romanized: *Mālī*) ta kasance daula a [yammacin Afirka](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Afirka_ta_Yamma "Afirka ta Yamma") daga c. 1226 zuwa shekarar 1670. Sundiata Keita ce ta kafa daular (a shekara ta 1214–c. 1255) kuma ta shahara da dukiyar sarakunanta, musamman [Mansa Musa](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mansa_Musa "Mansa Musa") (Musa Keita). Ana yin magana da harsunan Manding a cikin daular. A kololuwarta, Mali ita ce daula mafi girma a [yammacin Afirka](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Yammacin_Afirka "Yammacin Afirka"), inda ta yi tasiri sosai ga al'adun yankin ta hanyar yaɗa harshe, dokokinta da al'adunta. Yawancin bayanan da aka rubuta game da Daular Mali sun fito ne daga masanin tarihin Tunusiya na ƙarni na 14 [Ibn Khaldun](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ibn_Kaldun "Ibn Kaldun"), ɗan Moroko na ƙarni na 14 [Ibn Battuta](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ibn_Battuta "Ibn Battuta") da ɗan ƙasar Andalusian Leo Africanus na ƙarni na 16. Wata babbar hanyar samun bayanai ita ce al'adar baka ta Mandinka, kamar yadda masu ba da labari da aka sani da griots suka rubuta. [[2]](#cite_note-FOOTNOTEImperatoImperato2008-2)

Daular ta fara ne a matsayin wata karamar masarauta ta Mandinka da ke can saman kogin [Neja](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Neja_(kogi) "Neja (kogi)"), wacce ke kewayen Manding. [[1]](#cite_note-:4-1) A cikin karni na 11 da na 12, wata daula ta fara tasowa bayan faɗuwar daular [Ghana](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ghana "Ghana"), ko Wagadu, zuwa arewa. A cikin wannan lokacin, hanyoyin kasuwanci sun ƙaura zuwa kudu zuwa savanna, suna ƙarfafa ci gaban jihohi irin su Bonoman. Tarihin farko na Daular Mali (kafin karni na 13) ba a sani ba, saboda akwai labaran da ke karo da juna da kuma ingantattun bayanai daga malaman tarihin Larabawa da na baka. Sundiata Keita shine shugaba na farko wanda aka samu sahihin rubutaccen bayani (ta hanyar Ibn Khaldun). Sundiata Keita wani jarumi ne na daular Keita wanda aka yi kira da ya 'yantar da al'ummar Mali daga mulkin sarkin Sosso daular Soumaoro Kanté. Yakin Sosso a c. 1235 ya ba daular Mali damar shiga hanyoyin kasuwanci tsakanin Sahara.

Bayan mutuwar Sundiata Keita a c. Shekarar 1255, ana kiran sarakunan Mali da taken *mansa*. [[2]](#cite_note-FOOTNOTEImperatoImperato2008-2) a c. 1285 Sakoura, wanda tsohon bawa ne na gidan sarauta, ya zama sarki kuma yana ɗaya daga cikin manyan sarakunan [Mali](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mali "Mali"), wanda ya faɗaɗa yankin daular. Ya yi tattaki zuwa Makka a zamanin mulkin Mamluk Sultan An-Nasir Muhammad (r. 1298-1308), amma ya rasu a tafiyarsa ta gida. Bayan wasu sarakuna biyu Musa Keita ya zama mansa a c. 1312. Ya yi wata shahararriyar aikin hajji a Makka daga shekarar 1324 zuwa 1326. Kyautar da ya bayar ga Mamluk Masar da kuma yadda ya kashe zinare ya haifar da hauhawar farashin kayayyaki a Masar. [[3]](#cite_note-FOOTNOTEGoodwin1957-3) Maghan I ya gaji mahaifinsa a matsayin mansa a shekarar 1337, amma kawunsa Suleyman ya kore shi a shekarar 1341. A lokacin mulkin Suleyman na shekaru 19 ne Ibn Battuta ya ziyarci kasar Mali. [[2]](#cite_note-FOOTNOTEImperatoImperato2008-2) Mutuwar Suleyman ta nuna ƙarshen Zamanin Zinare na [Mali](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mali "Mali") da mafarin raguwar koma baya.

An sani daga Tarikh al-Sudan cewa har yanzu Mali ta kasance ƙasa mai girman gaske a karni na 15. Wani mai binciken dan kasar Venetia Alvise Cadamosto da ‘yan kasuwan Portugal sun tabbatar da cewa har yanzu [al’ummar Gambia](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kogin_Gambiya "Kogin Gambiya") na karkashin *mansa* na kasar Mali. [[2]](#cite_note-FOOTNOTEImperatoImperato2008-2) A ziyarar da Leo Africanus ya kai a farkon karni na 16, bayanin da ya yi game da yankunan Mali ya nuna cewa har yanzu daula ce mai girma. Duk da haka, daga shekara ta 1507 zuwa gaba jihohin da ke makwabtaka da su kamar Diara, Great Fulo da daular Songhay sun rabu a kan iyakar Mali. A shekara ta 1542, Songhay ya mamaye babban birnin kasar amma ba su yi nasara ba wajen mamaye daular. A cikin karni na 17, daular Mali ta fuskanci kutsawa daga Daular Bamana. Bayan yunkurin da [Mansa Mama Maghan](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mama_Maghan?action=edit&redlink=1 "Mama Maghan (babu wannan shafin)") ta yi na cin birnin Bamana bai yi nasara ba, a shekara ta 1670 Bamana ya kori tare da kona babban birnin ƙasar, kuma daular [Mali](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mali "Mali") ta wargaje cikin hanzari kuma ta daina wanzuwa, inda aka maye gurbinsu da sarakuna masu zaman kansu. Keitas sun koma garin Kangaba, inda suka zama sarakunan larduna. [[2]](#cite_note-FOOTNOTEImperatoImperato2008-2)

## Name (Suna)

[[gyara sashe](/w/index.php?title=Daular_Mali&veaction=edit&section=1 "Gyara sashe: Name (Suna)") | [gyara masomin](/w/index.php?title=Daular_Mali&action=edit&section=1 "Edit section's source code: Name (Suna)")]

*Mali*, *Mandé*, *Manden*, da *Manding* duk wasu lafuzzan lafuzza iri ɗaya ne na kalma ɗaya a cikin yaruka daban-daban. [[4]](#cite_note-FOOTNOTEDelafosse1912a-4) [Larabci](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Larabci "Larabci"): مالي‎, romanized: *Mālī*. [[5]](#cite_note-FOOTNOTENiane2006-5) *Mali* ita ce siffar [Fula](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fillanci "Fillanci"). [[6]](#cite_note-FOOTNOTEGomez2018-6) [[5]](#cite_note-FOOTNOTENiane2006-5) A cikin harsunan Manding, zuriyar zamani na harshen da ake magana a cikin tsakiyar daular Mali, *Manden* ko *Manding* shine sunan yankin da ya dace da tsakiyar daular [Mali](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mali "Mali"). [[7]](#cite_note-FOOTNOTEConrad2004-7)

Majiya mai tushe ta rabu kan ko Mali sunan wani gari ne ko yanki. [Ibn Battuta](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ibn_Battuta "Ibn Battuta"), wanda ya ziyarci babban birnin kasar daga shekarun 1352 zuwa 1353, ya kira kasar Mali. Catalan Atlas na 1375 ya kwatanta "birnin Melly" (Catalan) a [Afirka](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Afirka "Afirka") ta Yamma. [[8]](#cite_note-FOOTNOTEFauvelle2018-8) [Leo Africanus](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Leo_Africanus?action=edit&redlink=1 "Leo Africanus (babu wannan shafin)") ya ce ana kiran babban birnin Melli. [[9]](#cite_note-FOOTNOTEHunwick1973-9) Sai dai al-Umari ya bai wa *Mali* sunan babban birnin kasar kuma [Ibn Khaldun](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ibn_Khaldun?action=edit&redlink=1 "Ibn Khaldun (babu wannan shafin)") yana kiran *Mali* a matsayin al'umma, inda kowanne ya ba da sunaye daban-daban ga kansa. [[10]](#cite_note-FOOTNOTELevtzionHopkins2000-10) Ko *Mali* ta samo asali ne a matsayin sunan wani gari ko yanki, daga baya aka yi amfani da sunan ga dukan daular da ake mulki daga Mali. [[10]](#cite_note-FOOTNOTELevtzionHopkins2000-10) [[9]](#cite_note-FOOTNOTEHunwick1973-9)

Wani hasashe kuma ya nuna cewa sunan Mali ya samo asali ne daga Mandé *mali* "hippopotamus", dabbar da ke da mahimmanci ga Keitas, kuma Mandé yana nufin "karamin manatee". Wani almara ya yi iƙirarin cewa Sunjata ya rikiɗe zuwa hippopotamus. [[5]](#cite_note-FOOTNOTENiane2006-5) Duk da haka, waɗannan hasashe sun ƙi su daga cikin gida kuma ba su dace da yanayin da ake gani na *Mali* da *Mandé* ba. [[11]](#cite_note-11)

[↑](#cite_ref-11) [Delafosse 1912a](#CITEREFDelafosse1912a) harvnb error: no target: CITEREFDelafosse1912a ([help](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rukuni:Harv_and_Sfn_template_errors?action=edit&redlink=1 "Rukuni:Harv and Sfn template errors (babu wannan shafin)")) "On a voulou trouver à ce mto une étymologie totémique et on a traduit *Mali* par «hippopotame» et *Mandé* par «petit lamentin» : ces deux étymologies sont rejetées par les indigènes du pays, c'est-à-dire les Malinké, qui déclarent que *Mandé* ou *Mali* est simpliment le nom de leur patrie et qu'ils n'en connaissent pas la signification (1) et qui, au surplus, n'ont aucun totem de peuple, pas plus le lamentin que l'hippopotame: un de leurs clans seulement a pour *tana* ou «tabou» l'hippopotame et il n'en porte pas le nom (clan des Keïta)." "(1) Si d'ailleurs la forme *mali* peut signifier «hippopotame» dans certains dialectes, ce sens ne peut en aucune façon s'appliquer à la forme mandé; part contre, si l'on peut traduire *mandé*, *mané*, *mani*, etc. par «petit lamentin», il serait bien difficile de donner la même traduction aux formes *mali*, "mallé", etc.; on pourrait encore proposer l'étymologie de «fils de maitre», mais elle serait également fort douteuse."

title: Christa Reinig
text:
# Christa Reinig

**Christa Reinig** (6 ga watan Agustan a shekara ta 1926, a [Berlin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Berlin "Berlin") - 30 ga watan Satumbar a shekara ta 2008, a [Munich](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/M%C3%BCnchen "München")) mawaki ne na Jamus, marubucin almara da marubucin da ba na almara ba, kuma ɗan wasan kwaikwayo. Ta fara aikinta a yankin Soviet wanda ya zama Gabashin Berlin, an dakatar da ita a can, bayan bugawa a [Yammacin Jamus](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Yammacin_Jamus "Yammacin Jamus"), kuma ta koma Yamma a shekarar 1964, ta zauna a Munich. Ta kasance a bayyane [lesbian](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ma%C9%97igo "Maɗigo"). Ayyukanta suna da alamar baƙar fata, da ba'a.

## Rayuwa da aiki

[[gyara sashe](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Christa_Reinig&veaction=edit&section=1 "Gyara sashe: Rayuwa da aiki") | [gyara masomin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Christa_Reinig&action=edit&section=1 "Edit section's source code: Rayuwa da aiki")]

Reinig ta girma ne a gabashin Berlin ta mahaifiyarta, [Wilhelmine Reinig](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wilhelmine_Reinig?action=edit&redlink=1 "Wilhelmine Reinig (babu wannan shafin)"), wacce mace ce mai tsaftacewa. Bayan karshen [Yaƙin Duniya na Biyu](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ya%C6%99in_Duniya_na_II "Yaƙin Duniya na II"), Reinig ya kasance _Trümmerfrau_, kuma ya yi aiki a masana'anta.[[1]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Christa_Reinig#cite_note-Fembio-1) Ta kuma sayar da furanni a kan _Alexanderplatz_ a cikin shekarun 1940. A cikin shekarun 1950, ta sami Abitur a makarantar dare, kuma ta ci gaba da karatun tarihin fasaha a Jami'ar Humboldt, bayan haka ta ɗauki aiki a Gidan Tarihi na Märkisches, [gidan kayan gargajiya na tarihin Berlin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Museum_of_the_history_of_Berlin?action=edit&redlink=1 "Museum of the history of Berlin (babu wannan shafin)"), da Mark Brandenburg, inda ta yi aiki, har sai da ta bar Berlin zuwa Yamma.[[2]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Christa_Reinig#cite_note-radio-2)[[1]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Christa_Reinig#cite_note-Fembio-1)

Ta fara rubuce-rubucen rubuce-buce a ƙarshen shekarun 1940 a cikin mujallar satirical _Ulenspiegel_, [[3]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Christa_Reinig#cite_note-Tagesspiegel-3) a kan shawarar Bertolt Brecht; tana aiki a can a matsayin edita. [[4]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Christa_Reinig#cite_note-Spiegel-4) A shekara ta 1956, an haɗa ta da "Ballade vom blutigen Bomme" ("Ballad of Bloody Bomme", wanda aka fara bugawa a shekara ta 1952) a cikin littafin waka na Walter Höllerer Transit, wanda ya kawo ta ga masu karatu a Yamma; wani marubuci a shekara ta 1963 ya yi magana game da "haɗin ban mamaki na rashin tausayi da baƙin ciki mara tushe. "[[5]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Christa_Reinig#cite_note-5) Koyaya, an hana ta bugawa a Gabas, tun daga 1951, [[3]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Christa_Reinig#cite_note-Tagesspiegel-3) yayin da take ɗaliba. [[4]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Christa_Reinig#cite_note-Spiegel-4) Ta riga ta shiga cikin West Berlin _Gruppe Zukunftsachlicher Dichter_ (rukunin marubutan tunani na gaba), kuma ta ci gaba da buga waƙoƙi da labaru tare da masu wallafa Jamus ta Yamma.[[6]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Christa_Reinig#cite_note-Fembiode-6)

A shekara ta 1964, bayan mutuwar mahaifiyarta, [[6]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Christa_Reinig#cite_note-Fembiode-6) Reinig ta yi tafiya zuwa Jamus ta Yamma don karɓar Kyautar wallafe-wallafen Bremen kuma ta zauna a can, ta zauna a [Munich](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/M%C3%BCnchen "München"). [[3]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Christa_Reinig#cite_note-Tagesspiegel-3) Tana da ankylosing spondylitis; ta bar teburinta a gidan kayan gargajiya babu komai, sai dai X-ray na kashinta.

A shekara ta 1971, ta karya wuyanta a faduwa a kan matakala mai juzu'i; rashin isasshen kulawa ta kiwon lafiya ya bar ta da nakasa sosai, [[7]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Christa_Reinig#cite_note-Paradepferd-7) kuma tana rayuwa a kan fansho na gwamnati. [[3]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Christa_Reinig#cite_note-Tagesspiegel-3) Ba za ta iya sake amfani da na'urar buga takardu ba, har sai an haɗa ta da abubuwan da aka yi da musamman a cikin shekara ta 1973, bayan haka ta rubuta littafinta na farko, tarihin rayuwa Die himmlische und die irdische Geometrie (The Heavenly and the Earthly Geometry), wanda ta kammala a cikin 1974.[[4]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Christa_Reinig#cite_note-Spiegel-4)[[7]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Christa_Reinig#cite_note-Paradepferd-7)

Reinig ta mutu a ranar 30 ga Satumba 2008 a gidan kula da Katolika, inda ta koma a farkon wannan shekarar.[[3]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Christa_Reinig#cite_note-Tagesspiegel-3) Ta bar takardunta zuwa Gidan Tarihin Littattafan Jamusanci a Marbach ne Neckar .

## Jigogi da nau'ikan rubuce-rubuce

[[gyara sashe](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Christa_Reinig&veaction=edit&section=2 "Gyara sashe: Jigogi da nau'ikan rubuce-rubuce") | [gyara masomin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Christa_Reinig&action=edit&section=2 "Edit section's source code: Jigogi da nau'ikan rubuce-rubuce")]

Reinig ta fara ne a matsayin mawaki, kuma muryarta sau da yawa tana da alamomi da kuma metaphysical, da kuma halin baƙar fata, [[3]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Christa_Reinig#cite_note-Tagesspiegel-3) irony, brash, rayuwa- tabbatar da sarcasm, [[3]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Christa_Reinig#cite_note-Tagesspiegel-3) da kuma "mai sauƙin gaske". An san ta da 'yar tawaye, wacce ta tafi da kanta.[[8]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Christa_Reinig#cite_note-AquariumSZ-8) Ta ji kamar baƙo a Gabashin Jamus, duk da asalinta, da kuma a cikin ƙungiyar mata.[[2]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Christa_Reinig#cite_note-radio-2)

Labarin ta na farko da aka buga ya zo ne a shekarar 1946, "Ein Fischerdorf"; [[4]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Christa_Reinig#cite_note-Spiegel-4) kuma tsakanin 1949 da 1951, ta rubuta labaru game da mata da ke rayuwa ba tare da maza ba; duk da haka, shekaru 25 bayan haka, har sai tarihin rayuwa Die himmlische und die irdische Geometrie, aikin "pre-feminist" a cikin muryar mata, [[7]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Christa_Reinig#cite_note-Paradepferd-7) maza sun kasance a tsakiyar aikinta. Shekaru goma da suka fara a tsakiyar shekarun 1970, ta kasance marubuciya mai tsattsauran ra'ayi. Littafinsa na satirical na 1976, _Entmannung_, ya bayyana shugabanci a cikin tunanin maza da mata, [[4]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Christa_Reinig#cite_note-Spiegel-4) kuma ya kai ta ga fitowa; [1] a cikin zagaye na waƙoƙi na 1979, _Müßiggang ist aller Liebe Anfang_ (daga baya aka buga shi a fassarar Turanci kamar yadda _Rashin aiki shine Tushen Duk Ƙauna_), ta bayyana lesbianism a cikin aikinta a karon farko.[[1]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Christa_Reinig#cite_note-Fembio-1)[[9]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Christa_Reinig#cite_note-9) Reinig ta ce game da kanta a cikin wata hira da take da shekaru sittin, "Ni marubuciya ce ta lesbian kamar yadda ni marubuciya ce a matsayin marubuciya ta mata, kuma 'yar luwaɗi; _Entmannung_, wanda ke nufin "masculation", wani masanin tarihin Jamus mai ra'ayin mazan jiya ya bayyana shi, a matsayin "mafi girman kai na mata".[[1]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Christa_Reinig#cite_note-Fembio-1)[[3]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Christa_Reinig#cite_note-Tagesspiegel-3) A ƙarshen shekarun 1980s, ta bar ƙungiyar mata; a cikin _Müßiggang ist aller Liebe Anfang_, ta rubuta: "Wani lokaci rigar gay tana kusa da ni fiye da rigar mata". [[1]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Christa_Reinig#cite_note-Fembio-1)[[10]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Christa_Reinig#cite_note-10)Ta kuma fassara wallafe-wallafen Rasha, kuma ta rubuta wasan kwaikwayo na sauti. Littafinta na ƙarshe, a shekara ta 2006, wani nau'i ne na tunanin falsafa mai taken, _Das Gelbe vom Himmel_ (The Yellow from Heaven). [[4]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Christa_Reinig#cite_note-Spiegel-4) [1][[3]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Christa_Reinig#cite_note-Tagesspiegel-3)

title: Spent (wasan bidiyo)
text:
# _Spent_ (wasan bidiyo)

Spent (mai suna SPENT) wasa ne na kan yanar gizo game da [talauci](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Talauci "Talauci") da Rashin gida. Kamfanin talla na McKinney ne ya kirkireshi don abokin ciniki na pro bono Urban Ministries of Durham (UMD), wata kungiya mai zaman kanta a Durham, North Carolina wacce ke ba da sabis ga waɗanda ke cikin talauci.[[1]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Spent_(wasan_bidiyo)#cite_note-1) Dole ne 'yan wasa su yanke shawara mai wuya don rayuwa na wata daya a kan $ 1,000, sau da yawa ana tilasta musu zaɓar tsakanin zaɓuɓɓuka biyu masu ɗaci iri ɗaya, kamar samun abinci mai gina jiki da samun wutar lantarki, ko biyan mafi ƙarancin kuɗin katin bashi da kuma biyan kuɗin haya.

An saki Spent don burauza da wayar hannu a watan Fabrairun 2011. Izuwa shekara ta 2014, an buga shi fiye da sau miliyan 4.[[2]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Spent_(wasan_bidiyo)#cite_note-2)[needs update]

## Tsarin Wasa

[[gyara sashe](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Spent_(wasan_bidiyo)&veaction=edit&section=1 "Gyara sashe: Tsarin Wasa") | [gyara masomin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Spent_(wasan_bidiyo)&action=edit&section=1 "Edit section's source code: Tsarin Wasa")]

Mai wasan, wanda yake iyaye guda ne da ke fama da talauci, ana ba shi dala 1,000 domin ya rayu na tsawon wata guda; sannan dole ne ya zaɓi aikin yi, wanda kowannensu ake biyan mafi ƙarancin albashi. Manufar wasan ita ce a ƙarshen watan ya kasance akwai wani kuɗi da ya rage. A tsawon watan da wasan ya ƙunsa, dole ne mai wasan ya yanke shawara masu wahala da suka shafi gidaje, abubuwan amfani na yau da kullum, kayan abinci, da salon rayuwa, da sauransu, domin tabbatar da rayuwarsa na aƙalla wannan watan; da dama daga cikin waɗannan shawarwarin na iya haifar da mummunan sakamako na dogon lokaci. Misali, zaɓin rashin sabunta rajistar abin hawa (wadda ke kashe kuɗi mai yawa) na iya sa a tsayar da mai wasan yayin tuƙi, inda zai zaɓi ko dai ya biya tara ko kuma ya shafe ranar aiki yana zuwa kotu. Hakan yana ƙara masa wani gargadin aiki (inda ake korar mai wasan daga aikinsa bayan gargadi na uku), ƙarin kuɗin da zai ci gaba da fuskanta na dogon lokaci, da kuma raguwar kuɗin da zai karɓa a matsayin albashi.'Yan wasan suna da zaɓi don amfani da haɗin kafofin sada zumunta na ainihi a kan dandamali kamar [Facebook](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fezbuk "Fezbuk") da [Twitter](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Twitter "Twitter") don neman taimako ga aboki, ta hanyar zama tallan kwayoyin halitta (organic advertising) ga shafin yanar gizon tare da keɓance ƙwarewar mai amfani.

Wasu daga cikin shawarwarin suna ɗauke da gajerun saƙonni masu ba da bayanai game da ƙididdiga na zahiri da kuma matsalolin da suka shafi talauci. Alal misali, bayan yanke shawarar ko za a zauna kusa da wurin aiki (inda kuɗin haya ya yi tsada, amma kuɗin sufuri ya yi ƙasa) ko kuma a zauna nesa da wurin aiki (inda kuɗin haya ya fi araha, amma kuɗin sufuri ya fi yawa sosai), ana nuna wa mai wasan saƙon: "Rashin Gidaje masu araha shine dalilin farko na rashin gida".

Wasan yana ƙarewa ne idan mai wasan ya rasa duk kuɗinsa kafin ƙarshen watan, ko ya kai ƙarshen watan da wasu kuɗi suka rage, ko kuma ya zaɓi kawo ƙarshen wasan da kansa. A allon ƙarshen wasan, an bayyana cewa har yanzu akwai kuɗin haya da za a biya, sannan a gayyaci mai wasan da ya “taimaka wa wani da ke rayuwa _Spent_ a yau” ta hanyar ƙarin koyo game da UMD da kuma ba da gudummawa ga ƙungiyar.

## Ƙirƙira

[[gyara sashe](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Spent_(wasan_bidiyo)&veaction=edit&section=2 "Gyara sashe: Ƙirƙira") | [gyara masomin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Spent_(wasan_bidiyo)&action=edit&section=2 "Edit section's source code: Ƙirƙira")]

Ƙungiyar McKinney mai mambobi 11 ta lura cewa dubban miliyoyin mutane a kowane wata suna buga wasannin zamantakewar yanar gizo kamar _FarmVille_ da _Mafia Wars_. Sun yi zargin cewa za a iya amfani da siffofin waɗannan wasanni wajen ilmantar da mutane game da ainihin yanayin talauci da rashin matsuguni. Ƙungiyar ta gudanar da tarukan tattaunawa tare da ma’aikatan shari’ar UMD da kuma mutanen da suke taimakawa, domin bincika abubuwan da suka dace wajen tsara yanayin da ke cikin _Spent_.[[3]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Spent_(wasan_bidiyo)#cite_note-3)

_Spent_ yana amfani da ƙididdiga na zahiri daga rayuwa a matsayin wani ɓangare na wasan, kamar ƙimar haya ta kasuwar Durham da aka yi la’akari da ita wajen ƙayyade farashin gidaje a wasan.

Masu ba da gudummawa sun ce kungiyar ta jimre da shekaru masu wahala don isar da wasan.

## Saki da yabo

[[gyara sashe](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Spent_(wasan_bidiyo)&veaction=edit&section=3 "Gyara sashe: Saki da yabo") | [gyara masomin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Spent_(wasan_bidiyo)&action=edit&section=3 "Edit section's source code: Saki da yabo")]

An fitar da _Spent_ a watan Fabrairun 2011.[[4]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Spent_(wasan_bidiyo)#cite_note-:0-4) Wasan ya tara dala 45,000 daga sabbin masu ba da gudummawa 25,000 ga UMD cikin sama da watanni 10 kaɗan,[[5]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Spent_(wasan_bidiyo)#cite_note-5)sannan ya samu yabo daga [CNN](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/CNN "CNN"), ABC, and _Fast Company_[[6]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Spent_(wasan_bidiyo)#cite_note-6) saboda yadda yake iya ƙara wayar da kan jama'a game da talauci a cikin yanayin kafofin sada zumunta mai jan hankali.

A watan Satumbar 2011, McKinney da UMD sun kaddamar da takarda ga mambobin Majalisa ta Amurka [[7]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Spent_(wasan_bidiyo)#cite_note-7) don ɗaukar minti goma suna buga wasan don "gane ƙalubalen da Amurkawa sama da miliyan 14 ke fuskanta".

zuwa watan Disamba na shekara ta 2013, wasan ya ci gaba da samun sabbin wasanni 5,000 a kowace rana. An saki sigar HTML a watan Yulin 2014.

Kusan mutane miliyan 2 sun kashe matsakaicin 11:46 a shafin.[[4]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Spent_(wasan_bidiyo)#cite_note-:0-4)

An yi amfani da kwaikwayon SPENT a manyan makarantun ilimi wajen koyar da ɗaliban ilimin iyali da consumer sciences game da talauci.

# Cadi


Cikin birnin cadi


**Mahamat Déby shugaban kasar mai ci**



manuniyar cadi


bodar cadi


Ƙasar **Chadi,** tana ɗaya daga cikin ƙasashen da suke [Afirika](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Afirka_ta_Tsakiya_(yanki) "Afirka ta Tsakiya (yanki)") ta tsakiya.[[1]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cadi#cite_note-1)[[2]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cadi#cite_note-2)[[3]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cadi#cite_note-3) Tanada iyaka da ƙasashe shida sune:- daga nahiyar gabas [Sudan](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sudan "Sudan"),[[4]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cadi#cite_note-4)[[5]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cadi#cite_note-5)[[6]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cadi#cite_note-6)[[7]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cadi#cite_note-7) nahiyar arewa [Libya](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Libya "Libya") daga nahiyar yamma [Nijar](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nijar "Nijar") da [Kamaru](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kamaru "Kamaru") da [Najeriya](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nijeriya "Nijeriya"), nahiyar kudu jamhuriyar [Afirka ta tsakiya](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Afirka_ta_tsakiya "Afirka ta tsakiya").[[8]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cadi#cite_note-8)[[9]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cadi#cite_note-9)[[10]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cadi#cite_note-10) Ƙasar Chadi ƙasa ce da bata da wani [kogi](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kogi "Kogi") ko teku,[[11]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cadi#cite_note-11)[[12]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cadi#cite_note-12) amma tanada wani ɗan tabki sunansa tabkin Chadi yana [arewa](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Arewa_maso_yammacin "Arewa maso yammacin") maso yammacin [Ndjamena](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ndjamena "Ndjamena") baban birnin ƙasar.[[13]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cadi#cite_note-13)[[14]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cadi#cite_note-14)[[15]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cadi#cite_note-15)[[16]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cadi#cite_note-16)

Kasar [Chadi](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Larabcin_Chadi "Larabcin Chadi") tasamu yancin gashin kanta daga hannun kasar [faransa](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Faransa "Faransa") tun daga ranar 11 ga watan Agusta a shekarar 1960,[[17]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cadi#cite_note-17)[[18]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cadi#cite_note-18)[[19]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cadi#cite_note-19) a wannan lokacin [Ngarta Tombalbaye](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ngarta_Tombalbaye "Ngarta Tombalbaye") dan kudanci chadi wanda ba musulmi bane ya karbi ikon kasa daga hannun [Faransa](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Faransa "Faransa").[[20]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cadi#cite_note-20)[[21]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cadi#cite_note-21) Bayan shekara 5 da karbar mulki sai aka fara yaki tsakaninsa da musulmai ýan arewacin kasar,[[22]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cadi#cite_note-22)[[23]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cadi#cite_note-23) acikin babban birni [Ndjamena](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ndjamena "Ndjamena"),[[24]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cadi#cite_note-24) haka aka cigaba da yakin har shekara ta 1979 musulmai suka yi nasara akan ýan kudancin kasar wadan da, mafi yawansu ba musulmai bane.[[25]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cadi#cite_note-25)[[26]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cadi#cite_note-26) A waccan lokaci [Hissène Habré](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hiss%C3%A8ne_Habr%C3%A9 "Hissène Habré") yazama shugaban Kasar.[[27]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cadi#cite_note-27)[[28]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cadi#cite_note-28)[[29]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cadi#cite_note-29)[[30]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cadi#cite_note-30)

title: Margaret Busby
text:
# Margaret Busby

**Margaret Yvonne Busby**, CBE, Hon. FRSL (an haife ta a shekara ta 1944) wacce kuma aka sani da **Nana Akua Ackon**, haifaffiyar kasar Ghana ce, edita, marubuciya kuma mai watsa shirye-shirye, mazauniyar [Birtaniya](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Birtaniya "Birtaniya"). Ita ce ƙarama kuma bakar mace ta farko mai buga littafi[[1]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Margaret_Busby#cite_note-1)[[2]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Margaret_Busby#cite_note-SpreadtheWord2-2) a cikin shekarun 1960 ta yi aiki tare da Clive Allison (1944-2011)[[3]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Margaret_Busby#cite_note-AllisonObit2-3) gidan wallafe-wallafen London da ke Allison da Busby (A & B).[[4]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Margaret_Busby#cite_note-4) Ta yi rubutun tarihin _Daughters of Africa_ (1992), da kuma _New Daughters of Africa_ na shekara ta 2019.[[5]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Margaret_Busby#cite_note-5) Ita ce ta karɓi kyautar Benson daga Royal Society of Literature.[[6]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Margaret_Busby#cite_note-Omuemezi2-6) A shekara ta 2020 an zaɓe ta ɗaya daga cikin "100 Great Black Britons".[[7]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Margaret_Busby#cite_note-100_Great_Black_Britons2-7)

## Ilimi da kuruciya

[[gyara sashe](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Margaret_Busby&veaction=edit&section=1 "Gyara sashe: Ilimi da kuruciya") | [gyara masomin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Margaret_Busby&action=edit&section=1 "Edit section's source code: Ilimi da kuruciya")]

An haifi Margaret Yvonne Busby a shekara ta 1944,[[8]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Margaret_Busby#cite_note-8)[[9]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Margaret_Busby#cite_note-brittlepaper.com2-9)[[10]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Margaret_Busby#cite_note-10) a Accra, Gold Coast (Ghana ta yanzu), ga iyaye Dr George Busby da Mrs Sarah Busby (_née_ Christian), waɗanda dukkansu suna da alaƙa da dangi zuwa Caribbean, musamman zuwa Trinidad, Barbados da Dominica. Dr Busby (1899-1980)[[11]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Margaret_Busby#cite_note-11)[[12]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Margaret_Busby#cite_note-12) aboki ne na tsawon rai na mai ba da shawara [Kwame Nkrumah](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kwame_Nkrumah "Kwame Nkrumah") George Padmore[[13]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Margaret_Busby#cite_note-13) kuma ya halarci makaranta tare da C. L. R. James a Kwalejin Queen's Royal, inda ya lashe Sikolashif na Island, wanda ya ba shi damar zuwa Burtaniya a 1919 don yin karatun likita.[[14]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Margaret_Busby#cite_note-ShereenAli2-14) Bayan kammala karatun farko a Jami'ar Edinburgh, ya koma Kwalejin Jami'a, Dublin, don kammala karatun digirinsa na likita, sannan ya yi aiki a matsayin likita a Walthamstow, Gabashin [London](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/London "London"),[[15]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Margaret_Busby#cite_note-video2-15) kafin ya koma ya zauna a Gold Coast a 1929.[[16]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Margaret_Busby#cite_note-16)[[17]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Margaret_Busby#cite_note-17) Ta hanyar mahaifiyarta, ita 'yar uwan wakilin [BBC](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/BBC "BBC") ce Moira Stuart,[[18]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Margaret_Busby#cite_note-18)[[19]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Margaret_Busby#cite_note-19)[[20]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Margaret_Busby#cite_note-20) kuma kakanta shi ne George James Christian (1869-1940),[[21]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Margaret_Busby#cite_note-21) wakili a Taron Farko na Afirka a [London](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/London "London") a 1900,[[22]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Margaret_Busby#cite_note-22)[[23]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Margaret_Busby#cite_note-23) wanda ya yi ƙaura zuwa Gold Coast a 1902.[[24]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Margaret_Busby#cite_note-24)[[25]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Margaret_Busby#cite_note-25)


Margaret Busby a gefe 

Iyayenta sun tura yaransu uku don suyi karatu a Ingila lokacin da Busby take shekara biyar. Ita da 'yar uwarta sun fara zuwa wata makaranta a gundumar Lake tare da Makarantar Charters Towers, makarantar kwana ta 'yan mata ta duniya a Bexhill-on-Sea.[[26]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Margaret_Busby#cite_note-GR2-26)[[27]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Margaret_Busby#cite_note-Granta2-27) Bayan wucewa ta matakan O a can tana da shekaru 14, Busby ta bar makaranta a 15,[[28]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Margaret_Busby#cite_note-28) ta koma Ghana ta ɗauki matakan A a 16,[[29]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Margaret_Busby#cite_note-Hoyt12-29) sannan ta yi shekara ɗaya a wata kwaleji a Cambridge don kar ta fara jami'a ma ƙarami.[[27]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Margaret_Busby#cite_note-Granta2-27) Tun tana dan shekara 17 ta karanci Turanci a Kwalejin Bedford (daga baya aka hade ta da Royal Holloway College), Jami'ar London,[[27]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Margaret_Busby#cite_note-Granta2-27)[[30]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Margaret_Busby#cite_note-30) inda ta shirya mujallar adabin kwaleji tare da buga wakoki na kanta, sannan ta kammala tare da digiri na BA a cikin shekaru 20.[[31]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Margaret_Busby#cite_note-31) Ta yi aure da mawakin jazz na Burtaniya kuma malami, Lionel Grigson (1942-1994).[[3]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Margaret_Busby#cite_note-AllisonObit2-3)

## Aikin wallafe-wallafe

[[gyara sashe](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Margaret_Busby&veaction=edit&section=2 "Gyara sashe: Aikin wallafe-wallafe") | [gyara masomin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Margaret_Busby&action=edit&section=2 "Edit section's source code: Aikin wallafe-wallafe")]

Yayin da kuma take jami'a ta sadu da takwararta ta kasuwanci nan gaba Clive Allison a wani biki a Bayswater Road,[[32]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Margaret_Busby#cite_note-remembers2-32) kuma sun yanke shawarar fara kamfanin buga littattafai.[[3]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Margaret_Busby#cite_note-AllisonObit2-3) Bayan kammala karatun, Busby ta yi aiki a takaice a Cresset Press - wani ɓangare na Kungiyar Barrie - yayin kafa Allison da Busby (A & B) wanda aka buga littattafansa na farko a shekarar 1967,[[33]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Margaret_Busby#cite_note-Bookseller2-33) ta zama mafi karancin mawallafin sannan kuma mace ta farko da ta wallafa littafin Afirka a Burtaniya - nasarar da ta tantance ta ce: "Yana da sauƙin zama na farko, kowannenmu zai iya gwada wani abu kuma ya kasance mace ta farko ko mace ta farko ta Afirka da ta yi X, Y ko Z. Amma, idan abu ne mai mahimmanci ba kwa son zama shi kaɗai. ...Ina kuma fatan zan iya, ta kowace hanya, in sa wani ya yi abin da na yi amma koya daga kurakurai na kuma yi kyau fiye da yadda na yi."[[34]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Margaret_Busby#cite_note-34)

Ta kuma kasance Daraktan Edita na Allison & Busby na shekaru 20,[[35]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Margaret_Busby#cite_note-SILeeds2-35) wallafa marubuta da yawa sanannu ciki har da Sam Greenlee (marubucin _The Spook Who Sat by the Door_, labari na farko da A & B ya buga, a shekara ta 1969),[[36]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Margaret_Busby#cite_note-36)[[37]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Margaret_Busby#cite_note-37) C. L. R. James,[[38]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Margaret_Busby#cite_note-38)[Buchi Emecheta](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Buchi_Emecheta "Buchi Emecheta"), Chester Himes, George Lamming, Roy Heath, Isma'ilu Reed, John Edgar Wideman, Nuruddin Farah, Rosa Guy, Val Wilmer, Colin MacInnes, H. Rap Brown, Julius Lester, Geoffrey Grigson, Edward Blishen, Dermot Healy, Adrian Mitchell, Matta Sweeney, Jill Murphy, Christine Qunta, Michael Horovitz, Alexandra Kollontai, Gordon Williams, Carlos Moore, Michèle Roberts, Molefe Pheto, Arthur Maimane, Maurice Nyagumbo, Giles Gordon, Claire Rayner, Clive Sinclair, Mineke Schipper, Chris Searle, Richard Stark, James Ellroy, Mafarauci S. Thompson, Margaret Thomson Davis, B. Traven, Alexis Lykiard, Tom Mallin, Labarin Jack Trevor, Michael Moorcock, Mervyn Peake, John Clute, Julian Savarin, Ralph de Boissière, Andrew Salkey, Harriet E. Wilson, da Miyamoto Musashi.[[32]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Margaret_Busby#cite_note-remembers2-32)[[26]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Margaret_Busby#cite_note-GR2-26)


Margaret Busby

Daga baya Busby ta kasance editan edita na Earthscan (watsa lakabi da Han Suyin, Frantz Fanon, Albert Memmi, René Dumont, Carolina Maria de Jesus, da sauransu),[[35]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Margaret_Busby#cite_note-SILeeds2-35) kafin su fara aiki mai zaman kansa a matsayin edita, marubuci, kuma mai sukar lamiri.

## Rubutu, gyarawa da watsa shirye-shirye

[[gyara sashe](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Margaret_Busby&veaction=edit&section=3 "Gyara sashe: Rubutu, gyarawa da watsa shirye-shirye") | [gyara masomin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Margaret_Busby&action=edit&section=3 "Edit section's source code: Rubutu, gyarawa da watsa shirye-shirye")]

A matsayin dan jarida, ta yi rubutu don _The Guardian_ (akasarin littafin bita[[39]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Margaret_Busby#cite_note-39)[[40]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Margaret_Busby#cite_note-40)[[41]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Margaret_Busby#cite_note-41)[[42]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Margaret_Busby#cite_note-42) ko labarin masu fasaha da masu fafutuka ciki har da Jessica Huntley, Buzz Johnson, Jayne Cortez, Jan Carew, Rosa Guy, Gwendolyn Brooks, Yuni Jordan, Toni Cade Bambara, Florynce Kennedy, Barry Reckord, Frank Crichlow, Connie Mark, Glenn Thompson, Agusta Wilson, Pearl Connor-Mogotsi, Geraldine Connor, Binyavanga Wainaina da Bell hooks),[[43]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Margaret_Busby#cite_note-43)_The Observer_,[[44]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Margaret_Busby#cite_note-44)_The Independent_,[[45]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Margaret_Busby#cite_note-45)_The Sunday Times_,[[46]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Margaret_Busby#cite_note-46)_The_ _New Statesman_,[[47]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Margaret_Busby#cite_note-47) da sauran wurare, duka manyan jaridu da mujallu na musamman.[[26]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Margaret_Busby#cite_note-GR2-26)[[48]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Margaret_Busby#cite_note-48)

### _'Yaya Matan Afurka_ (1992) da _Sabbin_ '_Yaya Matan Afurka_ (2019)

[[gyara sashe](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Margaret_Busby&veaction=edit&section=4 "Gyara sashe: 'Yaya Matan Afurka (1992) da Sabbin 'Yaya Matan Afurka  (2019)") | [gyara masomin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Margaret_Busby&action=edit&section=4 "Edit section's source code: 'Yaya Matan Afurka (1992) da Sabbin 'Yaya Matan Afurka  (2019)")]

Busby ta tattara 'littafin 'Ya'ya Matan Afurka _: Jerin Maganganu da kuma rubuce-rubuce daga Mata 'Yan Asalin Afurka daga Zamanin Tsohuwar Misra zuwa Yanzu_ (London: Cape, 1992),[[49]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Margaret_Busby#cite_note-49)[[50]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Margaret_Busby#cite_note-50) wanda _Black Enterprise_ ya bayyana a matsayin "alamar ƙasa", wanda ya haɗa da gudummawa a cikin kewayon nau'ikan mata sama da 200.[[51]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Margaret_Busby#cite_note-51) An sake yin nazari sosai akan wallafawa,[[52]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Margaret_Busby#cite_note-52)[[53]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Margaret_Busby#cite_note-53) yanzu ana nuna shi da ɗaukar aiki ta "matriarchs of the African literature. Sun fara yin rubutun 'Afirka', wanda ba kawai suna rubuta labarai game da danginsu ba, al'ummominsu da ƙasashe, har ma suna rubuta kansu cikin tarihin adabin Afirka da tarihin Afirka. Sun nemi sarari ga mata masu bayar da labarai a rubuce, kuma a wata ma'ana sun sake daukar matsayin mace a matsayin mahalicci kuma mai daukar labarun al'ummomin Afirka da yawa, idan aka yi la’akari da cewa zaman bayar da labarun gargajiya na yanki ne na mata."[[54]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Margaret_Busby#cite_note-54)

Busby ta gyara a wani sabon bugu na shekara ta 2019 mai take _Sabbin_ '_Yaya Matan Afurka_: _Jerin Maganganu da kuma rubuce-rubuce daga Mata 'Yan Asalin Afurka daga Zamanin Tsohuwar Misra zuwa Yanzu_ (wanda aka buga a Myriad Editions a Burtaniya), wanda ya nuna wasu marubutan sama da 200 daga ƙasashen waje na Afirka.[[6]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Margaret_Busby#cite_note-Omuemezi2-6)[[55]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Margaret_Busby#cite_note-55)[[56]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Margaret_Busby#cite_note-56)[[57]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Margaret_Busby#cite_note-57)[[58]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Margaret_Busby#cite_note-58) Wani mai sharhi a cikin _The Irish Times_ yayi sharhi: "Wani lokaci kuna buƙatar anthology don tunatar da ku game da iri-iri, ƙarfi da ƙima na rubuce-rubuce tsakanin wani yanki ko gungun mutane. _New Daughters of Africa_ na da mahimmanci saboda muryoyin Afirka sun katse ko raguwa cikin tarihi, kuma muryoyin mata sun fi haka."[[59]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Margaret_Busby#cite_note-59)


Margaret Busby

An haɗa shi da anthology na 2019, mai gabatar da sanarwar "Margaret Busby _New Daughters of Africa_ Award", tare da haɗin gwiwar SOAS, Jami'ar London, waɗanda za su amfana da ɗalibin mace mace ta Afirka,[[60]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Margaret_Busby#cite_note-60)[[61]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Margaret_Busby#cite_note-61)[[62]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Margaret_Busby#cite_note-62)[[63]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Margaret_Busby#cite_note-63) ta rufe kuɗin koyarwa da masauki a Studentsan Daliban Internationalasa na Duniya, London.[[64]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Margaret_Busby#cite_note-64)[[65]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Margaret_Busby#cite_note-65) Wanda ya fara karbar kyautar, dalibar [Kenya](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kenya "Kenya") Idza Luhumyo, ta fara karatun ta ne a kaka 2020.[[66]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Margaret_Busby#cite_note-66)[[67]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Margaret_Busby#cite_note-67)

### Sauran ayyukan littattafai

[[gyara sashe](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Margaret_Busby&veaction=edit&section=5 "Gyara sashe: Sauran ayyukan littattafai") | [gyara masomin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Margaret_Busby&action=edit&section=5 "Edit section's source code: Sauran ayyukan littattafai")]


Margaret Busby

Busby ta ba da gudummawa ga littattafai ciki har da Launin Sabon Yini: _Rubutu don Afurka ta Kudu_ (eds Sarah LeFanu da Stephen Hayward, 1990), _Uwaye: Tunawa daga 'Ya'ya Mata_ (ed. Joanna Goldsworthy, 1995),[[68]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Margaret_Busby#cite_note-68)_IC3: The Penguin Book of New Black Writing in Britain_ (eds Kadija Sesay da Courttia Newland, 2000),[[69]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Margaret_Busby#cite_note-69)_Why 2K? Anthology for a New Era_ (2000), _The Legacy of Efua Sutherland_ (2007), _Essays in Honour of Ama Ata Aidoo at 70_ (2012),[[70]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Margaret_Busby#cite_note-Brill2-70)_99 words_ (ed. Liz Gray, 2011),[[71]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Margaret_Busby#cite_note-71)_Black British Perspectives: A Series of Conversations on Black Art Forms_ (ed. Kadija Sesay, 2011), _If I Could Tell You Just One Thing...: Encounters with Remarkable People and Their Most Valuable Advice_ (ta Richard Reed, 2016),[[72]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Margaret_Busby#cite_note-72)[[73]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Margaret_Busby#cite_note-73)_Slay in Your Lane: The Black Girl Bible_ (ta Elizabeth Uviebinené da Yomi Adegoke, 2018),[[74]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Margaret_Busby#cite_note-74) da _The Artist in Time_ na Chris Fite-Wassilak (Yuli 2020).[[75]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Margaret_Busby#cite_note-75)[[76]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Margaret_Busby#cite_note-76)

A cikin shekara ta 2014, Busby ta yi rubutu tare da Ishmahil _Carnival: A Photographic and Testimonial History of the Notting Hill Carnival_.[[77]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Margaret_Busby#cite_note-77) Daga cikin wasu littattafan da ta rubuta gabatarwar ko kalmomin gaba sune Penguin Modern Classics bugu na _A Question of Power_ ta Bessie Head, _Emerging Perspectives on Buchi Emecheta_ (ed. Marie Umeh, 1996), _Beyond Words: South African Poetics_ (tare da Keorapetse Kgositsile, Don Mattera, Lebo Mashile da Phillippa Yaa de Villiers, 2009),[[78]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Margaret_Busby#cite_note-78) da _To Sweeten Bitter_ (2017) ta Raymond Antrobus.[[79]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Margaret_Busby#cite_note-79) Tare da Darcus Howe, Busby ta sake shirya _C.L.R. James's 80th Birthday Lectures_ (Race Yau Publications, 1984),[[80]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Margaret_Busby#cite_note-80) kuma ita ce edita tare da Beverley Mason FRSA na _No Colour Bar: Black British Art in Action 1960–1990_, wani littafin 2018 wanda ya fito daga nunin 2015-16 _No Colour Bar_ da aka gudanar a Guildhall Art Gallery.[[81]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Margaret_Busby#cite_note-81)

Busby ta kasance fitacciyar ɗan takara a babban nunin _Get Up, Stand Up Now: Generations of Black Creative Pioneers_ na 2019 a Somerset House,[[82]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Margaret_Busby#cite_note-82)[[83]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Margaret_Busby#cite_note-83) kuma ta ba da gudummawar gabatarwar muƙalar ga kasida,[[84]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Margaret_Busby#cite_note-84)[[85]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Margaret_Busby#cite_note-85) da kuma shiga cikin abubuwan da suka faru a can.[[86]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Margaret_Busby#cite_note-86)

### Watsa shirye-shirye da wasan kwaikwayo

[[gyara sashe](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Margaret_Busby&veaction=edit&section=6 "Gyara sashe: Watsa shirye-shirye da wasan kwaikwayo") | [gyara masomin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Margaret_Busby&action=edit&section=6 "Edit section's source code: Watsa shirye-shirye da wasan kwaikwayo")]

Busby ta yi aiki a kai a kai don rediyo da talabijin tun daga ƙarshen shekarun 1960, lokacin da ta gabatar da shirin mujallar _London Line_ don Babban Ofishin Bayanai,[[87]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Margaret_Busby#cite_note-87) kazalika da _Break For Women_ akan BBC African Service,[[33]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Margaret_Busby#cite_note-Bookseller2-33) daga baya kuma _Talking Africa_ akan Rediyon Spectrum, ban da bayyana a kan shirye-shirye da dama ciki har da _Kaleidoscope_, _Front Row_, _Open Book_, _Woman's Hour_, da _Democracy Now!_ (Amurka).[[14]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Margaret_Busby#cite_note-ShereenAli2-14)

Abubuwan da ta kunsa da kuma wasan kwaikwayo na Rediyon BBC sun hada da littattafan C. L. R. James,[[88]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Margaret_Busby#cite_note-88) Jean Rhys,[[89]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Margaret_Busby#cite_note-89)[Wole Soyinka](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wole_Soyinka "Wole Soyinka"),[[90]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Margaret_Busby#cite_note-90) Timothy Mo,[[91]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Margaret_Busby#cite_note-91) Sam Selvon,[[92]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Margaret_Busby#cite_note-92) Walter Mosley,[[93]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Margaret_Busby#cite_note-93) Henry Louis Gates,[[94]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Margaret_Busby#cite_note-94) Lawrence Scott[[95]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Margaret_Busby#cite_note-95) da Simi Bedford.[[96]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Margaret_Busby#cite_note-96) Wasan Busby wanda ya danganta da littafi _Minty Alley_ na C. L. R. James, wanda Pam Fraser Solomon ya kirkira, an fara watsa shi ne a Rediyon BBC 4 a 1998,[[97]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Margaret_Busby#cite_note-97)[[98]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Margaret_Busby#cite_note-98) inda ya lashe Hukumar Racaukaka Racabi'a "Race a cikin Media Award" (RIMA) a 1999.[[99]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Margaret_Busby#cite_note-99)[[100]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Margaret_Busby#cite_note-100) Hakanan ta kasance wani ɓangare na Penumbra Productions, kamfani mai zaman kanta, tare da sauran membobin da suka haɗa da Horace Ové, H. O. Nazarat, Farrukh Dhondy, Mustapha Matura, Michael Abbensetts da Lindsay Barrett, daga cikin ayyukan su jerin fina-finai ne da suka danganci laccoci da C. L. R. James a cikin 1980s.[[101]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Margaret_Busby#cite_note-101)[[102]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Margaret_Busby#cite_note-102)[[103]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Margaret_Busby#cite_note-103)

Rubutun da ta yi don matakin ya hada da _Sankofa_ (1999),[[104]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Margaret_Busby#cite_note-104)_Yaa Asantewaa – Warrior Queen_ (UK/Ghana, 2001-02),[[105]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Margaret_Busby#cite_note-105)[[106]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Margaret_Busby#cite_note-106)[[107]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Margaret_Busby#cite_note-107)[[108]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Margaret_Busby#cite_note-108) Geraldine Connor,[[109]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Margaret_Busby#cite_note-109)[[110]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Margaret_Busby#cite_note-110)[[111]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Margaret_Busby#cite_note-111) da kuma _An African Cargo_ (Greenwich Theater, 2007) wanda Felix Cross ya jagoranta.[[112]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Margaret_Busby#cite_note-112)[[113]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Margaret_Busby#cite_note-113)[[114]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Margaret_Busby#cite_note-114)[[115]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Margaret_Busby#cite_note-115)[[116]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Margaret_Busby#cite_note-116) Ta kuma kasance mai son kida.[[117]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Margaret_Busby#cite_note-117)[[118]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Margaret_Busby#cite_note-118)[[119]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Margaret_Busby#cite_note-119)

A cikin shekara ta 2014, bayan mutuwar [Maya Angelou](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Maya_Angelou "Maya Angelou"), Busby ta rubuta wata babbar kyauta mai taken _Maya Angelou: A Celebration_,[[120]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Margaret_Busby#cite_note-120) wanda ya faru a ranar 5 ga Oktoba a zauren Royal Festival yayin bikin Lissafin Lissafi na London; Paulette Randall ta jagorance shi, kuma Jon Snow da Moira Stuart suka shugabanta, bikin ya nuna gudummawa daga masu zane ciki har da Adjoa Andoh, Mala'ika Coulby, Chiwetel Ejiofor, Nicola Hughes, Ella Odedina, NITROvox, Roderick Williams da Ayanna Witter-Johnson.[[121]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Margaret_Busby#cite_note-121)[[122]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Margaret_Busby#cite_note-122)[[123]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Margaret_Busby#cite_note-123)[[124]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Margaret_Busby#cite_note-124)

A cikin Yunin shekara ta 2021, Busby ta fito a kan _Desert Island Discs_ na BBC Radio 4.[[125]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Margaret_Busby#cite_note-125)[[126]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Margaret_Busby#cite_note-126)

## Girmamawa da kyaututtuka

[[gyara sashe](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Margaret_Busby&veaction=edit&section=7 "Gyara sashe: Girmamawa da kyaututtuka") | [gyara masomin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Margaret_Busby&action=edit&section=7 "Edit section's source code: Girmamawa da kyaututtuka")]

*   1970: Kyautar Society of Young Publishers.[[127]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Margaret_Busby#cite_note-NPG2-127)
*   1977: An nuna a nunin Mayotte Magnus _Mata_, Hotunan manyan matan Biritaniya, a Gidan Hoto na Kasa na Landan, wanda aka sake bugawa a cikin shekara ta 2018 a matsayin _Illuminating Women_.[[128]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Margaret_Busby#cite_note-128)[[129]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Margaret_Busby#cite_note-129)[[130]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Margaret_Busby#cite_note-130)
*   1993: Kyautar Pandora [[131]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Margaret_Busby#cite_note-NPG-131) daga Women in Publishing.
*   1998: Mai Girma Memba na Alpha Kappa Alpha (AKA) Yankin Duniya.[[132]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Margaret_Busby#cite_note-132)
*   1999: Race a cikin Kyautar Mai jarida don wasan rediyo _Minty Alley_.[[14]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Margaret_Busby#cite_note-ShereenAli2-14)
*   1999: Girman gargajiya na Ghana kamar Nana Akua Ackon, Cape Coast.[[133]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Margaret_Busby#cite_note-133)
*   2004: Daraja digiri na Jami'a Open[[134]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Margaret_Busby#cite_note-134) don Sabis ga Fasaha da Kimiyya.
*   2004: An nuna shi a cikin hoton "Babban Rana a Landan" a ɗakin karatu na Burtaniya tsakanin marubuta 50 baƙi da [Asiya](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Asiya "Asiya") waɗanda suka ba da babbar gudummawa ga adabin Burtaniya.[[135]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Margaret_Busby#cite_note-135)[[136]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Margaret_Busby#cite_note-136)
*   2006: Jami'in Tsarin Mulkin Biritaniya, don hidima ga adabi da bugawa.[[137]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Margaret_Busby#cite_note-137)
*   2011: Fellowship Honorary, Sarauniya Mary, Jami'ar London.[[138]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Margaret_Busby#cite_note-138)
*   2015: Kyautar Henry Swanzy don Sabis na Musamman ga Harafin Caribbean, NGC Bocas Lit Fest, Trinidad.[[139]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Margaret_Busby#cite_note-139)[[140]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Margaret_Busby#cite_note-140)
*   2015: Kyautar karramawar Gadon Afirka ta Burtaniya[[141]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Margaret_Busby#cite_note-141) daga Gidan Amau.[[142]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Margaret_Busby#cite_note-142)[[143]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Margaret_Busby#cite_note-143)
*   2015: Memba na Daraja na PAWA (Ƙungiyar Marubuta ta Pan African) Kyauta, Ghana.[[144]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Margaret_Busby#cite_note-144)
*   2017: Zaɓaɓɓen Abokin Daraja na Royal Society of Literature.[[145]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Margaret_Busby#cite_note-145)[[146]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Margaret_Busby#cite_note-146)
*   2017: An ba da lambar yabo ta Benson ta Royal Society of Literature don nasarar rayuwa.[[147]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Margaret_Busby#cite_note-147)
*   2017: Taron Jami'ar Goldsmiths na London "Daughter of Africa: Celebrating Margaret Busby's 50 Years in Publishing and Beyond".[[148]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Margaret_Busby#cite_note-148)
*   2018: An zaɓa a matsayin ɗaya daga cikin 150 na Jami'ar London "Jagorancin Mata" don bikin shekaru 150 na manyan makarantun mata a Birtaniya.[[149]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Margaret_Busby#cite_note-149)
*   2019: Naugural Africa ya rubuta lambar yabo ta Rayuwa ta Royal Society of the Royal African Society.[[150]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Margaret_Busby#cite_note-150)
*   2019: Digiri na girmamawa daga SOAS, Jami'ar London.[[151]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Margaret_Busby#cite_note-151)
*   2020: Digiri na girmamawa daga Royal Holloway, Jami'ar London.[[152]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Margaret_Busby#cite_note-152)[[153]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Margaret_Busby#cite_note-153)
*   2020: An zabe daya daga cikin "Bakar Birtaniyya 100".[[154]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Margaret_Busby#cite_note-154)
*   2021: Kyautar Nasarar Rayuwa ta Littafin London.[[155]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Margaret_Busby#cite_note-155)[[156]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Margaret_Busby#cite_note-156)
*   2021 :Kwamandan Tsarin Mulkin Burtaniya.[[157]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Margaret_Busby#cite_note-157)

text:
# Granada


Granada.


Granada Fountain

**Granada** (lafazi: /geranada/)[[1]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Granada#cite_note-1) birni ne, da ke acikin yankin [Andalusiya](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Andalusiya?action=edit&redlink=1 "Andalusiya (babu wannan shafin)"), a ƙasar [Ispaniya](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ispaniya "Ispaniya"). Bisa ga ƙidayar jama'a da akayi acikin shekarar ta 2013, jimilar mutane 592,200 (dubu dari biyar da tisa'in da biyu da dari biyu). An gina birnin Granada a farkon karni na bakwai bayan haifuwan annabi Isa.[[2]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Granada#cite_note-2)

## Alqalumma.

[[gyara sashe](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Granada&veaction=edit&section=1 "Gyara sashe: Alqalumma.") | [gyara masomin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Granada&action=edit&section=1 "Edit section's source code: Alqalumma.")]

Sunan tarihi na Granada a cikin harshen Larabci shine غرناطة (Ġarnāṭa).[[3]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Granada#cite_note-3)[[4]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Granada#cite_note-4)[[5]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Granada#cite_note-5)[[6]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Granada#cite_note-6)Dukansu ma’anar sunan da asalinsa ba su da tabbas kuma an yi ta muhawara[[7]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Granada#cite_note-7)[[8]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Granada#cite_note-8). Toponym tabbas ya wanzu kafin zamanin Zirid a karni na 11.[[9]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Granada#cite_note-9) Watakila ya fara bayyana ne a karni na 9[[10]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Granada#cite_note-10) kuma ana samunsa a majiyoyin larabci tun daga karni na 10.[[11]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Granada#cite_note-11)

Kalmar Gárnata (ko Karnata) mai yiyuwa tana nufin "tudun baƙo"[[12]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Granada#cite_note-12): 41 [[13]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Granada#cite_note-13) Wata ma'anar kuma ita ce "[tudun mahajjata](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tudun_mahajjata?action=edit&redlink=1 "Tudun mahajjata (babu wannan shafin)")"[[14]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Granada#cite_note-14). Yana iya ma asalin Berber ne.[[15]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Granada#cite_note-15) Wata ka’idar ita ce ta samo asali ne daga granum na Latin (ko jam’in grana), ma’ana “iri”, “beads”, ko “launi mai jajal”, wanda da an daidaita shi zuwa Larabci kamar Ġarnāṭa ko Iġranāṭa.[[16]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Granada#cite_note-16) Marubucin tarihin Larabawa Al-Maqqari ya yi imanin cewa ya fito ne daga kalmar Latin da ake kira rumman, granata.[[17]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Granada#cite_note-17) A kowane hali, kalmar Latin ba a ma'anarta ta farko ba ta yi amfani da ita ba, amma a mafi ma'anar "ja", tana nufin launin ƙasan yankin da gine-gine. Wannan kuma zai yi kama da ilimin asalin sunan Alhambra.[[18]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Granada#cite_note-18)[[19]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Granada#cite_note-19)

## Tarihi.

[[gyara sashe](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Granada&veaction=edit&section=2 "Gyara sashe: Tarihi.") | [gyara masomin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Granada&action=edit&section=2 "Edit section's source code: Tarihi.")]

Tarihin Umayyawa[gyara sashe | Gyara masomin]

Duba kuma: Spain

Mosaic daga wani villa na Roman, wanda aka samo daga 1 AD, an gano shi a gundumar Los Mondragones a Granada (yanzu ana ajiye shi a Gidan Tarihi na Archaeological)

Yankin da ke kewaye da abin da ake kira Granada a yau yana da yawan jama'a tun aƙalla 5500 BC.[[20]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Granada#cite_note-20) Abubuwan tarihi na kayan tarihi da aka samu a cikin birnin sun nuna cewa wurin da birnin yake ciki, gami da yankin da ke kusa da hanyar Gran Vía de Colón, ana zaune tun zamanin Bronze Age. Mafi dadewar kango da aka samu a yankin na wani oppidum ne da ake kira Ilturir, wanda kabilar Iberian Bastetani ta kafa a shekara ta 650 BC.[[21]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Granada#cite_note-21) Ana kuma tabbatar da sunan Elibyrge dangane da wannan yanki.[[22]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Granada#cite_note-22) Wannan mazaunin ya zama daga baya aka sani da Iliberri ko Iliberis.[[23]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Granada#cite_note-23)[[24]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Granada#cite_note-24)[[25]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Granada#cite_note-25) A cikin 44 BC Iliberis ya zama mulkin mallaka na Roman kuma a cikin 27 BC ya zama gundumar Roman mai suna [Florentia Iliberritana](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Florentia_Iliberritana?action=edit&redlink=1 "Florentia Iliberritana (babu wannan shafin)") ('Flourishing Iliberri').[[26]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Granada#cite_note-26)[[27]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Granada#cite_note-27)

Gane Granada na yau tare da zamanin Iliberis na Roman da ci gaban tarihi tsakanin ƙauyuka biyu masana sun daɗe suna muhawara.[[28]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Granada#cite_note-28) Binciken kayan tarihi na zamani a kan tudun Albaicín sun gano abubuwan da ke nuna kasancewar wani muhimmin garin Romawa a wannan wurin.[[29]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Granada#cite_note-29) Ba a san komai ba, game da tarihin birnin a tsakanin ƙarshen zamanin Romawa zuwa karni na 11.[[30]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Granada#cite_note-30)

Kafawa da tarihin farko[gyara tushe]

Yunkurin Umayyawa na [Hispania](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hispania "Hispania"), wanda ya fara a shekara ta 711 AD, ya kawo manyan sassan yankin Iberian karkashin ikon Moorish kuma ya kafa al-Andalus. Majiyoyin tarihi na Larabci na farko sun ambaci cewa wani gari mai suna Qashtīliya, wanda daga baya aka fi sani da Madīnat Ilbīra (Elvira), yana kan gangaren kudanci na tsaunukan Saliyo de Elvira (kusa da Atarfe na yau) kuma ya zama mafi mahimmanci a yankin.[[31]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Granada#cite_note-31)[[32]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Granada#cite_note-32). Karamin wurin zama da kagara (ḥiṣn) mai suna Ġarnāṭa (wanda kuma aka fassara shi da Gharnāṭa) ya kasance a gefen kudu na kogin Darro ko kuma a wurin unguwar Albaicín ta yanzu. Na karshen yana da galibin yahudawa ne don haka kuma aka san shi da Gharnāṭat al-Yahūd ("Gharnāṭa na Yahudawa").[[33]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Granada#cite_note-33)[[34]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Granada#cite_note-34) An san gundumar da ke kusa da birnin da Kurat Ilbīra (kusan "Lardin Elvira"). Bayan shekara ta 743 sojoji daga yankin Sham ne suka kafa garin Ilbīra wadanda suka taka rawa wajen goyon bayan Abd al-Rahman na daya, wanda ya kafa Masarautar Cordoba kuma wata sabuwar daular Umayyawa[[35]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Granada#cite_note-35). A karshen karni na 9, a zamanin mulkin Abdallah (r. 844 – 912), birnin da kewayensa ya kasance wurin da aka yi rikici tsakanin muwalladi (Musulmi da suka tuba) wadanda suke biyayya ga gwamnatin tsakiya da Larabawa, karkashin jagorancin Sawār ibn Hamdūn, wanda ya fusata su.[[36]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Granada#cite_note-36)[[37]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Granada#cite_note-37).

Encyclopaedia of Islam, Three. Brill. ISSN 1873-9830. During the Roman period, there was a township named Iliberris on the slopes of the Sierra de Elvira, where archaeological remains of Roman, Visigothic, and Arab origin have been found. The existence of a Roman settlement in the same place as Granada—or rather, the identification of Granada with Iliberis—has been a bone of contention among historians of Granada since the 10th century. In the era of the so-called Christian "reconquest" of southern Spain, the notion of such continuity allowed the conquerors to speak of a "restoration" of Christianity in Granada. Some experts argue strongly for continuity between the Roman city and Granada, as against the possibility (supported by the Arabic sources) that Granada was, in fact, a Muslim foundation: archaeological evidence has not been decisive either way.

Routledge. pp. 490, 505 (see note 18). ISBN 978-1-317-23354-1. The location of the town of Ilbīra was a burning issue in Granada since the 16th century. The Catholic propaganda after 1492 pushed the identification of Ilbīra with Granada, and also with the Roman municipium Illiberis, where the first Church Council of Iberia took place in the early 4th century. If Granada was indeed Illiberis, the town was associated with one important early Christian centre and the right of the kings of Spain to take it over was providentially justified. However, there were enough mentions in the written sources, not only in Arabic, and even material evidence that suggested that Ilbīra, the first Islamic capital, was located near the village of Atarfe, about 15 kilometres north-west of Granada. The similarity in names suggested that Illiberis had been in Ilbīra and that Granada was a town founded by Muslims, ideas which implicitly supported the notion that Islam was an integral part of Spain rather than merely an enemy against which the nation had been built. After a debate four centuries long, M. Gómez Moreno compiled cases of the material evidence collected around the area of Atarfe by spoilers and even undertook an excavation in 1872 in which he found the mosque of the town, finally proving without any doubt that Ilbīra was located there. [p. 490] (...) See Gómez Moreno, Medina Elvira for the description of the debate and of the different interventions. It is interesting to note that this solves the question of the location of Ilbīra, but not of Illiberis, at least in the time of the Council. Excavations in Granada have uncovered strong evidence that suggests that the Iberian and Roman towns of the same name were located there (e.g. Sotomayor Muro, "¿Donde estuvo Iliberri?"). It seems that at some point in late Antiquity, possibly before the Islamic conquest, the town of Illiberis was moved to the location where it later became Madīna Ilbīrah (e.g. Adroher et al., "Discusión", pp. 202–206). To a certain extent, the debate still continues. [p. 505, note 18]
