# Harsunan Songhay

Zarma songhai dendi is languege of world in afrika accoding to union afrika[[1]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Harsunan_Songhay#cite_note-1)[Niger More than 12millions Mali 4 millions Bénin 3million Ghana 500.000 Sudan 500.000 Niger 1,500.000 Burkina 1million Algérie 100.000 And tribes of Songhai In other countries Zarma language speake Is more than 45 millions speakers](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Zarma "Zarma")


Mace yar qabilan Songhay

Harsunan **Songhay**, **Songhai** ko **Ayneha** harsuna ([soŋaj] ko[soŋoj], lafazi cikin Songhay: IPA:['sõʀai̯ ][_[ana buƙatar hujja](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Citation\_needed "Wikipedia:Citation needed")_] ) rukuni ne na [yaruka](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Harshe_(yare) "Harshe (yare)") / yarukan da ke da alaƙa da juna wanda ke tsakiyar tsakiyar [Kogin Neja](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Neja_(kogi) "Neja (kogi)") a ƙasashen [Afirka ta](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Afirka_ta_Yamma "Afirka ta Yamma") Yamma na [Mali](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mali "Mali"), [Nijar](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nijar_(%C6%99asa) "Nijar (ƙasa)"), [Benin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Benin "Benin"), [Burkina Faso](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Burkina_Faso "Burkina Faso") da [Najeriya](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Najeriya "Najeriya") . Musamman, ana magana da su a cikin biranen [Timbuktu](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Timbuktu "Timbuktu"), [Niamey](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Niamey "Niamey") da [Gao](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gao_(gari) "Gao (gari)") . Ana yin amfani dasu ko'ina a matsayin _yaren harshe_ a wannan yankin tun daga zamanin daular Songhai . A [Mali](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mali "Mali"), gwamnati a hukumance ta amince da yaren Gao (gabashin [Timbuktu](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Timbuktu "Timbuktu") ) a matsayin yaren da za a yi amfani da shi azaman matsakaiciyar ilimin firamare. [[2]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Harsunan_Songhay#cite_note-2)

Wasu yarukan Songhay ba su da fahimtar fahimtar juna tsakanin juna. Misali, Koyraboro Senni, ana magana da shi a Gao, ba shi da ma'ana ga masu magana da harshen [Zarma](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Zarma "Zarma") a [Nijar](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nijar_(%C6%99asa) "Nijar (ƙasa)"), a cewar _masana harsuna_ . Koyaya, Songhoyboro Ciine, Zarma, da Dendi suna da kyakkyawar fahimta tsakanin Nijar. [[3]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Harsunan_Songhay#cite_note-3)

Ga masana ilimin harshe, babban abin da ke shafan harsunan Songhay ya kasance wahalar tantance alaƙar su; ana ɗaukarsu a matsayin Nilo-Saharan, kamar yadda Joseph Greenberg ya bayyana a cikin shekarata 1963, amma har yanzu wannan rarrabuwa ya kasance mai kawo rigima. Masanin ilimin harshe Gerrit Dimmendaal shekarar (2008) ya yi imanin cewa a yanzu ya fi dacewa a ɗauke shi dangin mai yare mai zaman kansa. Roger Blench ya yi iƙirarin cewa harsunan Songhay da Saharar sun kafa reshen Songhay-Sahara tare da juna a cikin babban harshe na Nilo-Saharar phylum.

A tarihi, sunan _Songhay_ ba ƙabilanci ba ne ko kuma yaren yare ne ga kowa, amma suna ne ga masu mulki na Daular Songhai waɗanda suka dace da Songhai. Koyaya, madaidaiciyar kalmar da 'yan ƙasar ke amfani da ita don magance yarukan da kuma mutane **gabaɗaya** ita ce "Ayneha". Baya ga **Songhai da kyau**, wasu masu magana a Mali ma sun ɗauki sunan Songhay a matsayin sunan ƙabilanci, [[4]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Harsunan_Songhay#cite_note-4) duk da haka, wasu kungiyoyin masu magana da Songhay suna nuna kansu da wasu kalmomin ƙabilanci, kamar [Zarma](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Zabarmawa "Zabarmawa") (Djerma) ko Isawaghen (Sawaq).

'Yan waƙoƙi da wasiƙu da aka tsara a cikin Songhay da aka rubuta da rubutun larabci suna cikin Timbuktu. [[5]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Harsunan_Songhay#cite_note-5) Koyaya, a halin yanzu an rubuta Songhay cikin rubutun Latin.

## Iri-iri

[[gyara sashe](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Harsunan_Songhay&veaction=edit&section=1 "Gyara sashe: Iri-iri") | [gyara masomin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Harsunan_Songhay&action=edit&section=1 "Edit section's source code: Iri-iri")]

Adadin masu magana da Songhay

[Zabarmanwa](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Zabarmanwa?action=edit&redlink=1 "Zabarmanwa (babu wannan shafin)") (66.3%)

[Songhoyboro Ciine](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Songhoyboro_Ciine?action=edit&redlink=1 "Songhoyboro Ciine (babu wannan shafin)") (11%)

[Koyraboro Senni](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Koyraboro_Senni?action=edit&redlink=1 "Koyraboro Senni (babu wannan shafin)") (9.3%)

[Harshen Dendi](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Harshen_Dendi?action=edit&redlink=1 "Harshen Dendi (babu wannan shafin)") (5.5%)

[Harshen Koyra Chiini](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Harshen_Koyra_Chiini?action=edit&redlink=1 "Harshen Koyra Chiini (babu wannan shafin)") (4.3%)

[Tadaksahak](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tadaksahak?action=edit&redlink=1 "Tadaksahak (babu wannan shafin)") (2.2%)

Saura (1.4%)

Masu binciken sun rarraba harsunan Songhay zuwa manyan rassa biyu; Kudu da Arewa. [[6]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Harsunan_Songhay#cite_note-6) Kudancin Songhay yana tsakiyar Kogin Neja. [Zarma](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Zarma "Zarma") ( [Djerma](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Zarma "Zarma") ), yaren Songhay da ake ji da shi sosai tare da masu magana da miliyan biyu ko uku, babban harshe ne na kudu maso yammacin [Nijar](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nijar_(%C6%99asa) "Nijar (ƙasa)") (mai rusawa daga da kudancin Mali) gami da babban birnin [Yamai](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Niamey "Niamey") . Koyraboro Senni, tare da masu magana da magana 400,000, shine yaren garin Gao, mazaunin tsohuwar Daular Songhai. Ana magana da Koyra Chiini zuwa yamma. Ƙaramar Arewa mafi ƙanƙanta rukuni ne na [yaruka masu yawa na Berber](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Abzinanci "Abzinanci") waɗanda ake magana da su a cikin [Sahara](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sahara "Sahara") . Tunda tasirin Abzinancin ya zarce fiye da ƙamus zuwa cikin ilimin halittar juna, wasu lokuta ana kallon yaren arewacin Songhay kamar harsunan gauraye . [[7]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Harsunan_Songhay#cite_note-7)

## Haɗakar jinsi

[[gyara sashe](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Harsunan_Songhay&veaction=edit&section=2 "Gyara sashe: Haɗakar jinsi") | [gyara masomin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Harsunan_Songhay&action=edit&section=2 "Edit section's source code: Haɗakar jinsi")]

Diedrich Hermann Westermann, mishan ne kuma masanin harshe, ya yi jinkiri tsakanin sanya shi ga Gur ko la'akari da shi a matsayin keɓewa, kuma Maurice Delafosse ya haɗa shi da Mande . A halin yanzu, ana daukar Songhay a matsayin Nilo-Saharan, biyo bayan sake tsara harsunan Afirka da Joseph Greenberg ya yi a 1963; Hujjar Greenberg ta ta'allaka ne da kimanin ƙididdigar ƙididdiga 70, gami da karin magana .[_[ana buƙatar hujja](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Citation\_needed "Wikipedia:Citation needed")_] An gabatar da wannan shawarar ta musamman, musamman, Lionel Bender, wanda ke ganinsa a zaman wani yanki ne mai zaman kansa na Nilo-Saharan. Roger Blench ya lura cewa Songhay ya ba da ma'anar ma'anar kyan gani wanda ya dace da yaren Nilo da Sahara. Tun daga 2011, ya yi imanin cewa Songhay ya fi kusa da harsunan Sahara maƙwabta kuma ba ya bambanta.

Koyaya, rabe-raben Nilo-Saharan yana da rikici. Lacroix, wanda ya yi la'akari da kusan 30 daga cikin abubuwan da Greenberg ke ikirarin yarda da su sun yarda da hujjar Greenberg, kuma haka kuma ya yi iƙirarin cewa waɗannan ana gudanar da su ne tsakanin [Zarma](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Zarma "Zarma") da Saharar Sahara, [ Ina labarin Tagdal, wacce makwabta Saharan? ] don haka yana jagorantar mutum don zargin su da kalmomin lamuni . [[8]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Harsunan_Songhay#cite_note-8) Wasu Songhay– An dade ana kamanceceniya da Mande (aƙalla tun daga yammaci), da Mukarovsky (1966), Denis Creissels (1981) da Nicolaï (1977, 1984) sun bincika yiwuwar dangantakar Mande; Creissels sanya wasu 50 misãlai, ciki har da mutane da yawa sassan jiki da kuma morphological suffixes (kamar causative a _-endi),_ yayin da Nicolaï da'awar da wasu 450 irin wannan kalmomi, kazalika da wasu kama hankali typological halaye.[_[ana buƙatar hujja](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Citation\_needed "Wikipedia:Citation needed")_] Duk da haka, Nicolaï ƙarshe ƙarasa da cewa wannan m ya ba da isasshen, kuma a shekarar 1990 samarwa a sosai labari jarrabawa: cewa Songhay ne [Abzinanci](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Abzinanci "Abzinanci") na tushen Creole harshen, restructured karkashin Mande tasiri. A goyon bayan wannan ya kawo shawara 412 kamance, jere duk hanyar daga asali ƙamus _(tasa_ " hanta ") to a fili aro _(anzad_ " goge ", _alkaadi_ " Qadi ". ) Wasu kuma, kamar su Gerrit Dimmendaal, ba su gamsu ba, kuma Nicolaï (2003) ya yi la’akari da tambayar asalin Songhay har yanzu a buɗe yake, yayin da yake jayayya game da tsarin Bender da aka gabatar.[_[ana buƙatar hujja](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Citation\_needed "Wikipedia:Citation needed")_]

Kamanceceniyar yanayin halittar Greenberg tare da Nilo-Saharan sun haɗa da karin suna na _ai_ (cf. [Zaghawa](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Zaghawa "Zaghawa")_ai_ ), 'I', _ni_ (cf. [Kanuri](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kanuri "Kanuri")_nyi_ ), 'ku (sg.)', _Yer_ (misali Kanuri _-ye_ ), 'mu', _wor_ (cf. Kanuri _-wi_ ), 'kai (pl.)'; dangi da sigar formants _-ma_ (misali Kanuri _-ma_ ) da _-ko_ (cf. Maba _-ko_ ), _mahimmin kari ne -an_ (?), Karin maganar jam'in _hamayya -r_ (cf. Teso _-r_ ) wanda ya ɗauka don bayyana a cikin karin magana _yer_ da _wor_, mara tasiri / wucewa _-a_ (cf. Teso _-o_ ).[_[ana buƙatar hujja](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Citation\_needed "Wikipedia:Citation needed")_]

Mafi ban mamaki game da kamanceceniyar Mande wanda Creissels ya lissafa shine mutum na uku da ke magana _akan_ sg. (pan-Mande _a_ ), _ina_ pl. (kwanon rufi-Mande _i_ ko _e),_ da demonstratives _wo_ "wannan" (gwama Manding _o_, _wo_ ) kuma _babu_ "can" (cf. Soninke _ba_, sauran Mande _na_ ), mummunan _na_ (an samo shi a cikin yarukan yaren Manding) da kuma cikakkiyar _mana_ (cf. Manding _má_, _máŋ_ ), kalmomin _ma_ (cf. Manding _máa_ ), da copula _ti_ (cf. Bisa _ti_, Manding _de / le_ ), haɗin magana ta _ka_ (cf. Manding kà), _karin kalmomin_ _-ri_ (sakamakon - cf. Mandinka _-ri_, Bambara _-li_ aiwatar da sunaye), _-ncè_ (ethnonymic, cf. Soninke _-nke_, Mandinka _-nka_ ), _-anta_ (na al'ada, cf. Soninke _-ndi_, Mandinka _-njaŋ_ ...), _-anta_ (sakamakon sakamako, cf. Soninke _-nte_ ), _-endi_ (haddasawa, cf. Soninke, Mandinka _-ndi_ ), da kuma sanya _ra_ "in" (cf. Manding _lá_, Soso _ra_ ...)[_[ana buƙatar hujja](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Citation\_needed "Wikipedia:Citation needed")_]

Harsunan Songhay ana ɗaukar su a matsayin dangi mai zaman kansa ta Dimmendaal (2011), kodayake ya sanya Sahara a matsayin wani ɓangare na Nilo-Saharan.

## Nahawu

[[gyara sashe](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Harsunan_Songhay&veaction=edit&section=3 "Gyara sashe: Nahawu") | [gyara masomin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Harsunan_Songhay&action=edit&section=3 "Edit section's source code: Nahawu")]

Songhay ne mafi yawa a tonal, SOV kungiyar na harsuna, an togiya kasancewa bamban Koyra Chiini na Timbuktu, wanda shi ne maras tonal kuma yana amfani da SVO domin.

Songhay yana da morpheme _-ndi_ wanda ke nuna alama ko mawuyacin hali ko mara amfani. Fi'iloli na iya ɗaukar lokuta biyu na morpheme, ɗaya don kowane ma'ana. Ta haka ne a _zahiri ndi-ndi-ndi a_ fassara ta "[shinkafar] ta kasance ta sanya wani ya ci [wani: sanadi] [ta wani: sanadi]". [[9]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Harsunan_Songhay#cite_note-9)

title: Abubakar
text:
# Abubakar

Masallacin Abu Bakr Assadeek dake Turmus Ayya na kasar Falasdinu 


Abu Bakar ash-Shiddiq Imam Khairul Annas 


Rashidun Caliph Abu Bakr as-Șiddīq (Abdullah ibn Abi Quhafa) - أبو بكر الصديق عبد الله بن عثمان التيمي القرشي أول الخلفاء الراشدين.

**Abū Bakr aṣ-Ṣiddīq** ‘Abdallāh bin Abī Quḥāfah (Larabci: أبو بكر الصديق عبد الله بن أبي قحافة‎; Ya rayu daga shekara ta dari biyar da saba'in da uku 573 CE zuwa ashirin da uku 23 Agustan shekarar dari shida da talatin da uku 634 CE), An haife shine a 27 ga watan Octoban shekara ta 573 a garin [Makkah](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Makkah "Makkah") Kasar [Saudiya](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Saudiya "Saudiya").Ya rasu a 23 ga watan Agusta shekara ta 634, a garin [Madina](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Madina "Madina") an fi sanin sa da sunan Abu Bakar, Ya kasance Babban [Sahabi](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sahabi "Sahabi") kuma Sirikin Manzon Allah ne, Annabi [Muhammad](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Muhammad_(SAW) "Muhammad (SAW)") tsira da aminci Allah su tabbata a gare shi. Abu Bakar shi ne mutum na farko daya musulunta wanda badaga cikin dangin manzon Allah yake ba, Abu Bakar ya kasance mai biyayya ga Manzon Allah yayin rayuwarsa.[[1]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Abubakar#cite_note-1)[[2]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Abubakar#cite_note-2)

Abu Bakar أبو بكر Al-Siddiq

Amir al-Mu'mineenn Lokaci Khalifancinsa 8 Yuni 632 zuwa 23 Agusta 634 Shi ne Kalifa na farko da aka Samar akan wanda zai jagoranci musulmai bayan rasuwar Manzon Allah. An binne shi a masallacin Manzon Allah, a garin Madinah.[[3]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Abubakar#cite_note-3)

An haifi Abu Bakr a shekara ta 573 CE ga Abu Quhafa da Umm Khayr. Shi dan kabilar Banu Taim ne. A zamanin jahiliyya, ya kasance mai tauhidi kuma yayi Allah wadai da bautar gumaka. A matsayinsa na hamshakin dan kasuwa, Abubakar ya kasance yana ‘yanta bayi. Bayan musulunta a shekara ta 610, Abu Bakr ya yi aiki a matsayin babban mataimaki ga Muhammadu, wanda ya ba shi lakabin "al-Siddiq" ('Mai Gaskiya/Mai adalci'). Na farko dai ya halarci kusan dukkan yakokin da aka yi a karkashin manzon Allah. Ya ba da gudummawar dukiyarsa da yawa don tallafawa aikin Muhammadu da kuma cikin makusantan Muhammad. Ya kuma raka Muhammad akan hijirarsa zuwa Madina. Ta hanyar gayyatar Abubakar, manyan Sahabiyawa da yawa sun zama Musulmai. Ya kasance babban mashawarci na kusa ga Muhammadu, kasancewar kusan duk rikice-rikicen sojansa. Babu Muhammadu Abubakar ya jagoranci sallah da balaguro.

Bayan mutuwar Muhammad a shekara ta dari shida da talatin da biyu 632, Abu Bakr ya ci nasarar jagorancin al'ummar musulmi a matsayin Halifa Rashidun na farko. Zaben nasa dai ya samu adawa da dimbin jagororin kabilu masu tawaye, wadanda suka yi ridda daga Musulunci. A lokacin mulkinsa, ya sha fama da tashe-tashen hankula da dama, wadanda aka fi sani da Yakin Ridda, wanda a sakamakon haka ya sami damar hada kai tare da fadada mulkin daular Musulmi a kan daukacin yankin Larabawa. Ya kuma ba da umarnin fara kutsawa cikin daulolin Sassaniya da Byzantine makwabta, wanda a cikin shekaru da suka biyo bayan mutuwarsa, za su haifar da mamayar musulmi na Farisa da Levant. Baya ga siyasa, Abu Bakr kuma ana yaba masa don harhada Alqur'ani, wanda ya kasance yana da kundin rubutun halifa na kansa. Abubakar ya nada babban mashawarcinsa Umar (r. 634–644) a matsayin magajinsa kafin ya rasu a watan Agustan 634. Tare da Muhammad, an binne Abu Bakr a cikin 'Green Dome' a Al-Masjid an-Nabawi a Madina, wuri na biyu mafi tsarki. a Musulunci. Ya rasu ne sakamakon rashin lafiya bayan ya shafe shekaru biyu 2 da watanni 2 da kwana 14, Halifan Rashidun daya tilo da ya rasu a dalilin halitta. [[4]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Abubakar#cite_note-4) Duk da cewa lokacin khalifancinsa bai yi kankanta ba, amma ya hada da mamaye dauloli biyu mafiya karfi na lokacin, nasara mai ban mamaki a cikinta. Ya kafa wani yanayi na tarihi wanda a cikin 'yan shekarun da suka gabata zai kai ga daya daga cikin manyan dauloli a tarihi. Nasarar da ya yi a kan sojojin Larabawa 'yan tawaye na cikin gida wani muhimmin bangare ne na tarihin Musulunci. Abu Bakr yana da girma a tsakanin [musulmai](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Musulmai "Musulmai").[[5]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Abubakar#cite_note-5)

## Nasaba da Lakabi

[[gyara sashe](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Abubakar&veaction=edit&section=1 "Gyara sashe: Nasaba da Lakabi") | [gyara masomin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Abubakar&action=edit&section=1 "Edit section's source code: Nasaba da Lakabi")]

Cikakken sunan Abubakar shine Abdullahi bn Abi Quhafa bn Amir bn Amr bn Ka'b bn Sa'd bn Taym bn Murrah bn Ka'b bn Lu'ayy bn Ghalib bn Fihr. Zuriyarsa ta hadu da zuriyar Muhammad a ƙarni na shida tare da Murrah ibn Ka'b. An ambace shi a cikin Alkur'ani sau biyu.

### Abdullahi

[[gyara sashe](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Abubakar&veaction=edit&section=2 "Gyara sashe: Abdullahi") | [gyara masomin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Abubakar&action=edit&section=2 "Edit section's source code: Abdullahi")]

A Larabci, sunan Abd Allah yana nufin “bawan Allah”. Wannan shine sunan haihuwarsa.

### Abubakar

[[gyara sashe](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Abubakar&veaction=edit&section=3 "Gyara sashe: Abubakar") | [gyara masomin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Abubakar&action=edit&section=3 "Edit section's source code: Abubakar")]

Wannan laƙabin (kunya) an yi masa suna tun yana ƙarami lokacin da ya girma a cikin ƙabilar ƙauye kuma ya kasance mai son raƙuma. Ya yi wasa da ’yan maruƙa da awaki, yana samun wannan laƙabin “Abubakar,” ma’ana “uban raƙumi”. "bakir" a cikin Larabci matashi ne amma ya riga ya girma raƙumi.[[6]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Abubakar#cite_note-6)

### Ateeq

[[gyara sashe](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Abubakar&veaction=edit&section=4 "Gyara sashe: Ateeq") | [gyara masomin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Abubakar&action=edit&section=4 "Edit section's source code: Ateeq")]

Ɗaya daga cikin sunayensa na farko, kafin musuluntarsa, shine Ateeq, ma'ana "mai ceto". A wata ruwaya mai rauni a cikin Tirmizi, Annabi Muhammad daga baya ya sake maimaita wannan suna inda ya ce Abubakar shi ne “Ateeq Allah daga wuta” ma’ana “amince” ko “amince” da tarayya da Allah yana nuna kusanci da kariyarsa. wallahi.[[7]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Abubakar#cite_note-7)

### Al-Siddiq

[[gyara sashe](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Abubakar&veaction=edit&section=5 "Gyara sashe: Al-Siddiq") | [gyara masomin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Abubakar&action=edit&section=5 "Edit section's source code: Al-Siddiq")]

Muhammad ne ya kira shi Al-Siddiq (Mai gaskiya) bayan ya gaskata shi a waki’ar Isra’ila da Mi’iraji lokacin da wasu mutane ba su yi ba, kuma Ali ya tabbatar da wannan lakabi sau da yawa. An kuma ruwaito shi a cikin Alkur’ani mai girma a matsayin “na biyu na biyun da ke cikin kogo” dangane da waki’ar Hijira, inda tare da Muhammad ya boye a cikin kogon Jabal Thawr daga jam’iyyar Makka da aka aiko bayansu.[[8]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Abubakar#cite_note-8)

### Al-Sahib

[[gyara sashe](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Abubakar&veaction=edit&section=6 "Gyara sashe: Al-Sahib") | [gyara masomin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Abubakar&action=edit&section=6 "Edit section's source code: Al-Sahib")]

An kira shi da daraja da sunan “al-sahib” (sahabi) a cikin Alkur’ani yana mai bayyana matsayinsa na sahabi Annabi Muhammad a lokacin da ya buya daga kuraishawa a kogon Jabal Thawr a lokacin Hijira zuwa Madina:

"Ba kome idan kun ki ku taimake shi, kuma lalle ne Allah Yã taimake shi a lõkacin da kãfirai suka fitar da shi daga Makka, kuma bai kasance ba fãce dayan biyu.  Yayin da su biyun ke cikin kogon, sai ya tabbatar wa abokin nasa, “Kada ka damu;  Lalle Allah yana tare da mu."  Sai Allah Ya saukar da natsuwarSa a kan Annabi( SAW), kuma Ya taimake shi da rundunonin da ba ku gani ba, kuma Ya sanya kalmar kãfirai mafi ƙasƙanta, kuma kalmar Allah ita ce maɗaukakiya.  Kuma Allah Mabuwayi ne, Mai hikima.[9:40 -Alqur'ani bayyananne]."[[9]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Abubakar#cite_note-9)

### Al-Atqa

## Farkon Rayuwa

[[gyara sashe](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Abubakar&veaction=edit&section=9 "Gyara sashe: Farkon Rayuwa") | [gyara masomin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Abubakar&action=edit&section=9 "Edit section's source code: Farkon Rayuwa")]

An haifi Abu Bakr a Makka a wani lokaci a shekara ta 573 AZ, ga wani gida mai arziki a kabilar Banu Taym na kawancen kabilar Kuraishawa. Sunan mahaifinsa Uthman kuma an ba shi kunya Abu Quhafa, mahaifiyarsa kuwa ita ce Salma bint Sakhar wacce aka yiwa laqabin Ummul-Khair.

Ya yi ƙuruciyarsa kamar sauran yaran Larabawa na lokacin, daga cikin Badawiyyawa waɗanda suke kiran kansu Ahl-i-Ba'eer- mutanen raƙumi, kuma suka sami sha'awar raƙuma. A shekarunsa na farko ya yi wasa da ’ya’yan rakumi da akuya, kuma son rakumi ya sa ake masa lakabi da (kunya) “Abubakar”, mahaifin marakin rakumi.

Kamar sauran ƴaƴan dangin ƴan kasuwa na Makka, Abu Bakr ya kasance mai ilimi kuma ya sami sha'awar waƙa. Ya kasance yana halartar bikin baje kolin shekara-shekara a Ukaz, kuma yana shiga cikin baje kolin wakoki. Yana da kyakkyawan tunani kuma yana da kyakkyawar masaniya game da asalin ƙabilun Larabawa, labaransu da siyasarsu.[[10]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Abubakar#cite_note-10)

An adana labari cewa, lokacin yana ƙarami, mahaifinsa ya kai shi ɗakin [Ka'aba](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kaaba "Kaaba"), ya roƙe shi ya yi addu'a a gaban gumaka. Mahaifinsa ya tafi don halartar wani kasuwanci, kuma Abubakar ya kasance shi kaɗai. Da yake yiwa wani gunki magana, Abubakar ya ce: "Ya Ubangijina, ina bukatan tufafi masu kyau, ka bani su". Tsafi ya kasance ba ruwansa. Sai ya yi wa wani gunki magana, ya ce, “Ya Allah ka ba ni abinci mai dadi, ka ga ina jin yunwa”. Tsafi ya yi sanyi. Hakan ya gagara haqurin saurayi Abubakar. Ya ɗaga dutse, ya yi magana ga gunki, ya ce, "Ga shi, ina nufin dutse, idan kai ne Allah ka tsare kanka." Abubakar ya jefi gunkin ya bar Ka'aba. Ko ta yaya, ya rubuta cewa kafin ya musulunta, Abubakar ya kasance dan hanif ne kuma bai taba bautar gumaka ba.[[11]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Abubakar#cite_note-11)

## Karbar Addinin Musulinci

[[gyara sashe](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Abubakar&veaction=edit&section=10 "Gyara sashe: Karbar Addinin Musulinci") | [gyara masomin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Abubakar&action=edit&section=10 "Edit section's source code: Karbar Addinin Musulinci")]

Lokacin da ya dawo daga balaguron kasuwanci a Yemen, abokai sun sanar da shi cewa a cikin rashi, Muhammadu ya ayyana kansa a matsayin manzon Allah. Masanin tarihi Al-Tabari, a cikin littafinsa Tarikh al-Tabari, ya kawo daga Muhammad bn Sa'ad bn Abi Waqqas, wanda ya ce: "Na tambayi mahaifina ko Abubakar shine farkon musulmi? Ya ce: A’a, fiye da mutane hamsin ne suka musulunta kafin Abubakar; amma ya fi mu a matsayinmu na musulmi. Kuma Umar bn al-Khattab ya musulunta bayan maza arba'in da biyar mata ashirin da ɗaya. Amma wanda ya fi kowa a fagen Musulunci da imani, shi ne Ali bn Abi Talib."

Wasu Sunni da dukkan [Shi'a](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shi'a "Shi'a") sun yarda cewa mutum na biyu da ya karɓi Muhammad a matsayin manzon Allah a bainar jama'a shine Ali ibn Abi Talib, farkon matar Muhammad Khadija. Ibn Kathir, a cikin Al Bidaya Wal Nihayah, yayi watsi da wannan. Ya bayyana cewa mace ta farko da ta musulunta ita ce Khadijah. Zayd ibn Harithah shine bawa na farko da ya 'yanta ya musulunta. Ali bn Abi Talib shi ne yaro na farko da ya musulunta, domin bai kai ma balaga ba a lokacin, yayin da Abubakar shi ne mutum na farko da ya musulunta.[[12]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Abubakar#cite_note-12)

### Rayuwa ta gaba a Makka

[[gyara sashe](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Abubakar&veaction=edit&section=11 "Gyara sashe: Rayuwa ta gaba a Makka") | [gyara masomin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Abubakar&action=edit&section=11 "Edit section's source code: Rayuwa ta gaba a Makka")]

Matarsa Qutaylah bint Abd-al-Uzza ba ta karɓi Musulunci ba sai ya sake ta. Wata matarsa, Um Ruman, ta musulunta. Duk 'ya'yansa sun yarda da Musulunci in ban da Abd al-Rahman, wanda Abubakar ya barranta daga gare shi. Musuluntarsa kuma ya jawo mutane da yawa zuwa Musulunci. Ya ja hankalin abokansa na kut-da-kut da su musulunta, ya kuma gabatar da Musulunci ga sauran abokansa ta yadda da yawa daga cikinsu ma suka yarda da imani. Wadanda suka musulunta bisa nacewar Abubakar su ne:

*   Uthman Ibn Affan (wanda zai zama halifa na uku)
*   Al-Zubayr (wanda ya taka rawa a yakin Masar na musulmi)
*   Talha bn Ubayd-Allah, baffansa kuma babban sahabin annabi.
*   'Abd al-Rahman ibn 'Awf (wanda zai kasance wani muhimmin bangare na Halifancin Rashidun)
*   Sa'ad bn Abi Waqqas (wanda ya taka rawa a fafatawar musulunci na Farisa)
*   Abu Ubaidah bn al-Jarrah (wanda ya kasance babban kwamandan rundunar Rashidun a Levant)
*   Abu Salama, dan uwa ne ga Annabi Muhammadu.
*   Khalid bn Sa’id (wanda ya yi aiki a matsayin Janar a karkashin rundunar Rashidun a Sham).

Karɓar Abubakar ta zama wani ci gaba a cikin aikin Muhammadu. Bauta ta zama ruwan dare a Makka, kuma bayi da yawa sun karɓi Musulunci. A lokacin da dan ’yanci na gari ya karbi Musulunci, duk da adawar da ake yi masa, zai samu kariya daga kabilarsa. Ga bayi, duk da haka, babu irin wannan kariyar kuma yawanci suna fuskantar tsanantawa. Abubakar ya ji tausayin bayi, sai ya sayi takwas (maza hudu da mata hudu) sannan ya ‘yanta su, ya biya dinari 40,000 don ‘yancinsu. Mazajen sune:

1.   Bilal bin Rabah
2.   Abu Fukah
3.   Ammar bin Yasir
4.   Abu Fuhayra

Matan sun kasance:

1.   Lubaynah
2.   Al-Nahdiah
3.   Ummu Ubay
4.   Harithah bint al-Muammil

Mafi yawan bayin da Abubakar ya 'yanta, ko dai mata ne ko kuma tsoffi kuma maza ne masu rauni. Da baban Abubakar ya tambaye shi me ya sa bai ‘yanta bayi masu karfi da matasa ba, wadanda za su iya zama madogara a gare shi, sai Abubakar ya amsa masa da cewa yana ‘yanta bayi ne saboda Allah, ba don kansa ba.

### Zaluncin Kuraishawa, 613

[[gyara sashe](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Abubakar&veaction=edit&section=12 "Gyara sashe: Zaluncin Kuraishawa, 613") | [gyara masomin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Abubakar&action=edit&section=12 "Edit section's source code: Zaluncin Kuraishawa, 613")]

BABBAN LANARIN: Zaluntar Musulmai daga Makka Shekaru uku bayan haifuwar Musulunci, Musulmai sun asirta imaninsu. A cikin 613, bisa ga al'adar Musulunci, Allah ya umurce Muhammadu ya kira mutane zuwa Musulunci a fili. Abu Bakr ya gabatar da jawabin farko ga jama'a don yin mubaya'a ga Muhammad. A fusace samarin kabilar kuraishawa suka garzaya wurin Abubakar suka yi masa duka har sai da ya suma. Bayan faruwar wannan lamari sai mahaifiyar Abubakar ta musulunta. Kuraishawa sun tsananta wa Abubakar sau da yawa. Ko da yake da akidar Abubakar da danginsa sun kare, amma ba haka ba ne ga daukacin kabilar Kuraishawa.

#### Shekarar karshe a Makka

[[gyara sashe](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Abubakar&veaction=edit&section=13 "Gyara sashe: Shekarar karshe a Makka") | [gyara masomin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Abubakar&action=edit&section=13 "Edit section's source code: Shekarar karshe a Makka")]

A shekara ta 617, Kuraishawa sun tilasta wa [Banu Hashim](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Banu_Hashim "Banu Hashim") kauracewa. Muhammad tare da magoya bayansa daga Banu Hashim, an yanke su ne a hanyar wucewa daga Makka. An yanke duk wata alaka ta zamantakewa da Banu Hashim kuma jiharsu ta kasance a gidan yari.[Bayyanawa] Kafin a yi hijira da yawa daga Musulmai zuwa Abyssinia (yanzu Habasha). Abu Bakr yana cikin bacin rai ya tashi ya nufi kasar Yemen daga nan ya nufi Abisiniya. Ya gamu da wani abokinsa mai suna Ad-Dughna (shugaban kabilar Qarah) a wajen Makka, wanda ya gayyaci Abubakar don neman kariyarsa daga kuraishawa. Abu Bakr ya koma Makka, hakan ya masa sauki, amma jim kadan saboda matsin Kuraishawa, sai Ad-Dughna ya yi watsi da kariyarsa. Kuraishawa sun sake samun 'yanci don tsananta wa Abubakar.

A shekara ta 620, kawun Muhammad kuma mai kare shi, Abu Talib bn Abd al-Muttalib, da matar Muhammad Khadija ya rasu. 'Yar Abubakar Aisha ta kasance ango da Muhammad; duk da haka, an yanke shawarar cewa za a gudanar da ainihin daurin auren daga baya. A cikin 620 Abu Bakr shine mutum na farko da ya fara ba da shaida ga Muhammad Isra'i da Mi'raj (Tafiyar Dare).

## Hijira zuwa madina

[[gyara sashe](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Abubakar&veaction=edit&section=22 "Gyara sashe: Hijira zuwa madina") | [gyara masomin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Abubakar&action=edit&section=22 "Edit section's source code: Hijira zuwa madina")]

A shekara ta 622, bisa gayyatar musulmin Madina, Muhammad ya umurci musulmi da su yi hijira zuwa Madina. An fara hijira a cikin batches. Ali shi ne na karshe da ya ci gaba da zama a Makka, wanda aka ba shi alhakin daidaita duk wani lamuni da musulmi suka karba, kuma ya shahara a kwance a gadon Muhammad lokacin da Kuraishawa karkashin jagorancin Ikrima suka yi yunkurin kashe Muhammad a lokacin da yake barci. Ana cikin haka sai [Abubakar](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Abubakar) ya raka [Muhammad](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Muhammad "Muhammad") (S.A.W) zuwa Madina. Saboda hatsarin da Kuraishawa ke da shi, ba su bi hanyar ba, sai dai sun bi ta wata hanya, inda suka fake a wani kogo na Jabal Thawr, mai nisan mil biyar kudu da Makka. Abd Allah bn Abi Bakr ya kasance yana sauraren tsare-tsare da tattaunawa na kuraishawa, kuma da dare ya kan kai labari zuwa ga wadanda suka gudu a cikin kogon. Asma bint Abi Bakr ‘yar Abubakar ta rika kawo musu abinci kullum. Aamir, bawan Abubakar, yakan kawo garken awaki a bakin kogon kowane dare, inda ake shayar da su. Kuraishawa sun aika da ƙungiyoyin bincike ta kowace hanya. Wata ƙungiya ta zo kusa da ƙofar kogon, amma ta kasa ganinsu. Saboda haka, aya Qur'ani 9:40 ta sauka. A’isha da Abu Sa’id al-Khudri da Abd Allah bn Abbas suna tafsirin wannan ayar sun ce Abubakar shi ne sahabin da ya zauna tare da Muhammad (S.A.W) a cikin kogon.

Bayan sun zauna a cikin kogon na tsawon kwana uku da darare uku, [Abubakar](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Abubakar) da Muhammad (S.A.W) suka wuce Madina, suka zauna na wani lokaci a Quba, wata unguwar bayan [Madina](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Madina "Madina").

## Rayuwar sa a Madinah

[[gyara sashe](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Abubakar&veaction=edit&section=23 "Gyara sashe: Rayuwar sa a Madinah") | [gyara masomin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Abubakar&action=edit&section=23 "Edit section's source code: Rayuwar sa a Madinah")]

A Madina, Muhammad(S.A.W) ya yanke shawarar gina masallaci. Sai aka zabi wani fili, sannan Abubakar ya biya kudin kasar. Musulmai, gami da Abubakar, sun gina masallaci mai suna Al-Masjid al-Nabawi a wurin. Abubakar ya kasance tare da Khaarijah bin Zaid Ansari (wanda ya kasance daga Madina) a matsayin ɗan'uwa a cikin imani. Dangantakar Abubakar da Khaarijah ta kasance mafi kyawu, wanda hakan ya kara karfi lokacin da Abubakar ya auri Habiba ‘yar Khaarijah. Khaarijah bin Zaid Ansari ya zauna a garin Sunh, wata unguwar Madina, shi ma Abubakar ya zauna. Bayan iyalan Abubakar sun isa Madina, sai ya sayi wani gida kusa da na Muhammad.

Yayin da yanayin Makka ya bushe, yanayin Madina ya yi dauri kuma saboda haka ne akasarin bakin haure suka yi rashin lafiya a lokacin da suka isa. Abu Bakr ya kamu da zazzabi na tsawon kwanaki, inda Khaarijah da iyalansa suka halarta. A Makka, Abubakar ya kasance mai sana’ar sayar da kaya, kuma ya fara sana’ar a Madina. Ya bude sabon kantinsa a Sunh, daga nan kuma aka kawo kayan sawa zuwa kasuwa a Madina. Ba da daɗewa ba kasuwancinsa ya bunƙasa. A farkon shekara ta 623, 'yar Abu Bakr, Aisha, wadda ta riga ta auri Muhammadu(S.A.W), an aika zuwa gidan Muhammad(S.A.W) bayan bikin aure mai sauki, wanda ya kara karfafa dangantaka tsakanin Abubakar da Muhammad.(S.A.W).

## Wafatin Shugaba Annabi Muhammadu (S.A.W)

[[gyara sashe](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Abubakar&veaction=edit&section=24 "Gyara sashe: Wafatin Shugaba Annabi Muhammadu (S.A.W)") | [gyara masomin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Abubakar&action=edit&section=24 "Edit section's source code: Wafatin Shugaba Annabi Muhammadu (S.A.W)")]

Akwai hadisai da dama dangane da kwanaki na karshe na Annabi Muhammadu(S.A.W) wadanda aka yi amfani da su wajen karfafa ra'ayin babban abota da amana da aka ce sun kasance tsakaninsa da Abubakar. A cikin irin wannan al'amari, yayin da Muhammadu(S.A.W) ke gab da rasuwa, ya sami kansa ya kasa gudanar da sallah kamar yadda ya saba. Ya umurci Abubakar da ya maye gurbinsa, ya yi biris da damuwar A’isha cewa mahaifinta yana da taurin kai ga wannan matsayi. Daga baya Abubakar ya hau matsayin, kuma a lokacin da Muhammad(S.A.W) ya shiga dakin sallah wata rana da safe a lokacin sallar asuba, Abubakar ya yi yunkurin komawa baya don ya bar shi ya dauki inda ya saba ya jagoranci. Muhammad(S.A.W) kuwa ya kyale shi ya cigaba. A wani lamari makamancin haka, a daidai wannan lokaci ne Muhammad(S.A.W) ya hau kan mimbari ya yi jawabi ga jama'a yana mai cewa: "Allah ya bai wa bawansa zabi tsakanin duniya da abin da ke wurin Allah kuma shi ne ya zabi na karshen." Abu Bakr, yana fahimtar haka da cewa Muhammadu(S.A.W) bai daɗe da rayuwa ba, sai ya ce, “A’a, mu da ’ya’yanmu za su zama fansarka. Muhammad(S.A.W) ya yi ta’aziyya ga abokin nasa kuma ya ba da umarnin a rufe dukkan kofofin da suke shiga masallacin ban da abin da ke fitowa daga gidan Abubakar, “domin ban san wanda ya fi shi abokina ba.”

Bayan rasuwar Muhammadu(S.A.W), al'ummar musulmi ba su shirya don rasa shugabansu ba kuma mutane da yawa sun fuskanci kaduwa sosai. Umar ya shafi musamman, a maimakon haka ya bayyana cewa Muhammadu(S.A.W) ya je neman shawara da Allah kuma nan ba da jimawa ba zai dawo, yana tsoratar da duk wanda zai ce Muhammadu(S.A.W) ya rasu. Abubakar bayan ya koma Madina ya kwantar da hankalin Umar ta hanyar nuna masa gawar Muhammadu(S.A.W), yana mai gamsar da shi game da mutuwarsa[61]. Daga nan sai ya yi jawabi ga wadanda suka taru a masallacin, inda ya ce, “Duk wanda ya bauta wa Muhammadu(S.A.W), Muhammadu(S.A.W) ya rasu, duk wanda ya bauta wa Allah, to, Allah rayayye ne, ba mai mutuwa ba”, don haka ya kawo karshen duk wani shakulatin bangaranci a cikin al’umma. Daga nan sai ya karkare da ayoyin Alqur’ani cewa: “(Ya Muhammad)(S.A.W) Lallai kai mai mutuwa ne, kuma su ma za su mutu”. [39:30] "Muhammad bai zama ba face manzo, kuma lalle ne manzanni da yawa sun shude a gabaninsa, idan ya mutu ko aka kashe shi, to, za ku juya a dugaduganku? Kuma wanda ya juya a kan dugadugansa , ba zai cutar da Allah ko kadan ba, kuma Allah zai saka wa masu godiya."

## Saqifa

[[gyara sashe](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Abubakar&veaction=edit&section=25 "Gyara sashe: Saqifa") | [gyara masomin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Abubakar&action=edit&section=25 "Edit section's source code: Saqifa")]

Bayan wafatin Muhammad, an gudanar da taron Ansar' ('yan asalin Madina) a unguwar Saqifah na kabilar Banu Sa'ida, abin da aka sani a lokacin shi ne manufar taron ita ce. don Ansar su yanke shawara a kan sabon shugaban al'ummar musulmi a tsakanin su, tare da keɓe Muhajirun (masu hijira daga Makka), ko da yake daga baya wannan ya zama batun muhawara.

Amma duk da haka Abubakar da Umar da suka sami labarin taron sai suka damu da yiwuwar juyin mulki, suka gaggauta zuwa wurin taron. Da isarsu, Abubakar ya yi wa mutanen da suka taru jawabi tare da gargadin cewa yunƙurin zaɓen shugaba ba na ƙabilar Muhammad ba, Quraishawa, zai iya haifar da sabani, domin su kaɗai ne za su iya ba da umarnin girmama da ya dace a tsakanin al'umma. Sannan ya kama hannun Umar da Abu Ubaidah ya mika su ga Ansaru a matsayin zabin da zai dace. Habab ibn Mundhir wani jigo a yakin Badar ya mayar da martani da nasa shawarar cewa Kuraishawa da Ansar su zabi shugaba kowanne daga cikinsu, wanda zai yi mulki tare. Kungiyar ta yi zafi da jin wannan shawara kuma ta fara jayayya a tsakaninsu. Masani na Orientalist William Muir ya ba da lura da yanayin:

Lokacin yana da mahimmanci. Haɗin kai na Imani ya kasance cikin haɗari. Ƙarfin da aka raba zai faɗi guntu, kuma duk yana iya ɓacewa. Tufafin Manzon Allah Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallama dole ne ya hau kan Magaji xaya, kuma a kan xaya. Mulkin Musulunci ya bukaci a yi halifanci da ba a raba; kuma Larabawa ba za ta amince da wani shugaba ba sai daga cikin Kuraishawa.

Umar ya yi gaggawar riko hannun Abubakar ya rantse wa na baya, misali da mutanen da suka taru. Taron dai ya watse ne a lokacin da wata hatsaniya ta barke tsakanin Umar da Sarkin Banu Sa’ida, Sa’ad bn Ubadah. Wannan yana iya nuni da cewa ba za a yi ijma'i akan zabin Abubakar ba, tare da tada jijiyoyin wuya a sakamakon sabanin.

Abu Bakr ya kasance kusa da duniya an yarda da shi a matsayin shugaban al'ummar musulmi (karkashin lakabin Khalifa) sakamakon Saqifah, ko da yake ya fuskanci sabani saboda gaugawar taron. Sahabbai da dama, wadanda suka fi shahara a cikinsu su ne Ali ibn Abi Talib, da farko sun ki amincewa da ikonsa. A cikin ’yan Shi’a, an kuma yi iƙirarin cewa a baya an naɗa Ali a matsayin magajin Muhammadu, tare da kallon zaben a matsayin wanda ya saba wa burin na biyu. Daga baya Abubakar ya aika Umar ya fuskanci Ali, wanda hakan ya haifar da rikici wanda watakila ya hada da tashin hankali. Sai dai bayan wata shida kungiyar ta yi sulhu da Abubakar kuma Ali ya yi masa mubaya'a.

## Jihadi tare da Annabi Muhammadu(S.A.W)

[[gyara sashe](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Abubakar&veaction=edit&section=26 "Gyara sashe: Jihadi tare da Annabi Muhammadu(S.A.W)") | [gyara masomin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Abubakar&action=edit&section=26 "Edit section's source code: Jihadi tare da Annabi Muhammadu(S.A.W)")]

### Yakin Badar

[[gyara sashe](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Abubakar&veaction=edit&section=27 "Gyara sashe: Yakin Badar") | [gyara masomin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Abubakar&action=edit&section=27 "Edit section's source code: Yakin Badar")]

A shekara ta 624, Abubakar ya shiga yakin farko tsakanin Musulmai da Kuraishawa na Makka, wanda aka fi sani da Yakin Badar, amma bai yi yaki ba, a maimakon haka ya zama daya daga cikin masu gadin tantin Muhammad. Dangane da haka, daga baya Ali ya tambayi abokansa a kan wanene suke ganin ya fi kowa jarumta a cikin mutane? Kowa ya ce Ali ya fi kowa jarumtaka. Sai Ali ya amsa da cewa:

A'a Abubakar shine mafi jarumtar mazaje. A yakin Badar mun yi tanadin wani rumfa ga Annabi, amma da aka ce mu ba da kanmu aikin gadinsa babu wanda ya fito sai Abubakar. Da takobi a zare ya dauki matsayinsa a gefen Manzon Allah yana tsare shi daga kafirai ta hanyar kai hari ga wadanda suka kuskura su ci gaba da wannan hanya. Don haka ya kasance jarumin mazaje.

A cikin lissafin Ahlus-Sunnah, a lokacin irin wannan harin, fayafai guda biyu daga garkuwar [Abubakar](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Abubakar) sun shiga cikin kuncin Muhammad. Abubakar ya ci gaba da niyyar ciro wadannan fayafai amma Abu Ubaidah bn al-Jarrah ya bukaci ya bar masa al'amarin, ya rasa allurarsa guda biyu a yayin aikin. A cikin wa] annan labarun daga baya Abubakar, tare da wasu sahabbai, suka jagoranci Muhammadu(S.A.W)zuwa wurin tsira.

### Yakin Uhudu

[[gyara sashe](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Abubakar&veaction=edit&section=28 "Gyara sashe: Yakin Uhudu") | [gyara masomin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Abubakar&action=edit&section=28 "Edit section's source code: Yakin Uhudu")]

A shekara ta 625, ya halarci yakin Uhudu, inda aka fatattaki mafi yawan musulmi, kuma shi da kansa ya samu rauni. Kafin a fara yakin, dansa Abd al-Rahman, wanda a lokacin har yanzu ba musulmi ba ne, kuma yana yaki a bangaren Kuraishawa, ya fito ya jefar da kalubalen fada. Abubakar ya yarda da kalubalen amma Muhammad ya hana shi. Daga baya Abdurrahman ya matso kusa da mahaifinsa ya ce masa "Kai an tona mini asiri ne, amma na kau da kai ban kashe ka ba." Don haka sai Abubakar ya amsa da cewa "Duk da haka, da a ce an bijire mini a matsayin abin hari da ban kau da kai daga gare ku ba." A kashi na biyu na yakin, sojojin dawakan Khalid bn al-Walid sun far wa musulmi daga baya, inda suka canza nasarar musulmi zuwa ga ci. Da yawa sun gudu daga fagen fama har da Abubakar. Duk da haka, bisa ga nasa lissafin, shi ne "wanda ya fara dawowa".

### Yakin Khandaki

[[gyara sashe](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Abubakar&veaction=edit&section=29 "Gyara sashe: Yakin Khandaki") | [gyara masomin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Abubakar&action=edit&section=29 "Edit section's source code: Yakin Khandaki")]

A shekara ta 627 ya halarci Yakin Rarara da ma Banu Qurayza. A yakin Rarara, Muhammadu ya raba ramin zuwa sassa da dama kuma an sanya wata tawaga da za ta gadin kowane sashe. Daya daga cikin wadannan runduna ta kasance karkashin jagorancin Abubakar. Makiya sun yi ta kai hare-hare akai-akai a kokarinsu na ketare ramin, inda aka fatattake su. Domin tunawa da wannan taron an gina wani masallaci, wanda daga baya aka fi sani da 'Masjid-i-Siddiq', a wurin da Abubakar ya kori tuhumar da makiya ke yi.

### Yakin Khaibar

[[gyara sashe](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Abubakar&veaction=edit&section=30 "Gyara sashe: Yakin Khaibar") | [gyara masomin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Abubakar&action=edit&section=30 "Edit section's source code: Yakin Khaibar")]

Abubakar ya halarci yakin Khaibar. Khaybar yana da kagara guda takwas, mafi karfi da tsaro a cikinsu ana kiransa Al-Qamus. Muhammad ya aiki Abubakar tare da gungun mayaka domin su yi yunkurin dauka, amma ba su samu ba. Haka kuma Muhammadu ya aika Umar tare da gungun mayaka, amma shi ma Umar bai iya cin galaba a kan Al-Qamus ba. Wasu musulmi ma sun yi yunƙurin kame katangar, amma ba su yi nasara ba. A ƙarshe, Muhammadu ya aika Ali, wanda ya ci nasara da shugaban abokan gaba, Marhab.

## Yaƙin shekarun ƙarshe na Annabi Muhammadu(S.A.W)

[[gyara sashe](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Abubakar&veaction=edit&section=31 "Gyara sashe: Yaƙin shekarun ƙarshe na Annabi Muhammadu(S.A.W)") | [gyara masomin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Abubakar&action=edit&section=31 "Edit section's source code: Yaƙin shekarun ƙarshe na Annabi Muhammadu(S.A.W)")]

A shekara ta 629 Muhammad ya aika Amr bn al-'As zuwa Zaat-ul-Sallasal, sannan Abu Ubaidah bn al-Jarrah ya biyo baya don amsa kiran karfafawa. Abubakar da Umar sun jagoranci wata runduna a qarqashin al-Jarrah, sai suka kai farmaki suka fatattaki maqiya.

A cikin 630, lokacin da Musulmai suka ci [Makka](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Makka "Makka"), Abu Bakr yana cikin sojoji. Kafin a ci Makka babansa Abu Quhafa ya musulunta.

## Yakin Hunayni da Ta'if

[[gyara sashe](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Abubakar&veaction=edit&section=32 "Gyara sashe: Yakin Hunayni da Ta'if") | [gyara masomin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Abubakar&action=edit&section=32 "Edit section's source code: Yakin Hunayni da Ta'if")]

A shekara ta 630, maharba daga kabilun yankin sun yi wa sojojin musulmi kwanton bauna a lokacin da suke wucewa ta kwarin Hunain, mai nisan mil goma sha daya daga arewa maso gabashin Makka. Ba tare da an sansu ba, sai jami'an gaba na sojojin musulmi suka gudu a firgice. An sami rudani sosai, rakuma, dawakai da mutane sun yi karo da juna a ƙoƙarin neman mafaka. Muhammad kuwa ya tsaya kyam. Sahabbai tara ne suka rage a wajensa, ciki har da Abubakar. Karkashin umarnin Muhammadu, kawun nasa Abbas ya yi kira da babbar murya, "Ya ku Musulmai, ku zo wurin Annabin Allah". Sojojin musulmi ne suka ji kiran suka taru a gefen Muhammad. Lokacin da Musulmai suka taru a adadi mai yawa, Muhammadu ya ba da umarnin a gurfanar da abokan gaba. A fadan hannu da hannu da ya biyo bayan kabilun an fatattaki su suka gudu zuwa Autas.[[13]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Abubakar#cite_note-13)

Muhammad ya aika da tawagar da za su gadin wucewar Hunain kuma ya jagoranci babbar runduna zuwa Autas. A arangama da aka yi a Autas kabilun sun kasa daurewa musulmi hari. Gaskanta ci gaba da tsayin daka ba shi da amfani, kabilun sun balle kuma suka koma Ta'if.

Muhammad ne ya nada Abubakar ya jagoranci harin da aka kai wa Ta'if. Kabilan sun kulle kansu a cikin kagara kuma suka ki fitowa fili. Musulmai sun yi amfani da katafalu, amma ba tare da wani sakamako na gaske ba. Musulman sun yi yunkurin yin amfani da wata hanyar gwaji, inda wasu gungun sojoji da ke da garkuwa da rigar saniya suka yi gaba suka kona kofar. Duk da haka, abokan gaba sun jefa jajayen tarkacen ƙarfe a kan gwajin, wanda ya sa ya zama mara amfani.

An kwashe makonni biyu ana kewaye, kuma har yanzu babu alamar rauni a cikin kagara. Muhammad ya gudanar da majalisar yaki. Abubakar ya ba da shawarar cewa za a iya tayar da wannan kawanya, kuma Allah ya yi tanadin faduwar kagara. An yarda da shawarar, kuma a cikin Fabrairu 630, an tayar da kewayen Ta'if kuma sojojin musulmi suka koma Makka. Bayan ‘yan kwanaki sai Malik bin Auf kwamanda ya zo Makka ya musulunta.[[14]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Abubakar#cite_note-14)

## Abubakar a matsayin Amirul Hajji

[[gyara sashe](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Abubakar&veaction=edit&section=33 "Gyara sashe: Abubakar a matsayin Amirul Hajji") | [gyara masomin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Abubakar&action=edit&section=33 "Edit section's source code: Abubakar a matsayin Amirul Hajji")]

A shekara ta 631 miladiyya, Muhammad ya aika da tawaga musulmi dari uku daga Madina domin gudanar da aikin Hajji bisa ga sabuwar hanyar Musulunci, ya nada Abubakar a matsayin shugaban tawagar. Washegari bayan Abubakar da tawagarsa sun tafi aikin Hajji, Muhammadu ya sami sabon wahayi: Suratu Tawbah, sura ta tara na Alqur'ani. An ruwaito cewa lokacin da wannan wahayi ya zo, wani ya ba wa Muhammad shawarar ya aika da labarinsa ga Abubakar. Muhammad yace mutumin gidansa ne kadai zai iya shelanta wahayi.

Muhammadu(S.A.W) ya kira Ali, ya tambaye shi ya shelanta wani yanki na Suratu Tawbah ga mutane a ranar layya lokacin da suka taru a Mina. Ali ya fita bisa rakumin Muhammadu mai tsinke kunne, ya riski Abubakar. Lokacin da Ali ya shiga jam’iyyar, Abubakar ya so sanin ko ya zo ne domin ya ba da umurni ko ya isar da su. Ali ya ce bai zo ne ya maye gurbin Abubakar a matsayin Amirul Hajji ba, kuma aikin sa kawai shi ne isar da sako na musamman ga mutane a madadin Muhammad(S.A.W).

A Makka, Abu Bakr ya jagoranci bikin Hajji, kuma Ali ya karanta sanarwar a madadin Muhammad. Manyan batutuwan sanarwar sun hada da:

1.   Don haka ba a ba wa waɗanda ba musulmi damar ziyartar Ka'aba' ko yin aikin hajji ba.
2.   Kada wani ya yi dawafin Ka'aba tsirara.
3.   Ba a yarda da shirka ba. Inda musulmi suka yi wata yarjejeniya da mushrikai irin wadannan yarjejeniyoyin za a girmama su na tsawon lokacin da aka kayyade. Inda babu yarjejeniyoyin sai aka bayar da wata huxu (hudu) sannan kuma ba za a baiwa mushrikai kwata kwata ba.

Tun daga ranar da aka yi shelar sabon zamani ya waye, kuma Musulunci ne kawai ya zama koli a Larabawa.

## Fitar Abubakar(R.A) yaki

[[gyara sashe](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Abubakar&veaction=edit&section=34 "Gyara sashe: Fitar Abubakar(R.A) yaki") | [gyara masomin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Abubakar&action=edit&section=34 "Edit section's source code: Fitar Abubakar(R.A) yaki")]

Abu Bakr ya jagoranci balaguron soji guda daya, watau Bakin Abu Bakr As-Siddiq,[51] wanda ya gudana a Najd, a watan Yuli 628 (wata na uku 7AH a kalandar Musulunci). Abu Bakr ya jagoranci wani babban kamfani a Nejd bisa umarnin Muhammad. An kashe da yawa an kuma kai su fursuna. Littafin Hadisin Sunna Sunan Abu Dawud ya ambaci taron.

## Fitar Usama bin Zayd yaki

[[gyara sashe](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Abubakar&veaction=edit&section=35 "Gyara sashe: Fitar Usama bin Zayd yaki") | [gyara masomin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Abubakar&action=edit&section=35 "Edit section's source code: Fitar Usama bin Zayd yaki")]

A cikin 632, a cikin makonni na ƙarshe na rayuwarsa, Muhammadu ya ba da umarnin a kai hari zuwa Siriya don ɗaukar fansa kan cin nasarar da aka yi wa Musulmai a Yaƙin Mu'tah wasu shekaru baya. Wanda ya jagoranci kamfen shine Usama bn Zayd, wanda aka kashe mahaifinsa, ɗan riƙon Muhammad Zayd ibn Harithah, a rikicin baya. Bai fi shekara ashirin ba, ba a gogewa ba kuma ba a gwada shi ba, nadin Usama ya yi ta cece-kuce, inda ya zama matsala musamman a lokacin da aka sanya tsofaffin sojoji kamar su Abubakar, da Abu Ubaidah bn al-Jarrah da Sa'ad bn Abi Waqqas karkashin jagorancinsa. Duk da haka, an aika da balaguro, ko da yake ba da daɗewa ba bayan an tashi, an sami labarin mutuwar Muhammadu, wanda ya tilasta sojojin su koma Madina. Ba a sake shiga yakin ba sai bayan hawan Abubakar zuwa halifanci, inda a nan ne ya zabi ya kara tabbatar da umarnin Usama, wanda a karshe ya kai ga nasara.[[15]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Abubakar#cite_note-15)

## Rasuwar(Wafatin) sa

[[gyara sashe](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Abubakar&veaction=edit&section=36 "Gyara sashe: Rasuwar(Wafatin) sa") | [gyara masomin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Abubakar&action=edit&section=36 "Edit section's source code: Rasuwar(Wafatin) sa")]

A ranar 23 ga Agusta 634, Abubakar ya yi rashin lafiya kuma bai warke ba. Zazzabi mai zafi ya kamashi ya kwanta. Ciwonsa ya daɗe, kuma da yanayinsa ya tsananta, sai ya ji kamar ƙarshensa ya kusa. Da ya gane haka sai ya aika aka kirawo Ali ya bukace shi da ya yi tafsirinsa tunda Ali ma ya yi wa Muhammad. Abubakar ya ga ya kamata ya nada magajinsa don kada lamarin ya zama sanadin sabani a tsakanin musulmi bayan rasuwarsa, duk da cewa an yi ta cece-kuce kan rashin nada Ali. Ya nada Umar a kan wannan aiki bayan ya tattauna da wasu Sahabbai. Wasu daga cikinsu sun fifita nadin, wasu kuma ba sa son ta, saboda taurin hali na Umar. Don haka Abubakar ya yi wasiyyarsa ta karshe ga Usman bn Affan kamar haka:

"Da sunan Allah Mai rahama.  Wannan ita ce wasiyyar Abubakar xan Abu Quhafa, a lokacin da yake cikin sa’a ta qarshen duniya, kuma ta farkon lahira;  Sa'ar da kafiri ya yi imani a cikinta, azzalumai ya gamsu da munanan ayyukansu, na zabi Umar dan Khaddab a matsayin magajina.  Saboda haka, ku ji shi, ku yi masa biyayya.  Idan ya yi daidai, tabbatar da ayyukansa.  Niyyata tana da kyau, amma ba zan iya ganin sakamakon nan gaba ba.  Kuma waɗanda suka yi zãlunci, to, zã su yi wa kansu hisãbi mai tsanani a bãyan haka.  Lafiya lau.  Da fatan za a kasance tare da yardar Ubangiji ta albarka".
Umar ya jagoranci sallar jana'izarsa kuma an binne shi a gefen kabarin Muhammad (S.A.W). Allah shi dada haske a kabarin sa. [[16]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Abubakar#cite_note-16)

title: Ɗan siyasa
text:
# Ɗan siyasa

An san ’yan siyasa da maganganun maganganu, kamar a cikin jawabai ko tallace-tallacen yakin neman zabe. An san su musamman da yin amfani da jigogi na gama-gari wadanda ke ba su damar habaka matsayinsu na siyasa ta hanyar da suka saba da masu jefa kuri'a. [[5]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/%C6%8Aan_siyasa#cite_note-5) ’

Yan siyasa na larura sun zama kwararrun masu amfani da kafofin watsa labarai. [[6]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/%C6%8Aan_siyasa#cite_note-6) Yan siyasa a karni na 19 sun yi amfani da jaridu da mujallu da kasidu da kuma fosta. [[7]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/%C6%8Aan_siyasa#cite_note-7) A cikin karni na 20, sun shiga cikin rediyo da talabijin, suna mai da tallace-tallacen talabijin ya zama mafi tsada a cikin yakin neman zabe. [[8]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/%C6%8Aan_siyasa#cite_note-8) A cikin karni na 21, sun ƙara shiga cikin kafofin watsa labarun dangane da Intanet da wayoyin hannu.[[9]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/%C6%8Aan_siyasa#cite_note-9) Jita-jita koyaushe tana taka rawa sosai a siyasa, tare da jita-jita marasa kyau game da abokin hamayya yawanci mafi inganci fiye da jita-jita masu kyau game da nasu bangaren.[[10]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/%C6%8Aan_siyasa#cite_note-10)

title: Itofiya
text:
# Itofiya


Yankin itofiya a duniya

**Jamhuriyar Tarayyar Itofiya:** da turanci _**[Ethiopia](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ethiopian\_Airlines "Ethiopian Airlines"),**_ da harshen amhare ( ኢትዮጵያ )[[1]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-1)[[2]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-2)[[3]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-3) ada an santa da suna [habasha](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Habasha "Habasha"), kasa ce dake a kudancin [Afirka](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Afirka "Afirka").[[4]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-4)[[5]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-5)[[6]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-6) Ta kasancee'yantacciyar kasa ce wadda turawan mulkin mallaka basu mulke ta ba har zuwa shekara ta (1936)[[7]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-7)[[8]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-8)[[9]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-9) sai sojojin [Italiya](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Italiya "Italiya") suka fada cikin kasar amma 'yan kasar suka yi taron-dangi da sojojin [Birtaniya](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Birtaniya "Birtaniya") suka kori sojojin [Italiya](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Italiya "Italiya") a shekara ta, (1941)[[10]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-10)[[11]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-11)[[12]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-12) ammah batasamu 'yancin kanta ba sai da ƙasar [ingila](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ingila "Ingila") tasa mata hannu a shekara ta [(1944](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/1944?action=edit&redlink=1 "1944 (babu wannan shafin)").)[[13]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-13)[[14]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-14)[[15]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-15)[[16]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-16)

## Tarihi

## Tattalin Arziki

[[gyara sashe](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Itofiya&veaction=edit&section=2 "Gyara sashe: Tattalin Arziki") | [gyara masomin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Itofiya&action=edit&section=2 "Edit section's source code: Tattalin Arziki")]

Habasha ta yi rajista mafi saurin bunƙasa tattalin arziki a ƙarƙashin gwamnatin Meles Zenawi.[[42]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-42)[[43]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-43)[[44]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-44) A cewar IMF, Habasha na daya daga cikin kasashe masu saurin bunkasar tattalin arziki a duniya, inda ta yi rijista sama da kashi 10 cikin 100 na bunkasuwar tattalin arziki daga 2004 zuwa 2009.[[45]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-:4-45)[[46]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-46)[[45]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-:4-45) Ita ce tattalin arzikin Afirka mafi saurin bunƙasa ba tare da dogaro da mai ba a cikin shekarun 2007 zuwa 2008.[[47]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-47)[[48]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-48)[[49]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-49) A cikin shekarar 2015, Bankin Duniya ya nuna cewa Habasha ta sami saurin bunƙasa tattalin arziƙin tare da haɓakar ainihin kayan cikin gida (GDP) a matsakaicin 10.9% tsakanin 2004 da 2014.[[50]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-50)[[51]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-51)[[52]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-52)

A cikin Shekara ta 2008 da 2011, ayyukan ci gaban Habasha da ci gaban da aka samu sun fuskanci ƙalubale sakamakon hauhawar hauhawar farashin kayayyaki da mawuyacin halin ma'auni na biyan kuɗi.[[53]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-53)[[54]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-54)[[55]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-55) Haɓakar hauhawar farashin kayayyaki ya haura zuwa kashi 40 cikin 100 a watan Agustan 2011 saboda rashin daidaiton manufofin kuɗi, ƙarin ƙarin albashin ma'aikatan gwamnati a farkon 2011, da tsadar abinci.[[56]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-56)[[57]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-57)[[58]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-58)

Duk da saurin bunƙasa a cikin 'yan shekarun nan, GDP na kowane mutum yana ɗaya daga cikin mafi ƙasƙanci a duniya, kuma tattalin arzikin yana fuskantar matsaloli masu yawa na tsarin. Dangane da bayanan baya-bayan nan daga shekarar 2019,[[59]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-59)[[60]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-60)[[61]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-61) kashi 68.7% na yawan jama'a suna fama da talauci da yawa da kuma ƙarin 18.4% masu rauni zuwa gare shi.[[62]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-62)[[63]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-63)[[64]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-64)

Tare da sanya hannun jari mai mahimmanci a cikin ayyukan jama'a da wuraren shakatawa na masana'antu, Habasha tana ƙoƙarin magance matsalolin tsarinta ta zama cibiyar samar da haske a Afirka.[[65]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-65)[[66]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-66)[[67]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-:5-67)[[67]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-:5-67)[[67]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-:5-67) A cikin 2019 an zartar da wata doka da ta ba wa 'yan Habasha 'yan gudun hijira damar saka hannun jari a masana'antar hidimar hada-hadar kudi ta Habasha.[[68]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-68)[[69]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-69)[[70]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-70)

Kundin tsarin mulkin Habasha ya fayyace cewa ‘yancin mallakar filaye na “jahar da jama’a ne kawai”, amma ‘yan kasar na iya yin hayar filaye har na tsawon shekaru 99,[[71]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-71)[[72]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-72)[[73]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-73) amma ba za su iya yin jinginar gida ko sayarwa ba. Ana ba da izinin yin hayar filaye na tsawon shekaru ashirin kuma ana tsammanin wannan zai tabbatar da cewa ƙasar ta tafi ga mafi yawan masu amfani. Ana daukar rabon filaye da gudanar da mulki a matsayin wani yanki da aka kafa cin hanci da rashawa,[[74]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-74)[[75]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-75)[[76]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-76) kuma sau da yawa ana neman biyan sauƙaƙawa da kuma cin hanci lokacin da ake fuskantar al’amuran da suka shafi ƙasa.[[77]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-77)[[78]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-78)[[79]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-79) Da yake babu mallakar filaye, ayyukan samar da ababen more rayuwa galibi ana yin su ne kawai ba tare da tambayar masu amfani da filaye ba,[[80]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-80)[[81]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-81)[[82]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-82) wanda daga nan sai a koma gudun hijira ba tare da gida ko fili ba. Yawan fushi da rashin yarda wani lokaci yakan haifar da zanga-zangar jama'a.[[83]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-:6-83)[[83]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-:6-83)[[83]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-:6-83)[[83]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-:6-83)[[84]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-84) Bugu da kari, amfanin noma ya ragu sosai, kuma har yanzu ana fama da fari da yawa a kasar, wanda hakan ke haddasa rarrabuwar kawuna a cikin gida.[[85]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-85)[[86]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-86)[[87]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-87)

## Makamashi da wutar lantarki

[[gyara sashe](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Itofiya&veaction=edit&section=3 "Gyara sashe: Makamashi da wutar lantarki") | [gyara masomin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Itofiya&action=edit&section=3 "Edit section's source code: Makamashi da wutar lantarki")]

Habasha na da manyan koguna 14 da ke kwarara daga tsaunukanta, ciki har da kogin Nilu. Tana da mafi girman wuraren ajiyar ruwa a Afirka.[[88]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-88)[[89]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-89)[[90]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-90) Ya zuwa 2012, masana'antar samar da wutar lantarki suna wakiltar kusan kashi 88.2% na jimillar ƙarfin samar da wutar lantarki.[[91]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-91)[[92]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-92)[[93]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-:7-93)[[93]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-:7-93)[[93]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-:7-93)

Babban madatsar ruwa ta Habasha da aka gina tsakanin 2011 zuwa 2023, wanda zai zama madatsar ruwa mafi girma a Afirka.[[94]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-94)[[95]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-95)[[96]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-96)

An samar da ragowar wutar lantarki daga burbushin mai (8.3%) da hanyoyin sabunta (3.6%).

Adadin wutar lantarki na jimillar yawan jama'a a shekarar 2016 ya kai kashi 42%, tare da kashi 85% a cikin birane da kuma kashi 26% a yankunan karkara. Ya zuwa shekarar 2016,[[97]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-97)[[98]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-98)[[99]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-99) jimlar samar da wutar lantarki ya kai TW⋅h 11.15 kuma ana amfani da shi ya kai 9.062 TW⋅h. An fitar da wutar lantarki 0.166 TW⋅h, da 0 kW⋅h da aka shigo da su, da kuma 2.784 GW na karfin samar da wutar lantarki.[[100]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-100)[[101]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-101)[[102]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-102) Habasha tana isar da kusan kashi 81% na yawan ruwa zuwa kogin Nilu ta cikin kogin Blue Nile, kogin Sobat da Atbara.[[103]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-103)[[104]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-104)[[105]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-105) A shekara ta 1959, Masar da Sudan sun rattaba hannu kan wata yerjejeniya ta kasashen biyu, yarjejeniyar ruwan Nilu ta shekarar 1959,[[106]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-106)[[107]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-:8-107)[[107]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-:8-107) wadda ta bai wa kasashen biyu ‘yancin kan ruwa na ruwan Nilu.[[108]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-108)[[109]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-109)[[110]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-110) Tun daga lokacin, Masar ta hana kusan dukkan ayyukan da ake yi a Habasha da ke neman amfani da magudanan ruwan Nilu na cikin gida.[[111]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-111)[[112]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-112)[[113]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-113) Wannan ya yi tasiri wajen hana tallafin samar da wutar lantarki daga waje da ayyukan ban ruwa a yammacin Habasha,[[114]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-:9-114)[[114]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-:9-114)[[115]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-115) wanda hakan ya kawo cikas ga ayyukan raya tattalin arziki na tushen albarkatun ruwa. Sai dai kasar Habasha na shirin gina wani katafaren madatsar ruwa mai karfin megawatt 6,450 a kogin Blue Nile.[[116]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-116)[[117]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-117)[[118]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-118) An kammala shi a shekara ta 2023, wannan babbar madatsar ruwa ta Habasha za ta kasance tashar samar da wutar lantarki mafi girma a Afirka.[[119]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-119)[[120]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-120)[[121]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-121) Aikin samar da wutar lantarki na Gibe III ya zuwa yanzu shi ne mafi girma a kasar tare da samar da wutar lantarki mai karfin megawatt 1,870. A cikin shekara ta 2017-18 (2010 E.C)[[122]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-122)[[123]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-123)[[124]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-124) wannan madatsar ruwa mai amfani da wutar lantarki ta samar da 4,900 GW⋅h.[245]

### Kudin Akshaye

[[gyara sashe](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Itofiya&veaction=edit&section=6 "Gyara sashe: Kudin Akshaye") | [gyara masomin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Itofiya&action=edit&section=6 "Edit section's source code: Kudin Akshaye")]

A cikin 980 BC, an kafa D'Mt a cikin Are Eritrea da kuma arewacin Ethiopia a yankin Tigray,[[125]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-125)[[126]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-126)[[127]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-127) kuma an yi imani da cewa yanayin da zai gaje ya zama magaji ya zama magajinsa.[[128]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-128)[[129]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-129)[[130]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-130) Wannan babban birnin kasar da aka samu a Yeha a cikin menene yanzu yanzu Habasha.[[131]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-131)[[132]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-132)[[133]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-133) Yawancin masana tarihi sun yi la'akari da wannan wayewar dan adam dan kasar Habasha na asalin kasar, kodayake a farkon lokacin da suka ba da gudummawa saboda yawan tasirin Bahar Maliya.[[134]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-134)[[135]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-135)[[136]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-136)

Sauran malamai sun dauki matsayin wata kungiyar al'adun afroasicic da rassan da ke magana da kayayyaki da kuma semitic; Wato,[[137]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-137)[[138]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-138)[[139]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-139) jama'ar lard na gida da Sabaenans daga Kudancin Arabia. Duk da haka, Geez,[[140]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-140)[[141]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-141)[[142]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-:1-142)[[142]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-:1-142)[[142]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-:1-142) tsohon Semit Harshen Habasha na Habasha na Habasha, ana tunanin ya haɓaka da kansa daga yaren Sabaenan.[[143]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-143) A farkon rabin 2000 BC, sauran masu magana da Semitic suna zaune a Habasha da Eritrea inda Gealz ya kirkira. [[144]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-144)[[145]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-145)[[146]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-146) Yanzu haka Sabaea ya kasance yana tunanin ya kasance ƙarami,[[147]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-147)[[148]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-148)[[149]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-149) iyakance ga wasu ƙananan yankuna, kuma ya ɓace bayan 'yan shekarun da suka gabata ko karni.[[150]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-150)[[151]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-151)[[152]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-152) Wataƙila mulkin ciniki ne ko kuma mallaka na soja cikin Alliance tare da Wuta ta Habasha ko kuma wasu ƙasashen Preto-Axumite.[[153]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-153)[[154]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-154)[[155]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-155)

Daular Axum a ganiya a karni na 6

Bayan faɗuwar D'Mt a karni na 4 BC, filin duniya Filato ya zo da mulkin magazarta.[[156]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-156)[[157]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-157)[[158]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-158) A cikin karni na 1 AD, mulkin Aksharum ya fito a cikin abin da yake yanzu yankin Tigray da Eritrea.[[159]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-159)[[160]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-160)[[161]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-161) A cewar littafin Axum, babban babban babban babban birnin farko, Itiyopis, ɗan Cush.[[162]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-162)[[163]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-163)[[164]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-164) Daga baya ya mika akmarinum a baya a wasu lokata a wannan gefen Bahar Maliya.[[165]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-165)[[166]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-166)[[167]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-167) A cikin Peran Annabi Mani da aka lissafa Axum tare da Rome, Farisa,[[168]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-168)[[169]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-169)[[170]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-170) da China a matsayin daya daga cikin manyan iko guda hudu na zamanin sa, a cikin karni na ### Tsakanin Zamani

[[gyara sashe](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Itofiya&veaction=edit&section=7 "Gyara sashe: Tsakanin Zamani") | [gyara masomin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Itofiya&action=edit&section=7 "Edit section's source code: Tsakanin Zamani")]

Babban labarin: Habasha a tsakiyar zamanai

Masarautar ta karɓi sunan "Ethiopia" a zamanin mulkin Ezana a karni na 4.[[200]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-200)[[201]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-201)[[202]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-202) Bayan cin nasarar daular Kush a shekara ta 330, yankin Aksumite ya kai kololuwarsa tsakanin ƙarni na 5 da na 6.[[203]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-203)[[204]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-204)[[205]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-205) An katse wannan lokacin ta hanyar kutse da dama cikin yankin kariyar Larabawa ta Kudu,[[206]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-206)[[207]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-207)[[208]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-208) gami da Dhu Nuwas na Yahudawa na Masarautar Himyarite da yaƙe-yaƙe na Aksumite-Farisiya.[[209]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-209)[[210]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-210)[[211]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-211) A shekara ta 575, Aksumiyawa sun kewaye birnin Sana'a suka sake mamaye birnin bayan kashe gwamnanta Sayf ibn Dhī Yazan.[[212]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-212)[[213]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-213)[[214]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-214) An bar Bahar Maliya ga Khalifancin Rashidun a shekara ta 646,[[215]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-215)[[216]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-216)[[217]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-217) kuma musulmin Larabawa sun wawashe birnin Adulis mai tashar jiragen ruwa a karni na 8; tare da lalata ƙasa da ba za a iya jurewa ba, da'awar sauyin yanayi da ruwan sama na lokaci-lokaci daga 730 zuwa 760,[[218]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-218)[[219]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-219)[[220]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-220) waɗannan abubuwan na iya haifar da mulkin ƙasa a matsayin wani ɓangare na muhimmiyar hanyar kasuwanci.[[221]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-221)[[222]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-222)[[223]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-223) Aksum ya zo karshe a shekara ta 960 lokacin da Sarauniya Gudit ta yi nasara akan sarkin Aksum na karshe.[[224]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-224)[[225]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-225)[[226]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-226) A sakamakon haka, ragowar al'ummar Aksumiyya su koma yankin kudancin kasar, su kafa daular Zagwe, suka canza babban birninsu zuwa Lalibela.[[227]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-227)[[228]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-228)[[229]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-229) Mulkin Zagwe ya ƙare lokacin da wani babban mutum mai daraja na Amhara Yekuno Amlak ya yi tawaye ga Sarki Yetbarak kuma ya kafa daular Habasha (wanda aka sani da "Abyssinia").[[230]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-230)[[231]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-231)[[232]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-232)

Biete Medhane Alem, wanda aka gina a zamanin daular Zagwe a tsakiyar zamanai

Daular Habasha ta fara fadada yankunan karkashin jagorancin Amda Seyon I.[[233]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-233)[[234]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-234)[[235]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-235)[[236]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-236) Ya kaddamar da yakin yaki da makiya musulmi na gabas, wanda ya haifar da gagarumin sauyi a cikin ma'auni wajen nuna goyon baya ga kiristoci tsawon shekaru biyu masu zuwa.[[237]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-237)[[238]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-238)[[239]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-239) Bayan nasarar yakin gabas da Amda Seyon ya yi, akasarin sarakunan musulmi a yankin kahon Afirka sun shiga karkashin mulkin daular Habasha.[[240]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-240)[[241]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-241)[[242]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-242) An miƙe daga Gojjam zuwa gabar tekun Somaliya a cikin Zelia.[[243]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-243)[[244]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-244)[[245]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-245) Daga cikin wadannan al'ummomin musulmi akwai masarautar Ifat. A zamanin sarki Zara Yaqob,[[246]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-246)[[247]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-247)[[248]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-248) daular Habasha ta kai kololuwarta.[[249]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-249)[[250]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-250)[[251]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-251) Mulkinsa ya kasance alama ce ta hanyar haɗin gwiwar mallakar yankuna daga sarakunan farko,[[252]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-252)[[253]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-253)[[254]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-254) da kula da gina majami'u da gidajen ibada da yawa, haɓaka wallafe-wallafe da fasaha, da ƙarfafa ikon daular tsakiya.[[255]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-255)[[256]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-256)[[257]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-257) Magajin Ifat, Adal Sultanate,[[258]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-258)[[259]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-259)[[260]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-260) ya yi ƙoƙari ya ci Habasha a lokacin yaƙin Habasha-Adal, amma a ƙarshe an ci nasara a yakin Wayna Daga 1543.[[261]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-261)[[262]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-262)[[263]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-263)

A karni na 16, kwararowar 'yan kabilar Oromo zuwa sassan arewacin yankin ya wargaza karfin daular.[[264]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-264)[[265]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-265)[[266]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-266) Da suka taso daga yankin Guji da Borena a yau, Oromos sun sami ƙwarin guiwa ne da ra'ayoyi da yawa na al'ada - tun daga Moggaasaa[[267]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-267)[[268]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-268)[[269]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-269) da Liqimssa - waɗanda yawancinsu ke da alaƙa da farmakin da suka kai. Wannan ya ci gaba har zuwa gada na Meslé.[[270]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-270)[[271]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-271)[[272]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-272) A cewar Abba Bahrey, farkon fadada ya faru ne a karkashin Sarkin sarakuna Dawit II (luba Melbah),[[273]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-273)[[274]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-274)[[275]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-275) lokacin da suka mamaye Bale kafin su mamaye Adal Sultanate.[[276]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-276)[[277]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-277)[[278]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-278)

Habasha ta ga babban huldar diflomasiyya da Portugal daga karni na 17, galibin alaka da addini. Tun daga 1555,[[279]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-279)[[280]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-280)[[281]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-281) Jesuits Portuguese sun yi ƙoƙarin haɓaka Roman Katolika a matsayin addinin jiha. Bayan gazawa da yawa, sun aika da masu mishan da yawa a cikin 1603,[[282]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-282)[[283]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-283)[[284]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-284) ciki har da wanda ya fi tasiri, Mutanen Espanya Jesuit Pedro Paez.[[285]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-285)[[286]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-286)[[287]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-287) A karkashin sarki Susenyos na I, Roman Katolika ya zama addinin daular Habasha a shekara ta 1622.[[288]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-288)[[289]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-289)[[290]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-290) Wannan shawarar ta haifar da tashin hankali daga al'ummar Orthodox.[[291]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-291)[[292]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-292)[[293]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-293)
