## Habasha da Musulunci

[[gyara sashe](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Itofiya&veaction=edit&section=8 "Gyara sashe: Habasha da Musulunci") | [gyara masomin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Itofiya&action=edit&section=8 "Edit section's source code: Habasha da Musulunci")]

Kasar habasha ita ce kasa ta farko da ta kare [musulmin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Musulmin?action=edit&redlink=1 "Musulmin (babu wannan shafin)") farko da su ka tsira daga arnan [makka](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Makka "Makka"),[[295]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-295)[[296]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-296)[[297]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-297) da kyakkyawar dangantakar da take tsakanin musulmai da habasha a zamanin Annabi Muhammad (S. A. W)[[298]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-298)[[299]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-299)[[300]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-300)[manzon Allah,](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Manzon_Allah "Manzon Allah") amma ta soma wargajewa tsakanin habasha da kasashen musulinci a zamanin [Umar dan khaddab](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Umar_dan_khaddab?action=edit&redlink=1 "Umar dan khaddab (babu wannan shafin)") yardar Allah ta Kara tabbata a ga reshi,[[301]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-301)[[302]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-302)[[303]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-303) a wannan lokacin habashawa suka yi ruwan bama-bamai a tashar jirgin ruwa ta [jidda](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jidda?action=edit&redlink=1 "Jidda (babu wannan shafin)") kasar [saudiyya](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Saudiyya "Saudiyya") abin da yasa musulmai suka maida martani.[[304]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-304)[[305]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-305)[[306]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-306)

A shekara ta 83 ta hijira musulmai suka kama wani birni a kusa da habasha dan su ringa lura da habashawa, a shekara ta 1510 bayan haihuwar Annabi **Isah**[[307]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-307)[[308]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-308)[[309]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-309) sarauniyar habasha ta aika manzo na musamman zuwa ga aiman wail sarkin Burtugal dan saboda ya ci musulmai da yaki a taikun [Indiya](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Indiya "Indiya") ta kuma nemi hadin kai daga wajan shi dan ya turamata da sojoji ta yaki [makka](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Makka "Makka") sai ya yadda da maganarta ya turumata sojojin masu dumbin yawa ko da haka musulmai sun ci su da yaki sun kashe musu babban hafsan sojojin su,[[310]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-310)[[311]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-311)[[312]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-312) amma duk da haka musulmai basusamu dama sun shiga habasha ba.[[313]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-313)[[314]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-314)[[315]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Itofiya#cite_note-315)

# Brigitte Oleschinski

**Brigitte Oleschinski** (* 10 ga Agusta 1955 a [Cologne](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/K%C3%B6ln "Köln") ) ƙwararriyar [masaniyar siyasa](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kimiyyar_siyasa "Kimiyyar siyasa") ce kuma mawaƙiya ' yar ƙasar Jamus .

## Rayuwa

[[gyara sashe](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Brigitte_Oleschinski&veaction=edit&section=1 "Gyara sashe: Rayuwa") | [gyara masomin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Brigitte_Oleschinski&action=edit&section=1 "Edit section's source code: Rayuwa")]

Brigitte Oleschinski ta yi karatun [kimiyyar siyasa](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kimiyyar_siyasa "Kimiyyar siyasa") a Jami'ar Free ta Berlin . A shekarar 1993, ta sami digirin digirgir a fannin falsafa tare da takardar digiri kan tarihin cocin fursunoni a Jamhuriyar Weimar da kuma Reich na Uku . A shekarar 1990, ta yi aiki a Cibiyar Tunawa da Juyin Juya Halin Jamus da ke Berlin. A shekarar 1992, ta kasance ɗaya daga cikin waɗanda suka kafa Cibiyar Takardu da Bayanai ta Torgau, wadda ta yi gyare-gyare da kuma buga muƙaloli da dama na tarihi. Tana zaune a Berlin a yau.

Baya ga aikinta a matsayin masanin tarihi na zamani, Oleschinski tana wallafa waƙoƙi da kasidu tun daga shekarar 1990. [Angelika Overath](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Angelika_Overath "Angelika Overath") ta bayyana ta a cikin littafin _Neue Zürcher Zeitung_ a matsayin wacce ta kasance cikin "ɗaya daga cikin sabbin muryoyi masu mahimmanci a cikin waƙoƙin Jamusanci". Oleschinski ya ɗauki ra'ayin cewa ma'anoni da tasirin waƙoƙi ba su taso daga manufar marubucin ba, sai dai sun fito ne daban-daban a cikin kowane mai karɓa. Tana ganin cewa waƙoƙi kuzari ne na ɓoye da ake fitarwa ta hanyar hulɗa da su. [[1]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Brigitte_Oleschinski#cite_note-Overath-1) Oleschinski ya kasance memba na PEN Center Jamus tun daga shekarar 1998.

# Nahiya

_Wannan Muƙalar **guntuwa** ce: tana buƙatar a inganta ta, kuna iya [gyara ta](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Nahiya&action=edit)._


antarctica a nahiyar duniya

**Nahiya** na nufin manya-manyan da'irar shimfiɗaɗɗun ƙasashe da ake da su a duniya. Akan ƙididdige su ne dangane da yarjejeniya ba wai don wasu ƙa'idoji na musamman ba, akwai yankuna na ƙasa guda bakwai wanda ake ɗauka a matsayin [nahiyoyin duniya](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Duniya "Duniya"). Wanda aka jera su daga mafi girmansu zuwa mafi ƙanƙantansu, waɗannan nahiyoyi bakwai sune: [Asiya](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Asiya "Asiya"), [Afirka](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Afirka "Afirka"), [Amurka ta Arewa](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Amurka_ta_Arewa "Amurka ta Arewa"), [Amurka ta Kudu](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Amurka_ta_Kudu "Amurka ta Kudu"), [Antatika](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Antatika "Antatika"), [Turai](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Turai "Turai"), [Ostiraliya](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ostiraliya_(nahiya) "Ostiraliya (nahiya)").[[1]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nahiya#cite_note-1) Wasu 'yan bambance-bambance na iya haɗe wadannan nahiyoyi misali, [Amurka](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Amurka "Amurka"), _Eurasia_, ko kuma [Afro-Eurasia](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Afro-Eurasia "Afro-Eurasia") akan dauke su a wasu lokutan a matsayin nahiya ɗaya wadanda ka iya rage yawan nahiyoyin zuwa guda huɗu.

Amma abin da aka fi haƙƙaƙewa akai shi ne, waɗannan nahiyoyi guda Bakwai ne. Kuma sun haɗar da Afirka da _Antatika_ da Asiya da Ostraliya da Turai da kudancin Amirka da kuma Arewacin Amirka. Wannan a yadda aka karantar da ɗalibai kenan a yankin nahiyar Amirka baki ɗaya. Ana daukan Zealandia, wani katafaren yanki na duniya a matsayin nahiya mai zaman kanta.

Amma kuma a yankin nahiyar Turai da kuma sauran sassan duniya, mafi yawan ɗaliban yankunan ana karantar da su cewar, nahiyoyi Shida rak ake da su a duniyar nan. Ma'ana a waɗannan yankuna ana duban Kudancin Amirka da kuma Arewacin Amirka a matsayin nahiya guda ɗaya ta Amirka. Anan lissafin nahiyoyi shidan kenan ya haɗar da Afirka da Amirka da Antarctica da [Asiya](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Asiya "Asiya") da Australiya da kuma Turai.

To sai dai a halin da ake ciki kuma, mafiya yawan masana ta fuskar kimiyya na duban waɗannan nahiyoyi Shida da cewar nahiyar Turai da ta Asiya a dunƙule suke wuri ɗaya a matsayin nahiya guda, don haka ne ma suke kiran nahiyar da suna Eurasiya, sai kuma Afirka da Antarctica da Austaraliya da Kudancin Amirka da kuma Arewacin Amirka.

Masana ilimin taswirar duniya, su kuma a halin yanzu sun kasafta duniyar nan zuwa yankuna takwas domin samun sauƙin fahimta. Yanki na farko dai shi ne na Asiya, wanda ya ƙunshi Gabas ta Tsakiya da Arewacin Afirka. Sai kuma Turai da Arewacin Amirka. Akwai kuma Tsakiyar Amirka da yankin Carribbean, kana kuma Kudancin Amirka da Afirka da Austaraliya da kuma Yankin Teku, wato Oceania kenan.

title: Bahar Rum
text:
# Bahar Rum


kogin bahar rum


kogin bahar rum

**Tekun Bahar Rum teku**[ne](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Teku "Teku") da ke da alaƙa da [Tekun Atlantika](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tekun_Atalanta "Tekun Atalanta"), Basin Bahar Rum ya kewaye shi kuma kusan an rufe shi da ƙasa: a arewa ta yamma da Kudancin Turai da Anatoliya, a kudu ta arewacin Afirka, a gabas kuma ta Levant. Tekun ya taka muhimmiyar rawa a tarihin wayewar Yammacin Turai. Shaidar Geological ta nuna cewa kusan shekaru miliyan biyar da digo Tara (5.9) da suka gabata, an yanke Tekun Bahar Rum daga Tekun Atlantika kuma an yanke shi a wani ɓangare ko gaba daya a cikin shekaru kusan dubu Dayton (600,000) a lokacin rikicin salinity na Messin kafin ambaliyar Zanclean ta cika kusan shekaru 5.3 miliyan da suka wuce.


kogin bahar rum

Tekun Bahar Rum ya ƙunshi yanki kusan 2,500,000 square kilometres (970,000 sq mi) ,[[1]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bahar_Rum#cite_note-1) yana wakiltar kashi 0.7% na saman tekun duniya, amma haɗinsa zuwa Tekun Atlantika ta mashigin Gibraltar-mashigin da ke haɗa Tekun Atlantika zuwa Tekun Bahar Rum kuma ya raba yankin Iberian Peninsula a [Turai](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Turai "Turai") da [Maroko](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Moroko "Moroko") a [Afirka](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Afirka "Afirka"). kawai 14 kilometres (9 mi) fadi. Tekun Bahar Rum ya ƙunshi tsibirai da yawa, wasu daga cikinsu sun fito ne daga dutsen mai aman wuta. Manyan tsibirai biyu masu nisa sune [Sicily](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sisiliya "Sisiliya") da [Sardinia](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sardiniya "Sardiniya").


Bahar Rum

Tekun Bahar Rum yana da matsakaicin zurfin zurfin 1,500 metres (4,900 ft) kuma mafi zurfin da aka rubuta shine 5,109 metres (16,762 ft) ± 1 metre (3 ft) a cikin Calypso Deep a cikin Tekun Ionian. Ya ta'allaka ne tsakanin latitudes 30° da 46° N da longitudes 6° W da 36° E. Tsawonsa daga yamma–gabas, daga mashigin Gibraltar zuwa mashigin tekun Alexandretta, a kudu maso gabashin gabar tekun [Turkiyya](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Turkiyya "Turkiyya"), yana da kusan kilomita 4,000 kilometres (2,500 mi) . Tsawon arewa-kudu ya bambanta sosai tsakanin mabambantan gaɓar teku da ko madaidaicin hanyoyi ne kawai ake la'akari. Har ila yau, ciki har da sauye-sauye na tsayin daka, mafi guntuwar hanyar jigilar kayayyaki tsakanin Tekun Trieste na kasa da kasa da gabar da tekun Libya na Gulf of Sidra kusan kilomita 1,900 kilometres (1,200 mi) . Yanayin ruwa yana da sauƙi a cikin hunturu kuma yana dumi a lokacin rani kuma suna ba da suna ga nau'in yanayi na Mediterranean saboda yawancin hazo yana fadowa a cikin watanni masu sanyi. Gabashin ta na kudanci da gabas suna cike da hamada masu zafi da ba su da nisa a cikin kasa, amma gabar tekun nan da nan a dukkan bangarorin Tekun Bahar Rum na da nasaba da daidaita yanayin teku.


Tekun Bahar Rum

Tekun dai wata hanya ce mai muhimmanci ga 'yan kasuwa da matafiya na zamanin da, wanda ke saukaka kasuwanci da musayar al'adu tsakanin al'ummomin yankin. Tarihin yankin Bahar Rum yana da mahimmanci don fahimtar asali da ci gaban yawancin al'ummomin zamani. Daular Roma ta kasance tana da ikon mallakar ruwa a cikin teku tsawon ƙarni.

Ƙasashen da ke kewaye da Tekun Bahar Rum bisa agogon hannu su ne [Spain](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ispaniya "Ispaniya"), [Faransa](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Faransa "Faransa"), [Monaco](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Monaco "Monaco"), [Italiya](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Italiya "Italiya"), [Slovenia](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sloveniya "Sloveniya"), [Croatia](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kroatiya "Kroatiya"), [Bosnia and Herzegovina](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bosnia_da_Herzegovina "Bosnia da Herzegovina"), [Montenegro](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Montenegro "Montenegro"), [Albania](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Albaniya "Albaniya"), [Greece](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Girka_(%C6%99asa) "Girka (ƙasa)"), [Turkey](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Turkiyya "Turkiyya"), [Syria](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Siriya "Siriya"), [Lebanon](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lebanon "Lebanon"), [Israel](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Isra'ila "Isra'ila"), [Palestine](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/State_of_Palestine "State of Palestine"), [Egypt](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Misra "Misra"), [Libya](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Libya "Libya"), [Tunisia](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tunisiya "Tunisiya"), [Algeria](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Aljeriya "Aljeriya"), da kuma [Maroko](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Moroko "Moroko"); [Malta](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Malta "Malta") da [Cyprus](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cyprus "Cyprus") kasashe tsibiri ne a cikin teku. Bugu da ƙari, yankin [Arewacin Cyprus](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Arewacin_Cyprus "Arewacin Cyprus") da ake jayayya, da wasu abubuwan ban mamaki, musamman [Gibraltar](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gibraltar "Gibraltar") da Ceuta, suna da bakin teku a kan teku. [Iskandariya](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Alexandria "Alexandria") ita ce mafi girma mazaunin bakin teku. Ruwan magudanan ruwa ya ƙunshi wasu ƙasashe masu yawa, [kogin Nilu](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nil "Nil") shine kogin mafi tsayi da ke ƙarewa a Tekun Bahar Rum.

## Tarihi

[[gyara sashe](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Bahar_Rum&veaction=edit&section=1 "Gyara sashe: Tarihi") | [gyara masomin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Bahar_Rum&action=edit&section=1 "Edit section's source code: Tarihi")]

### Wayewar da

[[gyara sashe](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Bahar_Rum&veaction=edit&section=2 "Gyara sashe: Wayewar da") | [gyara masomin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Bahar_Rum&action=edit&section=2 "Edit section's source code: Wayewar da")]


 Girkanci (ja) da Phoenician (rawaya) mazauna a zamanin da c. karni na 6 BC


 Daular Roma a mafi nisa a cikin AD 117

Manyan tsoffin civilization sun kasance a kusa da Bahar Rum. Tekun ya ba da hanyoyin kasuwanci, mulkin mallaka, da yaƙi, da kuma abinci (daga kamun kifi da tattara sauran abincin teku) ga al'ummomi da yawa a tsawon shekaru.[[2]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bahar_Rum#cite_note-2)

Mafi shaharar wayewar Bahar Rum a zamanin da na gargajiya sune jihohin birnin Girka, Farisa da Phoenicians, waɗanda dukkansu suka mamaye gabar tekun Bahar Rum.

Darius I na Farisa, wanda ya ci Masar ta dā, ya gina magudanar ruwa da ke haɗa Tekun Bahar Rum da Bahar Maliya. Magudanar Dariyus tana da faɗin isa ga triremes biyu su wuce juna tare da tsawaita tsawaitawa, kuma yana buƙatar kwanaki huɗu don wucewa. [[3]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bahar_Rum#cite_note-3)

Daga baya, lokacin da [Augustus](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Augustus "Augustus") ya kafa daular Roma, Romawa suna kiran Bahar Rum a matsayin _Mare Nostrum_ ("Tekunmu"). A cikin shekaru 400 masu zuwa, Daular Roma ta mallaki Tekun Bahar Rum gaba ɗaya da kusan dukkan yankunan bakin teku daga Gibraltar zuwa Levant.[[4]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bahar_Rum#cite_note-4)

A cikin shekara ta 2019, ƙungiyar ƙwararrun kayan tarihi daga Cibiyar Binciken Ruwa ta Jami'ar Akdeniz (UA) ta bayyana wani hatsarin jirgin ruwa tun shekaru dubu uku da dari shida (3,600) a tekun Bahar Rum a [Turkiyya](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Turkiyya "Turkiyya"). Tan 1.5 na tagulla da aka samu a cikin jirgin an yi amfani da su wajen kimanta shekarunsa.

## Zamanin Tsakiya da Dauloli

[[gyara sashe](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Bahar_Rum&veaction=edit&section=3 "Gyara sashe: Zamanin Tsakiya da Dauloli") | [gyara masomin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Bahar_Rum&action=edit&section=3 "Edit section's source code: Zamanin Tsakiya da Dauloli")]

Daular Rum ta Yamma ta ruguje a kusan shekara ta 476 AD. Gabas ta sake zama mai iko yayin da ikon Romawa ya ci gaba da wanzuwa a Daular Byzantine da aka kafa a ƙarni na 4 daga gabashin rabin Daular Romawa. A wannan lokacin, wani iko ya taso a ƙarni na 7, kuma tare da shi addinin Musulunci, wanda nan da nan ya ratsa daga gabas; a mafi girman matakinsa, Larabawa, a ƙarƙashin Umayyawa, sun mallaki Yankin Iberian, suna yin sabon mataki na fasaha da al'adu a yankin.

Tashar jiragen ruwa da jiragen ruwa na Genoa a farkon ƙarni na 14, ta Quinto Cenni

An gabatar da nau'ikan abinci, kayan ƙanshi da amfanin gona iri-iri zuwa Spain da Sicily na yammacin Bahar Rum a lokacin mulkin Larabawa, ta hanyar hanyoyin kasuwanci na duniyar Musulunci. Waɗannan sun haɗa da rake, shinkafa, auduga, alfalfa, lemu, lemun tsami, apricots, alayyafo, eggplant, karas, saffron da ayaba. Larabawa sun ci gaba da noma da samar da man zaitun mai yawa (kalmomin Sifaniyanci na 'mai' da 'zaitun'—aceite da aceituna, bi da bi—an samo su ne daga al-zait na Larabci, ma'ana 'ruwan zaitun'),[43] da rumman (alamar heraldic ta Granada) daga zamanin Girka da Romawa na gargajiya.

Mamaye-mamayen Larabawa sun kawo cikas ga dangantakar kasuwanci tsakanin Yammacin Turai da Gabashin Turai yayin da suka kawo cikas ga hanyoyin kasuwanci da Daular Gabashin Asiya. Duk da haka, wannan ya haifar da tasirin da ba a kai tsaye ba na haɓaka ciniki a faɗin Tekun Caspian. An sake tura fitar da hatsi daga Masar zuwa duniyar Gabas. An ɗauki kayayyaki daga daular Gabashin Asiya, kamar siliki da kayan ƙanshi, daga Masar zuwa tashoshin jiragen ruwa kamar Venice da Constantinople ta hanyar matuƙan jiragen ruwa da 'yan kasuwa Yahudawa. Harin Viking ya ƙara kawo cikas ga cinikin yammacin Turai kuma ya dakatar da shi. Duk da haka, Norsemen sun haɓaka cinikin daga Norway zuwa White Sea, yayin da kuma suka yi ciniki da kayayyaki masu tsada daga Spain da Bahar Rum. Byzantines a tsakiyar ƙarni na 8 sun sake mallakar yankin da ke kewaye da yankin arewa maso gabashin Bahar Rum. Jiragen ruwan Venetian daga ƙarni na 9 sun yi amfani da makamai don magance cin zarafin da Larabawa ke yi musu yayin da suke mai da hankali kan cinikin kayayyakin Asiya a Venice.

Yaƙin Lepanto, 1571, ya ƙare da nasara ga Ƙungiyar Alfarma ta Turai a kan Turkawa ta Ottoman.

Fatimids sun ci gaba da hulɗar kasuwanci da biranen Italiya kamar Amalfi da Genoa kafin Yaƙin Crusades, a cewar takardun Cairo Geniza. Wata takarda mai kwanan wata 996 ta ambaci 'yan kasuwar Amalfian da ke zaune a Alkahira. Wata wasiƙa ta bayyana cewa Genoese sun yi ciniki da Alexandria. Khalifan al-Mustansir ya ba 'yan kasuwar Amalfian damar zama a Urushalima kimanin 1060 maimakon gidan kula da Latin.

Yaƙin Crusades ya haifar da bunƙasa ciniki tsakanin Turai da yankin da ke wajen ƙasar. Genoa, Venice da Pisa sun ƙirƙiri yankunan da 'yan Crusades ke iko da su kuma suka zo suka mallaki cinikin da ke tsakanin Gabas. Waɗannan yankunan kuma sun ba su damar yin ciniki da Gabas. Duk da cewa faɗuwar ƙasashen Crusades da yunƙurin hana hulɗa da ƙasashen Musulmi da Paparoma suka yi, sun kawo cikas ga cinikin da ke tsakanin Gabas na ɗan lokaci, duk da haka, ya ci gaba. Duk da haka, Turai ta fara farfaɗowa lokacin da aka sami tsakiyar ikon gwamnati a hankali a lokacin Renaissance na ƙarni na 12.

Rundunar sojojin Anglo-Holland ta kai hari kan Algiers don tallafawa wa'adin sakin bayin Turai, Agusta 1816

Ƙarfin Ottoman da ke Anatolia ya ci gaba da ƙaruwa, kuma a cikin 1453 ya kawar da Daular Byzantine tare da cin nasarar Constantinople. Hayreddin Barbarossa, kyaftin ɗin Ottoman alama ce ta wannan mamayar tare da nasarar Yaƙin Preveza (1538), wanda ya buɗe Tripoli da gabashin Bahar Rum ga mulkin Ottoman. Yayin da ƙarfin sojojin ruwa na ƙasashen Turai ya ƙaru, sun fuskanci faɗaɗa Ottoman a yankin lokacin da Yaƙin Lepanto (1571) ya lalata ƙarfin Sojojin Ruwa na Ottoman. Wannan shine yaƙin ruwa na ƙarshe da aka yi tsakanin jiragen ruwa.

'Yan fashin teku na Barbary na Arewa maso Yammacin Afirka sun yi farautar jiragen ruwa na Kirista da bakin teku a Tekun Bahar Rum ta Yamma. A cewar Robert Davis, daga ƙarni na 16 zuwa na 19, 'yan fashin teku sun kama Turawa miliyan 1 zuwa 1.25 a matsayin bayi.

Ci gaban jigilar jiragen ruwa a teku ya fara shafar dukkan Bahar Rum. A da, yawancin cinikin da ke tsakanin Yammacin Turai da Gabas yana ratsa yankin, amma bayan shekarun 1490, haɓaka hanyar teku zuwa Tekun Indiya ya ba da damar shigo da kayan ƙanshi na Asiya da sauran kayayyaki ta tashoshin jiragen ruwa na Atlantika na yammacin Turai.

# Faransanci

**Faransanci** (da Faransanci _français_; da Turanci _French_) [harshe](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Harshe "Harshe"), ne da keda asali daga ƙasar [Faransa](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Faransa "Faransa") kuma ya yadu ne a [duniya](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Duniya "Duniya") sakamakon shaharar da mutanen Faransa keda shi. # Jimmy Wales

**Jimmy Donal Wales** (**/ˈdʒɪmi ˈdoʊnəl weɪlz/**); (An haife shi ranar bakwai (7) ga watan Augustan shekara ta alif 1966) a garin [Huntsville](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Huntsville?action=edit&redlink=1 "Huntsville (babu wannan shafin)") da ke jihar [Alabama](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Alabama "Alabama") a Ƙasar [Amurka](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Amurika "Amurika"), yana zaune a [Landon](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Landon "Landon") da ke Ƙasar [Ingila](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ingila "Ingila"). ɗan kasuwar ƙasar Tarayyar Amurka ne.[[1]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jimmy_Wales#cite_note-1)[[2]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jimmy_Wales#cite_note-Date_of_birth-2) Jimmy Wales da [Larry Sanger](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Larry_Sanger "Larry Sanger") ne suka ƙirƙiri babbar manhajar [Wikipidiya](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia "Wikipedia") a shekara ta [2001](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/2001 "2001"). Ya yi karatu a Jami'ar Auburn da Jami'ar Jihar Alabama, Tuscaloosa inda ya samu shaidar digiri na biyu a Jami'ar jihar [Indiana](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Indiana "Indiana"), shahararren ɗan kasuwar yanar gizo ne, kuma yana da adadin kuɗi sama da dala miliyan daya ($1,000,000) a shekara ta dubu biyu da sha hudu (2014).

## Farkon rayuwa da karatu

[[gyara sashe](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Jimmy_Wales&veaction=edit&section=1 "Gyara sashe: Farkon rayuwa da karatu") | [gyara masomin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Jimmy_Wales&action=edit&section=1 "Edit section's source code: Farkon rayuwa da karatu")]

text:
# Gudunmuwa

**Gudunmuwa** Asalin Harshe Binciken farko dangane da asalin harshe an gudanar da shi ne bisa umarnin Fir’aunan Misra (Egypt) wanda ya yi zamani a qarni 7. Wannan Far’auna ya umarci bawansa da ya keve wasu tagwaye. Kalmar farko da suka fara furtawa ita ce ‘bekos’ wadda take nufin ‘mummuqi’ a harshen Phrygia da ake amfani da shi a yammacin Persia. Wannan sarki ya kuma yi iqirarin cewa, harshe Phrygia shi ne harshen asali wanda ragowar harsunan duniya suka samo asali daga gare shi. Wannan bincike yana da rauni. Har ila yau, sarkin Scotland ya gudanar da makamancin wannan bincike, inda ya ware wata bebiyar mace wanda ya haxa ta da qananan yara domin gano harshen asali. Wannan ya samar musu da duk wani abu na rayuwa wanda ya haxa da abinci, da ruwa, d s. Kalmar farko da suka fara furtawa a yayin da suka kai munzalin Magana ta fito ne daga harshen ‘Hebrew’. Don haka, wannan sarki shi ma ya yi iqirarin cewa, harshen Hebrew shi ne harshen da aka fara Magana da shi.

Ra’o’in Asalin Harshe.

Akwai ra’a’yoyi daban-daban wa’inda suka bayyana asalin harshe. A nan za mu yi qoqarin kawo wasu tare da bayyana rauninsu dangane da da’awarsu game da asalin harshe.

n Ra’i

1. Kalmomin amsa kama ba su da yawa a cikin harsuna. Hakazalika, kowane harshe yana da irin tasa hanyar da yake bayyana sautukan asali (natural sounds)

2. Har ila yau, wannan ra’i ya yi watsi da daya daga cikin siffofin harshen Dan-Adam – wato rashin alaqa tsakanin sauti da ma’anarsa.

Ra’in Pooh-Pooh Jean Jacquest R. ne ya samar da wannan ra’i a qarni na 18, inda ya yi iqirarin cewa, harshe ya samo asali ne sakamakon zafi ko haushi ko murna (instinctive emotional cries). Jean ya dogara ne bisa sautukan motsin rai kamar ‘ah!’ hey! d.s. wadanda harsunan duniya ke amfani da su.

Rauni Ra’i

1. Rashin yawan sautukan motsin-rai a harsuna. b. Ajiyar zuciya da sauran sautukan motsin rai ba su da alaqa da baqi da wasali da ake samu a tsarin sauti. Ra’in Ishara Wannan ra’i ya yi da’awar cewa, harshe ya samu ne daga isharori. Babbar hujjar da wannan ra’i ya dogara da ita, ita ce masu amfani da harsuna daban-daban na amfani da isharori a-kai-a-kai a cikin maganganunsu. Misali, mabaraci mai jin yunwa na yin ishara ta hanyar taba bakinsa da shafa cikinsa domin nuna halin da yake ciki na yunwa. Ta irin wannan hanya ce wannan ra’i yake ganin mutanen farko suke sadarwa a tsakaninsu. Raunin Ra’i a. Wannan ra’i ya kasa nuna yadda ishara ta zama harshe Daga qarshe, duk da raunin wannan ra’i, masana na ganin wannan ra’i ya fi ragowar ra’a’yoyi kama da gaskiya dangane da asalin harshe.

# Auth.wikimedia.org

A halin yanzu babu muƙala akan wannan shafin, zaku iya **[binciko wannan shafin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Musamman:Search/Auth.wikimedia.org "Musamman:Search/Auth.wikimedia.org")** a cikin Hausa Wikipedia ko ku [bincika jadawalin ayyuka](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Musamman:Log&page=Auth.wikimedia.org). "Fassara")26 Satumba 2003 Duk alamun tambarin guda uku da Nupedia yayi amfani dasu. An yi amfani da tambari na farko daga Maris zuwa Agusta 2000, na biyu daga Agusta 2000 zuwa Fabrairu 2001, kuma na uku daga Fabrairu 2001 zuwa Satumba 2003. misalin mukalun nupedia tsohon tambarin nupedia **Nupedia** yaren Ingilishi ne, [encyclopedia na](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Insakulofidiya "Insakulofidiya") yanar gizo wanda masu ba da gudummawa suka rubuta labaransu tare da ƙwarewar batun da ya dace, ƙwararrun editoci suka duba su kafin a wallafa su, kuma a basu lasisi azaman abun ciki kyauta . [Jimmy Wales](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jimmy_Wales "Jimmy Wales") ne ya kafa ta kuma [Bomis](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bomis "en:Bomis") ya kirkira ta, tare da [Larry Sanger](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Larry_Sanger "Larry Sanger") a matsayin babban edita. Nupedia yayi aiki daga watan Oktobar 1999[[1]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nupedia#cite_note-1)[[2]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nupedia#cite_note-hive2-2)har zuwa Satan Satumbar 2003. Mafi shahararren sananne a yau shine magabacin [Wikipedia](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia "Wikipedia"), amma Nupedia yana da tsari na yarda da matakai guda bakwai don sarrafa abubuwan cikin labarai kafin a sanya shi, maimakon rayayyar sabunta [wiki](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wiki "en:Wiki"). Nupedia ya tsara wata kwamiti, tare da masana don tsara dokokin, kuma ta amince da abubuwa 21 ne kawai a cikin shekarar farko, idan aka kwatanta da Wikipedia da take sanya labarai 200 a watan farko, da 18,000 a shekarar farko.[[3]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nupedia#cite_note-SangerMemoir2-3) Ba kamar Wikipedia ba, Nupedia ba wiki bane; a maimakon haka ya kasance yana da kyakkyawan tsarin sake duba takwarorinmu, wanda aka tsara shi don sanya kayan aikinta masu inganci kwatankwacin na ƙwararrun masana ƙwararru. Nupedia ya bukaci malamai (daidai da PhD) don ba da gudummawar abubuwan ciki. [[4]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nupedia#cite_note-thewikipediarevolution382-4) Kafin ta daina aiki, Nupedia ta samar da kasidu guda 25 da aka yarda dasu [[5]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nupedia#cite_note-5) wadanda suka kammala aikin binciken su (labaran guda uku sun wanzu a siga iri biyu daban daban) kuma akwai wasu labarai guda 150 da suke kan aiki. [[6]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nupedia#cite_note-6) Wales ta fi son sauƙin Wikipedia ta sauƙaƙan labarai, yayin da Sanger ya gwammace tsarin duban da Nupedia ya yi amfani da shi [[7]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nupedia#cite_note-SangerMemoir3-7) kuma daga baya ya kafa [Citizendium](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Citizendium "en:Citizendium") a 2006 a matsayin ƙwararren masanin da aka sake dubawa zuwa Wikipedia. [[8]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nupedia#cite_note-8) A watan Yunin shekarar 2008, [CNET](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/CNET "en:CNET") UK sun jera Nupedia a matsayin ɗayan manyan rukunin yanar gizon da ba su da kyau a cikin karamin [history of the Internet](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/History_of_the_Internet "en:History of the Internet"), , tare da lura da yadda tsananin iko ya iyakance aika bayanan.[[9]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nupedia#cite_note-9) ## Tarihi [[gyara sashe](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Nupedia&veaction=edit§ion=1 "Gyara sashe: Tarihi") | [gyara masomin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Nupedia&action=edit§ion=1 "Edit section's source code: Tarihi")] A watan Oktoba shekarar 1999,[[10]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nupedia#cite_note-10) Jimmy Wales ya fara tunani game da kundin encyclopedia na intanet wanda masu sa kai suka gina kuma, a cikin watan Janairu shekarar 2000, ya ɗauki Larry Sanger don kula da ci gabanta. [[11]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nupedia#cite_note-hive3-11) Aikin ya tafi kan layi bisa hukuma a ranar 9 ga watan Maris, 2000. [[12]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nupedia#cite_note-Liane_Gouthro2-12) A watan Nuwamba na 2000, duk da haka, an buga takardu masu tsayi guda biyu.[[13]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nupedia#cite_note-idg2-13) Tun daga farkonta, Nupedia kyauta ne na kayan kyauta,[[14]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nupedia#cite_note-Liane_Gouthro3-14) tare da Bomis da nufin samar da kudaden shiga daga tallace-tallacen kan layi akan Nupedia.com.[[15]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nupedia#cite_note-idg3-15) Da farko aikin ya yi amfani da lasisin gida, Nupedia Open Content License. A watan Janairun 2001, ta sauya zuwa lasisin samun takardu na kyauta na GNU bisa roƙon [Richard Stallman](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Richard_Stallman "en:Richard Stallman") da [Free Software Foundation](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Free_Software_Foundation "en:Free Software Foundation").[[16]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nupedia#cite_note-16) Hakanan a cikin watan Janairu shekarar 2001, Nupedia ya fara [Wikipedia](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia "Wikipedia") a matsayin aiki na gefe don ba da damar haɗin kai a kan labarai kafin shiga cikin tsarin duba abokan. [[17]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nupedia#cite_note-17) Wannan ya jawo hankulan bangarorin biyu, saboda hakan ya samar da tsarin tsarin mulki wanda yafi dacewa da masu ra'ayin [GNE encyclopedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/GNE_(encyclopedia) "en:GNE (encyclopedia)"). Sakamakon haka ne, GNE bai taɓa haɓaka ba da gaske, kuma an kawar da barazanar gasa tsakanin ayyukan. Yayinda Wikipedia ke bunkasa da kuma jan hankalin masu bayar da gudummawa, nan take ta bunkasa rayuwa ta kashin kanta kuma ta fara gudanar da ayyukanta ba tare da Nupedia ba, kodayake Sanger da farko ya jagoranci aiki a Wikipedia ta hanyar amatsayinsa na babban editan Nupedia. Baya ga haifar da dakatar da aikin GNE, Wikipedia ya haifar da mutuwar Nupedia a hankali. Sakamakon durkushewar tattalin arzikin intanet a wancan lokacin, Jimmy Wales ya yanke shawarar daina bayar da tallafi ga babban edita mai karbar albashi a watan Disambar 2001,[[18]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nupedia#cite_note-hive4-18) kuma Sanger ya yi murabus daga ayyukan biyu jim kadan bayan haka.[[19]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nupedia#cite_note-19) Bayan tafiyar Sanger, Nupedia ya zama abin da Wikipedia za ta yi tunani akai; na labaran Nupedia da suka kammala aikin bita, biyu ne kawai suka yi hakan bayan 2001. Yayin da Nupedia ya ragu cikin rashin aiki, to tunanin sauya shi zuwa ingantaccen sigar abubuwan Wikipedia da aka amince da su lokaci-lokaci ana warware su, amma ba a aiwatar da su ba. An rufe gidan yanar gizon Nupedia.com ne a ranar 26 ga watan Satumba, 2003.[[20]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nupedia#cite_note-20) Nupedia ta encyclopedic abun ciki, wanda galibi aka bayyana shi da iyakantacce, tun daga lokacin aka shiga cikin Wikipedia. ## Tsarin edita [[gyara sashe](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Nupedia&veaction=edit§ion=2 "Gyara sashe: Tsarin edita") | [gyara masomin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Nupedia&action=edit§ion=2 "Edit section's source code: Tsarin edita")] Misali na labarin Nupedia akan zamanin gargajiya na kiɗa . Nupedia yana da tsarin edita mai matakai bakwai, wanda ya kunshi: 1. Sanyawa 2. Neman mai bibiyar jagora 3. Gudanar da bita 4. Bude bita 5. Gubar kwafa 6. Bude kwafe 7. Approvalarshe yarda da alama Authors aka sa ran samun gwani ilmi (ko da yake da definition gwani a yarda a gare wani mataki na sassauci, kuma an yarda cewa wasu articles za a iya rubuta da mai kyau marubuci, maimakon wani gwani _da se)_[[21]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nupedia#cite_note-21), kuma masu gyara approving articles don ana tsammanin bugawa "ya zama gwanaye na gaske a fannoninsu kuma (tare da 'yan kaɗan) [su] mallaki PhD". [[22]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nupedia#cite_note-NupediaEditor2-22) Ruth Ifcher wani mutum ne Sanger ya dogara kuma yayi aiki tare tare da manufofin Nupedia da hanyoyin farko. Ifcher, yana riƙe da digiri mafi girma, ya kasance mai shirye-shiryen kwamfuta kuma tsohon editan kwafi kuma ya yarda ya zama babban editan kwafin sa kai.[[23]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nupedia#cite_note-23) ## Ci gaban software [[gyara sashe](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Nupedia&veaction=edit§ion=3 "Gyara sashe: Ci gaban software") | [gyara masomin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Nupedia&action=edit§ion=3 "Edit section's source code: Ci gaban software")] Nupedia ya sami karbuwa daga software na haɗin gwiwar NupeCode. NupeCode kyauta ce / buɗaɗɗen software (wanda aka saki a ƙarƙashin [GNU General Public License](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/GNU_General_Public_License "en:GNU General Public License")) an tsara shi don manyan ayyukan nazarin ƙwararru . An samo lambar ta hanyar wurin ajiyar [CVS](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Concurrent_Versions_System "en:Concurrent Versions System") na Nupedia. Daya daga cikin matsalolin da Nupedia ya fuskanta a tsawon rayuwarsa shine cewa software bata aiki. Yawancin ayyukan da aka ɓata an yi izgili da su ta amfani da tubalin rubutu da aka ja layi a ƙarƙashinsu wanda ya zama alamun haɗi, amma a zahiri ba haka bane. A zaman wani ɓangare na aikin, sabon sigar asalin software (wanda ake kira "NuNupedia") yana kan ci gaba. An aiwatar da NuNupedia don gwaji a [SourceForge](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/SourceForge "en:SourceForge"), amma bai taɓa isa matakin ci gaba don maye gurbin asalin software ba.[[24]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nupedia#cite_note-24) ## Duba kuma [[gyara sashe](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Nupedia&veaction=edit§ion=4 "Gyara sashe: Duba kuma") | [gyara masomin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Nupedia&action=edit§ion=4 "Edit section's source code: Duba kuma")] * Jerin kundin bayanan yanar gizo * Jerin wikis * Scholarpedia * Wikipedia:Nupedia and Wikipedia §An kwashe labaran zuwa Wikipedia ## Manazarta [[gyara sashe](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Nupedia&veaction=edit§ion=5 "Gyara sashe: Manazarta") | [gyara masomin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Nupedia&action=edit§ion=5 "Edit section's source code: Manazarta")] 1. text:
# Allah

**Allah**, **Ubangiji**, **Mahalicci**, Larabci: **الله**, turanci _**God**_, Allāh suna ne na **Abin Bauta** a addinin [musulunci](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Musulunci "Musulunci"), da wasu [addinai](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Addinai?action=edit&redlink=1 "Addinai (babu wannan shafin)"), ansamo sunan ne daga [Larabci](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Larabci "Larabci") inda ya maye kalmar da ake amfani da ita na Ubangiji. a harshen [Hausa.](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hausawa "Hausawa")

**Allah** shi ne ubangiji makadaici wanda yahalicci [sammai](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sama "Sama") (bakwai ) da [kassai](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kasa "Kasa") (bakwai ), da duk abunda ke cikin duniya baki daya, mutum da aljannu da dabbobi da kwari da kuma tsuntsaye baki daya kuma shine wanda keda iko akan komai da kowa.[[1]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Allah#cite_note-1)

# Turanci


turawan Finafo


rubutattace



Tarihin turanci

[[1]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Turanci#cite_note-1)[[2]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Turanci#cite_note-2)**Turanci:**[Harshe](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Harshe "Harshe") ne kuma yana daga cikin harsunan da ake amfani da su a nahiyar [turai](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Turai "Turai") da ƙasashen dake yammacin [duniya](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Duniya "Duniya"), wato nahiyar [Amurka](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Amurika "Amurika") ta Arewa, shi ne yare na biyu mafi yawan ma su magana a faɗin duniya.[[3]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Turanci#cite_note-3)[[4]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Turanci#cite_note-4)[[5]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Turanci#cite_note-5)[[6]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Turanci#cite_note-6)

Turanci na ɗaya daga cikin yaren da ya kewaye duniya saboda kusan duk inda kaje a duniya kusan sai ka samu masu jin Turanci, a Turance ana kiran shi da (global language).[[7]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Turanci#cite_note-7)[[8]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Turanci#cite_note-8)[[9]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Turanci#cite_note-9)[[10]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Turanci#cite_note-10)[[11]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Turanci#cite_note-11)

Turanci shi ne harshen majalisar ɗinkin duniya (MDIngiladkuma wasu ƙasashen da Ƙasar Ingila ta yi wa mulkin mallaka, misali: [Najeriya](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Najeriya "Najeriya") da [Gana](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ghana "Ghana") da [Indiya](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Indiya "Indiya") da sauran ƙasashen rainon [Ingila](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ingila "Ingila").[[12]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Turanci#cite_note-12)[[13]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Turanci#cite_note-13)

title: Adanlma Njaay
text:
# Adanlma Njaay

**Adama Amanda Ndiaye** 'yar kasar Senegal ce Mai tsara kayan ado. Har ila yau, tana da sunan **Adama Paris**, wanda kuma shine sunan lakabi da take da shi kuma tana aiki. Ana iya samun sassanta, waɗanda aka ƙera a [Maroko](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Moroko "Moroko"), a duniya, gami da [Birnin New York](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/New_York_(birni) "New York (birni)"), [Tokyo](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tokyo "Tokyo"), [Landan](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Landan "Landan") da [Paris](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Faris "Faris"). An yaba mata da fara Black Fashion Week .

## Rayuwa

[[gyara sashe](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Adanlma_Njaay&veaction=edit&section=1 "Gyara sashe: Rayuwa") | [gyara masomin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Adanlma_Njaay&action=edit&section=1 "Edit section's source code: Rayuwa")]

Ndiaye an haife ta ne a [Kinshasa](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kinshasa "Kinshasa"), Zaire kuma ta fito ne daga asalin Senegal, [[1]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Adanlma_Njaay#cite_note-webbio-1) sannan ta girma a Turai, inda iyayenta suka kasance diflomasiyya. Ta bar aikin banki a Turai don neman ƙirar kayan kwalliya a ƙasarta ta asali. Afirka tana da dogon tarihi na ƙira amma tana fama da rashin karɓuwa ga jama'a, kuma tara jari ga kasuwancinta abu ne mai wahala. Domin faɗaɗa hangen nesa na ƙirar Afirka, Ndiaye ta ƙirƙiri Dakar Fashion Week.[[2]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Adanlma_Njaay#cite_note-vogueit-2) A shekara ta 2012, shekara ta goma ta wasan kwaikwayon, ya ja hankalin masu zanen kaya talatin daga kasashe tara a Afirka da Asiya, tare da masu sauraro da ke fitowa daga ko'ina cikin duniya, kuma yana da kasafin kudin aiki sama da CFA miliyan 80 (kimanin US $ 150,000). [[3]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Adanlma_Njaay#cite_note-3) Ta kuma shirya abubuwan Black Fashion Week a [Prague](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Prag "Prag"), Jamhuriyar Czech, da Bahia, Brazil.[[4]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Adanlma_Njaay#cite_note-4)[[5]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Adanlma_Njaay#cite_note-bbc-5)

Zane-zanenta sun samo asali ne daga birane da kuma tsarin duniya baki ɗaya. A wata hira da ta yi da Vogue Italia, ta ce, "Yawancin abin da na kwadaitar da shi ya fito ne daga manyan birane... Manufara ita ce kuma har yanzu ina raba wa dukkan mata na zamani salon zamani ba tare da iyaka ba."[[2]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Adanlma_Njaay#cite_note-vogueit-2)

Ndaiye ya lura cewa a tsakanin kasashe da yawa na Afirka, rashin amincewa da addini ya sa masu zanen kaya ba su iya yin aikin su ba. Ta yaba wa al'adun haƙuri na Senegal don samar da yanayin tallafi.[[5]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Adanlma_Njaay#cite_note-bbc-5) Ta kuma yi magana, tare da wasu masu zanen Afirka, don kara kudade da samun damar samun bashi daga gwamnatoci don inganta kirkire-kirkire da samar da aiki a masana'antar kayan ado.[[6]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Adanlma_Njaay#cite_note-6)

title: Kongo Basin
text:
# Kongo Basin

Dajin da ke cikin Tekun Kwango shi ne dajin mafi girma a Afirka kuma na biyu a girman dajin Amazon, inda yake da hekta miliyan 300 idan aka kwatanta da hekta miliyan 800 na Amazon.[[2]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kongo_Basin#cite_note-2) Saboda girmansa da bambancinsa, ƙwararru da yawa sun siffanta dajin dajin da ke da mahimmanci don rage sauyin yanayi saboda rawar da yake takawa a matsayin sinadari na carbon. [[3]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kongo_Basin#cite_note-3) Duk da haka, sare gandun daji da lalatar halittu ta hanyar tasirin sauyin yanayi na iya ƙara damuwa a kan yanayin dajin, wanda hakan zai sa yanayin yanayin ruwa ya zama mai canzawa. [[4]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kongo_Basin#cite_note-4) Wani bincike na shekarar 2012 ya gano cewa bambancin hazo da sauyin yanayi ke haifarwa zai yi mummunan tasiri ga ayyukan tattalin arziki a cikin kwandon shara.

Rubuce-rubuce takwas na Basin Kongo an rubuta su a cikin jerin abubuwan tarihi na duniya, biyar kuma suna cikin jerin abubuwan tarihi na duniya a cikin haɗari (dukansu biyar suna cikin [Jamhuriyar Demokradiyyar Kongo](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jamhuriyar_Dimokura%C9%97iyyar_Kwango "Jamhuriyar Dimokuraɗiyyar Kwango")). Kashi 14 cikin 100 na gandun dajin danshi an keɓe shi a matsayin kariya.[[5]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kongo_Basin#cite_note-5)

## Ilimin Ƙasa

[[gyara sashe](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Kongo_Basin&veaction=edit&section=1 "Gyara sashe: Ilimin Ƙasa") | [gyara masomin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Kongo_Basin&action=edit&section=1 "Edit section's source code: Ilimin Ƙasa")]

Basin na Kongo wani babban rami ne a cikin Congo Craton, wanda ya ƙunshi duwatsu na zamani (Phanerozoic, musamman daga Mesozoic zuwa yanzu) a cikin tsohon ɓangaren ƙasa mai shekaru Archean. Lalacewar Craton ta fara tun daga ƙarshen Cambrian ko farkon Ordovician, ta ci gaba a lokacin Paleozoic, inda aka samu gagarumin lalacewa da kuma unconformity. Sediment ya fara taruwa cikin sauri daga Mesozoic (Triassic) har zuwa yau.[[6]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kongo_Basin#cite_note-:3-6)

A lokacin Jurassic, akwai tafkin ruwan ɗanɗano a cikin Basin, wanda ya ci gaba har zuwa farkon Cretaceous. Daga ƙarshen Cretaceous, haɗin gwiwa da Trans-Saharan seaway ya kawo shigar ruwan teku, wanda ya haɗa Tekun Atlantika da Tekun Tethys. Wannan ya samar da tarin fossils na pollen, ƙananan halittu, da kifaye. A lokacin Cretaceous, bututun kimberlite sun bayyana, wanda ake ganin ya samo asali daga raguwar saurin seafloor spreading na Mid-Atlantic Ridge, kuma su ne tushen lu’ulu’u na yankin.[[6]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kongo_Basin#cite_note-:3-6)[[7]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kongo_Basin#cite_note-7)[[8]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kongo_Basin#cite_note-8)

A lokacin Cenozoic, tudu a gefen Cuvette Centrale ya katse haɗin teku. A Paleogene, ruwan sama mai yawa ya mai da Basin wurin tabkuna da fadamomi. A Neogene, yanayi ya koma bushewa da fari na lokaci-lokaci, amma daga baya ya dawo da yanayin ruwa mai yawa ta hanyar fluvial deposits.[[6]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kongo_Basin#cite_note-:3-6)

Waɗannan su ne manyan tsarin sedimentary da aka samu a Basin:[[6]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kongo_Basin#cite_note-:3-6)

*   Carboniferous/Permian na ƙarshe - Lukuga Formation (Lower Karoo)
*   Triassic na farko zuwa Jurassic na farko - Haute Lueki Formation (Upper Karoo)
*   Jurassic na ƙarshe - Stanleyville Formation
*   Cretaceous na farko - Loia Formation, Kamina Series
*   Cretaceous na ƙarshe - Bokungu Formation, Kwango Series (Nsele Group, Inzia Group)
*   Paleogene - Kwango Formation, Kalahari System, Sables Bateke Series
*   Neogene - Limons Series, Kalahari System, Sables Bateke Series

## Bayani

[[gyara sashe](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Kongo_Basin&veaction=edit&section=2 "Gyara sashe: Bayani") | [gyara masomin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Kongo_Basin&action=edit&section=2 "Edit section's source code: Bayani")]


Hanyar kwarara da kwararon ruwan Kogin Kongo tare da kasashen da aka nuna

Kongo suna ne na gargajiya ga tsakiyar Afirka ta tsakiyar layin hie (equatorial Middle Africa) wacce ke tsakanin Tekun Guinea da Manyan Tabkunan Afirka. Kwararon yana farawa ne a cikin tuddai na tsarin East African Rift tare da shigar ruwa daga kogunan Chambeshi, Uele da Ubangi a sassan sama da kuma Kogin Lualaba mai shayar da wuraren dausayi a sassan tsakiya. Saboda ƙanƙantar shekaru da kuma hauhawa mai ƙarfi na East African Rift a madogaran ruwan, nauyin daskarewar abubuwa na shekara-shekara na kogin yana da girma sosai, amma kwararon ruwan (drainage basin) ya mamaye manyan yankuna masu ƙarancin tuddai a kusan dukkan fadin yankinsa.[[9]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kongo_Basin#cite_note-McDonald2005-9) An siffanta shi galibi ta hanyar tuddai na geological swells ciki har da Bie, Mayumbe, Adamlia, Nile-Congo, East African, da Zambian Swells.[[10]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kongo_Basin#cite_note-10)


Mutanen Isangi suna rayuwa a kan Kogin Kongo

Kwararon yana ƙarewa ne a inda kogin yake ɓonewa cikin Tekun Guinea a kan Tekun Atlantika. Kwararon yana da jimillar fadin kilomita murabba'i miliyan 3.7 kuma gida ne ga wasu manyan dazuzzukan ruwan sama na wurare masu zafi (tropical rainforest) da ba a taɓa su ba a duniyar nan, baya ga manyan wuraren dausayi.

Kasashen da ke cikin yankin Kongo gaba daya ko a sashi:

*   [Angola](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Angola "Angola")
*   [Gabon](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gabon "Gabon")
*   [Burundi](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Burundi "Burundi")
*   [Kamaru](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kamaru "Kamaru")
*   [Jamhuriyar Afirka ta Tsakiya](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Afirka_ta_Tsakiya_(%C6%99asa) "Afirka ta Tsakiya (ƙasa)")
*   [Jamhuriyar Demokradiyyar Kongo](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jamhuriyar_Dimokura%C9%97iyyar_Kwango "Jamhuriyar Dimokuraɗiyyar Kwango")
*   [Jamhuriyar Kwango](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jamhuriyar_Kwango "Jamhuriyar Kwango")
*   [Rwanda](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rwanda "Rwanda")
*   [Tanzaniya](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tanzaniya "Tanzaniya")
*   [Zambiya](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Zambiya "Zambiya")

## Tarihi

[[gyara sashe](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Kongo_Basin&veaction=edit&section=3 "Gyara sashe: Tarihi") | [gyara masomin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Kongo_Basin&action=edit&section=3 "Edit section's source code: Tarihi")]

Mazauna farko na yankin Kwararon Kongo an yi amanna cewa pygmies ne, kuma a wancan lokacin, duku-dukun dazuzzuka da yanayi mai raddah na ruwa sun sa yawan jama'ar yankin ya kasance kaɗan, tare da hana haɓakar al'ummar masu farauta da masu taro (hunter-gatherer), waɗanda ragowar al'adarsu ta tsira har zuwa yau. Daga baya mutanen Bantu suka yi ƙaura zuwa wurin kuma suka kafa Daular Kongo (Kingdom of Kongo).

Bélgiyum, Faransa, da Portugal daga baya sun kafa ikon mulkin mallaka a kan dukkan yankin a ƙarshen ƙarni na 19. Babban Dokar Taron Berlin (Berlin Conference) na 1885 ta ba da takaitaccen ma'ana ga "kwararon al'ada" na Kongo, wanda ya haɗa da dukkan ainihin kwararon da wasu sauran yankuna. Babban Dokar ta tilasta wa waɗanda suka sanya hannu su kasance tsaka-tsaki a cikin kwararon al'ada, amma ba a girmama wannan ba a lokacin Yaƙin Duniya na Ɗaya.


Taswirar Kwararon Kongo na Al'ada

Cibiyar Albarkatun Duniya (World Resources Institute) ta kiyasta cewa mutane miliyan 80 ne ke zaune a ciki da kuma kewayen Kwararon Kongo.[[11]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kongo_Basin#cite_note-:0-11)


Masu farauta da taro na Pygmy a Jamhuriyar Afirka ta Tsakiya.

## Shuke-shuke da Dabbobi

[[gyara sashe](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Kongo_Basin&veaction=edit&section=4 "Gyara sashe: Shuke-shuke da Dabbobi") | [gyara masomin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Kongo_Basin&action=edit&section=4 "Edit section's source code: Shuke-shuke da Dabbobi")]

Dajin Kongo gida ne ga okapi, giwar dajin Afirka, dorinar ruwa ta pygmy, bongo (barewa), chimpanzee, bonobo da jiminar Kongo (Congo peafowl). Babban dabbar daji mai cin nama a wurin ita ce damisa (leopard), wacce ta fi na takwarorinsu na daji girma saboda rashin gasa daga sauran manyan dabbobi masu cin nama. Kwararon gida ne ga gorilla ta yammacin ƙasa (western lowland gorilla) mai fuskantar haɗarin karewa. A shekara ta 2010, Shirin Muhalli na Majalisar Ɗinkin Duniya ya yi gargaɗin cewa gorilla na iya karewa daga babban Kwararon Kongo a cikin tsawon shekaru 15.

*   [![Image 14: Gorilla ta yammacin kasa](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/3/36/Gorilla_gorilla04.jpg/250px-Gorilla_gorilla04.jpg?utm_source=ha.wikipedia.org&utm_campaign=parser&utm_content=thumbnail)](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fayil:Gorilla_gorilla04.jpg "Gorilla ta yammacin kasa") Gorilla ta yammacin kasa 
*   [![Image 15: Giwar dajin Afirka](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/f/f3/Loxodontacyclotis.jpg/250px-Loxodontacyclotis.jpg?utm_source=ha.wikipedia.org&utm_campaign=parser&utm_content=thumbnail)](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fayil:Loxodontacyclotis.jpg "Giwar dajin Afirka") Giwar dajin Afirka 


Dajin Ruwan Sama na Ituri

Kwararon Kongo shine daji mafi girma a Afirka. Fiye da nau'ikan shuke-shuke 10,000 ne ake iya samun su a ciki da kewaye dajin.[[11]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kongo_Basin#cite_note-:0-11) Dazuzzukan masu raddah sun mamaye kilomita murabba'i miliyan 1.6.[[12]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kongo_Basin#cite_note-:1-12) Kwararon Kongo wata muhimmiyar hanya ce ta samun katako na teak na Afirka, wanda ake amfani da shi wajen gina kayan daki da shimfiɗar ƙasa. Kimanin mutane miliyan 40 ne suka dogara da waɗannan dazuzzukan, suna rayuwa a kan hanyoyin rayuwa na gargajiya.

## Muhalli da Kariya

[[gyara sashe](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Kongo_Basin&veaction=edit&section=5 "Gyara sashe: Muhalli da Kariya") | [gyara masomin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Kongo_Basin&action=edit&section=5 "Edit section's source code: Muhalli da Kariya")]

A matakin duniya, dazuzzukan Kongo suna aiki ne azaman huhu na biyu na duniya, takwaran dajin Amazon da ke saurin raguwa. Su babban "ma'ajiyar carbon" (carbon sink) ne, suna kama carbon wanda in ba haka ba zai iya kasancewa carbon dioxide. Kwararon Kongo yana ɗauke da kusan kashi 8% na carbon da ke cikin dazuzzukan duniya. Duk da wannan mahimmancin, yana samun ƙarancin kulawar kimiyya idan aka kwatanta da Amazon ko dazuzzukan wurare masu zafi na Kudu maso Gabashin Asiya.[[13]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kongo_Basin#cite_note-13) Idan aka sare waɗannan dazuzzukan, carbon ɗin da suka kama za a sake shi cikin sararin samaniya. Hasashe na sare dazuzzuka na gaba ba tare da tsayawa ba ya kiyasta cewa nan da shekara ta 2050 ayyuka a Jamhuriyar Demokradiyyar Kongo zasu saki kusan adadin carbon dioxide ɗaya da wanda Burtaniya ta fitar a cikin shekaru 60 da suka gabata. Wani bincike da masana kimiyya na Burtaniya suka yi a shekarar 2013 ya nuna cewa sare dazuzzuka a cikin dajin ruwan sama na Kwararon Kongo yana raguwa.[[14]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kongo_Basin#cite_note-14) A cikin 2017, masana kimiyya na Burtaniya sun gano cewa wuraren dausayi na peatlands a cikin Cuvette Centrale, waɗanda suka mamaye jimillar murabba'i 145,500, suna ɗauke da tan biliyan 30 na carbon, ko kuma daidai da shekaru 20 na hayakin man fetur na Amurka.[[15]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kongo_Basin#cite_note-15)[[16]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kongo_Basin#cite_note-16) A cikin 2021, adadin sare dazuzzuka na dajin Kongo ya ƙaru da kashi 5%.[[17]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kongo_Basin#cite_note-17)


Aikin sare bishiyoyi na masana'antu a Kwararon Kongo. Daga 2015 zuwa 2019, adadin sare dazuzzuka a Jamhuriyar Demokradiyyar Kongo ya ninka sau biyu.[[18]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kongo_Basin#cite_note-18)

Global Forest Atlas ta kiyasta cewa masana'antar katako ta mamaye hekta miliyan 44 zuwa 66 na daji.[[11]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kongo_Basin#cite_note-:0-11) Wani bincike da aka buga a shekarar 2019 a cikin Nature Sustainability ya nuna cewa an gina hanyoyi na tsawon mil 54,000 don izinin daji tsakanin 2003 da 2018, wanda ya kai jimillar mil 143,500.[[19]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kongo_Basin#cite_note-19) An amince da dakatar da sare bishiyoyi a dajin Kongo tsakanin Bankin Duniya da Jamhuriyar Demokradiyyar Kongo a watan Mayun 2002. Bankin Duniya ya amince ya samar da dala miliyan 90 na tallafin ci gaba ga Jamhuriyar Demokradiyyar Kongo tare da sharadin cewa gwamnati ba za ta bayar da wani sabon izini ga kamfanonin katako don cin gajiyar dajin ba. Yarjejeniyar ta kuma haramta sabunta izinin da ake da su a halin yanzu.[[20]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kongo_Basin#cite_note-20)

Gwamnati ta rubuta sabuwar dokar daji wacce ke buƙatar kamfanoni su saka hannun jari a cikin ci gaban gida da kuma bin tsarin daidaitawa na shekaru 25 na sare bishiyoyi ta hanyar jujjuyawa. Lokacin da aka ba kamfani izini daga gwamnatin tsakiya don yin katako a Kongo, dole ne ya sanya hannu kan yarjejeniya da sarakunan gida da masu mallakar filaye na gado, waɗanda ke ba da izinin cire bishiyoyin don musanya da kayan tallafin ci gaba. A ka'ida, dole ne kamfanonin su biya gwamnati kusan hayar dala miliyan 18 a kowace shekara don waɗannan izinin, wanda ya kamata a mayar da kashi 40% ga gwamnatocin jihohi don saka hannun jari a ci gaban zamantakewar al'ummar gari a wuraren da aka sare bishiyoyin.

A cikin tsarinta na yanzu, Yarjejeniyar Kyoto (Kyoto Protocol) ba ta ba da lada ga abin da ake kira "guji sare dazuzzuka"—tsare-tsaren da ke kare daji daga sarewa. Amma masana kimiyyar yanayi da yawa da masu tsara manufofi suna fatan cewa tattaunawa don mai gurbin Kyoto zai haɗa da irin waɗannan matakan. Idan haka ne, za a iya samun kwarin gwiwa na kudi don kare dazuzzuka. L’Île Mbiye, wani tsibiri ne a cikin Kogin Lualaba a Kisangani, yana cikin wani aiki game da kiyaye tsarin halittun daji, wanda Jami'ar Stellenbosch ke gudanarwa. Jamhuriyar Demokradiyyar Kongo kuma tana neman faɗaɗa yankin daji da ke ƙarƙashin kariya, wanda take fatan samun diyya ta hanyar kasuwanni masu tasowa (emerging markets) don carbon na daji. Babban kungiyar muhalli ta Kongo da ke aiki don ceton dazuzzuka ita ce wata kungiya mai zaman kanta (NGO) mai suna OCEAN, wacce ke aiki azaman hanyar haɗi tsakanin ƙungiyoyin ƙasa da ƙasa kamar Greenpeace da ƙungiyoyin al'ummomin gida a cikin yankunan da aka ba da izini.

# Nijar (ƙasa)


Niger, Niamey, Place du Liptako-Gourma


Tutan nijar


**Nijar ko Nijer**[[1]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nijar_(%C6%99asa)#cite_note-1)[[2]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nijar_(%C6%99asa)#cite_note-2) ƙasa ce da ke yankin [Afrika](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Afrika "Afrika") ta Yamma. Tana maƙwabtaka da ƙasashe bakwai ([Najeriya](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nijeriya "Nijeriya") daga kudu, [Libya](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Libya "Libya") daga arewa maso gabas, [Aljeriya](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Aljeriya "Aljeriya") daga arewa maso yamma, [Mali](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mali "Mali") daga yamma, [Burkina faso](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Burkina_Faso "Burkina Faso") da [Benin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Benin "Benin") daga kudu maso yamma, [Chadi](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cadi "Cadi") daga gabas). Tana da al'umma da ta kai fiye da mutum miliyan sha bakwai (17) Kuma tana da ƙabilu daban-daban, kamar su: [Hausawa](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hausawa "Hausawa"), [Zabarmawa](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Zabarmawa "Zabarmawa"), [Abzinawa](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Abzinawa "Abzinawa"), [Fulani](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fulani "Fulani"), [Kanuri](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kanuri "Kanuri"), [Bugaje](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bugaje "Bugaje"), [Barebari](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Barebari "Barebari"), [Larabawa](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Larabawa "Larabawa"), [Tubawa](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tubawa?action=edit&redlink=1 "Tubawa (babu wannan shafin)"), da [Gurmawa](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gurmawa?action=edit&redlink=1 "Gurmawa (babu wannan shafin)"). Nijar ta na ɗaya daga cikin ƙasashen ƙungiyar tattalin arziƙin ƙasashen yammacin **[Africa](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Africa_Centre "Africa Centre").** ([CEDEAO](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/CEDEAO?action=edit&redlink=1 "CEDEAO (babu wannan shafin)")). Nijar tana da faɗin ƙasa kimanin 1,270,000Km (490,000sq mi) ta biyu 2 a fadin ƙasa, a ƙasashen Afirka ta yamma. Wajan 80% na ƙasar saharah ne, wajan 22 million mutanan ƙasar Nijar musulmai ne


Mohammed Bazum Tsohon Shugaban Ƙasar Wanda Sojoji Suka Yi Wa Juyin Mulki

Nijar ta samu 'yancin kanta a shekara ta 1960 daga Turawan mulkin mallaka na kasar [Faransa](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Faransa "Faransa"). Tana da arziKin ma'adanai na cikin kasa kamar [zinariya](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Zinariya?action=edit&redlink=1 "Zinariya (babu wannan shafin)"), da [ƙarfe](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Karfe "Karfe"), da [gawayi](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gawayi "Gawayi"), da [uranium](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Uranium?action=edit&redlink=1 "Uranium (babu wannan shafin)"), da kuma [fetur](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Petrol?action=edit&redlink=1 "Petrol (babu wannan shafin)").

## Al'umman Nijar 2013

[[gyara sashe](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Nijar_(%C6%99asa)&veaction=edit&section=1 "Gyara sashe: Al'umman Nijar 2013") | [gyara masomin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Nijar_(%C6%99asa)&action=edit&section=1 "Edit section's source code: Al'umman Nijar 2013")]

A lissafin kasafin ƙasa da INS ta fitar[[3]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nijar_(%C6%99asa)#cite_note-3), a shekara ta 2013, ƙasar Nijar tana da al'umma milyan sha bakwai da dubu ɗari da ashirin da tara da saba'in da shida (17,129,076).

_Birane da ke da adadin al'umma samada dubu goma (10,000) akan kidayar shekara ta 2012._


Masana da masu ruwa a tsaki da gwamnatin mulkin soji ta Jamhuriyar Nijar ta tara domin tsara makomar ƙasar sun kammala taron ƙasa da suka kwashe kwana biyar suna gudanarwa.[[6]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nijar_(%C6%99asa)#cite_note-6)

Taron ya fara ne daga ranar Asabar 15 ga watan Fabarairu, zuwa Alhamis 20 ga watan na Fabarairu.[[7]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nijar_(%C6%99asa)#cite_note-7)

Shugaban mulkin soji na ƙasar Abdourahamane Tchiani ne ya kira taron domin seta hanyar da ƙasar za ta bi a shekaru masu zuwa.[[8]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nijar_(%C6%99asa)#cite_note-8)

Tun farko, bayan juyin mulkin da sojojin suka yi wa Mohammed Bazoum, gwamnatin sojin ta Nijar ta nuna alamun cewa za ta iya mayar da mulki ga farar hula cikin shekara uku, sai dai sakamakon taron ƙasar ya nuna akasin haka.[[9]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nijar_(%C6%99asa)#cite_note-9)

Ga wasu daga cikin abubuwan da taron ya cimma:

## Tabbatar da Tchina a matsayin shugaban ƙasa

[[gyara sashe](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Nijar_(%C6%99asa)&veaction=edit&section=3 "Gyara sashe: Tabbatar da Tchina a matsayin shugaban ƙasa") | [gyara masomin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Nijar_(%C6%99asa)&action=edit&section=3 "Edit section's source code: Tabbatar da Tchina a matsayin shugaban ƙasa")]

Taron haɗin kan ƙasar na Jamhuriyar Nijar ya amince da sauya yadda ake kiran jagoran juyin mulkin ƙasar zuwa 'shugaban ƙasa'.[[10]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nijar_(%C6%99asa)#cite_note-10)

Taron ya ce ya cimma matsayar ne bayan la'akari da "jagorancin" da Tchiani ya nuna wajen sake ƙwato wa Nijar "ƴancinta".[[11]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nijar_(%C6%99asa)#cite_note-11)

## Gwamnatin riƙon ƙwarya ta shekara biyar

[[gyara sashe](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Nijar_(%C6%99asa)&veaction=edit&section=4 "Gyara sashe: Gwamnatin riƙon ƙwarya ta shekara biyar") | [gyara masomin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Nijar_(%C6%99asa)&action=edit&section=4 "Edit section's source code: Gwamnatin riƙon ƙwarya ta shekara biyar")]

Taron ƙasar ta Jamhuriyar Nijar ya amince da samar da gwamnatin riƙon ƙwarya ta tsawon shekara biyar, wadda ita ce za ta tsara yadda za a mayar da ƙasar kan tafarkin dimokuraɗiyya[[12]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nijar_(%C6%99asa)#cite_note-12)

A lokacin gabatar da jawabi kan matsayar da taron ya cimma, ɗaya daga cikin jagororin taron, Bibata Niandou ta ce: "Miƙa mulki zai kasance a cikin wata 60, wato shekara biyar, daga ranar da aka amince da wannan tsari."[[13]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nijar_(%C6%99asa)#cite_note-13)

Sai dai ta ƙara da bayanin cewa wa'adin da aka ɗiba na mayar da mulkin ga farar hula zai iya "sauyawa" bisa la'akari da "yanayin tsaro" a ƙasar.[[14]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nijar_(%C6%99asa)#cite_note-14)

## Takara

[[gyara sashe](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Nijar_(%C6%99asa)&veaction=edit&section=5 "Gyara sashe: Takara") | [gyara masomin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Nijar_(%C6%99asa)&action=edit&section=5 "Edit section's source code: Takara")]

Taron ya yarda cewa jagororin mulkin sojin ƙasar za su iya tsayawa takara a zaɓen da za a gudanar bayan shekara biyar na riƙon ƙwarya.[[15]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nijar_(%C6%99asa)#cite_note-15)

Dama wannan na daga cikin manyan abubuwan da aka shirya samun matsaya a kan shi.[[16]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nijar_(%C6%99asa)#cite_note-16)

Hakan na nufin shugaban mulkin soji na ƙasar a yanzu na da damar tsayawa takara.[[17]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nijar_(%C6%99asa)#cite_note-17)

Wannan na daga cikin ɗabi'un shugabannin mulkin soji a nahiyar Afirka, inda sojojin da suka yi juyin mulki kan rikiɗe zuwa shugabannin farar hula ta hanyar zaɓe.[[18]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nijar_(%C6%99asa)#cite_note-18)

Na baya-bayan nan shi ne zaɓen da aka yi wa Mahamat Idris Deby a matsayin shugaban ƙasa bayan kasancewarsa shugaban ƙasar soji sanadiyyar mutuwar mahaifinsa.[[19]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nijar_(%C6%99asa)#cite_note-19)

## Ƙara wa Tchiani muƙami

[[gyara sashe](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Nijar_(%C6%99asa)&veaction=edit&section=6 "Gyara sashe: Ƙara wa Tchiani muƙami") | [gyara masomin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Nijar_(%C6%99asa)&action=edit&section=6 "Edit section's source code: Ƙara wa Tchiani muƙami")]

Ɗaya daga cikin mataimakan shugaban taron, Abdoulaye Seydou ya kuma bayyana cewa taron ya amince da ƙara wa shugaban mulkin soji na ƙasar Abdourahamane Tchiani daga Birgediya-Janar zuwa Janar na soja.[[20]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nijar_(%C6%99asa)#cite_note-20)

*   Me ake tsammani daga babban taron ƙasa na Jamhuriyar Nijar?
*   Ƙasashen da cin hanci da rashawa suka yi wa katutu a 2024 - Rahoto
*   Me zai faru bayan ficewar ƙasashen Nijar da Mali da Burkina Faso daga Ecowas?

A yanzu dai za a gabatar wa majalisar mulkin sojin Jamhuriyar Nijar matsayra da taron ya cimma domin amincewa tare da ɗaukar matsaya ta ƙarshe.[[21]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nijar_(%C6%99asa)#cite_note-21)

Taron ya ƙunshi mutane kimanin 700, waɗanda suka fito daga ɓangarori da dama na ƙasar, da suka haɗa da tsofaffin ministoci da masana da lauyoyi da sojoji da malamai da kuma ƴan ƙungiyoyi masu zaman kansu.[[22]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nijar_(%C6%99asa)#cite_note-22)

Jamhuriyar Nijar na daga cikin ƙasashe uku - Burkina Faso, Mali da Nijar - waɗanda suka tsame kansu daga ƙungiyar ƙasashen yammacin Afirka, tun bayan juyin mulkin soji da suka faru a ƙasashen.[[23]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nijar_(%C6%99asa)#cite_note-23)

Haka nan sun raba-gari da ƙasashen yammacin duniya, ciki har da uwar-gijiyarsu, Faransa, sannan suka karkata alaƙarsu zuwa Rasha.[[24]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nijar_(%C6%99asa)#cite_note-24)

# Najeriya


_**Nigeria w1 locator**_


tutar najeriya


manuniyar najeriya


babban birnin najeriya


crisis a najeriya


Sojan Nigeria 

'**[Najeriya](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Najeriya);'** (/nadʒɪəriyə/) ko **Nijeriya** (/niˈdʒɪəriyə/) da ([turanci](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Turanci "Turanci"): _Nigeria_): A Gwamnatance **Tarayyar [Najeriya](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Najeriya)** ƙasa ce da take a [Afirka](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Afirka_ta_Yamma "Afirka ta Yamma")[ta](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Afirka_ta_Yammah?action=edit&redlink=1 "Afirka ta Yammah (babu wannan shafin)") yamma.[[1]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Najeriya#cite_note-1)[[2]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Najeriya#cite_note-2)[[3]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Najeriya#cite_note-3) Tana da iyaka da ƙasar [Nijar](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nijar "Nijar") daga [Arewa](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Arewa "Arewa"), da [Chadi](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cadi "Cadi") daga Arewa maso gabas da [Kamaru](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kamaru "Kamaru") daga gabas da [Benin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Benin "Benin") daga yammah, daga kudanci kuma tana a gaɓar [Tekun Atlantika](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tekun_Atalanta "Tekun Atalanta").[[4]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Najeriya#cite_note-4)[[5]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Najeriya#cite_note-5)[[6]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Najeriya#cite_note-6) Jamhuriyar Tarayyar [Najeriya](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Najeriya) ta ƙunshi Jihohi guda (36) tare da _Babban Birnin_ Tarayya [Abuja](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Abuja "Abuja") inda fadar [shugaban ƙasar](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shugaban_kasa "Shugaban kasa") wato "villa" take.[[7]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Najeriya#cite_note-:0-7)[[8]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Najeriya#cite_note-8)[[9]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Najeriya#cite_note-9)

[Abuja](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lagos_(birni) "Lagos (birni)") tana ɗaya daga cikin manyan bira ne a [duniya](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Duniya "Duniya").[[10]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Najeriya#cite_note-10)[[11]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Najeriya#cite_note-11)[[12]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Najeriya#cite_note-12)


Shopping District


Shugaban Kasar Nijeriya

Najeriya ta kasance gida da dama ga ƴan asalin [turawa](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Turawa "Turawa") masu mulkin mallaka, jihohin da suka mallaka tunda (BC)[[13]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Najeriya#cite_note-13)[[14]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Najeriya#cite_note-14)[[15]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Najeriya#cite_note-15) tare da [Nok Wayewa](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Al'adar_Nok "Al'adar Nok") ta kasance ita ce karo na farko da Turawan mulkin mallaka suka fara mallakewa a [Yammacin Africa](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Yammacin_Africa "Yammacin Africa") a cikin ƙarni na sha biyar (15).[[16]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Najeriya#cite_note-16)[[17]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Najeriya#cite_note-17)[[18]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Najeriya#cite_note-18) A zamani jihar an samo asali da [Birtaniya](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Birtaniya "Birtaniya") a cikin karni na sha tara (19) yana ɗaukar yanayin na yanzu tare da haɗe yankin [Kudancin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kudanci "Kudanci")[Najeriya](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Najeriya) da kuma kare [Arewacin Najeriya](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Arewacin_Najeriya "Arewacin Najeriya") a cikin shekara ta alif dubu ɗaya da ɗari tara da goma sha huɗu (1914)[[19]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Najeriya#cite_note-19)[[20]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Najeriya#cite_note-20)[[21]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Najeriya#cite_note-21)[[22]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Najeriya#cite_note-22) ta [Lord Lugard](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Frederick_Lugard "Frederick Lugard"). Ingilishi ya kafa tsarin gudanarwa da na doka yayin aiwatar da mulkin kai tsaye ta hanyar shugabannin gargajiya.[[23]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Najeriya#cite_note-23)[[24]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Najeriya#cite_note-24)[[25]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Najeriya#cite_note-25) Najeriya, ta zama ƙasar tarayyar da ke da ƴanci kai tsaye a ranar (1)ga watan [Oktoba](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Oktoba "Oktoba"), shekara ta alif dubu ɗaya da ɗari tara da sittin (1960).[[26]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Najeriya#cite_note-26)[[27]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Najeriya#cite_note-27)[[28]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Najeriya#cite_note-28) Ta fuskanci yaƙin basasa daga shekara ta dubu ɗaya da ɗari tara da sittin da bakwai (1967) zuwa shekarar dubu ɗaya da ɗari tara da saba'in da bakwai (1977).[[29]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Najeriya#cite_note-29)[[30]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Najeriya#cite_note-30)[[31]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Najeriya#cite_note-31) Sannan a biyo bayan zaɓaɓɓun gwamnatocin farar hula da mulkin kama-karya na soja, har sai an sami tabbatacciyar [dimokuraɗiyya](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dimokura%C9%97iyya "Dimokuraɗiyya") a shekara ta alif dari tara da chasa'in da tara (1999) zaɓen shugaban ƙasa na shekara ta (2015)dubu biyu da sha biyar shi ne karo na farko da shugaban [ƙasa](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shugaban_Nijeriya "Shugaban Nijeriya") mai ci ya faɗi zaɓensa. [[32]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Najeriya#cite_note-32)[[33]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Najeriya#cite_note-33)[[34]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Najeriya#cite_note-34)

Najeriya; tafi Ko wace ƙasa yawan al'ummah acikin nahiyar Afrika, ƙasa ce Kuma mai yawan al’umma da ke zaune sama da ƙabilu guda ɗari biyu da sittin 260.[[35]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Najeriya#cite_note-35)[[36]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Najeriya#cite_note-36)[[37]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Najeriya#cite_note-37) waɗanda ke magana [[Harsunan Najeriya|da yarurruka daban daban guda ɗari biyar (500) dukkansu suna ɗauke da al'adu iri daban daban. Manyan ƙabilun guda uku su ne; [Hausa – Fulani](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hausa%E2%80%93Fulani "Hausa–Fulani") a [Arewa](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Arewacin_Najeriya "Arewacin Najeriya"), [Yarbawa](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Yarbawa "Yarbawa") a [Yamma](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kasar_Yarbawa "Kasar Yarbawa"), da kuma [Igbo](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Inyamurai "Inyamurai") a gabas, waɗanda suka hada da kashi sittin (60%) na yawan mutanen. Yaren [hukuma](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Harshen_gwamnati?action=edit&redlink=1 "Harshen gwamnati (babu wannan shafin)") shi ne [Ingilishi](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/English_cricket_team_in_the_West_Indies_in_2008%E2%80%9309 "English cricket team in the West Indies in 2008–09"),[[38]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Najeriya#cite_note-38)[[39]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Najeriya#cite_note-39)[[40]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Najeriya#cite_note-40) wanda aka zaɓa don sauƙaƙe haɗin harshe a matakin ƙasa. Tsarin mulkin Nijeriya ya tabbatar da ƴancin yin addini kuma ƙasa ce dake ɗauke da al’ummar musulmai da kirista, a lokaci guda. [Najeriya](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Najeriya) ta kasu kashi biyu tsakanin [musulmai](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Musulmi "Musulmi"), waɗanda yawanci ke zaune a arewacin ƙasar, da kuma [kiristoci](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kirista "Kirista"),[[41]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Najeriya#cite_note-41)[[42]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Najeriya#cite_note-42)[[43]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Najeriya#cite_note-43) waɗanda yawanci ke zaune a kudancin ƙasar, tare da ƴan tsirarun da ke yin addinin asali, kamar waɗanda ke cikin ƙabilar Igbo da kuma yarbawa.[[44]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Najeriya#cite_note-44)[[45]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Najeriya#cite_note-45)[[46]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Najeriya#cite_note-46)


Bola Ahmed Tinubu shugaban ƙasar na yanzu

Najeriya ,ita ce ƙasa mafi yawan mutane a [Afirka](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Afirka "Afirka") kuma ƙasa ta bakwai mafi yawan mutane a duniya,[[47]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Najeriya#cite_note-47)[[48]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Najeriya#cite_note-48)[[49]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Najeriya#cite_note-49) tare da kimanin mutane miliyan ɗari biyu da shida (2,00,000,006). Tattalin arzikinta shine mafi girma a [Afirka](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Afirka "Afirka"), kuma shi ne na ashirin da shida (26)[[50]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Najeriya#cite_note-50)[[51]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Najeriya#cite_note-51)[[52]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Najeriya#cite_note-52) mafi girma a duniya ta hanyar GDP maras faɗi, kuma na ashirin da biyar (25), mafi girma daga PPP. Najeriya galibi ana ƙiranta da "Giant of Africa", ma'ana ƙarfin [Afrika](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Afirka "Afirka") saboda yawan jama'a da tattalin arziƙinta, [kuma bankin duniya](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bankin_Duniya "Bankin Duniya") yana dauƙarta a matsayin [kasuwa](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kasuwa_masu_tasowa?action=edit&redlink=1 "Kasuwa masu tasowa (babu wannan shafin)") mai tasowa. Karamar yanki ce a cikin Afirka, matsakaiciyar ƙarfi a cikin al'amuran ƙasa da ƙasa, sannan kuma tana ɗaya daga cikin ƙasashe mafi yawan [al’umma a duniya](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gingara_karfi?action=edit&redlink=1 "Gingara karfi (babu wannan shafin)").[[53]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Najeriya#cite_note-53)[[54]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Najeriya#cite_note-54)[[55]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Najeriya#cite_note-55) Koyaya ƙasar tana ƙasa sosai a cikin jerin ƙasashen duniya, kuma har yanzu tana ɗaya daga cikin ƙasashe masu rashawa a duniya. Najeriya memba ce ta kafuwar tarayyar [Afirka](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Afirka "Afirka"), kuma memba ce a ƙungiyoyin ƙasa da ƙasa da dama, waɗanda suka haɗa da [Majalisar Ɗinkin Duniya](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Majalisar_Dinkin_Duniya "Majalisar Dinkin Duniya"), ƙungiyar ƙasashen Yammacin Africa ([ECOWAS)](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/ECOWAS "ECOWAS") ƙungiyar ƙasashe masu arziƙin man fetur, ([OPEC](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/OPEC "OPEC")) kuma memba ce na yau da kullum a gamayyar [MINT](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/MINT_(tattalin_arziki) "MINT (tattalin arziki)"), kuma tana ɗaya daga cikin ƙasashe goma sha ɗaya masu tashen ƙaruwan tattalin arziƙi wato "[Next Eleven](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sha_dayan_gaba_%22Next_Eleven%22?action=edit&redlink=1 "Sha dayan gaba \"Next Eleven\" (babu wannan shafin)")".[[56]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Najeriya#cite_note-56)[[57]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Najeriya#cite_note-57)[[58]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Najeriya#cite_note-58)

## Kirkira:

[[gyara sashe](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Najeriya&veaction=edit&section=1 "Gyara sashe: Kirkira:") | [gyara masomin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Najeriya&action=edit&section=1 "Edit section's source code: Kirkira:")]

Sunan _[Nijeriya](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/Nigeria "wiktionary:Nigeria")_ an dauke shi daga Kogin [Neja](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Neja_(kogi) "Neja (kogi)") wanda ya ratsa kasar.[[59]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Najeriya#cite_note-59)[[60]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Najeriya#cite_note-60)[[61]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Najeriya#cite_note-61) Wannan sunan ya samo asali ne a ranar takwas (8), ga watan Janairun shekara ta (1897) dan jaridar Ingila [Flora Shaw](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Flora_Shaw,_Lady_Lugard "Flora Shaw, Lady Lugard"), wanda daga baya ya auri [Lord Lugard](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Frederick_Lugard "Frederick Lugard"), mai kula da mulkin mallaka na Burtaniya.[[62]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Najeriya#cite_note-62)[[63]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Najeriya#cite_note-63)[[64]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Najeriya#cite_note-64)[Nijar](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nijar "Nijar") da ke makwabtaka da ita sun samo sunan daga wannan kogin.[[65]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Najeriya#cite_note-65)[[66]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Najeriya#cite_note-66)[[67]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Najeriya#cite_note-67) Asalin sunan _Nijar_, wanda asali ana amfani da shi ne kawai zuwa tsakiyar Kogin Neja, ba tabbas. Watakila kalmar ta canza sunan [Tuareg](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Buzaye "Buzaye")_egerew n-iger ewen_ da mazauna ke amfani da shi a tsakiyar kogin da ke kusa da [Timbuktu](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Timbuktu "Timbuktu") kafin mulkin mallaka na Turai na karni na (19). [[68]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Najeriya#cite_note-68)[[69]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Najeriya#cite_note-69)[[70]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Najeriya#cite_note-70)
