## Tarihi:

[[gyara sashe](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Najeriya&veaction=edit&section=2 "Gyara sashe: Tarihi:") | [gyara masomin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Najeriya&action=edit&section=2 "Edit section's source code: Tarihi:")]


Babban Bankin Nigeria.


Shugaban kasan najeriya(bola ahmad tinubu)

Tarihi, ya nuna cewar [Nijeriya](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Najeriya_a_1960 "Najeriya a 1960") dadaddar kasa ce, kuma tarihi yanuna kasar na nan tun a shekara ta (**500),**[[71]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Najeriya#cite_note-71)[[72]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Najeriya#cite_note-72)[[73]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Najeriya#cite_note-73) kafin haihuwar Yesu Almasihu wato Annabi Isah (A.S) a wannan lokaci suka samata suna [Kasar Hausa](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kasar_Hausa "Kasar Hausa").[[74]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Najeriya#cite_note-74)[[75]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Najeriya#cite_note-75)[[76]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Najeriya#cite_note-76) Addinin musulunci ya shiga Kasar [Hausa](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hausawa "Hausawa") ne tun a karni na goma sha uku (13) miladiya.[[77]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Najeriya#cite_note-77)[[78]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Najeriya#cite_note-78)[[79]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Najeriya#cite_note-79) a karshen karni na goma sha daya (11) zuwa tsakiyar karni na goma sha hudu (14) miladiya. Kanem Barno suka mamaye Kasar Hausa, kuma Fulani sun mamaye Kasar [Hausa](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hausa "Hausa") a farkon karni na goma sha tara (19) miladiya har zuwan Turawan Mulkin Mallaka suka mamaye [Lagos](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lagos "Lagos") a shekara ta [(1881](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/1881?action=edit&redlink=1 "1881 (babu wannan shafin)")) miladiyya, ana cikin [Yakin duniya](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Yakin_duniya_I?action=edit&redlink=1 "Yakin duniya I (babu wannan shafin)") na farko sai Turawan Mulkin Mallaka suka karo sojojin ruwa saboda suna tsoran Jamusawa da ke Kamaru kada sumamaye Najeriya, amma mulkin Najeriya na farko a hannun Turawan [Portugal](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Portugal "Portugal").[[80]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Najeriya#cite_note-80)[[81]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Najeriya#cite_note-81)[[82]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Najeriya#cite_note-82) A shekara ta dubu daya da dari takwas da tamanin da biyar [(1885)](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/1885?action=edit&redlink=1 "1885 (babu wannan shafin)") sai Turawan [Birtaniya](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Birtaniya "Birtaniya") suka mamaye duk fadin Nijeria har zuwa Daya (1) ga watan oktoba, 1960. Nijeriya ta samu 'yancin kanta daga Turawan Biritaniya.[[83]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Najeriya#cite_note-83)[[84]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Najeriya#cite_note-84)[[85]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Najeriya#cite_note-85)

# Gidauniyar Wikimedia


Gidauniyar wikimedia

**Gidauniyar Wikimedia _('_ WMF**, ko a takaice **Wikimedia**) wata Gidauniya ce a [Amurka](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tarayyar_Amurka "Tarayyar Amurka") wanda bana samar da jari bace sai dai [ma'aikatar taimako](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ma'aikatar_taimako?action=edit&redlink=1 "Ma'aikatar taimako (babu wannan shafin)") da ke da helkwata a birnin [San Francisco](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/San_Francisco "San Francisco"), [California](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/California "California").[[1]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikimedia_Foundation#cite_note-Hanson2016-1) Anfi sanin kamfanin da daukan nauyin shafukan Wikipidiya, wani mashahurin kundin ilimi na yanar gizo, har wayau ta na daukan nauyin wasu shafuka masu alaka da kuma Mediawiki, wata softwaya ta yanar gizo.[[2]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikimedia_Foundation#cite_note-2)[[3]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikimedia_Foundation#cite_note-3)[[4]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikimedia_Foundation#cite_note-4)[[5]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikimedia_Foundation#cite_note-5)

[Jimmy Wales](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jimmy_Wales "Jimmy Wales") ne ya kirkiri Gidauniyar ta Wikipedia a shekara ta 2003 a [St. Petersburg, Florida](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/St._Petersburg,_Florida?action=edit&redlink=1 "St. Petersburg, Florida (babu wannan shafin)"), a matsayin hanyar tallafawa Wikipedia, Wikitionary da sauran manhajojinta wadanda a da [Bomis](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bomis?action=edit&redlink=1 "Bomis (babu wannan shafin)") ne ke daukan nauyinsu.[[6]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikimedia_Foundation#cite_note-Rupert_Neate-6)[[7]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikimedia_Foundation#cite_note-7) Gidauniyar ta na ciyar da kanta ta hanyar miliyoyin kudade da ake samo daga makaranta shafukan Wikipidiya, wadanda ake tattarawa ta hanyar kamfe na shekara-shekara da kuma neman tallafi don Wikipidiya. Akwai tallafe-tallafe na musamman daga kamfanonin fasaha da dama da kuma kungiyoyin jin kan jama'a.

Gidauniyar ta habaka cikin sauri tun lokacin da aka kafa ta. Yi zuwa shhekara ta 2021, ta dauki ma'aikata da masu ayyukan kwantiragi sama da mutum 550, tare da samun kudin shiga a duk shekara da suka kai kimanin dala miliyan US$160, kudaden kuwa da ake kashewa a duk shekara sun kai kimanin dala miliyan 110, kuma habakar tallafi na sama da dala miliyan 100 a bisa watan Junin 2021.

## Kuduri

[[gyara sashe](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Gidauniyar_Wikimedia&veaction=edit&section=1 "Gyara sashe: Kuduri") | [gyara masomin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Gidauniyar_Wikimedia&action=edit&section=1 "Edit section's source code: Kuduri")]

Gidauniyar _Wikimedia Foundation_ nada Kuduri karfafawa da kuma shigar da mutane daga sassa daban-daban na duniya wajen tattarawa da kuma habaka bayanai na ilimi a karkashin lasisi ta kyauta ko kuma ajiya don amfanin al'umma, da kuma yada shi ilimin da kyau a sassa daban daban na duniya.[[8]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikimedia_Foundation#cite_note-:0-8)

Don tabbatar da wannan kuduri, Gidauniyar na samar da kayan aiki na fasaha da na kungiyoyi don tallafawa mambobin al'ummomi wajen habaka bayanai akan wiki a cikin harsuna daban daban.[[8]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikimedia_Foundation#cite_note-:0-8) Ita Gidauniyar bata ita rubutawa ko kirkirar bayanai akan shafukan wiki da kanta ba.[[9]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikimedia_Foundation#cite_note-9) Sai dai Gidauniyar ta na aiki da mutane masu bada gudummawa da kungiyoyin abokan hulda kamar su Chaptocin Wikimedia, thematic organizations, user group da dai sauran abokan aiki daga Kasashen daban daban na duniya, kuma ta yi alkawari acikin kudirinta cewa zata gabatar da bayanai na ilimi masu amfani daga shafukanta ga al'umma kyauta a yanar gizo don wanzuwa na har abada.[[10]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikimedia_Foundation#cite_note-10)

Wikimedia Foundation ta samu ikon sashe [501(c)(3)](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/501(c)(3)?action=edit&redlink=1 "501(c)(3) (babu wannan shafin)") daga dokar [Internal Revenue Code](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Internal_Revenue_Code?action=edit&redlink=1 "Internal Revenue Code (babu wannan shafin)") ta Tarayyar Amurka amatsayin ta takasance na taimakon alumma a shekarar 2005.[[11]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikimedia_Foundation#cite_note-11) Lambar [National Taxonomy of Exempt Entities](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/National_Taxonomy_of_Exempt_Entities?action=edit&redlink=1 "National Taxonomy of Exempt Entities (babu wannan shafin)") (NTEE) code shine B60 ([Adult](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Adult_education?action=edit&redlink=1 "Adult education (babu wannan shafin)"), [Continuing education](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Continuing_education?action=edit&redlink=1 "Continuing education (babu wannan shafin)")).[[12]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikimedia_Foundation#cite_note-12)[[13]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikimedia_Foundation#cite_note-13) Dokokin foundation ya bayyana jawabin dan karba da farfado da bayanai akan ilimi ta bayar dashi ta hanyar daya dace ga duniya baki daya.[[14]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikimedia_Foundation#cite_note-14)

text:
# Madinah


Masallacin Annabi (s.a.w) dak e birnin madinah


madina Hilton

**Madinah:** Birni ne da ke a yammacin [ Saudi Arabia][_[permanent dead link](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Link\_rot "Wikipedia:Link rot")_] A nahiyar [Asiya](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Asiya "Asiya") cikin tsakiyar yankin gabas ta tsakiyar larabawa, shi dai wannan birni ya kafu ne tun dubbanin shekaru a baya tun a zamanin Annabawa. Hakika birnin Mad**inah** garin [Musulunci](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Musulunci "Musulunci") ne shi ne birnin manzon Allah Annabi [Muhammad](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Muhammad "Muhammad") (S.A.W). Kafin zuwan [Musulunci](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Musulunci "Musulunci") ana kiran birnin da suna **Yathrib,** amma daga baya sai Annabi ya canjawa garin suna zuwa **Madinah** ko kuma **Madinat Al-munawwarah,** a cikin birnin akwai babban [masallaci](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Masallaci "Masallaci") wanda shine farkon Masallacin da Annabi Muhammad (S A W) da ya gina a Madinah, wannan masallaci shine ake Kira da masallacin **Quba**.

**FAƊIN ƘASA**

Birnin Madinah yana da fadin kasa kamar haka:

*   **Fadin gari**

589 km2 (227 sq mi)

*   **Fadin babban birni**

293 km2 (112 sq mi)

*   **Maki mafi daukaka**

608 m (1,995 ft)

*   **kididdigar yawan mutane** a shekarar (2010)

1,180,770

*   **Density**

2,000/km2 (5,200/sq mi)


Wannan taswirar Birnin Madinah kenan.

Hakika birnin Madinah yanada matukar tasiri a Musulunci, shi ne garin Annabi Muhammad (S.A.W) bayan hijararsa daga birnin [Makkah](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Makkah "Makkah") acikin garin yayi rayuwa har yakoma zuwa ga Allah, sannan kuma acikin birnin aka birne shi, acikin dakin matarsa nana Aisha inda a nanne yarasu, Wanda a yanzu nan ne masallacinsa, Shi yasa duk Alhazan da sukaje Madinah to sai sun kai ziyara **kabarinsa** (S.A.W) da manyan **sahabbansa.**

# Masallacin Annabi SAW na Madina

[[gyara sashe](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Madinah&veaction=edit&section=1 "Gyara sashe: Masallacin Annabi SAW na Madina") | [gyara masomin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Madinah&action=edit&section=1 "Edit section's source code: Masallacin Annabi SAW na Madina")]

Ziyara zuwa waje na biyu mafi tsarki a Musulunci, wanda ya samu shekara 1440 da suka gabata.

Daga Sagiru Saleh

### Babban Masallacin Madina shi ne na biyu a cikin masallatai mafiya daraja, wanda kuma Annabi Muhammad (SAW) ya fara jagorantar Sallah a cikin sa.

[[gyara sashe](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Madinah&veaction=edit&section=2 "Gyara sashe: Babban Masallacin Madina shi ne na biyu a cikin masallatai mafiya daraja, wanda kuma Annabi Muhammad (SAW) ya fara jagorantar Sallah a cikin sa.") | [gyara masomin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Madinah&action=edit&section=2 "Edit section's source code: Babban Masallacin Madina shi ne na biyu a cikin masallatai mafiya daraja, wanda kuma Annabi Muhammad (SAW) ya fara jagorantar Sallah a cikin sa.")]

### Masallacin Manzon Allah shi ne wurin da aka fara sanya hasken lantarki a fadin yankin Larabawa a 1909, kamar yadda Sultan Ghalib Al Quaiti ya fada a littafinsa, _The holy cities, the Pilgrimage and the World of Islam._

[[gyara sashe](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Madinah&veaction=edit&section=3 "Gyara sashe: Masallacin Manzon Allah shi ne wurin da aka fara sanya hasken lantarki a fadin yankin Larabawa a 1909, kamar yadda Sultan Ghalib Al Quaiti ya fada a littafinsa, The holy cities, the Pilgrimage and the World of Islam.") | [gyara masomin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Madinah&action=edit&section=3 "Edit section's source code: Masallacin Manzon Allah shi ne wurin da aka fara sanya hasken lantarki a fadin yankin Larabawa a 1909, kamar yadda Sultan Ghalib Al Quaiti ya fada a littafinsa, The holy cities, the Pilgrimage and the World of Islam.")]

Ana fadada shi ta yadda zai dauki mutum miliyan daya da dubu 800. Inuwar rumfunan alfarma masu sarrafa kansu kuma masu daukar mutum dubu 800 guda 250 da ke masallacin sun kai murabba'in mita dubu 143, kamar yadda shafin hukumar gudanarwar masallacin ya bayyana.

Nan gaba za mu kawo muku bayanai gwargwadon hali a kan tambayoyin da kuka aiko mana na abubuwan da kuke son sani game da Masallacin Manzon Allah SAW da ke Madina.

Hadisai sun nuna cewa Masallacin Manzon Allah SAW shi ne masallaci mafi tsarki da falala da girma a ban kasa, bayan Masallacin Makkah.

Shi ya sa ake wa masallatan biyu lakabi da masallatai biyu tsarkaka masu daukaka, wato Al-haramainush sharifain, da harshen Larabci.

Masallacin Manzon Allah, wanda ke kwaryar birnin Madina a kasar Saudiyya shi ne wuri da aka fara sanya wa hasken lantarki a fadin yankin Labarawa tun a shekarar 1909 miladiyya.

Fitaccen marubucin tarihin Manzon Allah SAW, Safiur-Rahman Mubarakfuriya ya bayyana a littafin Al-rahikul Makhtum cewa masallacin shi ne biyu da aka gina a Madina bayan masallacin Kuba.A wancan lokaci an gina masallacin ne a kusa da gidan Annabi Muhammad (SAW) shekara ta farko bayan hijira daga Makka zuwa Madina (632 miladiyya). Kuma sallah daya a masallacin Manzon Allah SAW ta fi sallah 1,000 da aka yi a wasu masallatai daraja, ban da masallacin Ka'aba. Kabarin Manzon Allah SAW da na manyan sahabbansa biyu, Abubakar da Umar na cikin masallacin a yanzu, sakamakon fadada masallacin da aka yi a tsawon shekaru sama da 1,400, kaburburan na cikin wani daki da aka yi na kusa da mumbarin da ke cikin rauda, wanda a zamanin Annabi dakin matarsa ne Nana Aisha. Sakamakon fadada wannan masallaci a tsawon zamani, yanzu Rauda ta shige cikin wanan masallacin. Manzon Allah tsira da amincin Allah su tabbata a gare shi yana cewa tsakanin gidana da mimbarina akwai dausayi daga cikin dausayin Aljanna. Wannan wuri shi ne Rauda.

Girman Masallacin Madina

Saboda girman Masallacin Madinah ya kan dauke duk miliyoyin mahajjata da masu umrah da ke ziyartarsa a kowace shekara. Kuma shi ne wurin da mahajjata da masu umrah suka fi ziyarta a fadin Madina. A nan suke yin sallah, su shiga Rauda in hali ya samu, su ziyarci Annabi SAW da sahabbansa a makwancinsu da kuma makabartar Baki'a. Har yanzu ana ci gaba da fadada shi ta yadda zai iya daukar masallata kusan miliyan biyu a lokaci guda, saboda yadda yawan masu ziyartarsa ke karuwa a lokacin Hajji. Girman masallacin a yau ya kai ninki 100 na yadda aka fara gina shi. Kuma ya kusa mamaye fadin asalin garin Madina a zamanin Manzon Allah SAW..Sannan masallacin a bude yake a koyaushe domin masu ibada. Baya ga manyan hasumiyoyi 10 masu tsawon mita 103 kowannensu, masallacin na da kubbobi (tulluwa) 170 da suka hada da masu ruwan azurfa da farare da wasu 27 na zamani masu sarrafa kansu. Akwai kuma wata koriyar kubba babba a daidai saman inda kabarin Manzon Allah yake, ita ake wa kirari da Koriyar Kubba ta Dan Abdullahi. A gefen koriyar kubbar akwai wata kubba mai ruwan azurfa.

title: Tebur
text:
# Tebur

Bayyanar tasoshin da ke cikin kwarin Monument, a kan Colorado PlateauFilayen Colorado


Har Qatum, wani tebur da ke gefen kudancin [Makhtesh Ramon](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Makhtesh_Ramon "Makhtesh Ramon"), [Isra'ila](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Isra'ila "Isra'ila")


Ingleborough a Arewacin Yorkshire, Ingila


Dutsen Garfield, wani tebur a Colorado

Mesa wani wuri ne mai tsawo, mai tsawo mai laushi, ko tudun, wanda aka iyakance daga kowane bangare ta hanyar tsaunuka masu tsawo kuma yana tsaye a fili sama da filin da ke kewaye da shi. Mesas sun kunshi duwatsu masu laushi masu laushi, kamar shales, wanda aka rufe shi da wani nau'i mai tsayayya na [dutse](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Duwatsu_(geology) "Duwatsu (geology)") mai wuya, kamar sandstone ko dutse mai laushi, wanda ke samar da Caprock wanda ke kare taron mai laushi. Caprock na iya haɗawa da kwararar dutse mai laushi ko rushewar duricrust.

Ba kamar tudu ba, wanda ya fi girma, yanki mai _[tsawo](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kudin\_da\_aka\_samu "Kudin da aka samu")_ wanda bazai da _[dutse](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Butte "Butte")_ mai laushi ba (misali, Tibetan Plateau), an bayyana mesa ta hanyar shimfidar shimfiɗa da keɓewa mai tsayi. Manyan tsaunuka masu laushi tare da shimfidar wurare, da ba su da nisa kuma sau da yawa wani ɓangare na tsarin tsaunuka, ana kiransu tsaunuka. A butte ne karami, eroded mesa tare da iyakantaccen taro, yayin da wani cuesta yana da wani m shimfiɗa gangara da kuma daya steep escarpment saboda karkata strata.[[1]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tebur#cite_note-Migo%C5%842004a2-1)[[2]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tebur#cite_note-NeuendorfOthers2011a2-2)

## Sunayen, ma'anar da kuma asalin

[[gyara sashe](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Tebur&veaction=edit&section=1 "Gyara sashe: Sunayen, ma'anar da kuma asalin") | [gyara masomin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Tebur&action=edit&section=1 "Edit section's source code: Sunayen, ma'anar da kuma asalin")]

Kamar yadda masanin ilimin ƙasa Kirk Bryan ya lura a 1922, mesas "... tsaye a fili sama da ƙasar da ke kewaye da ita, kamar yadda _[tebur](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/mesa#Spanish "wiktionary:mesa")_ ke tsaye sama da bene wanda yake kwance".[[3]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tebur#cite_note-Bryan1992a-3) Daga wannan bayyanar ne aka karɓi kalmar mesa daga kalmar [Mutanen Espanya](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Yaren_Sifen "Yaren Sifen") mesa, ma'ana "tebur".[[4]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tebur#cite_note-Migo%C5%842004a-4)

Mesa yana kama da, amma yana da faɗin yanki mai faɗi fiye da, [butte](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Butte "Butte") . Babu iyaka girman girman da aka yarda da zai raba mesas daga ko dai buttes ko plateaus. Misali, tsaunukan da ke saman dutsen da aka fi sani da mesas a cikin Range na Cockburn na [Arewacin Yammacin Ostiraliya](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Arewa_Maso_Yammacin_Ostiraliya "Arewa Maso Yammacin Ostiraliya") suna da yankuna masu girman 350 square kilometres (140 sq mi) . Sabanin haka, tsaunuka masu lebur tare da ƙananan yanki kamar 0.1 square kilometres (0.039 sq mi) a cikin Dutsen Sandstone na Elbe, [Jamus](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jamus "Jamus"), an kwatanta su da mesas. [[4]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tebur#cite_note-Migo%C5%842004a-4)[[5]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tebur#cite_note-NeuendorfOthers2011a-5)

Ƙananan tsananin, wani tsauni mai faɗi, mai laushi, yawanci dutse mai nisa ko dutse mai matsakaici wanda aka iyakance a akalla gefe ɗaya ta dutse mai tsawo ko gangara kuma yana wakiltar ragowar lalacewa ana kiransa mesas.[[6]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tebur#cite_note-NeuendorfOthers2011a3-6)

A cikin wallafe-wallafen geomorphic da geologic na harshen Ingilishi, an kuma yi amfani da wasu kalmomi don mesa. Misali, a yankin Roraima na Venezuela, an yi amfani da sunan gargajiya, _tepui_, daga yaren Pomón na gida, da kuma kalmar _tsaunuka na tebur_ don bayyana tsaunuka masu laushi na gida. Irin waɗannan siffofi a Ostiraliya an san su da tuddai, tuddai na saman tebur, tuddai masu tasha, ko tsalle-tsalle (tsalle-tsaye). [[7]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tebur#cite_note-7) An kuma yi amfani da kalmar Jamusanci _**Tafelberg**_ a cikin wallafe-wallafen kimiyya na Ingilishi a baya.

## Kafawa

[[gyara sashe](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Tebur&veaction=edit&section=2 "Gyara sashe: Kafawa") | [gyara masomin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Tebur&action=edit&section=2 "Edit section's source code: Kafawa")]

Mesas sun samo asali ne ta hanyar yanayi da [rushewa](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Zaizayar_Kasa "Zaizayar Kasa") duwatsu masu laushi waɗanda aka ɗaga ta hanyar aikin tectonic. Bambance-bambance a cikin ikon nau'ikan dutse daban-daban don tsayayya da yanayi da [rushewa](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Zaizayar_Kasa "Zaizayar Kasa") suna haifar da nau'ikan duwatsu masu rauni don rushewa, suna barin nau'ikan tsaunuka masu tsayayya fiye da kewayenta. Wannan tsari ana kiransa lalacewar bambanci. Mafi yawan nau'ikan dutse masu tsayayya sun haɗa da sandstone, conglomerate, Quartzite, basalt, chert, limestone, kwararar dutse da sills.[[8]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tebur#cite_note-Easterbrook-8) Ruwan dutse da sills, musamman, suna da tsayayya sosai ga yanayi da rushewa, kuma galibi suna samar da saman, ko Caprock, na mesa. Ƙananan duwatsun dutse galibi sun ƙunshi shale, dutse mai laushi wanda ke da sauƙin sauyawa kuma ya lalace cikin sauƙi.[[8]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tebur#cite_note-Easterbrook-8)

Bambance-bambance a cikin ƙarfin nau'ikan dutse daban-daban shine abin da ke ba mesas siffar su ta musamman. Ana lalata duwatsu masu tsayayya a saman zuwa kwari, inda suke tattara ruwa daga yankin da ke kewaye da su, yayin da aka bar mafi tsayayya da tsayayya. Babban yanki na dutse mai tsayayya sosai, kamar sill, na iya kare yadudduka da ke ƙasa da shi daga rushewa yayin da dutse mai laushi da ke kewaye da shi ya rushe cikin kwari, don haka ya samar da caprock.

Bambance-bambance a cikin nau'in dutse kuma suna nunawa a bangarorin mesa, kamar yadda maimakon gangara mai santsi, bangarorin suna karyewa cikin tsarin matakala da ake kira "tsarin dutse da bench". Ƙungiyoyin da suka fi tsayayya sun samar da dutsen, ko matakala, yayin da ƙananan matakan da ba su da tsayayya suna samar da gangara mai laushi, ko benches, tsakanin dutsen. Duwatsun suna janyewa kuma a ƙarshe an yanke su daga babban dutse, ko tudu, ta hanyar sapping. Lokacin da gefen dutsen bai koma baya daidai ba amma a maimakon haka an yi amfani da shi ta hanyar raƙuman ruwa masu narkewa, ana iya yanke wani sashi daga babban dutsen, don samar da mesa.[[9]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tebur#cite_note-Easterbrook2-9)

Basal sapping yana faruwa ne yayin da ruwa ke gudana a kusa da yadudduka na [dutse](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Butte "Butte") na mesa ya lalata yadudduka masu laushi, ko dai a matsayin runoff daga saman mesa ko daga ruwan kasa da ke motsawa ta hanyar yadudduka da ke sama, wanda ke haifar da raguwa da kwarara na shale. Yayin da shale na ƙasa ya lalace, ba zai iya tallafawa shimfidar dutsen da ke sama ba, wanda ya rushe kuma ya koma baya. Lokacin da caprock ya ɓace har zuwa inda kawai kaɗan ya rage, an san shi da butte.

Yankin canji a kan 2 kilometres (1.2 mi), wanda aka sani da filin da aka yi amfani da shi, yana tsakanin tsaunuka masu tsawo da ƙananan tsaunuka. Ƙananan ƙasashen suna nuna tsaunuka masu tsawo da [maɓalli](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tsauni "Tsauni"). An raba mesa da maɓallan ta hanyar shimfiɗa ƙasa mai laushi. Ana zaton sun samo asali ne daga tsarin lalacewar kankara daga ƙasa ko tushen yanayi. Mesas da knobs suna raguwa da girma tare da karuwar nesa daga tsaunuka masu tsawo. Sauye-sauyen tsaunuka sun kasance daga kusan 2 zuwa 100 metres (330 ft) dangane da nisan da suke daga tsaunin.

text:
# Najeriya


_**Nigeria w1 locator**_


tutar najeriya


manuniyar najeriya


babban birnin najeriya


crisis a najeriya


Sojan Nigeria 

'**[Najeriya](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Najeriya);'** (/nadʒɪəriyə/) ko **Nijeriya** (/niˈdʒɪəriyə/) da ([turanci](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Turanci "Turanci"): _Nigeria_): A Gwamnatance **Tarayyar [Najeriya](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Najeriya)** ƙasa ce da take a [Afirka](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Afirka_ta_Yamma "Afirka ta Yamma")[ta](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Afirka_ta_Yammah?action=edit&redlink=1 "Afirka ta Yammah (babu wannan shafin)") yamma.[[1]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nijeriya#cite_note-1)[[2]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nijeriya#cite_note-2)[[3]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nijeriya#cite_note-3) Tana da iyaka da ƙasar [Nijar](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nijar "Nijar") daga [Arewa](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Arewa "Arewa"), da [Chadi](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cadi "Cadi") daga Arewa maso gabas da [Kamaru](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kamaru "Kamaru") daga gabas da [Benin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Benin "Benin") daga yammah, daga kudanci kuma tana a gaɓar [Tekun Atlantika](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tekun_Atalanta "Tekun Atalanta").[[4]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nijeriya#cite_note-4)[[5]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nijeriya#cite_note-5)[[6]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nijeriya#cite_note-6) Jamhuriyar Tarayyar [Najeriya](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Najeriya) ta ƙunshi Jihohi guda (36) tare da _Babban Birnin_ Tarayya [Abuja](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Abuja "Abuja") inda fadar [shugaban ƙasar](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shugaban_kasa "Shugaban kasa") wato "villa" take.[[7]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nijeriya#cite_note-:0-7)[[8]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nijeriya#cite_note-8)[[9]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nijeriya#cite_note-9)

[Abuja](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lagos_(birni) "Lagos (birni)") tana ɗaya daga cikin manyan bira ne a [duniya](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Duniya "Duniya").[[10]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nijeriya#cite_note-10)[[11]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nijeriya#cite_note-11)[[12]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nijeriya#cite_note-12)


Shopping District


Shugaban Kasar Nijeriya

Najeriya ta kasance gida da dama ga ƴan asalin [turawa](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Turawa "Turawa") masu mulkin mallaka, jihohin da suka mallaka tunda (BC)[[13]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nijeriya#cite_note-13)[[14]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nijeriya#cite_note-14)[[15]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nijeriya#cite_note-15) tare da [Nok Wayewa](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Al'adar_Nok "Al'adar Nok") ta kasance ita ce karo na farko da Turawan mulkin mallaka suka fara mallakewa a [Yammacin Africa](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Yammacin_Africa "Yammacin Africa") a cikin ƙarni na sha biyar (15).[[16]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nijeriya#cite_note-16)[[17]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nijeriya#cite_note-17)[[18]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nijeriya#cite_note-18) A zamani jihar an samo asali da [Birtaniya](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Birtaniya "Birtaniya") a cikin karni na sha tara (19) yana ɗaukar yanayin na yanzu tare da haɗe yankin [Kudancin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kudanci "Kudanci")[Najeriya](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Najeriya) da kuma kare [Arewacin Najeriya](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Arewacin_Najeriya "Arewacin Najeriya") a cikin shekara ta alif dubu ɗaya da ɗari tara da goma sha huɗu (1914)[[19]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nijeriya#cite_note-19)[[20]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nijeriya#cite_note-20)[[21]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nijeriya#cite_note-21)[[22]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nijeriya#cite_note-22) ta [Lord Lugard](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Frederick_Lugard "Frederick Lugard"). Ingilishi ya kafa tsarin gudanarwa da na doka yayin aiwatar da mulkin kai tsaye ta hanyar shugabannin gargajiya.[[23]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nijeriya#cite_note-23)[[24]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nijeriya#cite_note-24)[[25]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nijeriya#cite_note-25) Najeriya, ta zama ƙasar tarayyar da ke da ƴanci kai tsaye a ranar (1)ga watan [Oktoba](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Oktoba "Oktoba"), shekara ta alif dubu ɗaya da ɗari tara da sittin (1960).[[26]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nijeriya#cite_note-26)[[27]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nijeriya#cite_note-27)[[28]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nijeriya#cite_note-28) Ta fuskanci yaƙin basasa daga shekara ta dubu ɗaya da ɗari tara da sittin da bakwai (1967) zuwa shekarar dubu ɗaya da ɗari tara da saba'in da bakwai (1977).[[29]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nijeriya#cite_note-29)[[30]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nijeriya#cite_note-30)[[31]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nijeriya#cite_note-31) Sannan a biyo bayan zaɓaɓɓun gwamnatocin farar hula da mulkin kama-karya na soja, har sai an sami tabbatacciyar [dimokuraɗiyya](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dimokura%C9%97iyya "Dimokuraɗiyya") a shekara ta alif dari tara da chasa'in da tara (1999) zaɓen shugaban ƙasa na shekara ta (2015)dubu biyu da sha biyar shi ne karo na farko da shugaban [ƙasa](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shugaban_Nijeriya "Shugaban Nijeriya") mai ci ya faɗi zaɓensa. [[32]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nijeriya#cite_note-32)[[33]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nijeriya#cite_note-33)[[34]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nijeriya#cite_note-34)

Najeriya; tafi Ko wace ƙasa yawan al'ummah acikin nahiyar Afrika, ƙasa ce Kuma mai yawan al’umma da ke zaune sama da ƙabilu guda ɗari biyu da sittin 260.[[35]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nijeriya#cite_note-35)[[36]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nijeriya#cite_note-36)[[37]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nijeriya#cite_note-37) waɗanda ke magana [[Harsunan Najeriya|da yarurruka daban daban guda ɗari biyar (500) dukkansu suna ɗauke da al'adu iri daban daban. Manyan ƙabilun guda uku su ne; [Hausa – Fulani](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hausa%E2%80%93Fulani "Hausa–Fulani") a [Arewa](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Arewacin_Najeriya "Arewacin Najeriya"), [Yarbawa](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Yarbawa "Yarbawa") a [Yamma](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kasar_Yarbawa "Kasar Yarbawa"), da kuma [Igbo](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Inyamurai "Inyamurai") a gabas, waɗanda suka hada da kashi sittin (60%) na yawan mutanen. Yaren [hukuma](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Harshen_gwamnati?action=edit&redlink=1 "Harshen gwamnati (babu wannan shafin)") shi ne [Ingilishi](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/English_cricket_team_in_the_West_Indies_in_2008%E2%80%9309 "English cricket team in the West Indies in 2008–09"),[[38]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nijeriya#cite_note-38)[[39]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nijeriya#cite_note-39)[[40]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nijeriya#cite_note-40) wanda aka zaɓa don sauƙaƙe haɗin harshe a matakin ƙasa. Tsarin mulkin Nijeriya ya tabbatar da ƴancin yin addini kuma ƙasa ce dake ɗauke da al’ummar musulmai da kirista, a lokaci guda. [Najeriya](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Najeriya) ta kasu kashi biyu tsakanin [musulmai](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Musulmi "Musulmi"), waɗanda yawanci ke zaune a arewacin ƙasar, da kuma [kiristoci](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kirista "Kirista"),[[41]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nijeriya#cite_note-41)[[42]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nijeriya#cite_note-42)[[43]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nijeriya#cite_note-43) waɗanda yawanci ke zaune a kudancin ƙasar, tare da ƴan tsirarun da ke yin addinin asali, kamar waɗanda ke cikin ƙabilar Igbo da kuma yarbawa.[[44]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nijeriya#cite_note-44)[[45]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nijeriya#cite_note-45)[[46]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nijeriya#cite_note-46)


Bola Ahmed Tinubu shugaban ƙasar na yanzu

Najeriya ,ita ce ƙasa mafi yawan mutane a [Afirka](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Afirka "Afirka") kuma ƙasa ta bakwai mafi yawan mutane a duniya,[[47]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nijeriya#cite_note-47)[[48]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nijeriya#cite_note-48)[[49]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nijeriya#cite_note-49) tare da kimanin mutane miliyan ɗari biyu da shida (2,00,000,006). Tattalin arzikinta shine mafi girma a [Afirka](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Afirka "Afirka"), kuma shi ne na ashirin da shida (26)[[50]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nijeriya#cite_note-50)[[51]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nijeriya#cite_note-51)[[52]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nijeriya#cite_note-52) mafi girma a duniya ta hanyar GDP maras faɗi, kuma na ashirin da biyar (25), mafi girma daga PPP. Najeriya galibi ana ƙiranta da "Giant of Africa", ma'ana ƙarfin [Afrika](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Afirka "Afirka") saboda yawan jama'a da tattalin arziƙinta, [kuma bankin duniya](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bankin_Duniya "Bankin Duniya") yana dauƙarta a matsayin [kasuwa](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kasuwa_masu_tasowa?action=edit&redlink=1 "Kasuwa masu tasowa (babu wannan shafin)") mai tasowa. Karamar yanki ce a cikin Afirka, matsakaiciyar ƙarfi a cikin al'amuran ƙasa da ƙasa, sannan kuma tana ɗaya daga cikin ƙasashe mafi yawan [al’umma a duniya](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gingara_karfi?action=edit&redlink=1 "Gingara karfi (babu wannan shafin)").[[53]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nijeriya#cite_note-53)[[54]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nijeriya#cite_note-54)[[55]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nijeriya#cite_note-55) Koyaya ƙasar tana ƙasa sosai a cikin jerin ƙasashen duniya, kuma har yanzu tana ɗaya daga cikin ƙasashe masu rashawa a duniya. Najeriya memba ce ta kafuwar tarayyar [Afirka](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Afirka "Afirka"), kuma memba ce a ƙungiyoyin ƙasa da ƙasa da dama, waɗanda suka haɗa da [Majalisar Ɗinkin Duniya](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Majalisar_Dinkin_Duniya "Majalisar Dinkin Duniya"), ƙungiyar ƙasashen Yammacin Africa ([ECOWAS)](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/ECOWAS "ECOWAS") ƙungiyar ƙasashe masu arziƙin man fetur, ([OPEC](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/OPEC "OPEC")) kuma memba ce na yau da kullum a gamayyar [MINT](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/MINT_(tattalin_arziki) "MINT (tattalin arziki)"), kuma tana ɗaya daga cikin ƙasashe goma sha ɗaya masu tashen ƙaruwan tattalin arziƙi wato "[Next Eleven](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sha_dayan_gaba_%22Next_Eleven%22?action=edit&redlink=1 "Sha dayan gaba \"Next Eleven\" (babu wannan shafin)")".[[56]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nijeriya#cite_note-56)[[57]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nijeriya#cite_note-57)[[58]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nijeriya#cite_note-58)

## Kirkira:

[[gyara sashe](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Najeriya&veaction=edit&section=1 "Gyara sashe: Kirkira:") | [gyara masomin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Najeriya&action=edit&section=1 "Edit section's source code: Kirkira:")]

Sunan _[Nijeriya](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/Nigeria "wiktionary:Nigeria")_ an dauke shi daga Kogin [Neja](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Neja_(kogi) "Neja (kogi)") wanda ya ratsa kasar.[[59]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nijeriya#cite_note-59)[[60]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nijeriya#cite_note-60)[[61]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nijeriya#cite_note-61) Wannan sunan ya samo asali ne a ranar takwas (8), ga watan Janairun shekara ta (1897) dan jaridar Ingila [Flora Shaw](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Flora_Shaw,_Lady_Lugard "Flora Shaw, Lady Lugard"), wanda daga baya ya auri [Lord Lugard](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Frederick_Lugard "Frederick Lugard"), mai kula da mulkin mallaka na Burtaniya.[[62]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nijeriya#cite_note-62)[[63]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nijeriya#cite_note-63)[[64]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nijeriya#cite_note-64)[Nijar](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nijar "Nijar") da ke makwabtaka da ita sun samo sunan daga wannan kogin.[[65]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nijeriya#cite_note-65)[[66]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nijeriya#cite_note-66)[[67]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nijeriya#cite_note-67) Asalin sunan _Nijar_, wanda asali ana amfani da shi ne kawai zuwa tsakiyar Kogin Neja, ba tabbas. Watakila kalmar ta canza sunan [Tuareg](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Buzaye "Buzaye")_egerew n-iger ewen_ da mazauna ke amfani da shi a tsakiyar kogin da ke kusa da [Timbuktu](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Timbuktu "Timbuktu") kafin mulkin mallaka na Turai na karni na (19). [[68]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nijeriya#cite_note-68)[[69]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nijeriya#cite_note-69)[[70]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nijeriya#cite_note-70)

## Tarihi:

[[gyara sashe](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Najeriya&veaction=edit&section=2 "Gyara sashe: Tarihi:") | [gyara masomin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Najeriya&action=edit&section=2 "Edit section's source code: Tarihi:")]


Babban Bankin Nigeria.


Shugaban kasan najeriya(bola ahmad tinubu)

Tarihi, ya nuna cewar [Nijeriya](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Najeriya_a_1960 "Najeriya a 1960") dadaddar kasa ce, kuma tarihi yanuna kasar na nan tun a shekara ta (**500),**[[71]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nijeriya#cite_note-71)[[72]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nijeriya#cite_note-72)[[73]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nijeriya#cite_note-73) kafin haihuwar Yesu Almasihu wato Annabi Isah (A.S) a wannan lokaci suka samata suna [Kasar Hausa](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kasar_Hausa "Kasar Hausa").[[74]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nijeriya#cite_note-74)[[75]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nijeriya#cite_note-75)[[76]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nijeriya#cite_note-76) Addinin musulunci ya shiga Kasar [Hausa](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hausawa "Hausawa") ne tun a karni na goma sha uku (13) miladiya.[[77]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nijeriya#cite_note-77)[[78]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nijeriya#cite_note-78)[[79]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nijeriya#cite_note-79) a karshen karni na goma sha daya (11) zuwa tsakiyar karni na goma sha hudu (14) miladiya. Kanem Barno suka mamaye Kasar Hausa, kuma Fulani sun mamaye Kasar [Hausa](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hausa "Hausa") a farkon karni na goma sha tara (19) miladiya har zuwan Turawan Mulkin Mallaka suka mamaye [Lagos](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lagos "Lagos") a shekara ta [(1881](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/1881?action=edit&redlink=1 "1881 (babu wannan shafin)")) miladiyya, ana cikin [Yakin duniya](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Yakin_duniya_I?action=edit&redlink=1 "Yakin duniya I (babu wannan shafin)") na farko sai Turawan Mulkin Mallaka suka karo sojojin ruwa saboda suna tsoran Jamusawa da ke Kamaru kada sumamaye Najeriya, amma mulkin Najeriya na farko a hannun Turawan [Portugal](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Portugal "Portugal").[[80]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nijeriya#cite_note-80)[[81]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nijeriya#cite_note-81)[[82]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nijeriya#cite_note-82) A shekara ta dubu daya da dari takwas da tamanin da biyar [(1885)](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/1885?action=edit&redlink=1 "1885 (babu wannan shafin)") sai Turawan [Birtaniya](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Birtaniya "Birtaniya") suka mamaye duk fadin Nijeria har zuwa Daya (1) ga watan oktoba, 1960. Nijeriya ta samu 'yancin kanta daga Turawan Biritaniya.[[83]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nijeriya#cite_note-83)[[84]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nijeriya#cite_note-84)[[85]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nijeriya#cite_note-85)

## Tsarin Mulki:

[[gyara sashe](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Najeriya&veaction=edit&section=4 "Gyara sashe: Tsarin Mulki:") | [gyara masomin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Najeriya&action=edit&section=4 "Edit section's source code: Tsarin Mulki:")]


Muhammadu Buhari Tsohon Shugaban Najeriya.

A shekara ta [(1966](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/1966?action=edit&redlink=1 "1966 (babu wannan shafin)")) zuwa shekara ta [(1979](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/1979 "1979")) sojoji ne ke da ikon a kan kasar, a shekara ta [(1979)](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/1979 "1979") a ka yi tsari wanda ya bawa talakawa ikon zaben gwamna. A shekara ta al [(1983](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/1983 "1983")) sojoji suka rushe wannan tsarin da juyin mulki har zuwa shekara ta [(1998](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/1998 "1998")) bayan rasuwar Sani Abacha, sai aka dawo da tsarin mulki na dimokaradiya aka bawa talakawa ikon zaben shugaban da suke so, a shekara ta alif dubu ɗaya da dari tara da casa'in da[(1999](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/1999 "1999")) aka yi zabe a kasa.[[86]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nijeriya#cite_note-86)[[87]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nijeriya#cite_note-87)[[88]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nijeriya#cite_note-88)[Obasanjo](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Olusegun_Obasanjo "Olusegun Obasanjo") ya lashe zabe ya zama shugaban kasa na farko wanda talaka suka zaba, ya hau karo na biyu har zuwa shekara ta dubu biyu da bakwai ([2007](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/2007 "2007"))a wannan shekara aka yi zabe, [Umaru Yar'Aduwa](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Umaru_Yar'Adua "Umaru Yar'Adua") ya lashe shi ne shugaban kasa a shekarar ta dubu biyu da sha daya (2011). Dukkansu sun fito daga jam'iyya daya ne, wato (jam'iyyar [PDP](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/PDP?action=edit&redlink=1 "PDP (babu wannan shafin)")).[[89]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nijeriya#cite_note-89)[[90]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nijeriya#cite_note-90)[[91]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nijeriya#cite_note-91) Umaru musa yar'aduwa ya rasu a shekara ta dubu biyu da tara (2009) matemakin sa Jonathan Goodluck ebele , ya cigaba da Mulki zuwa shekara ta dubu biyu da sha daya (2011).[[92]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nijeriya#cite_note-92)[[93]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nijeriya#cite_note-93)[[94]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nijeriya#cite_note-94) A yayin da a kayi zabe yalashe yacigaba da Mulki harzuwa she Kara ta dubu biyu da sha biyar (2015) yayin da a kayi zabe ta dubu biyu da sha biyar (2015) shugaban kasa wato General Muhammad Buhari yalashe zabe.[[95]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nijeriya#cite_note-95)[[96]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nijeriya#cite_note-96)[[97]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nijeriya#cite_note-97) Bayan shekara Tara wato yadda dimokiradiya ta tanadar ya sauka daga gadan Mulki she Kara ta dubu biyu da (2023), yabaiwa dan jam'iyarasa wato Bola Ahmad Tunubu Wanda yanzu shiyake rike da mulkin kasar Najeriya.[[7]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nijeriya#cite_note-:0-7)[[98]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nijeriya#cite_note-98)[[99]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nijeriya#cite_note-99)

title: Hausawa
text: # Hausawa Hausawa, a cikin shekaru dari biyar (500) da suka gabata a baya, sun ratsa babban yankin [Afirka](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Afirka "Afirka") a duk ƙusurwoyi guda huɗu (4) saboda dalilai daban-daban daga aikin soja, cinikayya mai nisa, farauta, yin [Hajji](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Aikin_Hajji "Aikin Hajji"), tserewa daga sarakunan hauka masu zalunci da kuma yaɗa addinin Islama. Saboda yawancin masu magana a cikin harshen Hausawa Musulmai ne, da yawa sun yi ƙoƙari su fara aikin hajji, abin da ake buƙata ga duk Musulman da suka iya halarta. A kan hanyar zuwa ko dawowa daga yankin Hijaz, mutane da yawa sun zauna, sau da yawa suna zama 'yan asalin ƙasar har zuwa wani mataki. Misali, yawancin Hausawa a Saudi Arabia sun bayyana kansu a matsayin Hausa da Afro-Arab.[[1]](#cite_note-:3-1) A cikin duniyar Larabawa, sunan mahaifiyar "Hausawi" (wanda aka rubuta "Hawsawi") alama ce ta kakannin Hausawa. Ƙasar mutanen Hausa ita ce ("Kasar Hausa"), wanda ke cikin arewacin Najeriya da Kudancin Nijar. Ana samun mutanen Hausawa a ko'ina, a cikin Afirka da Yammacin Asiya. Malami a Cambridge Charles Henry Robinson ya rubuta a shekarar 1890, cewa "Za a sami mazaunan mutanen Hausa a Alexandria, Tripoli, Tunis".[and]   Teburan da ke ƙasa yana nuna rarraba yawan kabilun Hausa ta ƙasar asali, a waje da [Najeriya](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Najeriya "Najeriya") da Nijar: [[2]](#cite_note-:4-2)[[3]](#cite_note-3) ## Tarihi [Daura](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Daura "Daura"), a arewacin [Najeriya](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Najeriya "Najeriya"), ita ce birni mafi tsufa a [Hausaland](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hausa_Bakwai "Hausa Bakwai"). Hausa na [Gobir](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gobir "Gobir"), kuma a arewacin Najeriya, suna magana da tsohuwar yaren gargajiya na yaren Hausa.[[7]](#cite_note-7) A tarihi, Katsina ita ce cibiyar ilimin Islama ta Hausa amma daga baya Sokoto ta maye gurbin ta daga karni na 19 Usman Dan Fodio [Musulunci](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Musulunci "Musulunci").[[8]](#cite_note-8) Hausawa a al'adu da tarihi sun fi kusanci da sauran kabilun [Sahel](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sahel "Sahel"), musamman [Fulani](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fulani "Fulani") ; [Zarma](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Zabarmawa "Zabarmawa") da [Songhai](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mutanen_Songhai "Mutanen Songhai") (a [Tillabery](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tillabéri_(gari) "Tillabéri (gari)"), [Tahoua](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tahoua_(gari) "Tahoua (gari)") da [Dosso](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Masarautar_Dosso "Masarautar Dosso") a [Nijar](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nijar_(ƙasa) "Nijar (ƙasa)") ); Larabawan [Kanuri](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ƙabilar_Kanuri "Ƙabilar Kanuri") da [Shuwa](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shuwa_Arab "Shuwa Arab") (a [Chadi](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cadi "Cadi"), [Sudan](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sudan "Sudan") da arewa maso gabashin Najeriya); [Abzinawa](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Buzaye "Buzaye") (a [Agadez](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Agadez "Agadez"), [Maradi](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Maradi "Maradi") da [Zinder](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Zinder "Zinder") ); [Gur](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Harsunan_Gur "Harsunan Gur") da [Gonja](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mutanen_Gonja "Mutanen Gonja") (a arewa maso gabashin [Ghana](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ghana "Ghana"), [Burkina Faso](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Burkina_Faso "Burkina Faso"), arewacin [Togo](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Togo "Togo") da [Benin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Benin "Benin") ta sama); [Gwari](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gbagyi "Gbagyi") (a tsakiyar Najeriya); da [Mandinka](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mutanen_Mandé "Mutanen Mandé"), Bambara, [Dioula](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mutanen_Dyula "Mutanen Dyula") da [Soninke](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mutanen_Soninke "Mutanen Soninke") (a [Mali](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mali "Mali"), [Senegal](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Senegal "Senegal"), [Gambia](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gambiya "Gambiya"), [Ivory Coast](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ivory_Coast "Ivory Coast") da [Guinea](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gini "Gini") ). [ *abubuwan da ake bukata* ] Dukkanin wadannan kabilu daban-daban a cikin da kewayen kasar Hausa suna zaune ne a cikin faffadan faffadan kasashen [Sahel](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sahel "Sahel") da [Sahara](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sahara "Sahara") da Sudan, kuma sakamakon yanayin kasa da kuma rikice-rikicen da ake samu na hanyoyin kasuwanci na Afirka na gargajiya, makwabtan Hausawa ne suka rinjayi al'adunsu, kamar yadda TL Hodgkin ya yi nuni da cewa, "Babban fa'idar [Kano](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kano_(birni) "Kano (birni)") ita ce, kasuwanci da kasuwanci kusan kowane iyali yana da hannu. wani abu ne mai girma game da wannan masana'anta, wanda ya bazu zuwa arewa har zuwa Murzuk, Ghat har ma da [Tripoli](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tripoli "Tripoli"), zuwa Yamma, ba kawai zuwa [Timbuctu](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Timbuktu "Timbuktu") ba, amma a wani mataki har zuwa gabar Tekun [Atlantika](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Masarautar_Adamawa "Masarautar Adamawa"), ainihin mazaunan Arguin suna sanye da rigar da aka saka da rini a [Kano](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kano_(birni) "Kano (birni)") ; zuwa gabas, ko'ina cikin [Borno](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Masarautar_Borno "Masarautar Borno"), ... da kuma yankin kudu maso gabas. sutura." A cikin sheda karara ga da'awar T. L Hodgkin, al'ummar [Agadez](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Agadez "Agadez") da sahara na tsakiyar Nijar, Abzinawa da kungiyoyin Hausa ba su da bambanci da juna a cikin tufafin gargajiya; both wear the tagelmust and indigo [Babban Riga/Gandora](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Babbar_riga "Babbar riga") . Amma ƙungiyoyin biyu sun bambanta ta harshe, salon rayuwa da kuma fitattun dabbobi masu kaya (Abinawa suna amfani da [raƙuma](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Raƙumi "Raƙumi"), yayin da Hausawa ke hawan dawakai ). Sauran Hausawa sun yi tasiri a kan sauran kabilun kudu da makamantansu da makwabtansu na Sahel, wadanda suka yi tasiri sosai a al’adun wadannan kungiyoyi. Dokokin [Shari’ar](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shari'a "Shari'a") Musulunci sako-sako ne a cikin kasar Hausa, wanda duk wani malami ko malamin addinin Musulunci ya fahimce ] [ *wanda* a kasar Hausa aka sani da *mallam* ko *mallan* ko *malam* (duba Maulana ). Wannan hali na jam’i na kabilanci da alaƙar al’adu ya baiwa Hausawa damar zama ɗaya daga cikin yankuna mafi girma na ƙabilun [Bantu](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mutanen_Bantu "Mutanen Bantu") a Afirka. [[9]](#cite_note-9) A karni na 7, [tsaunin Dalla](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dutsen_Dala "Dutsen Dala") da ke [Kano](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kano_(birni) "Kano (birni)") ya kasance wurin da al’ummar Hausawa suka yi hijira daga [Gaya](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gaya_(Nijeriya) "Gaya (Nijeriya)") suka yi sana’ar karfe. [[10]](#cite_note-10) An kafa masarautun [Hausa Bakwai](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hausa_Bakwai "Hausa Bakwai") a cikin karni na bakwai zuwa na 11. Daga cikin wadannan, [Masarautar Daura](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kingdom_of_Daura?action=edit&redlink=1 "Kingdom of Daura (babu wannan shafin)") ita ce ta farko, kamar yadda labarin [Bayajidda](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bayajidda "Bayajidda") ya fada. Labarin Bayajidda sabon tunani ne a tarihin Hausawa wanda ya samu karbuwa da karbuwa a hukumance a karkashin gwamnatin Musulunci da cibiyoyi da aka kafa bayan jihadin Usman dan Fodio a shekara ta 1804. [ *abubuwan da ake bukata* ] Masarautar Hausa sun kasance ƙungiyoyin siyasa masu zaman kansu a yankin Arewacin Najeriya a yanzu . Jihohin birnin Hausa sun zama yankunan kudancin kudancin sahara na cinikin ayari. Kamar sauran garuruwa irin su Gao da Timbuktu da ke daular Mali, wadannan jihohin sun zama cibiyar kasuwanci mai nisa. ‘Yan kasuwan Hausawa a kowanne daga cikin wadannan garuruwan sun tattara kayayyakin kasuwanci daga cikin gida kamar fata, rini, kayan doki, makullai na karafa da goro daga yankin dajin damina zuwa kudu ta hanyar ciniki ko kai hari bayi. su (da haraji) sannan a tura su arewa zuwa garuruwan da ke kusa da Bahar Rum . [1] A karni na 12 miladiyya, Hausawa sun zama daya daga cikin manyan kasashen Afirka masu karfin kasuwanci, suna fafatawa da Kanem-Bornu da Daular Mali . [2] Abubuwan da aka fi fitar dasu sune fata, zinari, tufa, gishiri, goro, bayi, fatun dabbobi, da henna . Tabbas ciniki ya rinjayi addini. A karni na 14, addinin musulunci ya fara yaduwa a kasar Hausa domin malaman Wangara, malamai da 'yan kasuwa daga Mali da ma na Magrib sun kawo addinin tare da su. A farkon karni na 15, Hausa suna amfani da Rubutun Larabci da aka gyara da aka sani da *[ajami](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ajami "Ajami")* don yin rikodin yarensu. Hausa sun tattara rubuce-rubuce da yawa, mafi mashahuri shine Kano Chronicle . An gano rubuce-rubucen Hausa da yawa na zamani masu kama da rubuce-bucen Timbuktu da aka rubuta a cikin rubutun Ajami kwanan nan, wasu daga cikinsu suna kwatanta taurari da [kalandar](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hijira_kalanda "Hijira kalanda").[[11]](#cite_note-11) An gina Gobarau Minaret a karni na 15 a Katsina . Ginin mita 50 ne wanda ke tsakiyar birnin Katsina, babban birnin Jihar Katsina. Gobarau minaret, alama ce ta jihar, misali ne na farko na gine-ginen Islama a cikin birni wanda ke alfahari da kansa a matsayin muhimmiyar cibiyar ilmantarwa ta Islama. An yi imanin cewa minaret yana daya daga cikin gine-gine na farko na Yammacin Afirka kuma ya kasance gini mafi tsayi a Katsina. Asalin masallacin an danganta shi da kokarin masanin addinin Islama mai tasiri Sheikh Muhammad al-Maghili da Sultan Muhammadu Korau na Katsina. Al-Maghili ya fito ne daga garin Tlemcen a Aljeriya ta yanzu kuma ya koyar na ɗan lokaci a Katsina, wanda ya zama cibiyar ilmantarwa a wannan lokacin, lokacin da ya ziyarci garin a ƙarshen karni na 15 a lokacin mulkin Muhammadu Korau . Shi da Korau sun tattauna ra'ayin gina masallaci don zama cibiyar ayyukan ruhaniya da na ilimi. An tsara masallacin Gobarau kuma an gina shi don nuna salon gine-ginen Timbuktu. Ya zama muhimmiyar cibiyar ilmantarwa, yana jan hankalin malamai da dalibai daga nesa da ko'ina, kuma daga baya ya zama wani nau'in jami'a.[1] [Muhammad Rumfa](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Muhammad_Rumfa "Muhammad Rumfa") shi ne Sultan na Sultanate na Kano, wanda ke cikin [Jihar Kano](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kano_(jiha) "Kano (jiha)") ta zamani, [Arewacin Najeriya](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Yankin_Arewacin_Najeriya "Yankin Arewacin Najeriya") . Ya yi sarauta daga 1463 har zuwa 1499.[[12]](#cite_note-wwr-12) Daga cikin nasarorin Rumfa sun hada da fadada ganuwar birni, gina babban fadar, [Gidan Rumfa](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gidan_Rumfa "Gidan Rumfa"), inganta bayi zuwa mukamai na gwamnati da kuma kafa babban [Kasuwar Kurmi](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kasuwar_Kurmi "Kasuwar Kurmi"), wanda har yanzu ana amfani dashi a yau. Kasuwar Kurmi tana daga cikin tsofaffin kasuwannin gida mafi girma a Afirka. An yi amfani da shi a matsayin kasuwar kasa da kasa inda ake musayar kayayyakin Arewacin Afirka don kayayyakin cikin gida ta hanyar cinikin Sahara.[[13]](#cite_note-ReferenceA-13)[[14]](#cite_note-nhm-14) Muhammad Rumfa shi ne kuma ke da alhakin yawancin Musulunci na Kano, yayin da ya bukaci fitattun mazauna su tuba.[[14]](#cite_note-nhm-14) An yi imanin cewa Sarauniya [Zazzau](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kingdom_of_Zazzau?action=edit&redlink=1 "Kingdom of Zazzau (babu wannan shafin)")"(Amina)(ko Aminatu) ta mallaki Zazzau tsakanin karni na 15 da karni na 16 na tsawon shekaru 34. Amina tana da shekaru 16 lokacin da mahaifiyarta, Bakwa Turunku ta zama sarauniya kuma an ba ta taken gargajiya na *Magajiya*, girmamawa da 'ya'yan sarakuna suka ɗauka. Ta inganta kwarewarta ta soja kuma ta zama sananniya saboda jaruntakarta da ayyukan soja, yayin da aka yi bikin a cikin waƙa a matsayin "Amina, 'yar Nikatau, mace mai iyawa kamar namiji. " [[15]](#cite_note-15) An yaba wa Amina a matsayin mai kula da gine-gine wanda ya kirkiro ganuwar ƙasa mai ƙarfi da ke kewaye da birninta, wanda shine samfurin ganuwar da aka yi amfani da ita a duk jihohin Hausa. Daga baya ta gina yawancin wadannan ganuwar, wanda aka fi sani da ganuwar Amina ko ganuwar amina, a kusa da biranen da aka ci nasara. Manufofin nasarorin da ta samu sun kasance biyu: fadada al'ummarta fiye da iyakokinta na farko da kuma rage biranen da aka ci nasara zuwa matsayin mai mulki. Sultan [Muhammad Bello](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Muhammadu_Bello "Muhammadu Bello") na [Sokoto](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sokoto_(birni) "Sokoto (birni)") ya bayyana cewa, "Ta yi yaƙi a kan waɗannan ƙasashe kuma ta shawo kansu gaba ɗaya don mutanen Katsina su biya haraji a gare ta da mutanen Kano kuma... ta yi yaƙi da biranen [Bauchi](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bauchi_(birni) "Bauchi (birni)") har sai mulkinta ya kai teku a kudu da yamma. " Hakazalika, ta jagoranci sojojinta har zuwa [Kwararafa](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kwararafa "Kwararafa") da [Nupe](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Masarautar_Bida "Masarautar Bida") kuma, bisa ga Tarihin Kano, "Sarkin Nupe ya aiko mata (watau gimbiya) 40 da 10,000 kola nuts" [[16]](#cite_note-16) Daga 1804 zuwa 1808, Fulani, wani kabilanci na Musulunci na Afirka wanda ya mamaye Afirka ta Yamma kuma ya zauna a Hausaland tun farkon shekarun 1500, tare da goyon bayan manoman Hausa da aka riga aka zalunta sun tayar da harajin shanu da tsanantawa na addini a ƙarƙashin sabon sarki na Gobir, wanda magajinsa da mahaifinsa suka yarda da masu bisharar Musulmi har ma sun fi son babban malamin Musulmi na ranar, Sheikh Usman Dan Fodio wanda sabon sarki ya nemi kawo karshen rayuwarsa. Sheikh Usman Dan Fodio ya tsere daga Gobir kuma daga masallacinsa ya ayyana Jihad a kan sarkinsa da duk sarakunan daular Habe saboda zargin haɗama, arna, rashin adalci ga ajin manoma, amfani da haraji mai nauyi da keta ka'idodin dokar Sharia. Kamancin al'adun Fulani da Hausa a matsayin mutanen Sahelian, duk da haka, sun ba da damar haɗin kai tsakanin kungiyoyin biyu. Tun daga farkon karni na 20, ana rarraba waɗannan mutane a matsayin "Hausa-Fulani" a cikin Najeriya maimakon a matsayin ƙungiyoyi.[1] A zahiri, yawancin Fulani da ke zaune a yankunan Hausa ba za su iya magana da Fulfulde ba kuma suna magana da Hausa a matsayin yarensu na farko. Yawancin Fulani a yankin ba su bambanta kansu daga Hausa ba, saboda sun daɗe suna aure, suna da addinin Islama kuma fiye da rabin dukkan Fulani na Najeriya sun shiga cikin al'adun Hausa.[2] Mai kula da mulkin mallaka na Burtaniya Frederick Lugard ya yi amfani da kishiya tsakanin yawancin sarakuna a kudu da gwamnatin Sokoto ta tsakiya don magance yiwuwar kokarin karewa yayin da mutanensa suka yi tafiya zuwa babban birnin.[1] Yayin da Birtaniya ta kusanci birnin Sokoto, sabon Sultan Muhammadu Attahiru I shirya gaggawa na kare birnin kuma ya yi yaƙi da sojojin da ke ci gaba da jagorancin Burtaniya. Birtaniya sun fito da nasara, suna aika Attahiru I da dubban mabiya a kan hijra na Mahdi. A ranar 13 ga Maris, 1903 a babbar kasuwar Sokoto, Wazirin Halifa na karshe ya mika wuya ga mulkin kasar Ingila. Bature ya nada Muhammadu Attahiru II a matsayin sabon Halifa. [1] Lugard ya soke Halifanci, amma ya ci gaba da rike mukaman Sultan a matsayin matsayi na alama a cikin sabuwar tsarin tsaro na Arewacin Najeriya . [2] A cikin watan Yuni 1903, Birtaniya ta ci nasara da sauran sojojin Attahiru na I, wanda aka kashe a wani mataki ; A shekara ta 1906 aka kawo karshen turjiya da turawan ingila da mamayar Hadejia da kuma rasuwar Sarki Muhammadu Mai Shahada na Hadejia a matsayin masarauta ta karshe da ke daular Sokoto. [3] An raba yankin daular Sokoto tsakanin turawan Ingila, Faransanci da Jamusawa karkashin sharuddan taron Berlin . [4] Birtaniya ta kafa Arewacin Najeriya Protectorate don gudanar da yankin, wanda ya hada da mafi yawan daular Sokoto da masarautanta mafi muhimmanci.[1] A karkashin Lugard, an ba da sarakuna daban-daban ikon cin gashin kansu na gida, don haka suna riƙe da yawancin ƙungiyar siyasa ta Khalifancin Sokoto.[2] An bi da yankin Sokoto a matsayin wani masarauta a cikin Protectorate na Najeriya. Saboda ba a taɓa haɗa shi da hanyar jirgin ƙasa ba, ya zama mai banƙyama a tattalin arziki da siyasa.[3] Sultan na Sokoto ya ci gaba da kasancewa a matsayin muhimmin matsayi na ruhaniya da addini na musulmi; an ci gaba da fahimtar alaƙar zuriya da dan Fodio. Ɗaya daga cikin manyan Sultans shine Siddiq Abubakar III, wanda ya rike mukamin shekaru 50 daga 1938 zuwa 1988. An san shi da karfi mai tabbatarwa a siyasar Najeriya, musamman a 1966 bayan kisan [Ahmadu Bello](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ahmadu_Bello "Ahmadu Bello"), Firayim Ministan Arewacin Najeriya.[[17]](#cite_note-Falola-17) Bayan gina Tsarin jirgin kasa na Najeriya, wanda ya kai daga Legas a 1896 zuwa Ibadan a 1900 da Kano a 1911, Hausa na arewacin Najeriya sun zama manyan masu samar da groundnuts. Sun ba da mamaki ga hukumomin Burtaniya, waɗanda suka yi tsammanin Hausa za su juya zuwa samar da auduga. Hausa suna da isasshen ƙwarewar aikin gona don fahimtar auduga yana buƙatar ƙarin ma'aikata kuma farashin Turai da aka bayar don groundnuts sun fi kyau fiye da waɗanda ke cikin auduga. "A cikin shekaru biyu manoma na Hausaland suna samar da tan da yawa na groundnuts cewa hanyar jirgin kasa ba ta iya jimre da zirga-zirga ba. A sakamakon haka, 'yan kasuwa na Turai a Kano dole ne su adana jaka na groundnots a kan tituna. " (Shillington 338). Hukumomin mulkin mallaka na Burtaniya da Faransa ne suka aiwatar da rubutun Boko kuma suka sanya haruffa na hukuma a cikin 1930.[1] Boko haruffa ce ta Latin da ake amfani da ita don rubuta Harshen Hausa. Mutanen Turai ne suka kirkiro boko na farko a farkon karni na 19, kuma sun bunkasa a farkon karni nke 20 ta hanyar Burtaniya (yawanci) da hukumomin mulkin mallaka na Faransa.[2] Tun daga shekarun 1950, boko ya kasance babban haruffa na Hausa.[3] Ana amfani da rubutun Larabci (ajami) yanzu kawai a makarantun Islama da kuma wallafe-wallafen Islama. A yau miliyoyin mutanen da ke magana da harshen Hausa, waɗanda zasu iya karatu da rubutu a cikin Ajami kawai, gwamnatin Najeriya tana ɗaukar su marasa karatu.[4] Duk da haka, Hausa Ajami yana nan a kan takardun banki na Naira. A cikin shekara ta 2014, a cikin wani yunkuri mai rikitarwa, an cire Ajami daga sabon takardar kudi na 100 Naira.[5] Duk da haka, Hausa sun kasance masu mahimmanci a [Nijar](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nijar_(ƙasa) "Nijar (ƙasa)") da [Arewacin Najeriya](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Yankin_Arewacin_Najeriya "Yankin Arewacin Najeriya"). ## Ƙungiyoyin mutanen Hausa Hausas a cikin ƙayyadadden ma'ana 'yan asalin Kasar Hausa (Hausaland) ne waɗanda ake samu a Yammacin Afirka. A cikin Hausa, an yi bambanci tsakanin ƙananan rukuni uku: Habe, Hausa-Fulani (Kado), da Banza ko Banza 7. ## Halitta Dangane da binciken Y-DNA na Hassan et al. (2008), kusan kashi 40.7% na Hausa a [Sudan](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sudan "Sudan") suna ɗauke da ƙungiyar haplogroup ta Yammacin Eurasia R-M173 (R1) tare da maye gurbin P25. Sauran sun fito ne daga zuriyar iyaye daban-daban na Afirka: 15.6% B-M60 (B) , 15.6% E-M33 (E1a) , 12.5% A-M13 (A1b1b2b) da 12.5% E-M2 (E1b1a1) . Ɗaya daga cikin mutane 32 da aka gwada (3.1%) na E-M78 (E1b1b1a1) [bayanin kula 2]. Wani B da aka yi kwanan nan a kan Hausa na [Arewa](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Arewa_(Najeriya) "Arewa (Najeriya)") (Northern Nigeria) ya nuna irin wannan sakamako: 47% [E1b1b](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/E1b1b?action=edit&redlink=1 "E1b1b (babu wannan shafin)")" id="mwAs0" rel="mw:WikiLink" title="E1b1a">E1b1a, 5% E1b1, 21% sauran Haplogroup E (E-M33, E-M75...), 18% R-M173 (R1) da 9% B. [[21]](#cite_note-Cole-Showers-21) Dangane da asalin gaba ɗaya, binciken DNA na autosomal na Tishkoff et al. (2009) ya sami Hausawa suna da alaƙa da mutanen Nilo-Sahara daga [Chadi](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cadi "Cadi") da [Sudan ta Kudu](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sudan_ta_Kudu "Sudan ta Kudu"). Wannan yana nuna cewa Hausa da sauran mutanen da ke magana da harshen Chadic na zamani sun fara magana da yarukan Nilo-Sahara, kafin su karɓi harsuna daga dangin Afroasiatic bayan ƙaura zuwa wannan yankin dubban shekaru da suka gabata: [[22]](#cite_note-Tishkoff-22) Daga K = 5-13, duk mutanen da ke magana da Nilo-Sahara daga kudancin Sudan, da Chadi tare da mutanen da ke zaune a tsakiyar Afirka da Asiya (Hoto S15). Wadannan sakamakon sun dace da bayanan harshe da na archaeological, suna ba da shawarar yiwuwar kakanninmu na Nilo-Sahara daga asalin gabashin Sudanese a cikin shekaru 105,500 da suka gabata, tare da ƙaura ta biyu zuwa yamma zuwa Tafkin Chadi da kudu zuwa kudancin Sudan na zamani, da ƙaura na baya-bayan nan zuwa gabas zuwa Kenya da Tanzania ≈3,000 ya (yana ba da damar tashi ga masu magana da Kudancin Nilotic) da yamma zuwa Chadi ≈2,500 ya (yana haifar da masu magana da tsakiya na Sudan) (S62, S67, S54). Wani ƙaura da aka tsara na masu magana da harshen Afroasiatic na Cathar ≈7,000 ya daga tsakiyar Sahara zuwa cikin Tafkin Chadi na iya haifar da yawancin mutanen yammacin Nilo-Saharans su sauya zuwa yarukan Chadic (S99). Bayananmu sun nuna cewa wannan canjin bai kasance tare da adadi mai yawa na kwayar halitta ta Afroasiatic16 ba. Binciken mtDNA yana ba da shaida don bambancin ≈8,000 ya na bambancin mtDNA wanda ke cikin manyan mitar a cikin al'ummomin Chadic kuma yana ba da shawarar asalin Gabashin Afirka ga yawancin zuriyar mtDNA a cikin waɗannan al'ummomi (S100). [[22]](#cite_note-Tishkoff-22) Wani binciken da aka yi daga shekarar 2019 wanda ya gano maza 218 da ba su da alaƙa da su daga kabilun [Ibo](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Inyamurai "Inyamurai"), Hausa da [Yoruba](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Yarbawa "Yarbawa") ta amfani da nazarin X-STR, ya gano cewa yayin nazarin alaƙar kwayar halitta, ba a gano bambance-bambance masu mahimmanci ba. Ya goyi bayan daidaito na kabilun Najeriya don alamun X-chromosome.[[23]](#cite_note-23) A cikin 2024, takarda ta sami daidaituwa a cikin Yoruba, Igbo da Hausa a Najeriya don X-Chromosomes (mtDNA). Koyaya, an sami bambance-bambance a cikin Hausa don Y-Chromosome, inda suke da ƙarin zuriyar uba da ke da alaƙa da masu magana da Afirka-Asia, yayin da Yoruba da Igbo suna da alaƙa ta uba da sauran kungiyoyin da ke magana da Nijar-Congo.[[24]](#cite_note-:2-24) Musamman, a cikin maza 135 na Yoruba da 134 na Igbo, an ga E-M2 a babban adadin 90%. Sabanin haka, maza 89 na Hausa suna da E-M2 a 43%, da kuma mitoci na R1b-V88 a 32%, A 9%, E1a 6%, B 5%, da kuma wani 5% da aka yi da wasu layin.[[24]](#cite_note-:2-24) ## Al'adu Ayyukan [al'adu](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Al'ada "Al'ada") Hausa suna da ban sha'awa a [Najeriya](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Najeriya "Najeriya") kuma sun tsayayya da gwajin lokaci saboda al'adu masu ƙarfi, girman kai na al'adu da kuma ingantaccen tsarin gwamnati na mulkin mallaka. Har ila yau, akwai manyan al'ummomin Hausa a kowane babban birni na Afirka a cikin unguwanni da ake kira *zango* ko *zongo*, ma'ana " sansanin caravan" a cikin Hausa (yana nuna asalin Kasuwanci waɗannan al'ummomi).[[1]](#cite_note-:1-25) Yawancin masu magana da Hausa, ba tare da la'akari da kabilanci ba, [Musulmai](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Musulmi "Musulmi") ne; Hausa sau da yawa yana aiki a matsayin harshen magana tsakanin [Musulmai](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Musulmi "Musulmi") a yankunan da ba na Hausa ba.
