title: Washington, D.C.
text:
# Washington, D.C.


Humboldtreise Washington DC.jpg

**Washington, D.C.**, ada ana kiranta da **District of Columbia** anfi saninta da **Washington** ko **D.C.**, itace [Babban birnin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Babban_birnin?action=edit&redlink=1 "Babban birnin (babu wannan shafin)") ƙasar [Tarayyar Amurka](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tarayyar_Amurka "Tarayyar Amurka").[[1]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Washington,_D.C.#cite_note-1) Ankirkire ta bayan [amuruka juyin juya hali](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Amuruka_juyin_juya_hali?action=edit&redlink=1 "Amuruka juyin juya hali (babu wannan shafin)") amatsayin fadar gwamnatin sabuwar, sunan Washington ansa sane bayan sunan [George Washington](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/George_Washington "George Washington"), [Shugaban Farko Na Tarayyar Amurka](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shugaban_Farko_Na_Tarayyar_Amurka?action=edit&redlink=1 "Shugaban Farko Na Tarayyar Amurka (babu wannan shafin)") kuma [Wadanda suka Kafa Tarayyar Amurka](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wadanda_suka_Kafa_Tarayyar_Amurka?action=edit&redlink=1 "Wadanda suka Kafa Tarayyar Amurka (babu wannan shafin)").[[2]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Washington,_D.C.#cite_note-2) Amatsayin ta na fadar [Gwamnatin Tarayyar Amurka](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gwamnatin_Tarayyar_Amurka?action=edit&redlink=1 "Gwamnatin Tarayyar Amurka (babu wannan shafin)") da kuma ma'aikatu na duniya da dama, Washington nada muhimmanci a [duniyar siyasa babbar birnin kasal](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Caput_mundi?action=edit&redlink=1 "Caput mundi (babu wannan shafin)").[[3]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Washington,_D.C.#cite_note-3) Birnin na daya daga cikin mafi yawan ziyarta a duniya, fiye da mutane (masu yawon bude ido) miliyan 20, ne ke ziyartar birnin a duk shekara.[[4]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Washington,_D.C.#cite_note-4)[[5]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Washington,_D.C.#cite_note-5)


Babban Dakin Karatu na Washington DC

Sa hannun da akayi na [Residence Act](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Residence_Act?action=edit&redlink=1 "Residence Act (babu wannan shafin)") acikin watan Julin 16,shekara ta 1790, ita ta amince da kafa [capital district](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Capital_districts_and_territories?action=edit&redlink=1 "Capital districts and territories (babu wannan shafin)") yakasance a [Potomac River](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Potomac_River?action=edit&redlink=1 "Potomac River (babu wannan shafin)") a gabar kasar na [East Coast](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/East_Coast_of_the_United_States?action=edit&redlink=1 "East Coast of the United States (babu wannan shafin)"). Kundin [Tsarin mulkinn](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tsarin_mulkin?action=edit&redlink=1 "Tsarin mulkin (babu wannan shafin)") kasar yasamar da [federal district](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Federal_district?action=edit&redlink=1 "Federal district (babu wannan shafin)") a karkashin [exclusive jurisdiction](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/District_of_Columbia_home_rule?action=edit&redlink=1 "District of Columbia home rule (babu wannan shafin)") na [U.S. Congress](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/U.S._Congress?action=edit&redlink=1 "U.S. Congress (babu wannan shafin)"), da kuma cewar District din kafa yakasance bangaren kowace jiha. The states of [Maryland](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Maryland "Maryland") and [Virginia](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Virginia "Virginia") each donated land to form the federal district, which included the pre-existing settlements of [Georgetown](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Georgetown_(Washington,_D.C.)?action=edit&redlink=1 "Georgetown (Washington, D.C.) (babu wannan shafin)") and [Alexandria](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Alexandria,_Virginia?action=edit&redlink=1 "Alexandria, Virginia (babu wannan shafin)"). The City of Washington was founded in 1791, to serve as the new national capital. In 1846, Congress [returned the land originally ceded by Virginia](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/District_of_Columbia_retrocession?action=edit&redlink=1 "District of Columbia retrocession (babu wannan shafin)"); in 1871, it created a [single municipal government](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/District_of_Columbia_Organic_Act_of_1871?action=edit&redlink=1 "District of Columbia Organic Act of 1871 (babu wannan shafin)") for the remaining portion of the District.

Washington nada yawan Mutane da aka kiyasta kusan kimanin 702,455, as of Yuli 2018[[update]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Washington,_D.C.&action=edit),[[6]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Washington,_D.C.#cite_note-census2018-6) making it the [20th most-populous city in the United States](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_United_States_cities_by_population?action=edit&redlink=1 "List of United States cities by population (babu wannan shafin)"). [Commuters](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Commuters?action=edit&redlink=1 "Commuters (babu wannan shafin)") from the surrounding Maryland and Virginia suburbs raise the city's daytime population to more than one million during the workweek.[[7]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Washington,_D.C.#cite_note-U.S._Department_of_Commerce-7) The [Washington metropolitan area](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Washington_metropolitan_area?action=edit&redlink=1 "Washington metropolitan area (babu wannan shafin)"), of which the District is the [principal city](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Principal_city?action=edit&redlink=1 "Principal city (babu wannan shafin)"), had a 2017 estimated population of 6,216,589,[[8]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Washington,_D.C.#cite_note-PopEstCBSA-8) the [sixth-largest](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Table_of_United_States_Metropolitan_Statistical_Areas?action=edit&redlink=1 "Table of United States Metropolitan Statistical Areas (babu wannan shafin)")[metropolitan statistical area](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Metropolitan_statistical_area?action=edit&redlink=1 "Metropolitan statistical area (babu wannan shafin)") in the nation.

Dukkanin rassa uku na Gwamnatin Amurka nada cibiyoyinsu ne a the District: congress (legislative), president (executive), and the [U.S. Supreme Court](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/U.S._Supreme_Court?action=edit&redlink=1 "U.S. Supreme Court (babu wannan shafin)") (judicial). Washington is home to many national [monuments and museums](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_museums_in_Washington,_D.C.?action=edit&redlink=1 "List of museums in Washington, D.C. (babu wannan shafin)"), primarily situated on or around the [National Mall](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/National_Mall?action=edit&redlink=1 "National Mall (babu wannan shafin)"). The city hosts [177 foreign embassies](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_diplomatic_missions_in_Washington,_D.C.?action=edit&redlink=1 "List of diplomatic missions in Washington, D.C. (babu wannan shafin)") as well as the headquarters of many international organizations, trade unions, non-profit, lobbying groups, and professional associations, including the [World Bank Group](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/World_Bank_Group?action=edit&redlink=1 "World Bank Group (babu wannan shafin)"), the [International Monetary Fund](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/International_Monetary_Fund?action=edit&redlink=1 "International Monetary Fund (babu wannan shafin)") (IMF), the [Organization of American States](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Organization_of_American_States?action=edit&redlink=1 "Organization of American States (babu wannan shafin)"), [AARP](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/AARP?action=edit&redlink=1 "AARP (babu wannan shafin)"), the [National Geographic Society](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/National_Geographic_Society?action=edit&redlink=1 "National Geographic Society (babu wannan shafin)"), the [Human Rights Campaign](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Human_Rights_Campaign?action=edit&redlink=1 "Human Rights Campaign (babu wannan shafin)"), the [International Finance Corporation](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/International_Finance_Corporation?action=edit&redlink=1 "International Finance Corporation (babu wannan shafin)"), and the [American Red Cross](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/American_Red_Cross?action=edit&redlink=1 "American Red Cross (babu wannan shafin)").

A locally elected [mayor](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mayor_of_the_District_of_Columbia?action=edit&redlink=1 "Mayor of the District of Columbia (babu wannan shafin)") and a 13‑member [council](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Council_of_the_District_of_Columbia?action=edit&redlink=1 "Council of the District of Columbia (babu wannan shafin)") have governed the District since 1973. However, Congress maintains supreme authority over the city and may overturn local laws. D.C. residents elect a [non-voting](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/District_of_Columbia_voting_rights?action=edit&redlink=1 "District of Columbia voting rights (babu wannan shafin)"), at-large [congressional delegate](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Non-voting_members_of_the_United_States_House_of_Representatives?action=edit&redlink=1 "Non-voting members of the United States House of Representatives (babu wannan shafin)") to the [House of Representatives](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/United_States_House_of_Representatives?action=edit&redlink=1 "United States House of Representatives (babu wannan shafin)"), but the District has no representation in the [Senate](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/United_States_Senate?action=edit&redlink=1 "United States Senate (babu wannan shafin)"). The District receives three [electoral votes](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/United_States_Electoral_College?action=edit&redlink=1 "United States Electoral College (babu wannan shafin)") in presidential elections as permitted by the [Twenty-third Amendment to the United States Constitution](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Twenty-third_Amendment_to_the_United_States_Constitution?action=edit&redlink=1 "Twenty-third Amendment to the United States Constitution (babu wannan shafin)"), ratified in 1961.

# Tattaunawar user:Gwanki

Latest comment: [shekara 1 da ta gabata](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/User_talk:Abubakar_A_Gwanki#c-Abdultambura18-20241123181700-Ina_bukatar_adalci)1 comment 1 person in discussion

Sunana Abdulrahim Abdullahi Sani ina bukatar adalci a cikin wannan korafi nawa. Na kasance ina bada gudummuwa a cikin wannan man haja ta Hausa Wikipedia. Ina gyara da kuma kirkirar sababbin mukaloli. A iya sani na ina kiyaye duk wata doka ta kirkirar mukaloli sannan in sanya musu Manazarta kamar yadda doka tace. ## Invitation to Organize Feminism and Folklore 2024 Writing Competition

[[gyara masomin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Tattaunawar_user:Gwanki&action=edit&section=9 "Edit section's source code: Invitation to Organize Feminism and Folklore 2024 Writing Competition")]

_Kuyi ƙoƙarin fassara wannan saƙo zuwa Hausa_
Dear Gwanki,

Hope you are doing well, Wishing you a Happy New Year!.

We extend a heartfelt invitation to you to organize the **[Feminism and Folklore 2024](https://meta.wikimedia.org/wiki/Feminism%20and%20Folklore%202024 "m:Feminism and Folklore 2024")** writing competition, which is scheduled to take place from February 1, 2024, to March 31, 2024. This year's edition of Feminism and Folklore will concentrate on feminism, women's issues, and gender-focused topics, aligning with a Wiki Loves Folklore gender gap focus and featuring a folk culture theme on Wikipedia.

This year we have created two new Tools for the Feminism and Folklore project. The tool is called **Campwiz**. This tool is created by the international Tech team of Wiki Loves Folkore especially crafted for Feminism and Folklore project. The tool works as same as fountain or dashboard but has extra abilities required for jury and submission of articles.

To create a new campaign on Campwiz, organizers to follow these steps:

1.   Go to the tool link: https://tools.wikilovesfolklore.org/
2.   Select your wiki on which you want to organize the campaign (enter the name or short code, such as "ha" for Hausa Wikipedia).
3.   Give your campaign a name example "Feminism and Folklore 2024 on Hausa Wikipedia)".
4.   Select the start and end dates (note: keep your start date as Feb 1 and end date as March 31).
5.   Provide a description for your campaign (you can briefly describe the campaign in this section).
6.   Make sure to keep the checkboxes ticked for "Allow users to submit articles that were not created but expanded." if you want to use the campaign for expanded articles also.
7.   Keep minimum added bytes as 4000 and minimum added words as 400 and click next.
8.   In the jury section, keep the checkboxes ticked for "Allow jury members to participate in the campaign" and "Prevent jury members from seeing each other's votes." As per your preference.
9.   Under the jury search box, type the username of your jury and click on the "+" button to add; you can add multiple jury members.
10.   Click next to review and then click on save.

With this we have also created a **Missing article tool**. This tool identifies articles in the English Wikipedia that are absent from your native language Wikipedia. You can customize your selection criteria, and our tool will provide you with a table displaying the missing articles along with suggested titles. You also have the option to download the list in both CSV and wikitable formats.

Both tools, the Missing Article Tool and the Campwiz Tool, are now available for public use during the Feminism and Folklore campaign. You can find more information about these tools here: https://tools.wikilovesfolklore.org/

There are also some changes in the rules and criteria's. Please go through the rules below.

1.   **Minimum Length:** The expanded or new article should have a minimum of _**4000 bytes or 400 words**_, ensuring sufficient depth and coverage of the chosen topic. The local organizers are free to choose the minimum length criteria as per needs of their local Wikipedia and must be clearly mention on local project page.
2.   **Language Quality:** Articles should not be poorly machine-translated, ensuring that language quality and readability are maintained at a high standard.
3.   **Timeline of Creation or Expansion:** The article should be created or expanded between 1 February and 31 March, aligning with the specified contest timeline.
4.   **Theme Relevance**: Articles should directly address the theme of feminism and folklore, exploring connections between gender, cultural traditions, and intangible heritage.
5.   **No Orphaned Articles:** Articles must not be orphaned, meaning they should be linked from at least one other article to ensure visibility within the Wikipedia ecosystem.
6.   **No Copyright violations:** There should be no copyright violations, and articles should adhere to local Wikipedia policies on notability, ensuring that the content meets the standards for notability.
7.   **Adequate references and Citations:** Each article should include proper references and citations following local Wikipedia policies, ensuring the reliability and credibility of the information presented.

Learn more about the contest details and prizes on our project page [here](https://meta.wikimedia.org/wiki/Feminism%20and%20Folklore%202024 "m:Feminism and Folklore 2024"). Should you require any assistance, please feel free to contact us on our meta talk page or via email.

We eagerly anticipate your enthusiastic coordination and participation in Feminism and Folklore 2024.

Thank you and Best wishes,

**Feminism and Folklore 2024 International Team**

## Organising Feminism and Folklore

[[gyara masomin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Tattaunawar_user:Gwanki&action=edit&section=12 "Edit section's source code: Organising Feminism and Folklore")]

Latest comment: [shekaru 2 da suka gabata](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/User_talk:Abubakar_A_Gwanki#c-MediaWiki_message_delivery-20240229055600-Organising_Feminism_and_Folklore)1 comment 1 person in discussion


Hello Community Organizers,

Thank you for organising Feminism and Folklore writing competition on your wiki. We congratulate you in joining and celebrating our cultural heritage and promoting gender equality on Wikipedia.

To encourage boost for the contributions of the participants, we're offering prizes for Feminism and Folklore local prizes. Each Wikipedia will have three local winners:

*   First Prize: $15 USD
*   Second Prize: $10 USD
*   Best Jury Article: $5 USD

All this will be in **gift voucher format only**. Kindly inform your local community regarding these prizes and post them on the local project page

The Best Jury Article will be chosen by the jury based on how unique the article is aligned with the theme. The jury will review all submissions and decide the winner together, making sure it's fair. These articles will also be featured on our social media handles.

We're also providing internet and childcare support to the first 50 organizers and Jury members for who request for it. Remember, only 50 organizers will get this support, and it's given on a first-come, first-served basis. The registration form will close after 50 registrations, and the deadline is March 15, 2024. This support is optional and not compulsory, so if you're interested, fill out the form [here](https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSdnytyact-HR6DvsWwnrVeWuzMfuNH1dSjpF24m6od-f3LzZQ/viewform).

Each organizer/jury who gets support will receive $30 USD in gift voucher format, even if they're involved in more than one wiki. No dual support will be provided if you have signed up in more than one language. This support is meant to appreciate your volunteer support for the contest.

We also invite all organizers and jury members to join us for office hours on **Saturday, March 2, 2024**. This session will help you understand the jury process for both contests and give you a chance to ask questions. More details are on [meta page](https://meta.wikimedia.org/wiki/Wiki_Loves_Folklore_2024_Office_Hour_2).

Let's celebrate our different cultures and work towards gender equality on Wikipedia!

Best regards,

Rockpeterson

Hello! I'm Vermont, a [steward](https://meta.wikimedia.org/wiki/Stewards "m:Stewards"). Apologies for writing in English. I couldn't find whether the Hausa Wikipedia has an admin noticeboard, so I'm messaging you directly.

I spot-checked 5 articles, and none of their text was modified from the Google Translate'd version at all. Unmodified machine translations are generally not very good, and also has resulted in broken links and tables, examples: [Harshen Bilen](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Harshen_Bilen?action=edit&redlink=1 "Harshen Bilen (babu wannan shafin)") and [Harshen Lemerig](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Harshen_Lemerig "Harshen Lemerig").

The one source is a copyrighted website, and the article's content is machine-translated from that website. ## Next Steps and Feedback Request for Feminism and Folklore Organizers

[[gyara masomin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Tattaunawar_user:Gwanki&action=edit&section=15 "Edit section's source code: Next Steps and Feedback Request for Feminism and Folklore Organizers")]

Dear Organizer,

I hope this message finds you well.

First and foremost, I want to extend my gratitude to you for your efforts in organizing the **Feminism and Folklore** campaign on your local Wikipedia. Your contribution has been instrumental in bridging the gender and folk gap on Wikipedia, and we truly appreciate your dedication to this important cause.

As the campaign draws to a close, I wanted to inform you about the next steps. It's time to commence the jury process using the CampWiz or Fountain tool where your campaign was hosted. Please ensure that you update the details of the jury, campaign links and the names of organizers accurately on the [sign-up page](https://meta.wikimedia.org/wiki/Feminism%20and%20Folklore%202024/Project%20Page "m:Feminism and Folklore 2024/Project Page").

Once the jury process is completed, kindly update the [results page](https://meta.wikimedia.org/wiki/Feminism%20and%20Folklore%202024/Results "m:Feminism and Folklore 2024/Results") accordingly. The deadline for jury submission of results is **April 30, 2024**. However, if you find that the number of articles is high and you require more time, please don't hesitate to inform us via email or on our Meta Wiki talk page. We are more than willing to approve an extension if needed.

Should you encounter any issues with the tools, please feel free to reach out to us on Telegram for assistance. Your feedback and progress updates are crucial for us to improve the campaign and better understand your community's insights.

Therefore, I kindly ask you to spare just 10 minutes to share your progress and achievements with us through a Google Form survey. Your input will greatly assist us in making the campaign more meaningful and impactful.

Here's the link to the survey: [Survey Google Form Link](https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfCkFONXlPVlakMmdh-BWtZp0orYBCSVvViJPbsjf2TIXAWvw/viewform?usp=sf_link)

Thank you once again for your hard work and dedication to the Feminism and Folklore campaign. Your efforts are deeply appreciated, and we look forward to hearing from you soon.

Warm regards,

**Feminism and Folklore International Team #WeTogether**

## [Workshop] Identifying Win-Win Relationships with Partners for Wikimedia

[[gyara masomin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Tattaunawar_user:Gwanki&action=edit&section=30 "Edit section's source code: [Workshop] Identifying Win-Win Relationships with Partners for Wikimedia")]

Dear Recipient,

 We are excited to invite you to the third workshop in our Advocacy series, part of the Feminism and Folklore International Campaign. This highly anticipated workshop, titled **"Identifying Win-Win Relationships with Partners for Wikimedia,"** will be led by the esteemed Alex Stinson, Lead Program Strategist at the Wikimedia Foundation. Wiki Loves Folklore 2025 is a photographic competition aimed at highlighting folk culture worldwide. The annual international photography competition is held on Wikimedia Commons between the 1st of February and the 31st of March. This campaign invites photographers and enthusiasts of folk culture globally to showcase their local traditions, festivals, cultural practices, and other folk events by uploading photographs to Wikimedia Commons.

As we celebrate the seventh anniversary of Wiki Loves Folklore, the international team is thrilled to invite Wikimedia affiliates, user groups, and organizations worldwide to host a local edition in their respective countries. This is an opportunity to bring more visibility to the folk culture of your region and contribute valuable content to the internet.

*   Please find the project page for this year’s edition at:

The Wiki Loves Folklore International Team

Dear Gwanki,

I’m reaching out with some exciting updates about **[Feminism and Folklore 2026](https://meta.wikimedia.org/wiki/Feminism%20and%20Folklore%202026 "m:Feminism and Folklore 2026")**. Thanks to the amazing support from organizers like you, the campaign has grown into one of the biggest and most collaborative initiatives in the entire Wikimedia movement. Your efforts have played a huge part in that, and we’re truly grateful. We’re hoping to make the 2026 edition even larger and even more community-driven.

We’d be very happy to have you join again as an organizer. The sign-up process is simple this year:

1.   Create your local event page (you can copy from the [sample](https://meta.wikimedia.org/wiki/Feminism_and_Folklore/Sample "m:Feminism and Folklore/Sample"))
2.   Set up your Fountain or [CampWiz](https://tools.wikilovesfolklore.org/campwiz/) campaign.

The focus of the campaign remains the same - creating or expanding Wikipedia content on feminism, women’s issues, gender topics, and diverse folk traditions from around the world. International and local prizes will continue as before.

**Special Prize for 2026:**

Every participant will receive a Wikipedia 25 digital postcard as a token of appreciation for contributing to the global movement during Wikipedia’s 25th anniversary year. This will be sent to all contributors who take part in the campaign.

Invitation to Organize Feminism and Folklore 2026
Dear Wikimedian,

We thank you for taking an initiative to organize the **[Feminism and Folklore 2026](https://meta.wikimedia.org/wiki/Feminism%20and%20Folklore%202026 "m:Feminism and Folklore 2026")** writing competition on your local Wikipedia.

The international campaign will run from **1 February to 31 March 2026** and aims to improve coverage of feminism, women’s histories, gender-related topics, and folk culture across Wikipedia projects.

About the Campaign
**Feminism and Folklore** is a global writing initiative that complements the **[Wiki Loves Folklore](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/Commons:Wiki%20Loves%20Folklore%202026 "c:Commons:Wiki Loves Folklore 2026")** photography competition. While Wiki Loves Folklore focuses on visual documentation, this writing campaign addresses the **gender gap on Wikipedia** by improving encyclopedic content related to folk culture and marginalized voices.

What Can Participants Write About?
Communities can contribute by creating, expanding, or translating articles related to:

*   Folk festivals, rituals, and celebrations
*   Folk dances, music, and traditional performances
*   Women and queer figures in folklore
*   Women in mythology and oral traditions
*   Women warriors, witches, and witch-hunting narratives
*   Fairy tales, folk stories, and legends
*   Folk games, sports, and cultural practices

Participants may work from curated article lists or generate new article suggestions using campaign tools.

Checklist for Organizers
Organizers are requested to complete the following steps to register their community:

1.   Create a local project page on your wiki [(see sample)](https://meta.wikimedia.org/wiki/Feminism%20and%20Folklore/Sample "m:Feminism and Folklore/Sample")
2.   Set up the campaign using the **CampWiz** tool
3.   Prepare a local article list and clearly mention: 
    *   Campaign timeline
    *   Local and international prizes

4.   Request a site notice from local administrators [(see sample)](https://mr.wikipedia.org/wiki/Template:SN-FNF "mr:Template:SN-FNF")
5.   Add your local project page and CampWiz link to the **[Meta project page](https://meta.wikimedia.org/wiki/Feminism%20and%20Folklore%202026/Project%20Page "m:Feminism and Folklore 2026/Project Page")**

Campaign Tools
The Wiki Loves Folklore Tech Team has introduced tools to support organizers and participants:

*   **Article List Generator by Topic** – Helps identify articles available on English Wikipedia but missing in your local language Wikipedia. The tool allows customized filters and provides downloadable article lists in CSV and wikitable formats.
*   **CampWiz** – Enables communities to manage writing campaigns effectively, including jury-based evaluation. This will be the third year CampWiz is officially used for Feminism and Folklore.

Both tools are now available for use in the campaign. **[Click here to access the tools](https://tools.wikilovesfolklore.org/)**

Learn More & Get Support
For detailed information about rules, timelines, and prizes, please visit the **[Feminism and Folklore 2026 project page](https://meta.wikimedia.org/wiki/Feminism%20and%20Folklore%202026 "m:Feminism and Folklore 2026")**.

If you have any questions or need assistance, feel free to reach out via:

*   **[Meta talk page](https://meta.wikimedia.org/wiki/Talk:Feminism%20and%20Folklore%202026/Project%20Page "m:Talk:Feminism and Folklore 2026/Project Page")**
*   Email us using details on the contact page.

Join Us in upcoming office hours
We look forward to your presence in the upcoming office hours where the community and the international Team can interact with each other and know more about the contest. resister yourself for the [office hours event](https://meta.wikimedia.org/wiki/Event:Wiki%20Loves%20Folklore%202026%20Office%20Hours "m:Event:Wiki Loves Folklore 2026 Office Hours").

Thank you and all the best,

**[Feminism and Folklore 2026 International Team](https://meta.wikimedia.org/wiki/Feminism%20and%20Folklore%202026 "m:Feminism and Folklore 2026")**

Greetings,

The [Universal Code of Conduct Coordinating Committee (U4C)](https://meta.wikimedia.org/wiki/Special:MyLanguage/Universal_Code_of_Conduct/Coordinating_Committee "m:Special:MyLanguage/Universal Code of Conduct/Coordinating Committee") seeks candidates for the 2026 election. The U4C is the global committee responsible for overseeing enforcement of the [Universal Code of Conduct](https://foundation.wikimedia.org/wiki/Special:MyLanguage/Policy:Universal%20Code%20of%20Conduct "foundation:Special:MyLanguage/Policy:Universal Code of Conduct"). Elections are held annually, if elected a committee member serves for two years.

This year the U4C requires candidates to hold administrator rights on at least one wiki, which is why you are being contacted as you appear to hold this right. There are other requirements, such as candidates must be at least 18 years old and may not be employed by the Wikimedia Foundation or other related chapters and affiliates. You can find more information in the [call for candidates on Meta-wiki](https://meta.wikimedia.org/wiki/Special:MyLanguage/Universal_Code_of_Conduct/Coordinating_Committee/Election/2026#Call_for_Candidates "m:Special:MyLanguage/Universal Code of Conduct/Coordinating Committee/Election/2026"). Additionally, the committee's working language is English; some ability to communicate in English is required.

The election opens on 18 May, if you are eligible and interested you have until 10 May to submit your candidacy. There will week between for candidates to answer questions from the community. Voting takes place privately in [SecurePoll](https://meta.wikimedia.org/wiki/Special:MyLanguage/SecurePoll "m:Special:MyLanguage/SecurePoll"), successful candidates must receive at least 60% support. More information is available on [the 2026 Elections page](https://meta.wikimedia.org/wiki/Special:MyLanguage/Universal_Code_of_Conduct/Coordinating_Committee/Election/2026 "m:Special:MyLanguage/Universal Code of Conduct/Coordinating Committee/Election/2026"), including timelines and other candidacy information. If you read over the material and consider yourself qualified, please consider submitting your name to run for the committee. If you think someone else in your community might be interested and qualified, please encourage them to run.

 In partnership with the U4C -- [Keegan (WMF)](https://meta.wikimedia.org/wiki/User:Keegan%20(WMF) "m:User:Keegan (WMF)") ([talk](https://meta.wikimedia.org/wiki/User_talk:Keegan%20(WMF) "m:User talk:Keegan (WMF)")) [18:33, 28 ga Afirilu, 2026 (UTC)](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tattaunawar_user:Gwanki#c-Keegan_(WMF)-20260428183300-You_may_be_an_eligible_candidate_for_the_U4C_election "watanni da suka gabata 3")[Reply](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/User_talk:Abubakar_A_Gwanki)[](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/User_talk:Abubakar_A_Gwanki)

Your dedication, coordination, and hard work played a vital role in making this year's [Feminism and Folklore](https://meta.wikimedia.org/wiki/Feminism%20and%20Folklore%202026 "m:Feminism and Folklore 2026") campaign successful. We truly appreciate the time and effort you invested in engaging your community and supporting participants.

As we have completed the jury phase and begin planning for next year's campaign, we would like to learn from your experiences. Please complete the organisers' feedback form and share your insights, challenges, and suggestions on how we can improve the campaign.

**This feedback form is mandatory for all organisers**, as it helps us evaluate the campaign and make meaningful improvements for future editions.

**Form link [here](https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSf6IsGAsxkTEWTwueyLg-gBjRVlY3g2kTNj3xRhDiILiQnQwQ/viewform?usp=dialog)**

Please submit your response by **25 June 2026**.

Thank you once again for your invaluable contributions and for helping make Feminism and Folklore a global success. We look forward to working with you again in the future!

Regards,

**Feminism and Folklore Team**

title: Musulunci
text:
# Musulunci

 Wata yarinya a Karanta Alqur'ani Mai girma



dakin Allah (S WA)


gurin ibadan musulmai

[[1]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Musulunci#cite_note-:0-1)**Addinin Musulunci** (Islama;[[2]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Musulunci#cite_note-2)[Larabci](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Larabci "Larabci"): ٱلْإِسْلَام‎, romanized:_al-Islām_, Turanci: Islam) Shi ne shaidawa babu abun bautawa da gaskiya sai [Allah](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Allah "Allah"), kuma [Annabi Muhammad](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Annabi_Muhammad "Annabi Muhammad") (S A W) bawan Allah ne kuma manzon Allah ne.[[3]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Musulunci#cite_note-3)[[4]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Musulunci#cite_note-4)[[5]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Musulunci#cite_note-5)[[6]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Musulunci#cite_note-6)[[7]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Musulunci#cite_note-7)[[8]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Musulunci#cite_note-:1-8)

Addinin yana da alaƙa da [Annabi Ibrahim](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Annabi_Ibrahim "Annabi Ibrahim") kuma ya ƙunshi hukunce-hukunce daga [Alqur'ani](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Alqur'ani_mai_girma "Alqur'ani mai girma") da kuma koyarwar Manzon tsira Annabi Muhammad (s a w) wanda shine ya zo da littafin sannan akwai aƙalla mabiya addinin [musulunci](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Musulunci) mutum biliyan ɗaya da ɗugo tara (1.9B). Addinin musulunci shine addini na biyu dangane da yawan mabiya bayan addinin [Kirista](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kirista "Kirista").[[9]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Musulunci#cite_note-www.pewresearch.org-2022-9)[[10]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Musulunci#cite_note-10)[[11]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Musulunci#cite_note-11)

[Annabi Muhammad](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Annabi_Muhammad "Annabi Muhammad") (S AW) tsira da amincin Allah su tabbata a gareshi,[[12]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Musulunci#cite_note-12) shine manzo wanda [Allah](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Allah "Allah") ya aiko shi zuwa ga mutane baki ɗaya kuma na ƙarshen/cikamakin annabawa a Duniya domin ya sake jaddada addinin Allah, a yi imani da Allah wanda ya halicci kowa da komai.

Addinin musulunci na da mabiya a duk faɗin ƙasashen Duniya kuma mafiya yawa su na zaune ne a yankin gabas ta tsakiya, da yankin Afirka ta arewa waɗanda mafi yawancinsu Larabawa ne masu bin addinin musulunci, sai dai akwai ɗinbin mabiya addinin musulunci a ko'ina a faɗin duniya.[[13]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Musulunci#cite_note-13) Ma'anar addinin Musulunci shine yarda da miƙa wuya da kaɗaita [Allah](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Allah "Allah") Maɗaukakin Sarki, wato shaidawa babu abin bautawa da gaskiya sai Allah kuma Annabi Muhammad (s.a.w) Manzon Allah ne.[[14]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Musulunci#cite_note-14)[[15]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Musulunci#cite_note-15)[[16]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Musulunci#cite_note-16)[[17]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Musulunci#cite_note-17)[[18]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Musulunci#cite_note-18)

Musulmai sun yi imani cewa addinin Musulunci shine cikakken addini kuma addini na gaskiya wanda aka turo [Annabawa da manzanni](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Annabi "Annabi") da yawa a baya, wanda suka haɗa da kakanmu [Annabi Adamu](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Adamu_a_Musulunci "Adamu a Musulunci"), Annabi Nuhu, [Annabi Ibrahim](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Annabi_Ibrahim "Annabi Ibrahim"), [Annabi Musa](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Annabi_Musa "Annabi Musa") da kuma [Annabi Isah](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Annabi_Isah "Annabi Isah").[[19]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Musulunci#cite_note-19)[[20]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Musulunci#cite_note-20)[[21]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Musulunci#cite_note-21)[[22]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Musulunci#cite_note-22)

Har wa yau, Musulmai sun yi imani cewa Alqur'ani maganar Allah ne, kuma saƙon Ubangiji ne na ƙarshe wanda babu tawaya a cikin shi. Tare da Alqur'ani, Musulmai sunyi imani da sauran littattafan da aka turo kamar [Attaura](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Attaura_a_Musulunci "Attaura a Musulunci"), Zabura da Injila. Kuma Annabi [Muhammad (SAW)](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Muhammad "Muhammad") shine cikamakin Annabawan Musulunci, kuma ta shine addinin Musulunci ya cika. Koyarwarsa da umurninsa ana ƙiran su da [Sunnah](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sunnah "Sunnah") wanda aka rubuta a littattafai da ake ƙira [Hadisi](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hadisi "Hadisi"), wanda ke koyar da tsarin mulki da rayuwa.

ANNABAWA

An yi imani da cewa Allah Ta’ala ne ya zaɓi [annabawa](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Annabawa "Annabawa") (Larabci: أنبياء, anbiyāʾ) domin su yi wa’azin saƙon Allah. Wasu daga cikin waɗannan annabawan kuma suna zuwa da sabon littafi, kuma ana kiran su “manzanni” (رسول, rasūl). Musulmai sun gaskata cewa annabawa mutane ne, ba alloli ba. An ce dukkan annabawan sun yi wa’azin saƙon Musulunci guda ɗaya – wato miƙa wuya ga nufin Allah – ga al’ummomi dabam-dabam a zamanin da suka gabata, kuma wannan shi ne dalilin da ake cewa ya haifar da kamanceceniya da yawa tsakanin addinai. [Alqur’ani](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Alqur'ani_mai_girma "Alqur'ani mai girma") ya ambaci sunayen mutane da yawa waɗanda ake ɗauka a matsayin annabawa a Musulunci, ciki har da Adamu, Nuhu, Ibrahim, Musa, Dawuda da Isa, alaihimus salam, da sauransu. Labaran da suka shafi annabawan da suka wuce abin da Alqur’ani ya ambata an tattara su kuma an yi nazari a kansu a cikin [Qisas al-Anbiya](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Qisas_al-Anbiya "en:Qisas al-Anbiya") (Labarun Annabawa).[[1]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Musulunci#cite_note-:0-1)[[23]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Musulunci#cite_note-23)

Musulmai sun yi imani cewa Allah Ya aiko Muhammadu (Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) a matsayin annabi na ƙarshe (“Hatimin Annabawa”) domin ya isar da cikakken saƙon Musulunci. A Musulunci, misalin rayuwar Muhammadu (S.A.W.) wanda ya zama abin koyi shi ake kira [sunnah](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sunnah "Sunnah") (a zahiri “hanyar da aka bi”). Ana ƙarfafa Musulmai su yi koyi da ɗabi’un Muhammadu (S.A.W.) a rayuwarsu ta yau da kullum, kuma ana ganin sunnah tana da muhimmanci wajen jagorantar fassarar Alqur’ani. Wannan misali an kiyaye shi a cikin hadisai da ake kira hadisi, waɗanda suka ƙunshi ruwayoyin maganganunsa, ayyukansa, da halayensa. Hadisi Qudsi wani nau’i ne na hadisi, wanda ake ɗauka a matsayin kalmomin Allah na zahiri da Muhammadu (S.A.W.) ya ruwaito, waɗanda ba sa cikin Alƙur’ani. Hadisi yana ƙunshe da abubuwa biyu: sarkar masu ruwaya, da ake kira sanad, da kuma ainihin lafazin, da ake kira matn. Akwai hanyoyi dabam-dabam na rarraba ingancin hadisai, inda ma’aunin da aka fi amfani da shi ya kasance: “sahihi” ko “ingantacce” (صحيح, ṣaḥīḥ); “hasan” ko “mai kyau” (حسن, ḥasan); ko “ɗa’if” ko “mai rauni” (ضعيف, ḍaʻīf), [[24]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Musulunci#cite_note-24)da sauransu. [Kutub al-Sittah](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kutub_al-Sittah "Kutub al-Sittah") tarin littattafai ne guda shida, waɗanda ake ɗauka a matsayin mafiya ingantattun ruwayoyi a Musuluncin Ahlus-Sunnah. Daga cikinsu akwai [Sahih al-Bukhari](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sahi_al-Bukhari "Sahi al-Bukhari"), wanda galibi Ahlus-Sunnah suke ɗaukarsa a matsayin ɗaya daga cikin mafiya ingantattun madogara bayan Alƙur’ani. Wani sanannen tushen hadisai kuma shi ne Littattafai Huɗu [(Al-Kutub al-Arba’ah](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Four_Books "en:The Four Books")), waɗanda ‘yan Shi’a suke ɗauka a matsayin mafiya ingantaccen tushen hadisi.[[8]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Musulunci#cite_note-:1-8)[[25]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Musulunci#cite_note-25)

# Brussels


_Wannan Muƙalar **guntuwa** ce: tana buƙatar a inganta ta, kuna iya [gyara ta](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Brussels&action=edit)._

**Brussels** ce babban Birnin Kasar Belgium. [[1]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Brussels#cite_note-1) Brussels tana da mutane mafi girma ta kasar Belgium da kuma kasar European Union. An gina birnin kasar Belgium a shekarar 979 na karshen 10 na daren farko, kuma Brussels ta kasar Belgium ta daban-daban, da kuma kwamfuta-tsakiya.


Brussels,shiene babban birnin ƙasar Belgium, tana da binciken da aka kashe mutanen da suka gabata a ƙasar Belgium. Brussels ta taka rawar daidai kuma ita ce karamin tashar Belgium. An sami wani zabe a Brussels a shekarar 1957, da kuma European Union, wanda ke kasashen duniya biyu. [[2]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Brussels#cite_note-2)

title: Esther Odekunle
text:
# Esther Odekunle

Esther A. Odekunle Listen ⓘ ƙwararriyar masaniyar cututtukan jijiyoyi ce ta ƙasar Birtaniya kuma Injiniyan rigakafin cututtuka . Tana aiki a matsayin injiniyan rigakafi ga kamfanin harhada magunguna na GlaxoSmithKline (GSK), inda bincikenta ya mayar da hankali kan gano da kuma kawar da haɗarin jiki da sinadarai daga ƙwayoyin rigakafi na magani don inganta rayuwarsu a matsayin magunguna. Tana kuma haɓaka ganin ƙwararru daban-daban a fannin STEM . [1] [1]

## Rayuwar farko da ilimi

[[gyara sashe](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Esther_Odekunle&veaction=edit&section=1 "Gyara sashe: Rayuwar farko da ilimi") | [gyara masomin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Esther_Odekunle&action=edit&section=1 "Edit section's source code: Rayuwar farko da ilimi")]

An haifi Odekunle a matsayin ƙarami a cikin 'yan uwanta kuma iyayenta ' [yan Najeriya](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/%C6%8Aan_Nijeriya "Ɗan Nijeriya") ne suka yi ƙaura zuwa [Burtaniya](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Birtaniya "Birtaniya") suka rene ta a [Burtaniya](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Birtaniya "Birtaniya") . [[1]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Esther_Odekunle#cite_note-Stride-1) Malamanta sun yi mata wahayi daga littattafan da suka shafi dabbobi da jikin ɗan adam, waɗanda suka ƙarfafa mata sha'awar kimiyya tun tana ƙarama. Bayan da ta fara tunanin yin aiki a fannin likitanci, ta sami digiri na farko a fannin [biochemistry](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Biochemistry "Biochemistry") da kuma digiri na uku a fannin ilimin jijiyoyi daga Jami'ar Queen Mary ta Landan . [[2]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Esther_Odekunle#cite_note-VSA-2)[[1]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Esther_Odekunle#cite_note-Stride-1)[[3]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Esther_Odekunle#cite_note-Independent-3) Aikin digirin digirgir nata a Queen Mary ya mayar da hankali kan tsarin neuropeptide a cikin kifin starfish [[4]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Esther_Odekunle#cite_note-UNC-4), wanda ya ƙare a cikin takardar digirin digirgir ta 2018. Ganowa da Halayen Siginar Vasopressin/Oxytocin a cikin Echinoderm da Xenacoelomorph [[5]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Esther_Odekunle#cite_note-ThesisRecord-5) . Ta zaɓi yin aiki a kan kifin starfish saboda ƙwarewar da ba a fahimta ba kamar sake farfaɗowa [[1]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Esther_Odekunle#cite_note-Stride-1) . Bayan ta yi aiki da beraye da beraye a matsayin dalibar jami'a, ta sami kwarin gwiwa daga gaskiyar cewa kifin starfish ba ya cizo. [[6]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Esther_Odekunle#cite_note-Sidenote-6) Ta ɗauki hutun shekara guda tsakanin shirye-shiryen digiri kuma ta sami cikakken kuɗi don aikinta na digiri na uku daga Society for Experimental Biology . [[1]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Esther_Odekunle#cite_note-Stride-1)

## Sana'a

[[gyara sashe](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Esther_Odekunle&veaction=edit&section=2 "Gyara sashe: Sana'a") | [gyara masomin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Esther_Odekunle&action=edit&section=2 "Edit section's source code: Sana'a")]

Manufar Odekunle a fannin ilimi ba wai ta ci gaba da zama farfesa a can ba ne, a'a, ta "bincika wani fanni na kimiyya mai zurfi da kuma ba da gudummawa ga fannin kimiyya" sannan daga ƙarshe ta yi amfani da ƙwarewarta ta kimiyya a fannin warkewa. [[7]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Esther_Odekunle#cite_note-Mentor-7) , ta lura cewa sha'awarta ta ta'allaka ne a kan binciken hulɗar masu karɓa da ligand a matakin amino acid don haɓaka gano magunguna [[8]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Esther_Odekunle#cite_note-8) . A matsayinta na injiniyar rigakafi a GSK, tana aiki don ƙirƙirar ƙwayoyin rigakafi daga ƙwayoyin B [[9]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Esther_Odekunle#cite_note-Pawdcast-9) da kuma inganta su a matsayin hanyoyin magance takamaiman cututtuka kamar su ciwon daji, kamuwa da cuta ta hanyar ƙwayoyin cuta, da cututtukan ƙwayoyin cuta . Saboda ƙuntatawa da aka sanya wa abin da masana kimiyya a matsayinta a masana'antar harhada magunguna za su iya faɗa game da aikinsu, Odekunle dole ta samar da murya a cikin al'ummar kimiyya baya ga yin magana game da abubuwan da ke ɓoye sirri. Wannan ya sa ta yi magana game da wariyar launin fata a fannin ilimi da kimiyya, sannan ta taimaka wajen ƙarfafawa da kuma bayyana waɗanda ba su da wakilci sosai a fannin kimiyya. Tana yin hakan a shafukan sada zumunta daban-daban. [[1]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Esther_Odekunle#cite_note-Stride-1) An raba wasu daga cikin abubuwan da ta kunsa, kamar shirinta na Henrietta Lacks a tashar [YouTube](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/YouTube "YouTube") ga ɗalibai tun daga farko har zuwa matakin ilimi mai zurfi. [[6]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Esther_Odekunle#cite_note-Sidenote-6)**Page [Samfuri:Rquote/styles.css](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Samfuri:Rquote/styles.css&action=edit&redlink=1 "Samfuri:Rquote/styles.css (babu wannan shafin)") has no content.**

A shekarar 2021, an zaɓi Odekunle a matsayin wanda ya lashe gasar ƙarshe ta Rising Star a cikin rukunin STEM na kyaututtukan kasuwanci na [Black British Business Awards](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Melanie_Eusebe "Melanie Eusebe") . [[10]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Esther_Odekunle#cite_note-10)

text:
# Neja (kogi)


Kogin Neja a Kulikoro, Mali.


Harkar kasuwanci a garin Boubon na bakin kogin neja a [Jamhuriyar Nojar](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nijer "Nijer").


Wani masunci mai kamun kifi a Kogin Neja


Kogin Neja da gadar [Lokoja](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lokoja "Lokoja") a [Najeriya](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Najeriya "Najeriya").


kogin neja

**Kogin Neja** ,wasu kan kirashi da **Kogin Nijar** yana da tsawon kilomita 4,180. Zurfinsa arba'in kilomita 2,117,700,a kasa. Matsakaicin ,saurinsa 5,589 m3/s wanda ya bambanta daga saurin 500 m3/s zuwa 27,600 m3/s.[[1]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Neja_(kogi)#cite_note-1) Mafarinsa daga tsaunukan [Gine], a kudu maso gabashin [Gine](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gine "Gine"). Ƙananan rafufukanta su ne kamar ire irensu kogin [Bani](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bani?action=edit&redlink=1 "Bani (babu wannan shafin)"), kogin [Sokoto](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sokoto_(kogi) "Sokoto (kogi)"), kogin [Kaduna](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kaduna_(kogi) "Kaduna (kogi)") da na kogin [[Benue (kogi)|Benuwe] ya bi cikin [Mali](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mali "Mali"), [Nijar](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nijar_(kasar)?action=edit&redlink=1 "Nijar (kasar) (babu wannan shafin)") da [Najeriya](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Najeriya "Najeriya") zuwa, [Tekun Atalanta](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tekun_Atalanta "Tekun Atalanta") wanda ya bi [Neja Delta](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Neja_Delta "Neja Delta"). Waɗannan biranen na samuwa a gefen kogin Neja: [Tembakounda](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tembakounda?action=edit&redlink=1 "Tembakounda (babu wannan shafin)"), [Bamako](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bamako "Bamako"), [Timbuktu](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Timbuktu "Timbuktu"), [Niamey](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Niamey "Niamey").[[2]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Neja_(kogi)#cite_note-2)

## Tarihin suna

[[gyara sashe](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Neja_(kogi)&veaction=edit&section=1 "Gyara sashe: Tarihin suna") | [gyara masomin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Neja_(kogi)&action=edit&section=1 "Edit section's source code: Tarihin suna")]

Farkon amfani da sunan "Niger" ga kogin shine Leo Africanus[[3]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Neja_(kogi)#cite_note-3) a cikin Della ya kwatanta dell'Africa et delle cose notabili che ivi sono, wanda aka buga a Italiyanci a 1550. Ko wannan kogin daidai yake da na ainihin Nijar, ko kuma kogin da aka fi sani da Ger (wanda a yanzu ake kira Oued Guir, a kasar Maroko), lamari ne na tattaunawa.[[4]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Neja_(kogi)#cite_note-4) An ce wannan Nigris ya raba "Afrika daidai" daga ƙasar Habasha (Yamma) zuwa kudu, kuma sunansa (da na kogin Ger) zai iya fitowa daga kalmar Berber gr-n-grwn ma'ana "kogin koguna", a matsayin sunan Abzinawa na yanzu ga kogin Nijar.[[5]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Neja_(kogi)#cite_note-5) Kamar yadda Timbuktu ya kasance ƙarshen kudancin babban hanyar kasuwanci ta Trans-Sahara zuwa yammacin Bahar Rum, ita ce tushen yawancin ilimin Turai na yankin.

Taswirorin tsakiyar Turai sun yi amfani da sunan Nijar zuwa tsakiyar kogin, a kasar Mali ta zamani, amma Quorra (Kworra) zuwa kasa a Najeriya ta zamani, saboda ba a san wadannan a matsayin kogi daya ba.[[6]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Neja_(kogi)#cite_note-6) Lokacin da turawan mulkin mallaka suka fara aika jiragen ruwa zuwa gabar tekun yammacin Afirka a karni na 16 da 17, kogin Senegal yakan kasance bakin tekun Nijar. Yankin Neja-Delta, wanda ke kwarara cikin Tekun Atlantika ta cikin dazukan mangrove da kuma dubban wuraren rarrabawa sama da kilomita 160 (mita 100), ana kyautata zaton wuraren dausayi ne na bakin teku. Sai da ziyarce-ziyarcen dajin Mungo na karni na 18, wanda ya ratsa kogin Neja, ya ziyarci manyan daulolin Sahel na zamaninsa, Turawa sun gano yadda ake tafiyar da Nijer daidai kuma suka fadada sunan har tsawonsa.

Kasashe na zamani na Najeriya da Nijar sun dauki sunayensu daga kogin, wanda ke nuna adawa da ikirarin kasa da turawan mulkin mallaka suka yi na kogin "na sama", "ƙananan" da "tsakiyar" kogin Niger a lokacin Scramble for Africa a karshen karni na 19.

## Yanayi

[[gyara sashe](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Neja_(kogi)&veaction=edit&section=2 "Gyara sashe: Yanayi") | [gyara masomin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Neja_(kogi)&action=edit&section=2 "Edit section's source code: Yanayi")]

A wani yanki na yankin Sahel na yammacin Afirka, kogin Niger na da yanayi mai zafi mai tsananin zafi a duk shekara; dogon lokacin rani mai tsanani daga Oktoba zuwa Mayu; da ɗan gajeren lokacin damina ba bisa ka'ida ba wanda ke da alaƙa da damina ta yammacin Afirka.[[7]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Neja_(kogi)#cite_note-7)

## Geography

[[gyara sashe](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Neja_(kogi)&veaction=edit&section=3 "Gyara sashe: Geography") | [gyara masomin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Neja_(kogi)&action=edit&section=3 "Edit section's source code: Geography")]

Babban lankwasa kogin Neja, wanda ake gani daga sararin samaniya, yana haifar da koren baka ta cikin ruwan sahel da Savanna. Koren da ke gefen hagu shine Neja Delta na ciki, kuma a gefen hagu akwai magudanar ruwa na kogin Senegal.

Gidajen laka a tsakiyar tsibiri a tafkin Debo, wani yanki mai fadi na kogin Niger

Kogin Neja wani kogi ne mai tsafta, wanda ke dauke da kashi goma kawai kamar na Nilu saboda kogin Neja yana kwance a cikin tsaffin duwatsu wadanda ke samar da ciyayi kadan.[[8]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Neja_(kogi)#cite_note-8) Kamar kogin Nilu, Nijar na cika shekara; wannan yana farawa a watan Satumba, ya kai kololuwa a watan Nuwamba, kuma yana ƙarewa a watan Mayu.[[9]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Neja_(kogi)#cite_note-9) Wani abin da ba a saba gani ba a kogin shi ne yankin Neja Delta na ciki, wanda ke samuwa inda saurinsa ke raguwa kwatsam.[[10]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Neja_(kogi)#cite_note-10) Sakamakon haka shi ne yanki na koguna da aka yi wa ado, da marshes, da manyan tafkuna; Ambaliyar ruwan sama ta sa Delta ta yi amfani sosai wajen kamun kifi da noma.[[11]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Neja_(kogi)#cite_note-11)

Kogin ya yi hasarar kusan kashi biyu bisa uku na yuwuwar kwararowar sa a cikin Delta na cikin gida tsakanin Ségou da Timbuktu don ratsawa da ƙafewa. Ruwan kogin Bani, wanda ke kwararowa cikin Delta a Mopti, ba ya biyan asarar da aka yi. Matsakaicin hasarar da aka kiyasta shine 31 km3 / shekara amma ya bambanta sosai tsakanin shekaru.[[12]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Neja_(kogi)#cite_note-12) Sannan kogin yana hade da magudanan ruwa daban-daban amma kuma ya rasa karin ruwan da zai kwashe. An kiyasta yawan ruwan da ke shiga Najeriya ya kai kilomita 25 a kowace shekara kafin shekarun 1980 da kuma kilomita 13.5 a kowace shekara a shekarun 1980.

Babban magudanar ruwa shi ne kogin Benue wanda ya hade da Nijar a Lokoja a Najeriya. Jimillar adadin magudanan ruwa a Nijeriya ya ninka sau shida fiye da wanda ke shigowa Nijeriya, inda magudanar ruwa a kusa da bakin kogin ya kai kilomita 177.0 a kowace shekara kafin shekarun 1980 da 147.3 km3 a kowace shekara a shekarun 1980.[[13]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Neja_(kogi)#cite_note-13)

### Hakika

[[gyara sashe](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Neja_(kogi)&veaction=edit&section=4 "Gyara sashe: Hakika") | [gyara masomin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Neja_(kogi)&action=edit&section=4 "Edit section's source code: Hakika")]

Taswirar Nijar, tana nuna magudanar ruwa da "Delta na cikin gida"

Nijar na daukar daya daga cikin hanyoyin da ba a saba gani ba na kowane babban kogi, siffar boomerang da ta daure ma masana ilmin kasa mamaki tsawon karni biyu. Tushensa (Tembakounda) yana da nisan kilomita 240 (150 mi) daga ciki daga Tekun Atlantika, amma kogin yana gudu kai tsaye daga teku zuwa cikin hamadar Sahara, sannan ya bi ta hannun dama kusa da tsohon birnin Timbuktu kuma ya nufi kudu maso gabas zuwa gabar tekun Guinea. Wannan bakon labarin kasa ya samo asali ne saboda kogin Neja tsohon koguna biyu ne da suka hade waje guda. Ƙasar Nijar daga maɓuɓɓugar yamma da Timbuktu zuwa lanƙwasa a cikin kogin na yanzu kusa da Timbuktu, ya taɓa zubar da ruwa zuwa wani busasshiyar tafki a arewa maso gabas da Timbuktu, yayin da ta ƙasan Nijar ta fara zuwa kudancin Timbuktu kuma ta bi ta kudu zuwa mashigin tekun Guinea. Tsawon lokaci da zaizayar kasa daga cikin kasa na Nijar ya haifar da kame yankin na sama da Nijer ta kasa.[[14]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Neja_(kogi)#cite_note-14)

Yankin arewacin kogin da aka fi sani da nijar lankwasa, yanki ne mai muhimmanci domin shi ne babban kogi kuma tushen ruwa a wannan yanki na sahara. Wannan ya sanya ta zama cibiyar kasuwanci a yammacin Sahara da kuma tsakiyar daular Sahel ta Mali da Gao. Yankin Kogin Niger da ke kewaye da shi yana daya daga cikin sassa daban-daban na ilimin halittar jiki na lardin Sudan, wanda kuma wani bangare ne na babban bangaren ilimin halittar jiki na Afirka

## History

[[gyara sashe](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Neja_(kogi)&veaction=edit&section=6 "Gyara sashe: History") | [gyara masomin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Neja_(kogi)&action=edit&section=6 "Edit section's source code: History")]

A karshen lokacin danshi na Afirka kimanin shekaru 5,500 kafin yanzu, hamadar Sahara ta zamani, wacce ta taba zama savanna, ta fuskanci kwararowar hamada.[[15]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Neja_(kogi)#cite_note-15) Yayin da nau'in shuka ke raguwa sosai,[[16]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Neja_(kogi)#cite_note-16) mutane sun yi ƙaura zuwa yankin lanƙwasa mai albarka kogin Neja, tare da albarkatu masu yawa da suka haɗa da tsire-tsire na kiwo da kifi.[[17]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Neja_(kogi)#cite_note-17) Kamar a cikin Crescent mai albarka, yawancin amfanin gonakin abinci ana noman su a yankin kogin Neja, da suka haɗa da dawa, shinkafar Afirka (Oryza glaberrima), da gero lu'u-lu'u.[[18]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Neja_(kogi)#cite_note-18) Ƙila ƙazamar Sahara ta iya jawo, ko aƙalla ta ƙara haɓaka, waɗannan gidaje. Noma, da kuma kamun kifi da kiwo, sun haifar da haɓakar ƙauyuka irin su Djenné-Djenno a cikin Delta Inner, wanda yanzu ya zama Gidan Tarihi na Duniya.[[19]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Neja_(kogi)#cite_note-19)

Yankin Nijar na lankwasa, a yankin Sahel, ya kasance mahimmiyar asali da kuma manufa ta kasuwanci tsakanin sahara, wanda ya haifar da arzikin manyan dauloli irin su Ghana, Mali, da daular Songhai. Manyan tashar jiragen ruwa na kasuwanci a gefen kogin, ciki har da Timbuktu da Gao, sun zama cibiyoyin koyo da al'adu. Har ila yau ciniki a yankin lankwasa na Nijar ya kawo addinin Musulunci a yankin a kusan karni na 14 miladiyya. Galibin yankin arewacin Nijar ya kasance musulmi a yau, duk da cewa kudancin kogin ya zama Kirista.

Rubuce-rubucen gargajiya game da ciki na Sahara sun fara da Ptolemy, wanda ya ambaci koguna biyu a cikin hamada: “Gir” (Γειρ)[[20]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Neja_(kogi)#cite_note-20)[[21]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Neja_(kogi)#cite_note-21) da kuma nisa zuwa kudu, “Nigir” (Νιγειρ)[[22]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Neja_(kogi)#cite_note-22)[[23]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Neja_(kogi)#cite_note-23). Na farko tun lokacin da aka gano shi da Wadi Ghir a arewa maso yammacin gefen Tuat, tare da iyakokin Maroko da Aljeriya na zamani.[[24]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Neja_(kogi)#cite_note-24)[[25]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Neja_(kogi)#cite_note-25) Wataƙila wannan ya kasance kamar yadda Ptolemy zai kasance yana da daidaitattun bayanai. Wataƙila Ni-Ger ya kasance hasashe, kodayake sunan ya makale kamar na kogin kudu da “sanannen duniya” na Bahar Rum. Suetonius ya ba da rahoton cewa Romawa suna tafiya zuwa "Ger", ko da yake a cikin rahoton duk wani sunan kogin da aka samo daga harshen Berber, wanda "gher" yana nufin "marar ruwa", rudani na iya tasowa cikin sauƙi.[[26]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Neja_(kogi)#cite_note-26) Pliny ya haɗu da waɗannan koguna guda biyu a matsayin ruwa mai tsayi guda ɗaya wanda ke gudana (ta tafkuna da sassan ƙasa) zuwa cikin kogin Nilu,[[27]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Neja_(kogi)#cite_note-27) ra'ayi wanda ya ci gaba a cikin duniyar Larabawa da Turai - kuma ya kara da cewa kogin Senegal a matsayin "Ger" - har zuwa karni na 19.

Yayin da ake kyautata zaton al'ummar kasar sun san hakikanin tafarkin Nijar, hakan ya kasance wani sirri ga kasashen waje har zuwa karshen karni na 18. An danganta alaka da kogin Nilu ba don kawai a lokacin ake kiran wannan babban kogin “Aethiopia” (wanda duk wasu kasashen da ke kudu da hamada ke kiransa da shi ta hanyar marubutan gargajiya), amma saboda kogin Nilu kamar Nijar yana ambaliya duk lokacin rani.[[28]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Neja_(kogi)#cite_note-28) Ta hanyar kwatancin Leo Africanus da ma Ibn Battuta - duk da ziyarar da ya yi a kogin - tatsuniyar da ta danganta Nijar da kogin Nilu ta ci gaba.

Yawancin balaguron da Turawa suka yi don shirya kogin bai yi nasara ba.[[29]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Neja_(kogi)#cite_note-29) A shekara ta 1788 aka kafa kungiyar Afirka a Ingila don inganta binciken Afirka da fatan gano Nijar, kuma a watan Yuni 1796 mai binciken Mungo Park na Scotland shi ne Bature na farko da ya sa ido kan tsakiyar kogin tun zamanin da (kuma watakila har abada). Ya rubuta asusu a cikin 1799, Travels in the Interior of Africa.[[30]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Neja_(kogi)#cite_note-30) Park ta ba da shawarar cewa Nijar da Kongo kogi ɗaya ne. Duk da cewa yankin Neja-Delta zai zama tamkar dan takara ne a fili, sai ga shi wani magudanar ruwa da fadama da ba su yi kama da kan babban kogi ba. Ya rasu a shekara ta 1806 a wani balaguro na biyu yana ƙoƙarin tabbatar da haɗin gwiwa tsakanin Nijar da Kongo.[[31]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Neja_(kogi)#cite_note-31) Ka'idar ta zama jagora a Turai.[48] An yi balaguro da yawa da suka gaza; duk da haka sirrin Nijar ba zai sake warwarewa ba har tsawon shekaru 25, a shekara ta 1830, lokacin da Richard Lander da dan uwansa suka zama Turawa na farko da suka bi tafarkin Nijar zuwa teku.[[32]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Neja_(kogi)#cite_note-32)

A cikin 1946, Faransawa uku Jean Sauvy, Pierre Ponty da mai shirya fina-finai Jean Rouch, tsoffin ma'aikatan gwamnati a yankin Faransanci na Afirka, sun shirya tafiya gabaɗayan kogin, kamar yadda babu wanda ya yi a baya. Sun yi tafiya daga farkon kogin kusa da Kissidougou a Guinea, suna tafiya da farko har a yi amfani da rafi, sannan suka canza zuwa sana'o'in gida daban-daban yayin da kogin ya fadada kuma ya canza. Biyu daga cikinsu sun isa teku a ranar 25 ga Maris, 1947, tare da Ponty ya bar balaguro a Yamai, da ɗan wuce rabin lokaci. Sun ɗauki kyamarar fim ɗin mm 16, sakamakon sakamakon fim ɗin ya ba wa Rouch tatsuniyoyi na farko na kabilanci guda biyu: "Au Pays des mages noirs", da "La chasse à l'hippopotame". An yi amfani da kyamara don kwatanta littafin Rouch na gaba "Le Niger En Pirogue" (Fernand Nathan, 1954), da kuma "Descente du Niger" na Sauvy (L'Harmattan, 2001). An kuma kawo na’urar buga rubutu, wanda Ponty ya fitar da labaran jaridu da yake aikawa a duk lokacin da zai yiwu.[[33]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Neja_(kogi)#cite_note-33)

## Hanyoyin ciniki da mahimmancin muhalli

[[gyara sashe](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Neja_(kogi)&veaction=edit&section=7 "Gyara sashe: Hanyoyin ciniki da mahimmancin muhalli") | [gyara masomin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Neja_(kogi)&action=edit&section=7 "Edit section's source code: Hanyoyin ciniki da mahimmancin muhalli")]

### Jijiyoyin kasuwanci

[[gyara sashe](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Neja_(kogi)&veaction=edit&section=8 "Gyara sashe: Jijiyoyin kasuwanci") | [gyara masomin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Neja_(kogi)&action=edit&section=8 "Edit section's source code: Jijiyoyin kasuwanci")]

Kogin Neja a tarihi ya kasance daya daga cikin manyan magudanan ruwa a yammacin Afirka, wanda ya zama babbar hanyar sufuri, sadarwa da kasuwanci. Kogin ya shimfiɗa sama da kilomita 4,180 (mil 2,600), kogin ya haɗu da yankuna daban-daban na muhalli waɗanda suka fito daga tsaunukan Guinea zuwa Sahel da Tekun Atlantika. Sassansa na kewayawa sun ba da damar zirga-zirgar mutane da kayayyaki ta nisa mai nisa tun kafin haɓaka hanyoyin zamani da layin dogo.Reader, John (1998).[[34]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Neja_(kogi)#cite_note-34)

Al'ummomin da ke gefen kogin sun haɓaka hanyoyin sadarwar kasuwanci masu yawa waɗanda suka haɗa yankunan noma na cikin ƙasa tare da cibiyoyin kasuwanci da kasuwannin bakin teku. Kwalekwale da sauran jiragen ruwa na jigilar kayan amfanin gona, kifi, dabbobi, tukwane, masaku, da kayayyakin da aka kera a tsakanin matsugunai. Harkokin sufurin kogi ya kasance mafi inganci fiye da tafiye-tafiye na kan ƙasa, musamman a lokacin damina lokacin da hanyoyi suka yi wuyar tafiya. Encyclopedia Britannica. "Kogin Niger."

### Gudunmawa a cikin hanyar sadarwar cinikayya ta sahara

[[gyara sashe](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Neja_(kogi)&veaction=edit&section=9 "Gyara sashe: Gudunmawa a cikin hanyar sadarwar cinikayya ta sahara") | [gyara masomin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Neja_(kogi)&action=edit&section=9 "Edit section's source code: Gudunmawa a cikin hanyar sadarwar cinikayya ta sahara")]

Kogin Neja yana da nasaba sosai da hanyoyin kasuwanci da ke ƙetare sahara da suka haɗa Afirka ta Yamma da Arewacin Afirka da duniyar Bahar Rum. Tun daga farkon karni na farko AZ, 'yan kasuwa sun yi amfani da kogin don jigilar kayayyaki zuwa kuma daga garuruwan ayari da ke gefen kudancin hamadar Sahara.[[35]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Neja_(kogi)#cite_note-35)

Zinariya daga yankunan dazuzzukan Afirka ta Yamma, ana jigilar su ta cikin Basin Neja zuwa cibiyoyin kasuwanci inda ake yin musayar gishiri, masaku, tagulla, dawakai da kayan alatu da aka kawo ta hamadar Sahara. Haka kuma kogin ya saukaka zirga-zirgar goro, giwaye, fata, hatsi, da bayi a lokuta daban-daban na tarihi.[[36]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Neja_(kogi)#cite_note-36)

Haɗin kai tsakanin zirga-zirgar kogi da hanyoyin ayarin hamada ya canza birane da yawa zuwa manyan cibiyoyin kasuwanci da ilimi. 'Yan kasuwa, malamai, mahajjata da shugabannin siyasa sun yi amfani da waɗannan hanyoyin don musayar ba kawai kaya ba har ma da ra'ayoyi, imani na addini da ayyukan al'adu.

### Ci gaban daulolin yammacin Afirka ta Tsakiya

[[gyara sashe](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Neja_(kogi)&veaction=edit&section=10 "Gyara sashe: Ci gaban daulolin yammacin Afirka ta Tsakiya") | [gyara masomin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Neja_(kogi)&action=edit&section=10 "Edit section's source code: Ci gaban daulolin yammacin Afirka ta Tsakiya")]

Kogin Neja ya taka muhimmiyar rawa wajen bullowa da wadatar wasu daga cikin manyan kasashen Afirka da suka yi tasiri kafin mulkin mallaka. Masarautar Ghana ta sami fa'ida a kaikaice daga hanyoyin kasuwanci da ke da alaƙa da kogin, yayin da daulolin Mali da Songhai ke gudanar da iko kai tsaye a kan wasu yankuna na kwarin Nijar.[[37]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Neja_(kogi)#cite_note-37)

A karkashin daular Mali, cinikin koguna ya ba da gudummawa ga ci gaban tattalin arziki tare da tallafawa manyan cibiyoyin birane kamar Timbuktu da Djenné. Shahararren mai mulki Mansa Musa ya yi amfani da kudaden shiga da ake samu ta hanyar kasuwanci wajen karfafa masarautu da tallafawa ilimin addinin Musulunci.

Daga baya Masarautar Songhai ta fadada ikonta a kan mafi yawan layin kogin Neja. Babban birninta, Gao, ya zama babbar cibiyar siyasa da kasuwanci, yayin da sufurin kogi ke sauƙaƙe sarrafa gudanarwa da motsin soja a duk faɗin daular.

### Manyan cibiyoyin ciniki

[[gyara sashe](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Neja_(kogi)&veaction=edit&section=11 "Gyara sashe: Manyan cibiyoyin ciniki") | [gyara masomin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Neja_(kogi)&action=edit&section=11 "Edit section's source code: Manyan cibiyoyin ciniki")]

Garuruwa da dama dake gefen kogin Neja sun zama fitattun cibiyoyin kasuwanci da al'adu.[[38]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Neja_(kogi)#cite_note-38)[[39]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Neja_(kogi)#cite_note-39)

### Timbuktu

[[gyara sashe](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Neja_(kogi)&veaction=edit&section=12 "Gyara sashe: Timbuktu") | [gyara masomin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Neja_(kogi)&action=edit&section=12 "Edit section's source code: Timbuktu")]

Da yake kusa da arewacin kogin Neja, Timbuktu ya zama babbar cibiyar kasuwanci da ilimi. ‘Yan kasuwa daga sassa na Afirka da na wajen sun taru a wurin don yin musayar kaya, yayin da malamai suka ba da gudummawa wajen ganin birnin ya zama cibiyar koyar da ilimin addinin Musulunci.

### Djenné

[[gyara sashe](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Neja_(kogi)&veaction=edit&section=13 "Gyara sashe: Djenné") | [gyara masomin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Neja_(kogi)&action=edit&section=13 "Edit section's source code: Djenné")]

Djenné ya fito a matsayin garin kasuwa mai albarka da ke kusa da yankin Neja Delta. Wurin da yake da mahimmanci ya ba 'yan kasuwa damar haɗa kasuwancin kogi tare da hanyoyin ayari na kan tudu. Birnin ya yi suna wajen kasuwancin zinari, gishiri, shinkafa, da sauran kayayyaki.

### Gao

[[gyara sashe](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Neja_(kogi)&veaction=edit&section=14 "Gyara sashe: Gao") | [gyara masomin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Neja_(kogi)&action=edit&section=14 "Edit section's source code: Gao")]

Gao ya kasance muhimmiyar cibiyar siyasa da tattalin arziki a lokacin Songhai. Wurin da birnin yake a kogin Neja ya sa ya zama muhimmin wurin musayar kasuwanci da gudanar da harkokin yanki.

### Muhimmancin muhalli

[[gyara sashe](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Neja_(kogi)&veaction=edit&section=15 "Gyara sashe: Muhimmancin muhalli") | [gyara masomin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Neja_(kogi)&action=edit&section=15 "Edit section's source code: Muhimmancin muhalli")]

Kogin Neja na daya daga cikin muhimman tsare-tsaren muhalli na Afirka. Basinsa ya kai kusan murabba'in kilomita miliyan 2.1 kuma yana tallafawa fiye da mutane miliyan 130 a cikin ƙasashe da yawa.

Kogin yana samar da ruwa don amfanin gida, ban ruwa, masana'antu, kamun kifi, sufuri, da samar da makamashi. Miliyoyin mutane sun dogara kai tsaye kan albarkatunta don rayuwarsu, wanda hakan ya sanya ta zama daya daga cikin tsarin kogin da ke da muhimmanci a fannin tattalin arziki da muhalli a nahiyar.

### Neja Delta na cikin gida

[[gyara sashe](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Neja_(kogi)&veaction=edit&section=16 "Gyara sashe: Neja Delta na cikin gida") | [gyara masomin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Neja_(kogi)&action=edit&section=16 "Edit section's source code: Neja Delta na cikin gida")]

Ɗaya daga cikin abubuwan da suka fi dacewa da yanayin kogin shine yankin Neja Delta na ciki a Mali. Yana rufe har zuwa murabba'in kilomita 30,000 a lokacin kololuwar lokuttan ambaliyar ruwa, yankin delta ya ƙunshi ciyayi mai dausayi, filayen ambaliya, tafkuna, da tashoshi waɗanda ke tallafawa keɓaɓɓen bambancin halittu.[[40]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Neja_(kogi)#cite_note-40)

Ambaliyar ruwa ta kowace shekara tana cika ƙasa da kayan abinci mai gina jiki, tana ci gaba da noman shinkafa, kuma tana haifar da matsuguni ga nau'ikan kifi da yawa. Yankin delta kuma yana tallafawa ɗimbin yawan tsuntsaye masu ƙaura da ke tafiya tsakanin Turai da Afirka.[[41]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Neja_(kogi)#cite_note-41)

### Kamun kifi da wadatar abinci

[[gyara sashe](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Neja_(kogi)&veaction=edit&section=17 "Gyara sashe: Kamun kifi da wadatar abinci") | [gyara masomin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Neja_(kogi)&action=edit&section=17 "Edit section's source code: Kamun kifi da wadatar abinci")]

Kogin Neja na tallafa wa daya daga cikin masana'antun kamun kifi na cikin gida da ke da amfani a Afirka. Dubban al'ummomin kamun kifi sun dogara da kogin don samun aikin yi da abinci. Ana girbe nau'o'in nau'o'in nau'in kifi kamar kifi, tilapia, perch Nile, da damisa a ko'ina cikin rafin.[[42]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Neja_(kogi)#cite_note-42)

Kifi daga Nijar ya zama muhimmin tushen furotin ga mazauna yankin kuma yana ba da gudummawa sosai ga samar da abinci a yankin. Ana ci gaba da aiwatar da hanyoyin kamun kifi na gargajiya da aka ƙera tsawon ƙarni tare da dabarun zamani.

### Dabbobin halittu da namun daji

[[gyara sashe](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Neja_(kogi)&veaction=edit&section=18 "Gyara sashe: Dabbobin halittu da namun daji") | [gyara masomin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Neja_(kogi)&action=edit&section=18 "Edit section's source code: Dabbobin halittu da namun daji")]

Kogin Neja ya ƙunshi wurare daban-daban da suka haɗa da ciyayi mai dausayi, savannas, dazuzzuka, filayen ambaliya, da muhallin mangrove. Waɗannan wuraren zama suna tallafawa ɗaruruwan nau'in kifaye, dabbobi masu rarrafe, amphibians, tsuntsaye, da dabbobi masu shayarwa.[[43]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Neja_(kogi)#cite_note-43)

Yankin Neja-Delta a Najeriya ya ƙunshi daya daga cikin mafi girma a cikin yanayin yanayin mangrove a Afirka kuma yana ba da mahimman wuraren kiwo don kifaye da halittun ruwa. Yawancin nau'in tsuntsaye masu ƙaura suna dogara ne akan wuraren dausayin kogin a lokacin ƙaura na yanayi.[[44]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Neja_(kogi)#cite_note-44)

### Kalubalen muhalli

[[gyara sashe](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Neja_(kogi)&veaction=edit&section=19 "Gyara sashe: Kalubalen muhalli") | [gyara masomin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Neja_(kogi)&action=edit&section=19 "Edit section's source code: Kalubalen muhalli")]

Duk da mahimmancin muhalli da tattalin arziki, kogin Neja na fuskantar matsi na muhalli. Haɓaka yawan jama'a, ƙauyuka, ayyukan masana'antu, gina madatsun ruwa, gurɓataccen ruwa, sare dazuzzuka, da sauyin yanayi sun canza yanayin kwararar yanayi kuma sun shafi ingancin ruwa.

Sassan yanayi ya taimaka wajen lokacin fari da rage ambaliya a wasu yankuna, yana barazana ga aikin noma, kamun kifi, da kuma yanayin damina. Bugu da kari, gurbacewar mai da gurbacewar muhalli a yankin Neja-Delta ya yi illa ga nau’ukan halittu da kuma rayuwar jama’a.[[45]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Neja_(kogi)#cite_note-45)

### Karewa da haɗin gwiwar yanki

[[gyara sashe](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Neja_(kogi)&veaction=edit&section=20 "Gyara sashe: Karewa da haɗin gwiwar yanki") | [gyara masomin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Neja_(kogi)&action=edit&section=20 "Edit section's source code: Karewa da haɗin gwiwar yanki")]

Kasashen yankin Neja sun ba da hadin kai ta hannun hukumar kula da rafin Neja (NBA), wata kungiya ce mai zaman kanta da aka kafa domin bunkasa sarrafa albarkatun kogin. Hukumar tana daidaita ayyukan da suka shafi kula da ruwa, kare muhalli, haɓaka wutar lantarki, da haɗin gwiwar tattalin arzikin yanki.[[46]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Neja_(kogi)#cite_note-46)

Shirye-shiryen kiyayewa sun fi mayar da hankali kan kare ciyayi mai dausayi, maido da gurbatattun halittu, inganta ingancin ruwa, da tabbatar da dorewar amfani da kamun kifi da albarkatun noma. Wadannan yunƙurin suna da mahimmanci don kiyaye mutuncin muhalli da darajar tattalin arzikin kogin Neja ga al'ummomi masu zuwa.[[47]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Neja_(kogi)#cite_note-47)

## Gudanarwa da haɓakawa

[[gyara sashe](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Neja_(kogi)&veaction=edit&section=21 "Gyara sashe: Gudanarwa da haɓakawa") | [gyara masomin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Neja_(kogi)&action=edit&section=21 "Edit section's source code: Gudanarwa da haɓakawa")]

Ruwan da ke cikin kogin Neja ana sarrafa shi ta hanyar madatsun ruwa. A Mali ana amfani da madatsar ruwa ta Sélingué da ke kogin Sankarani don samar da wutar lantarki amma kuma tana ba da izinin ban ruwa. Ana amfani da madatsun ruwa na karkatar da madatsun ruwa guda biyu, daya a Sotuba kusa da Bamako, daya kuma a Markala, kusa da magudanar Ségou, ana amfani da shi wajen ban ruwa kimanin hekta 54,000.[[48]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Neja_(kogi)#cite_note-48) A Najeriya ana amfani da Dam din Kainji, Dam Shiroro, Dam Zungeru, da Jebba Dam don samar da wutar lantarki.

Matsalolin ruwan kogin Neja na fuskantar matsin lamba saboda karuwar tauye ruwa don ban ruwa. Ana ci gaba da aikin gina madatsun ruwa na samar da wutar lantarki ta hanyar samar da wutar lantarki da za a yi amfani da su domin magance matsalar karancin wutar lantarki da ake fama da shi a kasashen da ke gabar ruwan Niger.[[49]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Neja_(kogi)#cite_note-49) Hukumar ta FAO ta yi kiyasin yawan noman noman da dukkanin kasashen da ke cikin kogin Nijar za su iya noma a hekta miliyan 2.8. Kadada 0.93m (ha) ne kawai ke ƙarƙashin ban ruwa a ƙarshen 1980s. An kiyasta yawan amfanin noman da ya kai mita 1.68 a Najeriya 0.56m ha a kasar Mali, kuma yankin da ake noman noman shi ne 0.67m ha da 0.19m ha.[[50]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Neja_(kogi)#cite_note-50)

text:
# Tarayyar Amurka




Expo 2010 United States of America pavilion

**Tarayyar Amurka:** (da Turanci _United States of America_) ko **Amurka** ko **Amurika** ko **Amerika** ko _**Haɗin kan Jahohin Amurka**_ jamhoriya ce da ta haɗa jihohi guda hamsin (50), da faɗin ƙasa da manya, [manyan](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Manyan_Biranen_Japan_da_Yawan_Jama'a_Cikin_Shekaru_Goma "Manyan Biranen Japan da Yawan Jama'a Cikin Shekaru Goma") ƙasashe [masu](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Masu?action=edit&redlink=1 "Masu (babu wannan shafin)") cin gashin kansu guda biyar. Akwai kuma wasu. yankunan marasa ƴanci guda 11, da kuma wasu ƙananan [tsibirai](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tsibirin_Kanariyas "Tsibirin Kanariyas") guda 9. [Amerika](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/American_driver "American driver") na da faɗin ƙasa da takai sukwaya mil miliyan 3.8 (wato kilo mita 9.8), da kuma adadin mutane [miliyan](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Miliyan?action=edit&redlink=1 "Miliyan (babu wannan shafin)") 325, ƙasar amurka itace ƙasa ta uku ko ta huɗu [wajen](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wajen?action=edit&redlink=1 "Wajen (babu wannan shafin)") yawan faɗin ƙasa kuma ta uku wajen yawan mutane. Birnin tarayyar ƙasar shine Washinton Gundumar [Kolombiya](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kolombiya "Kolombiya"), birni mafi yawan jama'a da girma kuma shine [New York](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/New_York "New York").[[1]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tarayyar_Amurka#cite_note-1)

Jihar [Alaska](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Alaska "Alaska") itace a gefen kwanar arewa maso yamma na arewacin [Amurka](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Amurka "Amurka"), iyaka da ƙasar [Kanada](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kanada "Kanada") daga gabas. Rushewar Tarayyar Soviets yayi sanadiyyar zaman Amurka ƙasa mafi ƙarfin iko a [duniya](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Duniya "Duniya") kuma Amurka itace ƙasar da ta gabatar da mulkin demokradiyya a ƙasashen [duniya](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Duniya "Duniya") da dama

Mutanen Paleo-Indian ne suka yi hijira daga ƙasar [Rasha](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rasha "Rasha") zuwa Arewacin Amurka aƙalla shekaru 15,000 da suka wuce. Mulkin mallakar turawan [Birtaniya](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Birtaniya "Birtaniya") ya fara ne daga ƙarni na 16. juyin juya halin Amurka ya fara ne a shekara ta 1776.

An kawo ƙarshen yaƙin ne a shekara ta 1783 bayan kafuwar Tarayyar Amurka. Amurka na amfani da Kundin tsarin mulki na shekara ta 1788, wanda aka sama suna _The bill of right_. Ƙasar Amurka itace ƙasa mafi ƙarfin iko a [Duniya](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Duniya "Duniya") tun bayan rushewar Taraiyar Soviets. Kuma itace ƙasar da ta gabatar da mulkin demokradiyya a wasu daga ƙasashen dake duniya.

ƙasar Amurka itace ta gabatar da [Majalisar Dinkin Duniya](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Majalisar_Dinkin_Duniya "Majalisar Dinkin Duniya"), [Bankin Duniya](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bankin_Duniya "Bankin Duniya"), da sauran manyan ƙungiyoyin duniya.Amurka itace ƙasa mafi ƙarfin tattalin arziƙin [duniya](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Duniya "Duniya") da [siyasa](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Siyasa "Siyasa") da kuma al'adu.
