# Benin


Shugaban kasar mai ci ahalin yanzu


manunin benin


wuri fetur a benin


tutar benin


ruwan kogi a benin


lokacin baya a benin


logo na benin


**Benin: Tana** daya daga cikin. Ƙasashen yammacin [Afrika](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Afrika "Afrika"), kuma ita ƙaramar ƙasa ce, da a ke cemata dukome , a shekara ta 1894 kasar [faransa](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Faransa "Faransa") ta mamaye ta har zuwa shekara ta 1960, sannan ta samu Yancin kanta. Benin ta yi iyaka da ƙasashe huɗu su ne; daga, gabacin ta [Nijeriya|Najeriya], daga yammacin ta [Togo], daga arewacin ta [Nijar](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nijar "Nijar"), daga [arewa](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Arewa "Arewa") maso yammaci ta [burkina faso,](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Burkina_faso "Burkina faso") Benin kasa ce me tsawo daga [kudanci](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kudanci "Kudanci") zuwa [arewaci](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Arewaci "Arewaci") 650km , kuma tsawanta daga gabance, zuwa yammace 110km, harshen [Faransanci](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Faransanci "Faransanci") shi ne yaren kasar, tana da yawan mutane kimanin 4,418,000 a shekara ta 1988, babban birnin ta [Cotonou](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cotonou "Cotonou") yawan mutanen ta sun kai 1050 , Benin tana da yaruka masu dinbun yawa ( fun, adja buriya [hausa](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hausa "Hausa") dande ) da sauran su.

# Duniya




duniya


**Duniya:**[[1]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Duniya#cite_note-1) (alama ce [![Image 35](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/0/0a/Earth_symbol_%28bold%29.svg/20px-Earth_symbol_%28bold%29.svg.png?utm_source=ha.wikipedia.org&utm_campaign=parser&utm_content=thumbnail)](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fayil:Earth_symbol_(bold).svg "🜨") da [![Image 36: ♁](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/4/49/Globus_cruciger_%28bold%29.svg/20px-Globus_cruciger_%28bold%29.svg.png?utm_source=ha.wikipedia.org&utm_campaign=parser&utm_content=thumbnail)](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fayil:Globus_cruciger_(bold).svg "♁")) halitta ce daga cikin dumbun [duniyoyin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Duniyoyi "Duniyoyi") dake cikin sararin samaniya, ainihi samaniya.[[2]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Duniya#cite_note-2)[[3]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Duniya#cite_note-3)

Hakika wannan duniya da muke ciki yar karama ce idan aka misaltata da duniyar, Mushtari duniyar da muke ciki itace ta uku tsakaninta da [Rana](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rana "Rana") daga cikin abinda ake kira da turanci; [Tsarin hasken rana](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tsarin_hasken_rana "Tsarin hasken rana"). Kuma ita kadai ce a yanzu da aka samu halitta mai rai a cikinta.[[4]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Duniya#cite_note-4)[[5]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Duniya#cite_note-5)[[6]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Duniya#cite_note-6)

Ita kadaice koramu da [Teku](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Teku "Teku") ke gudu a doronta amma sauran [duniyoyin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Duniyoyi "Duniyoyi") ko [Iska](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Iska "Iska") babu a cikinsu, balle har akai ga samun abu mai rai. Wani ikon sai Ubangiji da ya iya yin amfani da misali a duniyar nan da halittun subuhana ke rayuwa a cikinta.[[7]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Duniya#cite_note-7)[[8]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Duniya#cite_note-8)[[9]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Duniya#cite_note-9)[[10]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Duniya#cite_note-10)



Hoton duniyar Earth kenan da na'urar Satellite, ta dauka ranar 16 ga watan Disamba, 2021

# Wikipedia a harshen Hausa

_Wannan Muƙalar **guntuwa** ce: tana buƙatar a inganta ta, kuna iya [gyara ta](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Wikipedia\_a\_harshen\_Hausa&action=edit)._

## Gabatarwa

[[gyara sashe](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Wikipedia_a_harshen_Hausa&veaction=edit&section=1 "Gyara sashe: Gabatarwa") | [gyara masomin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Wikipedia_a_harshen_Hausa&action=edit&section=1 "Edit section's source code: Gabatarwa")]

Takaitaccen bayanin abubuwan da muƙalar ta ƙunsa. Ki yi bayani a kalmomi kaɗan (layi 3–5).

## Tarihi

[[gyara sashe](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Wikipedia_a_harshen_Hausa&veaction=edit&section=2 "Gyara sashe: Tarihi") | [gyara masomin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Wikipedia_a_harshen_Hausa&action=edit&section=2 "Edit section's source code: Tarihi")]

Ki bayyana tarihin asalin abu, shekarun da suka shafe, mahimman abubuwan da suka faru, da dalilan kafa shi.

## Sassa da Ayyuka

[[gyara sashe](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Wikipedia_a_harshen_Hausa&veaction=edit&section=3 "Gyara sashe: Sassa da Ayyuka") | [gyara masomin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Wikipedia_a_harshen_Hausa&action=edit&section=3 "Edit section's source code: Sassa da Ayyuka")]

(idan makaranta ce, hankali ce, gwamnati ce da sauransu) - Sashen koyo - Tsarukan koyarwa - Ayyukan dalibai ko ma’aikata - Gine-gine da kayayyakin more rayuwa

## Yawan Jama'a (Demography)

[[gyara sashe](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Wikipedia_a_harshen_Hausa&veaction=edit&section=4 "Gyara sashe: Yawan Jama'a (Demography)") | [gyara masomin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Wikipedia_a_harshen_Hausa&action=edit&section=4 "Edit section's source code: Yawan Jama'a (Demography)")]

(idan wurin ne, gari ko jiha) - Jimillar yawan jama'a - Yankunan da suke ciki - Rarrabuwar jinsi - Rarrabuwar shekaru

## Tattalin Arziki

[[gyara sashe](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Wikipedia_a_harshen_Hausa&veaction=edit&section=5 "Gyara sashe: Tattalin Arziki") | [gyara masomin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Wikipedia_a_harshen_Hausa&action=edit&section=5 "Edit section's source code: Tattalin Arziki")]

(idan yana da nasaba) - Manyan hanyoyin samun kudaden shiga - Kasuwanci - Noma ko masana’antu

## Muhalli

[[gyara sashe](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Wikipedia_a_harshen_Hausa&veaction=edit&section=6 "Gyara sashe: Muhalli") | [gyara masomin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Wikipedia_a_harshen_Hausa&action=edit&section=6 "Edit section's source code: Muhalli")]

(idan akwai) - Yanayin zafi - Yanayin ƙasa - Matsalolin muhalli (misali: gurbacewar iska)

## Fitattun Mutane

[[gyara sashe](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Wikipedia_a_harshen_Hausa&veaction=edit&section=7 "Gyara sashe: Fitattun Mutane") | [gyara masomin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Wikipedia_a_harshen_Hausa&action=edit&section=7 "Edit section's source code: Fitattun Mutane")]

(idan ya dace) Jerawa wasu mutane da suka fito daga wannan wuri ko makaranta.

## Manazarta

[[gyara sashe](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Wikipedia_a_harshen_Hausa&veaction=edit&section=8 "Gyara sashe: Manazarta") | [gyara masomin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Wikipedia_a_harshen_Hausa&action=edit&section=8 "Edit section's source code: Manazarta")]

*   Rubuta muhimman tushe da ki ka dogara da su.
*   Ki tabbatar an rubuta su daidai yadda Wikipedia ke so.
